text.title: 丛林搅局者
text.objectives: 击败法瑞拉的三名竞技场勇士。
text.description:
让那些猫人看看，这里是谁说了算。去干掉他们所有的勇士，你就能获得丛林里所有生物的尊重了。

你需要用这些图腾把他们引出来。

english.title: Rumble in the Jungle
english.objectives: Defeat the three arena champions of Fangri'la.
english.description:
Dem fancy cat-men gotta be shown who is da boss 'round dese parts. Kill all their champions, and ya will earn da respect of all creatures in da jungle.

Y'gonna need dese totems to draw dem out.

text.title: 寻求知识
text.objectives: 在阿苏纳的海岸线寻找古代圣物。
text.description: 你在外面游历的时候，有没有在阿苏纳周围注意到任何遗失的圣物？我收到消息说那里有一些宝物。这些传言很值得调查啊！

english.title: The Search for Knowledge
english.objectives: Look for ancient relics  on the shoreline of Azsuna.
english.description: While you were out gallivanting, did you notice any lost relics around Azsuna? My sources tell me there are treasures to be found. These rumors merit investigation!

text.title: 泽斯高的血腥刀刃
text.objectives: 从泽斯高的血环氏族兽人身上收集$oa柄血环仪祭之刃。
text.description: 血环氏族的鲜血仪式臭名昭著。那些野蛮人在自己身上刻下符咒，用最强壮的战士的鲜血制造药剂。$b$b他们使用的锯齿状仪祭之刃本身就有着强大的力量。为我收集一些那种利刃。我们会将其中的力量剥离出来，同时也可以更好地了解我们的敌人。

english.title: Bloodied Blades of Zeth'Gol
english.objectives: Collect $oa Bleeding Hollow Ritual Blades from Bleeding Hollow orcs in Zeth'Gol.
english.description: The Bleeding Hollow clan is infamous for their blood rituals. The brutes carve sigils into their flesh and create potions from the blood of their strongest warriors.$b$bThe curved ceremonial blades they use have a power all their own. Gather some of these for me. We will deprive them of these weapons and learn something about our enemy at the same time.

text.title: 水上作业
text.objectives: 在铁城港的士兵身上收集$oa张钢铁部落海军机要。
text.description: 钢铁部落的残部正通过铁城港向塔纳安丛林逃窜。如果我们能够多了解一些有关他们舰队的信息，就可以从影月谷要塞的船坞向他们发动反击了。$b$b也许你可以为我们收集一些海军情报？

english.title: A Little Wetwork
english.objectives: Collect $oa Iron Horde Naval Manifests from forces in Ironhold Harbor.
english.description: The shattered remnants of the Iron Horde pour into Tanaan through Ironhold Harbor. If we knew more about their fleet we could dispatch countermeasures from your shipyard in Shadowmoon.$b$bPerhaps you could gather some naval intelligence for our cause?

text.title: 打破邪能枷锁
text.objectives: 在塔纳安丛林的邪兽人身上收集$oa个魔血之瓶。
text.description: 古尔丹的邪能毒药将那些原本就凶猛的兽人变成了没有灵魂、只有憎恨的邪恶生物。但如果先知维伦在这里指导我们的话，他绝不会放弃整个种族。如果你能够找到他们的血液，也许我们还有机会逆转这一过程？$b$b整个塔纳安都有邪兽人， 但钢铁前线、邪能熔炉和基尔加丹王座是邪兽人最密集的地方。

english.title: Breaking Their Fel Bonds
english.objectives: Collect $oa Vials of Fel Blood from fel orcs throughout Tanaan Jungle.
english.description: Gul'dan's fel poison turns already ferocious orcs into hateful, vicious creatures with no soul. But were he here to guide us, Prophet Velen wouldn't give up on the whole race. If you could find samples of their blood, maybe we can reverse the process?$b$bYou'll find fel orcs all over Tanaan, but the Iron Front, the Fel Forge, and the Throne of Kil'jaeden are the most densely populated.

text.title: 暗影议会的秘密
text.objectives: 从卡纳克废墟或基尔加丹王座的暗影议会代表身上搜集$oa封暗影议会密函。
text.description: 古尔丹正在发展自己的间谍网络——也就是所谓的“暗影议会”。然而在竭力控制塔纳安的同时，暗影议会也不免有些疏忽大意了。他们中的成员开始公开抛头露面，在卡纳克废墟招募鸦人，或者在基尔加丹王座召唤恶魔。$b$b找到暗影议会的成员，如果那些蠢货有什么情报忘记了摧毁，就给我带回来！

english.title: Secrets of the Shadow Council
english.objectives: Collect $oa Shadow Council Missives from Shadow Council representatives in the Ruins of Kra'nak or the Throne of Kil'jaeden.
english.description: Gul'dan has been building a spy network for himself - the so-called "Shadow Council". As they struggle to control Tanaan, the Shadow Council has grown careless. Their members are out in the open, recruiting arakkoa at the Ruins of Kra'nak or summoning demons at the Throne of Kil'jaeden.$b$bFind members of the Shadow Council and acquire any intelligence they were foolish enough not to destroy!

text.title: 解除沙纳尔的武装
text.objectives: 从塔纳安丛林的沙纳尔神殿后面的矿井中收集$oa块德拉诺水晶原石。
text.description: 为了得到完美的水晶来驱动我们的奥术装置，沙纳尔神殿的德莱尼人会挖穿整座山脉去寻找。不幸的是，我们已经失去了神殿的控制权——那些萨格雷背叛了我们。$b$b$n，你必须进入那些矿井，夺回那些水晶，不要让萨格雷将它们用于恶魔仪式，就算必须杀死我们曾经的兄弟姐妹，也不要手软。

english.title: Disarming Sha'naar
english.objectives: Collect $oa Unrefined Draenic Crystals from the mines located within the Temple of Sha'naar in Tanaan Jungle.
english.description: Draenei at the Temple of Sha'naar would mine these mountains for perfect crystals to power our arcane devices. Sadly, the temple is lost to us - we have been betrayed by the Sargerei.$b$b$n, it is imperative that you venture into those mines and secure those crystals before the Sargerei use them in their demonic rituals. If you must kill our former brothers and sisters, so be it.

text.title: 穆兹的冒险
text.objectives: 带穆兹到白水溪找塞拉·智水。
text.description: <穆兹正在往下流漂去，你必须把他带回他的母亲身边。>
text.completion: Moozy! Thank the spirits you are okay! Oh thank you for returning him to me. Thank you!

english.title: Moozy's Adventure
english.objectives: Bring Moozy to Sella Waterwise at Whitewater Wash.
english.description: <Moozy is floating down the river and must be reunited with his mother.>
english.completion: Moozy! Thank the spirits you are okay! Oh thank you for returning him to me. Thank you!

text.title: 掌控它们的力量
text.objectives: 在塔纳安丛林的钢铁前线击败一只钢铁战争戈隆，并收集战争戈隆挽具。
text.description: 大主教玛拉达尔一直认为德拉诺的原始生物是无法驯服的。然而，钢铁部落还是想出了办法，把戈隆变成了他们的武器。如果能够知道他们是如何做到的，我们就可以在战场上占得优势。$b$b到钢铁前线去，杀死一头战争戈隆，将它的挽具带回来。你可能会需要帮助。

english.title: Harnessing Their Power
english.objectives: Collect a Wargronn Harness from an Iron Wargronn at the Iron Front in Tanaan Jungle.
english.description: We have always believed that the primal creatures of Draenor could not be tamed. And yet, the Iron Horde found a way to weaponize the gronn. It would be to our advantage to learn how.$b$bVenture to the Iron Front, slay a Wargronn, and retrieve its harness. You may want to find help.

text.title: 加强攻势
text.objectives: 在塔纳安丛林完成2项区域奖励目标。
text.description: 古尔丹的仆从逃跑了，指挥官！如果你还有力气的话，现在是向其他要塞发动攻击的最好机会。

english.title: Pressing the Attack
english.objectives: Complete 2 bonus objective areas within Tanaan Jungle.
english.description: Gul'dan's minions are on the run, commander! If you have the strength, now would be an opportune time to press forward and assault some of his other strongholds.

text.title: 胡恩之路
text.objectives: 跟随灵魂行者黑角踏上胡恩之路的旅程。
text.description: 兵力可以决定战争的成败，而“象征”的作用也至关重要。$b$b对我们族人而言，没有什么象征比来自祖先的祝福更得民心。$b$b梅拉必须走完胡恩之路。$b$B这条道路十分危险，而她只能带两个人同行：一位可以给她指引的灵魂行者，以及一位可以保护她的勇士。$b$b你愿意成为这位勇士吗？
text.completion: Quite a drop. Mind yourself in here, this is not a safe place.

english.title: The Path of Huln
english.objectives: Follow Spiritwalker Ebonhorn on the Path of Huln.
english.description: Armies are vital to the success of a war. But so are symbols.$b$bFor our people, few things make for a better symbol than the blessings of our most eldest ancestors.$b$bMayla must walk the Path of Huln.$b$BThe path is dangerous, and she may only bring two people with her: a spiritwalker to guide her and a champion to protect her.$b$bWill you be the champion?
english.completion: Quite a drop. Mind yourself in here, this is not a safe place.

objectiveDetails.description: 护送灵魂行者黑角踏上胡恩之路的旅程

text.title: 古老的秘密
text.objectives: 在奈萨里奥的宝库协助灵魂行者黑角。
text.description: 在梅拉继任大酋长之前，她还需要见证一个幻象。我希望你也可以一起看看。$b$b这是一个由高岭家族世代相传的古老秘密。请你千万不要泄露出去。
text.completion: That day, the hammer freed me of the corruption of the Black Dragonflight.$b$bIn gratitude, I have faithfully served the Highmountain family since Huln rescued me from this pit.$b$bIt has been my honor and my pleasure to watch each of his descendants earn the title of High Chieftain.

english.title: An Ancient Secret
english.objectives: Assist Spiritwalker Ebonhorn in Neltharion's Vault.
english.description: Before Mayla may be pronounced High Chieftain, there is one more vision she must see. I wish to show you as well.$b$bIt is an ancient secret, handed down along the Highmountain bloodline. I ask for your discretion in keeping it that way.
english.completion: That day, the hammer freed me of the corruption of the Black Dragonflight.$b$bIn gratitude, I have faithfully served the Highmountain family since Huln rescued me from this pit.$b$bIt has been my honor and my pleasure to watch each of his descendants earn the title of High Chieftain.

text.title: 泰坦对决
text.objectives: 找到并帮助胡恩·高岭的灵魂。
text.description: 胡恩取得卡兹格罗斯之锤的事迹并不是传说的尾声。$b$b不过，后面的部分就需要深入这个洞穴才能知晓。里面还有最后一个火盆。$b$b来吧，我们看看后面的故事。
text.completion: And so Huln cast out Deathwing into the land of Deepholm and claimed the Hammer of Khaz'goroth as his charge.$b$bBut there was one last bit of business for him to attend to...

english.title: Titanic Showdown
english.objectives: Find and aid the spirit of Huln Highmountain.
english.description: The tale of Huln did not end with him acquiring the Hammer of Khaz'goroth.$b$bNo. For that part, we must venture deeper into this cavern. A final brazier awaits us ahead.$b$bCome, let us see what happened next.
english.completion: And so Huln cast out Deathwing into the land of Deepholm and claimed the Hammer of Khaz'goroth as his charge.$b$bBut there was one last bit of business for him to attend to...

text.title: 后门
text.objectives: 逃出宝库。
text.description: 梅拉需要一些时间调整心态。$b$b也就是说，我们应该回到雷霆图腾。$b$b我们可以从南边的通道穿过古老的卓格巴尔奴隶营地，到达后面的开阔地带。$b$b那里有一座用于监视宝库的天角岗哨，它的作用是确保任何人的进出都逃不过我们的眼睛。那里的人可以帮助我们飞回去。
text.completion: I always thought it odd that Ebonhorn never seemed to age. Or at least, he always looked old, but he never got older.
text.completed: 在黑曜石瞭望台与梅拉·高岭谈一谈。

english.title: The Backdoor
english.objectives: Escape the Vault.
english.description: This will take Mayla some time to adjust to.$b$bThat being said, we should return to Thunder Totem.$b$bJust south of here is a tunnel that should take us through the old drogbar slave enclave and then to an opening beyond.$b$bWe keep a small Skyhorn outpost there to watch and ensure nothing enters or leaves this vault without us knowing about it. They should be able to fly us back.
english.completion: I always thought it odd that Ebonhorn never seemed to age. Or at least, he always looked old, but he never got older.
english.completed: Meet Mayla Highmountain at Obsidian Overlook.

text.title: 大酋长
text.objectives: 在雷霆图腾与梅拉·高岭谈一谈。
text.description: 我现在明白黑角一直想要告诉我什么了。$b$b族人需要的不是圣锤，而是一位领袖。一个即便心有畏惧也愿意挺身面对任何威胁的榜样。$b$b我只告诉你，我当然怕得要命，但是我的内心无比坚定。$b$b让我们一起回到雷霆图腾，准备面对战争。
text.completion: Even without the hammer, I know what to do next. When our forces are rallied, we can take the fight to the Underking.
text.completed: 在雷霆图腾与梅拉·高岭谈一谈。

english.title: The High Chieftain
english.objectives: Speak with Mayla Highmountain at Thunder Totem.
english.description: I understand what Ebonhorn has been trying to tell me for a while now.$b$bOur people do not need a hammer, we need a leader. One willing to stand against any threat, even if they are terrified to do so.$b$bAnd between you and me, I am definitely terrified, but resolved.$b$bLet us return to Thunder Totem and prepare ourselves for war.
english.completion: Even without the hammer, I know what to do next. When our forces are rallied, we can take the fight to the Underking.
english.completed: Speak with Mayla Highmountain at Thunder Totem.

text.title: 塔纳安屠魔者
text.objectives: 在塔纳安丛林击杀$oa个恶魔。
text.description: 恶魔！我恨它们！$b$b每过一个小时，古尔丹都会开启更多的传送门。只有一个办法能够阻止他，$n。$b$b<帕维克把戴着护手的那只手握紧成拳，砸在另一只手掌中。>$b$b砸扁它们！$b$b沙纳尔神殿是个不错的起点，不过如果你想要面对真正的挑战，就到基尔加丹王座去吧。

english.title: Demonslayer of Tanaan
english.objectives: Slay $oa demons in Tanaan Jungle.
english.description: Demons! Hate 'em!$b$bGul'dan is spinning up more summoning portals with each passing hour. There's only one way to stem the tide, $n.$b$b<Parvink smashes her gauntleted fist against her open palm.>$b$bSmash 'em!$b$bThe Temple of Sha'naar is a good place to start, or head up to the Throne of Kil'jaeden if you're looking for a real challenge.

text.title: 尖牙与利爪
text.objectives: 从塔纳安丛林的各种野生动物身上搜集$oa枚塔纳安丛林利齿。
text.description: 丛林里的那群拉木头的胆小鬼总是说这里太过凶险。你也知道，南边有掠食者的巢穴，佐拉姆沼泽里有凶悍的迅猛龙，甚至连海边的海洋生物和魔荚人都长着獠牙！$b$b咱们去搞个狩猎，怎么样？从野生动植物身上搜集牙齿。体型较大的野兽嘴里的牙齿也比较多。完成狩猎之后回这里来找我，咱们来比比谁的收获更多！

english.title: Tooth and Claw
english.objectives: Collect $oa Tanaan Jungle Teeth from the various wildlife within Tanaan Jungle.
english.description: These wimps lugging wood around the jungle keep talking about how dangerous it is. You know, between the ravager den to the south or the raptors that stalk Zorammarsh - hey, even the beach creatures or podlings have teeth!$b$bWhat do you say you and I do a little hunting? Collect teeth from wild beasts. The bigger the beast, the more teeth. Meet me back here and we'll compare our haul!

text.title: 打击钢铁部落
text.objectives: 在塔纳安丛林击杀$oa名钢铁部落兽人。
text.description: 钢铁部落在黑石铸造厂遭受挫败之后，就一直疲于奔命。虽然古尔丹把他们变成了邪兽人，但是我一点也不怕。这种嗜血的兽人比以前加倍强壮，却也加倍愚蠢。$b$b嘿！咱们到塔纳安的战场去消灭那些兽人吧！管他是兽人还是邪兽人——战个痛快。

english.title: Bringing Down the Iron Horde
english.objectives: Slay $oa Iron Horde orcs in Tanaan Jungle.
english.description: Ever since we humiliated 'em at Blackrock Foundry, the Iron Horde has been on the run. Gul'dan is converting them all into fel orcs, but I ain't scared. A bloodlusting orc is twice as strong but twice as stupid.$b$bHey! Let's wade into the battlefields of Tanaan and lay waste to as many orcs as we can. Orc or fel orc - doesn't matter to me.

text.title: 血债血偿
text.objectives: 消灭$1oa个邪能图腾牛头人。
text.description:
牛头人太过分了。我可不是因为害怕他们攻击洞穴并大肆屠戮，才逃离他们的岗哨的。

看来他们早有企图。消灭一些邪能图腾的人，削弱他们的战斗力。
text.completion: Their numbers are fewer, but still they threaten our safety.

english.title: They Will Pay With Blood
english.objectives: Slay $1oa Feltotem Tauren.
english.description:
The tauren go too far. I did not escape their outpost for fear that they would attack the cave and slaughter my people.

It looks like they planned to do it all along. Slay some of the Feltotem. Thin the herd.
english.completion: Their numbers are fewer, but still they threaten our safety.

text.title: 徽记猎手
text.objectives: 在圣剑谷收集剖肠、响蹄和蔑魔勇士的徽记。
text.description:
宝库的看守者尤特纳一向喜怒无常。挑战者远道而来寻求试炼，但是他却视若无睹。

想要引起他的注意，你就必须证明自己的实力。

有些挑战者正在圣剑谷的营地里等候。把他们的徽记带到尤特纳面前，让守护者看到他们，看到你。
text.completion:
It is a shame to see the first worthy challenger for the Aegis treating the trials with such disrespect. Such hubris cannot win the Aegis, for the gods will surely strike him down for his arrogance.

You, however, seem different. You have shown that you are a worthy challenger. $B$BI will allow you to begin the trials.

english.title: Ahead of the Game
english.objectives: Collect the heads of the Gutspill, Rumblehoof, and Felskorn champions in Valley of the Sword.
english.description:
The watcher Yotnar keeps the vault, and he is a fickle one. Challengers come from far and wide seeking the trials, but the watcher chooses not to see.

If you wish to catch his eye, show him you are worth being seen.

Some of these challengers await in camps throughout the Valley of the Sword. Bring their heads to Yotnar, so that he may see them, and you.
english.completion:
It is a shame to see the first worthy challenger for the Aegis treating the trials with such disrespect. Such hubris cannot win the Aegis, for the gods will surely strike him down for his arrogance.

You, however, seem different. You have shown that you are a worthy challenger. $B$BI will allow you to begin the trials.

text.title: 勇气试炼
text.objectives: 在守护者平台为档案装置充能，查看勇气试炼的全息影像记录。
text.description:
寻求阿格拉玛之盾的勇士必须完成三项伟大的试炼，才能通过勇者之门参与荣耀之战。你可以在这里找到试炼相关的知识，以及你必须面对的第一场挑战。

你可以在我们上方的中央高地找到关于勇气试炼的记录。把它找出来以了解你即将踏上的旅途。
text.completion: You have learned of the obstacles you must face. $B$BDo you still wish to continue?

english.title: A Trial of Valor
english.objectives: Power up the archive device and view the holographic record for the Trial of Valor in the Terrace of the Watchers.
english.description:
To seek the Aegis of Aggramar, a champion must complete three great trials before riding into glorious battle through the Gates of Valor. Here you will find the knowledge of the trials you must seek out, as well as the first challenge you must face.

Above us, adorning the central plateau, you will find the archive for the Trial of Valor. Seek it out, and learn where your path leads.
english.completion: You have learned of the obstacles you must face. $B$BDo you still wish to continue?

text.title: 意志试炼
text.objectives: 在守护者平台为档案装置充能，查看意志试炼的全息影像记录。
text.description:
意志试炼的介绍装置位于上方高地的顶端。把它找出来，并了解在托里姆峰会有什么等待着你。 

你要提高警觉，外来者。那个斯科瓦尔德留下了许多手下，他们绝对不友善。
text.completion: The knowledge you've gained is a powerful tool to use against your foes. $B$BDo not forget this.

english.title: A Trial of Will
english.objectives: Power up the archive device and view the holographic record for the Trial of Will in the Terrace of the Watchers.
english.description:
Upon the highest point of the plateau above, you will find the archive device for the Trial of Will. Seek it out to learn what awaits you in Thorim's Peak. 

Be on your guard, outsider. The one called Skovald has left behind many of his army, and they will no doubt be unfriendly.
english.completion: The knowledge you've gained is a powerful tool to use against your foes. $B$BDo not forget this.

text.title: 支离破碎的守护者
text.objectives: 在守护者平台收集尤特纳的躯干的各个部分。
text.description:
你的对手——斯科瓦尔德在完成第一场试炼之后，用他邪恶的力量撕裂了我的肉身。

支离破碎的我无法让竞争者进入宝库。 

他的手下亵渎了高地，我的躯体肯定被他们扯得七零八落。把我身体的部位找回来，这样我才能指引你进行试炼。
text.completion: Wonderful! $B$BIt is good to be whole again!

english.title: The Shattered Watcher
english.objectives: Collect the pieces of Yotnar's body from the Terrace of the Watchers.
english.description:
When your adversary - the one called Skovald- completed his first trial, he used his ill-begotten powers to sunder my physical body.

I cannot allow a contender to pass through the vault while I remain unwhole. 

His forces have no doubt scattered my pieces through the plateau which they currently desecrate. Bring them back to me, so that I may properly guide your trial.
english.completion: Wonderful! $B$BIt is good to be whole again!

text.title: 力量试炼
text.objectives: 使用档案装置，了解力量试炼。
text.description:
你让我又拥有了完整的身体，非常感谢你，外来者。你显然具备参加试炼的资格。 

现在进入宝库吧。第一场试炼的档案就在那里。

我会在里面等你。
text.completion: The trial is done, and you emerge victorious! $B$BIt is a great feat you have done here, but you are not through yet. Many great challenges await you on your path to the Aegis.

english.title: A Trial of Might
english.objectives: Activate the archive device to learn about the Trial of Might.
english.description:
I owe you my gratitude for helping make me whole again, outsider. It is clear that you are worthy to take on the trials. 

Go now into the vault. There you will find the archive for the first trial you must undertake.

I will meet you inside.
english.completion: The trial is done, and you emerge victorious! $B$BIt is a great feat you have done here, but you are not through yet. Many great challenges await you on your path to the Aegis.

text.title: 鲜血与献礼
text.objectives: 在圣剑谷收集7份挑战者的献礼。
text.description:
圣剑谷中聚集的挑战者们为宝库守护者准备了许多献礼。 

如果你带上这些供品去见尤特纳的话，说不定可以搏得他的好感。
text.completion: I appreciate your gifts, outsider. You show great respect to the trials. $B$BYou do well to honor our ways.

english.title: Blood and Gold
english.objectives: Collect 7 Challenger's Tributes from Valley of the Sword.
english.description:
The challengers gathered in the Valley of the Sword have brought with them offerings to the watchers of the vault. 

It might be a good idea to take some of these offerings with you to help in appeasing Yotnar.
english.completion: I appreciate your gifts, outsider. You show great respect to the trials. $B$BYou do well to honor our ways.

text.title: 7.0 Val'sharah - Vale - Vignette: Perrexx - TRACKING - twh

english.title: 7.0 Val'sharah - Vale - Vignette: Perrexx - TRACKING - twh

text.title: 守护者的祝福
text.objectives: 与尤特纳交谈，接受守护者的祝福。
text.description:
你通过了力量试炼，我会赋予你守护者的祝福。 

除此之外，为了帮助你面对接下来的试炼，我会为你的神器附上宝库守护者的力量。愿它在需要的时候帮你克服难关。

等你准备好接受祝福的时候就告诉我。
text.completion: The trial is done and you yet live. This land is full of wonders, yes?$B$BBut it looks like the God-King intends to give you trials on top of trials. Still you must hurry, for even now, the next awaits!

english.title: The Blessing of the Watchers
english.objectives: Speak to Yotnar to receive the blessing of the watchers.
english.description:
As is your due for passing the Trial of Might, I will grant you the blessing of the watchers. 

Furthermore, to aid you in your trials to come, I will bestow upon your artifact the power of the vault's keeper. May it serve you well in your time of need.

Speak to me when you are ready to receive this gift.
english.completion: The trial is done and you yet live. This land is full of wonders, yes?$B$BBut it looks like the God-King intends to give you trials on top of trials. Still you must hurry, for even now, the next awaits!

text.title: 我击沉了你的战列舰
text.objectives: 前往塔纳安的雄狮岗哨与守备官科索斯会面。
text.description:
指挥官，我们必须扩展舰队的规模，才能在对抗钢铁部落时拥有一线胜利的机会。

根据塔纳安发回的报告，一支新的联盟势力可以向我们提供建造战列舰所需的图纸。尽快到那里查明情况吧！
text.giverWindow: 在塔纳安的雄狮岗哨找到守备官科索斯。

english.title: I Sunk Your Battleship
english.objectives: Meet Vindicator Krethos at Lion's Watch in Tanaan Jungle.
english.description:
Commander, we must expand our fleet if we hope to stand a chance against the Iron Horde.

We have heard reports from Tanaan that a new Alliance faction can supply us with the plans to build battleships.  Head out there as soon as you can and investigate!
english.giverWindow: Find Vindicator Krethos at Lion's Watch in Tanaan Jungle.

objectiveDetails.description: 在先知之手阵营中达到尊敬声望

text.title: 林达斯的下落：搜索下水道
text.objectives: 搜索下水道，寻找关于林达斯下落的线索。
text.description: 林奇说林达斯逃进了达拉然的下水道。那里一定有关于他下落的线索。$b$b希望他还没有在达拉然的市民中间引起更多的骚乱。

english.title: Where's Lyndras: Sewer Sleuthing
english.objectives: Search the sewers for clues as to where Lyndras has gone.
english.description: Linzy said that Lyndras escaped down into the sewers of Dalaran. Surely there must be a clue down there as to his whereabouts.$b$bHopefully he hasn't caused any more commotion amongst the citizens of Dalaran.

text.title: 我击沉了你的战列舰
text.objectives: 前往塔纳安的沃玛尔与暗影猎手德恩加会面。
text.description:
指挥官，我们必须扩展舰队的规模，才能在对抗钢铁部落时拥有一线胜利的机会。

根据塔纳安发回的报告，一支新的部落势力可以向我们提供建造战列舰所需的图纸。尽快到那里查明情况吧！
text.giverWindow: 在塔纳安的沃玛尔找到暗影猎手德恩加。

english.title: I Sunk Your Battleship
english.objectives: Meet Shadow Hunter Denjai at Vol'mar in Tanaan Jungle.
english.description:
Commander, we must expand our fleet if we hope to stand a chance against the Iron Horde.

We have heard reports from Tanaan that a new Horde faction can supply us with the plans to build battleships.  Head out there as soon as you can and investigate!
english.giverWindow: Find Shadow Hunter Denjai at Vol'mar in Tanaan Jungle.

objectiveDetails.description: 在沃金之锋阵营中达到尊敬声望

text.title: 林达斯的下落：继续往下
text.objectives: 继续追踪林达斯。
text.description: 菲力兹提到了紫罗兰监狱附近的一个下水道口，在那里可能会发现林达斯的踪迹。

english.title: Where's Lyndras: Downward Spiral
english.objectives: Continue following Lyndras' trail.
english.description: Flitz mentioned a manhole near Violet Hold, perhaps that would be the best place to pick up Lyndras' trail.

text.title: Treasures of Deathwing
text.objectives: Defend Brann Bronzebeard.
text.description: Neltharion's Vault? Well why didn't that spiritwalker just say so?$b$bWhen we were jumpin' into the cavern I thought I saw a chamber up high that might have what we are after.$b$bHave a look around this place while I see if I can't find a way up.
text.completed: Speak with Brann Bronzebeard in Neltharian's Vault.

english.title: Treasures of Deathwing
english.objectives: Defend Brann Bronzebeard.
english.description: Neltharion's Vault? Well why didn't that spiritwalker just say so?$b$bWhen we were jumpin' into the cavern I thought I saw a chamber up high that might have what we are after.$b$bHave a look around this place while I see if I can't find a way up.
english.completed: Speak with Brann Bronzebeard in Neltharian's Vault.

text.title: 离水的鱼
text.objectives: 把$1oa条白水鲤鱼放回河里。
text.description:
卓格巴尔发狂了！他们正在乱砸一气，还把鱼丢到岸上。

最糟糕的是，眼下可不是捕鱼的好时候，我们必须把它们放回水里进行繁殖。
text.completion: Thank you. You saved enough fish that they can breed a new population.

english.title: Fish Out of Water
english.objectives: Return $1oa Whitewater Carp to the river.
english.description:
The drogbar are on a rampage! They're smashing everything they can find and are throwing fish to the shore.

Worst of all, it is the wrong time to harvest fish. They must be returned to the waters so they can breed.
english.completion: Thank you. You saved enough fish that they can breed a new population.

text.title: 校准专家
text.objectives: 把不准的玛洛瑞滴定管交给技术高超的炼金师校准。
text.description: 想要校准滴定管的精确度，需要多位技术高超的专家共同努力。$b$b菲拉斯的米莎拉·溪风对细节的注重令人赞赏。$b$b我虽然讨厌铁炉堡，但不得不承认那里有一位以精准而闻名的专家，克里姆佩尔·精量。$b$b另外，如果钱包没锁好的话，我绝不会踏上藏宝海湾半步，不过那里有个叫泰克斯·普图尔的倒是公认的公正可靠……大多数时候。

english.title: Calibration Experts
english.objectives: Take the Uncalibrated Malloric Burettes to skilled alchemists for calibration.
english.description: It will take the cooperation of several highly skilled sorts to calibrate these burettes.$b$bMyshalla Streambreeze in Feralas has demonstrated admirable attention to detail.$b$bI loathe Ironforge, but a resident named Krimple Proxmeasure is known for his precision.$b$bAnd while I'd never travel to Booty Bay without a lock on my wallet, Tryks Pourtrue has proven reliable and fair... mostly.

text.title: 孩子去哪儿了？
text.objectives: 解救6名被绑架的儿童。
text.description: 孩子们失踪了！$B$B那个可怕的格噜普斯正在德拉诺肆意横行，绑架儿童。请你去救救他们！$B$B我们的斥候在霜火岭发现了他的踪迹。

english.title: Where Are the Children?
english.objectives: Save 6 Kidnapped Children.
english.description: The children have gone missing!$B$BThat horrible Grumpus has been making his way throughout Draenor, snatching up children. Please save them!$B$BOur scouts have spotted him over in Frostfire Ridge.

text.title: 格噜噜的威胁
text.objectives: 消灭8只格噜噜。
text.description: 格噜噜是一种极其恐怖的生物，专为格噜普斯干坏事。$B$B如果你能解除它们的威胁，那么营救小孩的事情肯定没问题。

english.title: Menacing Grumplings
english.objectives: Kill 8 Grumplings.
english.description: The grumplings are horrid creatures. They're the ones doin' the dirty work for Grumpus.$B$BIf you're able to remove the threat I'm sure rescuing the children won't be much of a problem.

text.title: 格噜普斯
text.objectives: 消灭格噜普斯。
text.description: 格噜普斯的传说是德拉诺最古老的传说之一。$B$B传说这个卑鄙的恶棍会在凛冬之夜出没，绑架不听话的孩子。他会在自己的巢穴中，送恶心的礼物给这些孩子，利用他们的泪水召唤爪牙。$B$B但格噜普斯并不是传说，他是真实存在的，还抓走了我们的孩子！求求你，一定要杀了他！

english.title: Grumpus
english.objectives: Slay Grumpus.
english.description: One of Draenor's oldest stories is the legend of Grumpus.$B$BThe story tells of a mean-spirited brute that would come in the night, in the dead of winter, and kidnap children that misbehaved. Back at his lair, he would present them with awful toys, and use their tears to spawn his minions.$B$BBut Grumpus is no legend, he's real and he's taken our children! Please, you have to slay him!

text.title: 巨龙的地盘
text.objectives: 与维瑟尔交谈，然后飞到托里姆峰。
text.description:
多亏有你的帮助，泰姆贾里斯才能逃脱那个邪魔的控制。她嘱咐我留在这里，等你清除敌人之后带你去找她。

她在托里姆峰的顶端集结了我们的同胞，准备发起反攻。 

你愿意加入我们吗？
text.completion: You are truly a hero to my brood.  $B$BYou have gained a powerful ally today, outsider. The God-King has reason to fear you.

english.title: Where Dragons Rule
english.objectives: Speak to Vethir to fly to the top of Thorim's Peak.
english.description:
Thanks to your help, Thrymjaris was able to escape the clutches of that vile demon. She bid me wait for you, so that I could take you to her once you had finished dispatching your foes.

She has gathered our brood at the top of Thorim's Peak to prepare for a counterattack. 

Would you join us?
english.completion: You are truly a hero to my brood.  $B$BYou have gained a powerful ally today, outsider. The God-King has reason to fear you.

text.title: 奥丁和瓦拉加尔
text.objectives: 跟着丹妮卡去见奥丁。
text.description:
不要害怕，凡人，你还没死。奥丁派我赶在你死之前找到你。

我现在就带你去见他，跟我走吧。

english.title: Odyn and the Valarjar
english.objectives: Follow Danica to see Odyn.
english.description:
Fear not, mortal, you are not dead. I was directed to collect you before your demise by Odyn himself.

I will take you to Odyn now, follow me.

text.title: 再试一次！
text.objectives: 前往干船坞找亚纳斯建造新的驱逐舰。驱逐舰建造完成后，派它去执行新的行动。
text.description:
看来那艘潜水艇的火力比我们预想的要强一些！我们甚至没有发现他们靠近，就被先发打击击中了。

海战难免会损失舰船，指挥官。幸运的是，我们对这种情况早有准备。去干船坞与亚纳斯谈谈吧，他应该能帮我们快速建造出一艘新的驱逐舰。等舰船造好之后再回来找我，我有一个新的行动要指派给你。

english.title: If At First You Fail, Try Again!
english.objectives: Meet Yanas Seastrike at the dry docks and build another Destroyer.  Once the Destroyer is complete, send it on a new mission.
english.description:
Looks like that Submarine had a bit more firepower than we thought!  They used First Strike to hit us before we even saw it coming.

Losing ships is a part of naval battles, Commander.  Luckily, we were prepared for this exact sort of situation.  Speak with Yanas down at the dry docks, he should be able to help us quickly produce another Destroyer.  Head back here when the ship is complete, we will have a new mission ready for you.

objectiveDetails.description: 完成海军行动：卷土重来

text.title: 攻击狼群
text.objectives: 向狼群附近发射小动物手炮让狼群散开，让头狼暴露出来。
text.description:
是时候攻击狼群了！我已经为手炮上膛，你只需要瞄准射击就行。

小动物们应该会在冲击中存活下来，然后四处逃窜。逃窜的小动物肯定会让狼群分心，这样你就可以专心猎杀头狼了。

狩猎愉快！
text.completion: You made it back without any scratches. It looks like the backfire issue from the last prototype worked itself out.$b$bA few more tweaks and I'd say this hand cannon is ready for mass production. Thanks for the help, $n.

english.title: Wolf Pack Attack
english.objectives: Shoot the Critter Hand Cannon near wolf packs so that they scatter, allowing the packleaders to be singled out.
english.description:
It's time to attack the pack! I've preloaded the hand cannon. All you have to do is point and shoot.

The critters should survive the blast and hit the ground running. The howlers will be distracted by the critters, allowing you to focus on killing the packleaders.

Happy hunting!
english.completion: You made it back without any scratches. It looks like the backfire issue from the last prototype worked itself out.$b$bA few more tweaks and I'd say this hand cannon is ready for mass production. Thanks for the help, $n.

text.title: 生命之泉洞穴
text.objectives: 前往生命之泉洞穴与洁儿·河鬃碰头。
text.description:
卓格巴尔霸占了我的洞穴。那里是我们河鬃部族施行水魔法的地方，而且至高岭最纯净的治疗水源大部分出自那里。

到那里跟我碰头，我们一起把邪恶之徒赶出圣地。
text.completion: Are you ready? We are about to enter a cave... and the drogbar are at home in such dark places.

english.title: Lifespring Cavern
english.objectives: Meet Jale Rivermane at Lifespring Cavern.
english.description:
The drogbar have taken over my cavern. It is where we Rivermane practice our water magic and get much of the purest healing water in Highmountain.

Meet me there and we will cleanse that sacred place of these dark-dwellers.
english.completion: Are you ready? We are about to enter a cave... and the drogbar are at home in such dark places.

text.title: 搭乘魔蝠
text.objectives: 找白月搭乘魔蝠，然后飞上邪能之槌号。
text.description:
时候到了。我们已经重创了燃烧军团，让他们难以恢复元气。

快点，乘上坐骑，进攻泰兰娜的指挥部。

english.title: On Felbat Wings
english.objectives: Grab a felbat from Illidari Whitemoon and fly up to the Fel Hammer.
english.description:
It is time. We have dealt the Legion's forces a crippling blow from which they will never recover.

Quickly, let us mount up and take the fight to Tyranna's command center.

text.title: 真正的海军指挥官
text.objectives: 在你的舰船上安装高能炉并完成海军封锁行动。
text.description: 太好了！这正是我上周钓鱼时弄丢的图纸。这些图纸与我的原型设备完全对应。拿上这个高能炉，把它安装在我们的其中一艘舰船上。这可以让我们突破海上封锁，扩大我们的德拉诺海域的控制范围。

english.title: A True Naval Commander
english.objectives: Install the Blast Furnace equipment on your ship and complete the Naval Blockade mission.
english.description: Yes!  Those are the blueprints I misplaced when I was fishing last week.  These instructions match my prototype equipment one for one. Take this Blast Furnace and install it on one of our ships.  This should let us break the naval blocade and expand our control of the Draenor seas.

objectiveDetails.description: 为一艘舰船装备高能炉
完成海军封锁行动：南海

text.title: 武装舰队
text.objectives: 前往码头找到“老水手”乔伦。
text.description: 指挥官，我们要想赢下这场战争的话，就得给我们的舰队追加一些海军装备。去码头找“老水手”乔伦吧，他应该能帮上忙。
text.giverWindow: 前往码头找到“老水手”乔伦。

english.title: Equipping Our Fleet
english.objectives: Meet Salty Jorren at the docks.
english.description: Commander, our fleet is going to require some custom naval equipment if we hope to stand a chance in this war.  Find Salty Jorren down at the docks, he should be able to help us out.
english.giverWindow: Find Salty Jorren on the docks.

objectiveDetails.description: 前往码头找到“老水手”乔伦
在码头上找到高能炉图纸

text.title: 林达斯的下落：盗窃魔火
text.objectives: 向紫罗兰监狱的守卫打听林达斯的消息。
text.description: 守卫们肯定看到了林达斯从这里经过。魔尘的踪迹也很容易被发现。$B$B或许某个守卫知道林达斯的情况。

english.title: Where's Lyndras: Leyflame Larceny
english.objectives: Ask the Violet Hold guards about Lyndras.
english.description: The guards here must have seen Lyndras come through. The trail of ley dust isn't exactly hard to miss either.$B$BPerhaps one of the guards knows what became of Lyndras.

text.title: 恶心礼物！
text.objectives: 销毁5份怪礼物。
text.description: 格噜普斯那个死老头收集了各种古怪的礼物。他到处散布恶心到极点的礼物，一心要抹杀孩子们过节的兴致。$B$B拿上提神炸弹，朝格噜普斯的那些怪礼物扔，把它们炸个稀巴烂！$B$B我们要齐心协力才行，$n。去拯救节日氛围吧！

english.title: What Horrible Presents!
english.objectives: Destroy 5 Unusual Gifts.
english.description: That mean old Grumpus has amassed a collection of odd gifts. He's deliberately trying to crush the spirit of children everywhere by giving out the worst presents imaginable.$B$BTake this spirit bomb. Toss it on some of Grumpus's unusual gifts and take them out for good!$B$BWe're in this together, $n. Now go and save the spirit of the holiday!

text.title: 小动物驱散射击
text.objectives: 在日霜林地抓捕兔子。
text.description:
山里的嗥叫者总是成群出没。我可不想以一敌三。

幸运的是，那些狼群可不是我工程技术的对手！我刚刚完成了一部原型机，它可以使狼群分散。现在我需要一些“弹药”……

到南边的草地去帮我抓些兔子回来，我就让你第一个试试我的手炮。
text.completion: Hrm, these rabbits are a bit bigger than I thought, but we should still be able to stuff a few of them into the hand cannon.

english.title: Critter Scatter Shot
english.objectives: Catch rabbits in Sunfrost Glade.
english.description:
The howlers in these hills travel in packs. Three against one isn't a fight I want to pick.

Luckily those wolves are no match for my engineering skills! I just put the finishing touches on the prototype of a device that will help scatter the pack. All I need now is some ammo...

Snatch me some rabbits from the meadow south of here, and I'll let you be the first to try out the hand cannon.
english.completion: Hrm, these rabbits are a bit bigger than I thought, but we should still be able to stuff a few of them into the hand cannon.

text.title: 再试一次！
text.objectives: 前往干船坞找索洛格·拉克建造新的驱逐舰。驱逐舰建造完成后，派它去执行新的行动。
text.description:
看来那艘潜水艇的火力比我们预想的要强一些！我们甚至没有发现他们靠近，就被先发打击击中了。

海战难免会损失舰船，指挥官。幸运的是，我们对这种情况早有准备。去干船坞与索洛格谈谈吧，他应该能帮我们快速建造出一艘新的驱逐舰。等舰船造好之后再回来找我，我有一个新的行动要指派给你。
text.giverWindow: 在干船坞与索洛格碰头。

english.title: If At First You Fail, Try Again!
english.objectives: Meet Solog Roark at the dry docks and build another Destroyer.  Once the Destroyer is complete, send it on a new mission.
english.description:
Looks like that Submarine had a bit more firepower than we thought!  They used First Strike to hit us before we even saw it coming.

Losing ships is a part of naval battles, Commander.  Luckily, we were prepared for this exact sort of situation.  Speak with Solog down at the dry docks, he should be able to help us quickly produce another Destroyer.  Head back here when the ship is complete, we will have a new mission ready for you.
english.giverWindow: Find Solog Roark at the dry docks.

objectiveDetails.description: 完成海军行动：卷土重来

text.title: 武装舰队
text.objectives: 前往码头找到库隆克·锈火。
text.description: 指挥官，我们要想赢下这场战争的话，就得给我们的舰队追加一些海军装备。去码头找库隆克·锈火吧，他应该能帮上忙。
text.giverWindow: 在干船坞与库隆克·锈火碰头。

english.title: Equipping Our Fleet
english.objectives: Meet Kronk Rustspark at the docks.
english.description: Commander, our fleet is going to require some custom naval equipment if we hope to stand a chance in this war.  Find Kronk Rustspark down at the docks, he should be able to help us out.
english.giverWindow: Find Kronk Rustspark at the dry docks.

objectiveDetails.description: 前往码头找到库隆克·锈火

text.title: 真正的海军指挥官
text.objectives: 在你的舰船上安装高能炉并完成海军封锁行动。
text.description: 太好了！这正是我上周钓鱼时弄丢的图纸。这些图纸与我的原型设备完全对应。拿上这个高能炉，把它安装在我们的其中一艘舰船上。这可以让我们突破海上封锁，扩大我们的德拉诺海域的控制范围。

english.title: A True Naval Commander
english.objectives: Install the Blast Furnace equipment on your ship and complete the Naval Blockade mission.
english.description: Yes!  Those are the blueprints I misplaced when I was fishing last week.  These instructions match my prototype equipment one for one. Take this Blast Furnace and install it on one of our ships.  This should let us break the naval blockade and expand our control of the Draenor seas.

objectiveDetails.description: 为一艘舰船装备高能炉
完成海军封锁行动：南海

text.title: 铁匠之锤
text.objectives: 把萨里斯之锤带回他的店铺。
text.description: $n，如果不能弥补心里的遗憾，恐怕我将永远无法释怀。$b$b很久以前，我在黑鸦堡垒后面的海岸发现了一个洞穴。我进去探索的时候，遭到了一个邪恶生物的攻击。逃跑时，我弄丢了自己的锤子。$b$b我必须拿回锤子才能安心。

english.title: Between the Hammer...
english.objectives: Bring Saris' Hammer back to his shop.
english.description: $n, I fear that my spirit will remain bound to this place unless I am made whole again.$b$bLong ago, I discovered a cave near the coast behind Black Rook Hold. I explored the cave only to find an abominable creature that attacked me, causing me to drop my hammer as I fled.$b$bI need that hammer back if I am to be at peace.

text.title: 魔石特质
text.objectives: 观察奥拉尔德使用魔石矿石进行锻造。
text.description: 我从没见过这样的“魔石”矿石。它轻如秘银，却承载着更多的魔法力量……甚至超过了萨隆邪铁和源质矿。$b$b咱们试试用它来锻造吧。做成一副手甲怎么样？

english.title: The Properties of Leystone
english.objectives: Observe Alard as he attempts to work with the leystone ore.
english.description: I've never seen anything like this "leystone" ore. It's light, like mithril, but it carries much more of a magical energy... more even than saronite or elementium.$b$bLet's try making something with it. How about a nice pair of gauntlets?

text.title: 侠盗蝙蝠手
text.objectives: 骑上魔蝠前往地窟上方。
text.description:
你也听到玛维的话了，我们得离开这里。

在这些洞穴的最深处有一座升降机。我们赶紧前往那里吧。

english.title: Grand Theft Felbat
english.objectives: Ride a felbat to the upper vault.
english.description:
You heard what Maiev said. We need to get out of here.

There is an elevator shaft at the far end of these caverns. Let us make our way there.

objectiveDetails.description: 搭乘吸血魔蝠前往地窟上方

text.title: 战火锤炼
text.objectives: 消灭伊莫拉斯并获取他的力量。
text.description:
可怕的恶魔伊莫拉斯带领着一支燃烧军团的部队，征服并统治了一个遥远的枢纽世界。

守望者们费尽艰辛才把他制服，并关在了左边的密室里。虽然他被控制住了，但这种情况持续不了太久。

如果有恶魔猎手能够打败他，那么他的恶魔力量就会成为一份宝贵的战利品，让胜利者获得难以想象的力量。

我相信你可以做到，$n。
text.giverWindow: 伊莫拉斯充斥着凝聚的纯粹邪能。

english.title: Forged in Fire
english.objectives: Kill Immolanth and take his power.
english.description:
The fearsome demon, Immolanth, led a Legion army that conquered and eventually ruled a distant nexus world. 

Somehow, the Wardens imprisoned him, then kept him locked up in the chamber to our left. He is contained, but not for long.

The demon's power is a valuable prize to any demon hunter who can defeat him. Whoever can do so will gain power beyond imagining.

I believe that person could be you, $n.
english.giverWindow: Immolanth is full of pure, coalesced fel power.

objectiveDetails.description: 消灭伊莫拉斯并获取力量

text.title: 发送光线
text.objectives: 破坏格雷泽的护盾。
text.description:
东边是一个专为眼魔格雷泽打造的精密囚室。$B$B囚室在这里被入侵后不久就失效了。$B$B你必须旋转房间里的镜子，将能量射线聚焦在那头怪物身上。否则我们无法突破格雷泽那无懈可击的护盾。

赶快。奥图里斯已经去帮助其他人了，但我们现在处于下风。

english.title: Beam Me Up
english.objectives: Break Glazer's shield.
english.description:
To the east is an intricate prison chamber designed to contain the beholder, Glazer.$B$BIt began malfunctioning shortly after the breach.$B$BYou will need to rotate the mirrors in the room to focus an energy beam onto the creature. Otherwise, we cannot break through Glazer's impenetrable shield.

Hurry. Altruis went ahead to assist the others, but we are losing the fight.

text.title: 冻结时光
text.objectives: 启动寒冰地窟中的反制机关。
text.description:
守望者将各种危险的怪物都关在这个地窟中。现在古尔丹的部队破坏了囚室，情况相当……不妙。

许多战友都在南面的囚室中设法压制一头可怕的熔岩毁灭者，无暇分身。由于刚从静滞中苏醒，我们无法击败它。但我们也许能够重新激活房间中的压制力场。

去加入凯恩的队伍。尽一切可能密封那间囚室！

english.title: Frozen in Time
english.objectives: Activate the Countermeasures in the Vault of Ice.
english.description:
The Wardens kept all kinds of dangerous monsters locked up within this Vault. Now that Gul'dan's forces have breached the walls, it's proving rather... inconvenient.

Many of our forces are occupied with containing a fearsome magma destroyer in the southern chamber. With us freshly awoken from stasis, we don't have the means to take it down. However, we might be able to reactivate the room's containment field.

Go join up with Kayn. Do whatever it takes to seal that chamber!

text.title: 一路向上
text.objectives: 搭乘升降梯前往审判大厅。
text.description:
考瓦斯先过去找凯恩和奥图里斯了。

等升降梯来了就站上去，到上面的审判大厅去找他们。

english.title: All The Way Up
english.objectives: Ride the elevator to the Hall of Judgment.
english.description:
Kor'vas went ahead to meet up with Kayn and Altruis.

Step onto the elevator when it arrives, and meet them in the Hall of Judgment above.

text.title: 自由的绊脚石
text.objectives: 消灭巴斯提拉克斯并获取他的力量。
text.description:
剩下的兄弟们已经杀到最后一个房间，他们就在前面。

通往地窟出口的障碍就只剩下这次恶魔入侵的领导者，巴斯提拉克斯。

消灭他并夺取他的力量，为我们博得自由。
text.giverWindow: 他守卫着地窟出口。

english.title: Between Us and Freedom
english.objectives: Kill Bastillax and take his power.
english.description:
The last of our survivors have fought their way into the final chamber ahead.

Only one obstacle stands between us and the vault's exit - the leader of this demon invasion, Bastillax.

Kill him, take his power, and claim our freedom.
english.giverWindow: He guards the vault exit.

objectiveDetails.description: 消灭巴斯提拉克斯并获取力量

text.title: 伊利达雷，出发吧
text.objectives: 与大法师卡德加谈一谈。
text.description:
燃烧军团已经开始入侵我们的世界。在卡利姆多和东部王国的土地上，勇敢的保卫者们纷纷响应了战斗的召唤。

但是，如果没有你们的帮助，他们终究会失败。你们伊利达雷本来就是为了对付燃烧军团而专门训练出来的武器。

我只请求你跟我同行。你会在那边得到进一步的指示。

english.title: Illidari, We Are Leaving
english.objectives: Speak to Archmage Khadgar.
english.description:
The Legion has begun its invasion of our world. Across Kalimdor and the Eastern Kingdoms, brave defenders are answering the call to arms.
 
However, they will ultimately fail without your aid. You Illidari were uniquely trained as weapons against the Legion.

I only ask that you come with me. Further instructions await you on the other side.

text.title: 伊利达雷，出发吧
text.objectives: 与大法师卡德加谈一谈。
text.description:
燃烧军团已经开始入侵我们的世界。在卡利姆多和东部王国的土地上，勇敢的保卫者们纷纷响应了战斗的呼召。

但是，如果没有你们的帮助，他们终究会失败。你们伊利达雷本来就是为了对付燃烧军团而专门训练出来的武器。

我只请求你跟我同行。你会在那边得到进一步的指示。

english.title: Illidari, We Are Leaving
english.objectives: Speak to Archmage Khadgar.
english.description:
The Legion has begun its invasion of our world. Across Kalimdor and the Eastern Kingdoms, brave defenders are answering the call to arms.
 
However, they will ultimately fail without your aid. You Illidari were uniquely trained as weapons against the Legion.

I only ask that you come with me. Further instructions await you on the other side.

text.title: 战斗的召唤
text.objectives: 在暴风要塞与杰斯·织暗谈一谈。
text.description: 欢迎来到暴风城，这里是人类王国的心脏。不过，这座圣光之城现在被悲伤所笼罩。$b$b瓦里安·乌瑞恩国王战死沙场，留下了他的儿子安度因继承大统。$B$B联盟的领袖们在这里汇聚，祭奠英雄的离去。$b$b毫无疑问，你的特殊能力不可或缺。$b$b你可以在暴风要塞的王座厅找到新任国王，他身边有你的一位伊利达雷同伴。我得去达拉然一趟。$b$b祝你好运，$p。

english.title: The Call of War
english.objectives: Speak to Jace Darkweaver in Stormwind Keep.
english.description: Welcome to Stormwind, the heart of the human kingdom. But today, sorrow grips this bastion of the Light.$b$bKing Varian Wrynn has fallen in battle, leaving the crown to his son Anduin.$B$BThe leaders of the Alliance have gathered to pay their respects. No doubt they will have need of your unique skills.$b$bYou will find the king upon the throne of Stormwind Keep, attended by one of your fellow Illidari. I am needed in Dalaran.$b$bGood luck, $p.

text.title: The Call of War
text.objectives: Speak to the Warchief.
text.description: Welcome to Orgrimmar, the Horde's seat of power.$B$BEnter Grommash Hold straight ahead, and make your introduction to Warchief Vol'jin.$B$BHe is expecting you.

english.title: The Call of War
english.objectives: Speak to the Warchief.
english.description: Welcome to Orgrimmar, the Horde's seat of power.$B$BEnter Grommash Hold straight ahead, and make your introduction to Warchief Vol'jin.$B$BHe is expecting you.

text.title: 自由的绊脚石
text.objectives: 消灭巴斯提拉克斯并获取他的力量。
text.description:
剩下的兄弟们已经杀到最后一个房间，他们就在前面。

通往地窟出口的障碍就只剩下这次恶魔入侵的领导者，巴斯提拉克斯。

消灭他并夺取他的力量，为我们博得自由。
text.giverWindow: 他守卫着地窟出口。

english.title: Between Us and Freedom
english.objectives: Kill Bastillax and take his power.
english.description:
The last of our survivors have fought their way into the final chamber ahead.

Only one obstacle stands between us and the vault's exit - the leader of this demon invasion, Bastillax.

Kill him, take his power, and claim our freedom.
english.giverWindow: He guards the vault exit.

objectiveDetails.description: 消灭巴斯提拉克斯并获取力量

text.title: 崛起吧，勇士
text.completion: Highlord, so long as the Order of the Silver Hand stands, we will do everything in our power to destroy the Legion's foothold on Azeroth.$B$BTo succeed, we will need to enlist the best of our order.$B$BLet me be the first to serve, $n. I will act as your eyes and blade where you are not; I will carry out your will until my dying breath.

english.title: Rise, Champions
english.completion: Highlord, so long as the Order of the Silver Hand stands, we will do everything in our power to destroy the Legion's foothold on Azeroth.$B$BTo succeed, we will need to enlist the best of our order.$B$BLet me be the first to serve, $n. I will act as your eyes and blade where you are not; I will carry out your will until my dying breath.

enders.name: 玛克斯韦尔·泰罗索斯男爵

text.title: 王对王
text.objectives: 击败主宰使命号，夺取德拉诺海图以完成船坞传说系列任务。
text.description: 我挖到了一些情报——海军的行话管挖情报叫什么来着？潜水？$b$b总之，古尔丹派出了他最强大的旗舰前往德拉诺的四个角落执行一项侦察任务。他正在绘制海底魔网节点的位置图。我需要这些情报来升级你的戒指……可在古尔丹的手里，它们可能会造成灾难性的后果！$b$b快去拦截那支舰队吧，$n！抢在他们完成任务前干掉他那艘臭名昭著的旗舰“主宰使命号”，抢走他们的海图。快！

english.title: Master vs. Commander
english.objectives: Complete the legendary shipyard missions until you defeat the Master's Call and acquire a Draenic Sea Chart.
english.description: I've been doing a little digging - or whatever you call digging in naval terms. Snorkeling?$b$bGul'dan has sent his most powerful flagship on a scouting mission to the four corners of Draenor. He is mapping out all the oceanic ley-line conjunctions. This is information that I could use to upgrade your ring... But in Gul'dan's hands, it could be catastrophic.$b$bScramble the fleet, $n! Hunt down his infamous flagship, "The Master's Call," and steal that map before they complete their mission. Hurry!

text.title: 巡视
text.objectives: 跟随希尔瓦娜斯·风行者，并为她的舰船做好启航的准备。
text.description: 如你所见，我们不遗余力地支持你的伟大任务。$B$B最后的准备即将完成——来吧，和我一块走走。

english.title: Making the Rounds
english.objectives: Follow Lady Sylvanas Windrunner and prepare her ship to set sail.
english.description: As you can see, we have spared no expense in showing our support of your great quest.$B$BFinal preparations are being made - come, walk with me.

objectiveDetails.description: 与恐怖船长塔特赛尔交谈

text.title: 铁角魔石铸造
text.objectives: 在铁角飞地附近收集金属废料，然后使用绿蹄的铁砧和熔炉制作废金护手、废金护掌、废金腕甲，以及$4oa个废金护指。
text.description: 我感觉到你拥有强大的能力，但是你却没有发挥出来。我们铁角部族在锻造物品的时候，会比一般的铁匠多用一倍的金属。$b$b而且在锻造这种份量的魔石时，也有特殊的技巧，我之后会教你。$b$b用我们剩下的金属制造几个手甲零件，然后交给我焊接。

english.title: Ironhorn Leysmithing
english.objectives: Gather scrap metal around the Ironhorn Enclave. Then use the Greenhoof's Anvil and Forge to craft a Scrapmetal Handguard, a Scrapmetal Palmplate, a Scrapmetal Cuffplate, and $4oa Scrapmetal Fingerplates.
english.description: I sense great strength in you, yet you refuse to wield it. We Ironhorn use double the metal of any normal blacksmith to craft our wares.$b$bThere is also a technique in how you hammer such quantities of leystone that I will instruct you on.$b$bUse our scrap metal and hammer out the pieces for a gauntlet. I will weld the pieces together when you are finished.

text.title: 黑鸦堡垒的传奇人物
text.objectives: 到黑鸦堡垒寻找萨里斯·迅锤的线索。
text.description: $n，你听说过萨里斯·迅锤吗？$b$b他是黑鸦堡垒精灵中的传奇铁匠。不知道他的手艺是不是还流传于世。$b$b我要你到那里去寻找关于萨里斯的情报，或者看看他有没有留下什么东西，可以带回店里研究。

english.title: Legend of Black Rook Hold
english.objectives: Go to Black Rook Hold and search for Saris Swifthammer.
english.description: $n, have you heard of Saris Swifthammer?$b$bHe was a legendary blacksmith amongst the elves of Black Rook Hold. I wonder if any of his research still exists.$b$bI want you to travel there and see if you can discover anything about Saris, or see if he left anything we can research here at my shop.

text.title: Where Are the Children?
text.objectives: Help save the children.
text.description: The children have gone missing!$B$BThat horrible Grumpus has been making his way throughout Draenor, snatching up children. Please save them!$B$BOur scouts have spotted him over in Frostfire Ridge.

english.title: Where Are the Children?
english.objectives: Help save the children.
english.description: The children have gone missing!$B$BThat horrible Grumpus has been making his way throughout Draenor, snatching up children. Please save them!$B$BOur scouts have spotted him over in Frostfire Ridge.

text.title: Menacing Grumplings
text.objectives: Remove the grumpling threat.
text.description: The grumplings are horrid creatures. They're the ones doin' the dirty work for Grumpus.$B$BIf you're able to remove the threat I'm sure rescuing the children won't be much of a problem.

english.title: Menacing Grumplings
english.objectives: Remove the grumpling threat.
english.description: The grumplings are horrid creatures. They're the ones doin' the dirty work for Grumpus.$B$BIf you're able to remove the threat I'm sure rescuing the children won't be much of a problem.

text.title: 消灭南瓜娃娃
text.objectives: 消灭6个生长中的南瓜娃娃。
text.description: 白骨舰队从前一直劫掠德拉诺水域上的贸易船只。其中有一艘船上装着运往艾洛多尔的耕种用具。$B$B现在，他们用这些工具在我们的土地上传播瘟疫。腐烂的植物堆里散发出恐怖的气息。这种恶心的东西必须全部摧毁，不能让它们扩散到其他地方去。

english.title: Smashing Squashlings
english.objectives: Kill 6 Growing Squashlings.
english.description: The Bonefleet once raided trading ships traveling the waters of Draenor. One such ship carried farming supplies intended for Elodor.$B$BNow, they use these supplies to sow their plague into our earth. From the putrid mounds sprout vegetative horrors. These abominations must be destroyed, before they can spread across the landscape.

objectiveDetails.description: 消灭生长中的南瓜娃娃

text.title: 失乐园
text.objectives: 在达拉然的克拉苏斯平台与大法师卡德加谈一谈。
text.description: 大法师卡德加计划远征阿苏纳，你应该立刻前往达拉然，到克拉苏斯平台去找他。
text.completion: Perfect. Up for a little trip down to Azsuna?
text.giverTarget: 格雷森·沙东布瑞克公爵

english.title: Paradise Lost
english.objectives: Speak with Archmage Khadgar at Krasus' Landing in Dalaran.
english.description: Archmage Khadgar was planning an expedition to Azsuna - you should seek him out at Krasus' Landing in Dalaran immediately.
english.completion: Perfect. Up for a little trip down to Azsuna?

text.title: 白骨船暴乱
text.objectives: 消灭裂骨。
text.description: 每年的这个时候，都会有一股诡异的幽灵能量潮席卷德拉诺。在这股能量的感召下，一只亡灵海盗舰队会从迷雾中出现。我们称它为白骨舰队。$B$B白骨舰队的首领是一个名叫裂骨的野蛮海盗。他唯一的目标就是消灭德拉诺所有的生者。$B$B快去找到裂骨并击败他，以免他再次从迷雾中归来。

english.title: Mutiny on the Boneship
english.objectives: Kill Bonerender.
english.description: Each year, around this time, there is a strange surge of spiritual energy across Draenor. Beckoned by this phenomenon, a ghastly fleet of undead pirates emerges from the mist. We call it the Bonefleet.$B$BThe Bonefleet is led by a savage pirate known as Bonerender. He seeks nothing more than the complete destruction of all of the living of Draenor.$B$BSeek out Bonerender and defeat him, before he sails back into the mist once again.

text.title: 邪恶的肥料
text.objectives: 摧毁8桶恐怖肥料。
text.description: 白骨舰队最大的野心就是将他们的亡灵诅咒传播到陆地上。如果听之任之，诅咒很快就会像疾病一样攻占整片土地。$B$B亡灵的腐臭浸透了它们用来浇灌恐怖作物的肥料桶。它们就是瘟疫传播的源头，必须全部摧毁掉。

english.title: Foul Fertilizer
english.objectives: Destroy 8 kegs of Dread Fertilizer.
english.description: The Bonefleet wants nothing more than to spread their undead curse onto dry land. Like a sickness, it will slowly overtake the landscape if left unchecked.$B$BThe stench of undeath permeates the barrels of fertilizer they use to sow their dread crops. They are the source of the spreading plague, and must be destroyed.

text.title: 削减船员
text.objectives: 消灭12名白骨船船员。
text.description: 想要清除白骨舰队对德拉诺的威胁，就得削减白骨船上的船员数量。$B$B只要让他们的人数迅速缩减，就能把他们逼回大海中去，让他们一年都缓不过气来。

english.title: Culling the Crew
english.objectives: Destroy 12 Boneship crew members.
english.description: If we're going to protect Draenor from the Bonefleet menace, we'll need to thin out the crew.$B$BSee to a swift reduction in their numbers, and we might just push them back into the sea for another year.

text.title: 灌注新力量
text.objectives: 为你的武器灌注新的力量。
text.description: 在沙场上，就算是燃烧军团最穷凶极恶的恶魔领主也会对你的出现退让三分。但是，他们在不断培植邪恶势力，企图与你抗衡。$B$B大领主，我们必须增强你的实力，以维持我们的优势。$B$B有无数的圣光英雄在这些殿堂中长眠，他们的精华在你面前的祭坛中凝聚。把你的武器放上去，为它灌注新的力量。
text.completion: I will continue beseeching the Light to bolster the power of your weapon.$B$BFor now, its newfound strength should be more than enough.

english.title: Forging New Strength
english.objectives: Imbue your weapon with a new power.
english.description: Even the most nefarious Legion lords fear your presence on the battlefield. Yet they are relentless, fashioning ever more terrible horrors and fiends in hopes of countering your might.$B$BHighlord, we must augment your power to maintain our edge over the enemy.$B$BThe altar before you holds within it the essence of the countless heroes of the Light buried in these sacred halls. Place your weapon upon the altar and imbue it with new strength.
english.completion: I will continue beseeching the Light to bolster the power of your weapon.$B$BFor now, its newfound strength should be more than enough.

enders.name: 玛克斯韦尔·泰罗索斯男爵

text.title: 讲解锻造
text.objectives: 从黑鸦堡垒的精灵身上取得$1oa件黑鸦胸甲。
text.description: 因为我的店铺早就被洗劫一空，如果你真想见识我的手艺，就必须自己去寻找。$b$b黑鸦堡垒士兵的胸甲是我最自豪的杰作之一。它们既轻盈又坚固，能够提供完美的机动性。$b$b让我那些被诅咒的同胞交出他们的胸甲，并带回来给我。到时候，我会向你详细讲解制作胸甲的精妙之处。

english.title: ...And the Anvil
english.objectives: Gather $1oa Black Rook Breastplates from the elves of Black Rook Hold.
english.description: If you truly wish to see my work then you'll have to go and retrieve it as my shop has been raided of everything I've made.$b$bThe breastplates of the Black Rook soldiers were one of my greatest accomplishments. They're light, yet strong and offer great mobility$b$bRelinquish my cursed brethren of their breastplates and bring them back to me. I will explain the finer points of how I made them upon your return.

text.title: 黑鸦知识
text.objectives: 把萨里斯的研究笔记带回达拉然，交给奥拉尔德。
text.description: 你让我得以维护我的尊严，现在我想要报答你。我的研究成果都放在那个底座上面。拿去好好钻研，把我的手艺发扬光大。$b$b再次感谢，$n。

english.title: The Knowledge of Black Rook
english.objectives: Bring Saris' research back to Alard in Dalaran.
english.description: You have honored me with your help and now I wish to return those favors to you. On that pedestal there is all my research. Take it with you and learn from it so you may carry on my legacy.$b$bThank you again, $n.

text.title: 静谧森林
text.objectives: 在达拉然的克拉苏斯平台与大法师卡德加谈一谈。
text.description: 大法师卡德加不久前送来了关于瓦尔莎拉的好消息。$B$B你最好尽快去达拉然的克拉苏斯平台找他。
text.completion: <Archmage Khadgar smiles.>$B$BI rarely get to say this, but I have good news for you, $n.

english.title: The Tranquil Forest
english.objectives: Speak to Archmage Khadgar on Krasus' Landing in Dalaran.
english.description: Archmage Khadgar sent word about Val'sharah not long ago. It sounds like he has good news.$B$BYou should meet him on Krasus' Landing in Dalaran as soon as you are able.
english.completion: <Archmage Khadgar smiles.>$B$BI rarely get to say this, but I have good news for you, $n.

text.title: 孤寂山岭
text.objectives: 在达拉然的克拉苏斯平台与武士奥罗谈一谈。
text.description: 我们收到情报，最近有位至高岭的牛头人使者抵达了达拉然。虽然我们还不知道他的意图，但是他的人民可能成为连接我们与这个地区的重要纽带。$B$B卡德加正在达拉然的克拉苏斯平台会见那位使者，你应该去找他。
text.completion: Greetings champion. I am Warbrave Oro of the Highmountain tauren. I come on the winds of war to find you.
text.giverTarget: 格雷森·沙东布瑞克公爵

english.title: The Lone Mountain
english.objectives: Speak to Warbrave Oro at Krasus' Landing in Dalaran.
english.description: Our sources tell us that a Highmountain tauren emissary has recently arrived in Dalaran. We don't know his intentions, but his people could be an invaluable contact in the region.$B$BKhadgar is greeting the emissary at Krasus' Landing in Dalaran - you should seek him out.
english.completion: Greetings champion. I am Warbrave Oro of the Highmountain tauren. I come on the winds of war to find you.

text.title: 风暴峡湾
text.objectives: 在达拉然的紫罗兰城堡与空军上将罗杰斯谈一谈。
text.description: 空军上将罗杰斯要你到达拉然去见她。$B$B她会在紫罗兰城堡等你。听起来好像有重要的事情。
text.completion: It's an honor, $n.
text.giverTarget: 格雷森·沙东布瑞克公爵

english.title: Stormheim
english.objectives: Speak to Sky Admiral Rogers at the Violet Citadel in Dalaran.
english.description: Sky Admiral Rogers has sent word for you to meet her in Dalaran.$B$BShe should be waiting for you in the Violet Citadel. It sounded important.
english.completion: It's an honor, $n.

text.title: 提拔勇士
text.objectives: 招募阿卡玛和考瓦斯·血棘成为你的勇士。
text.description:
我认为我们应该尽快招揽阿卡玛。我们必须让其他人知道，我们把他当成自己人，而不是一个外人。

考瓦斯·血棘一次次地证明了自己的价值。她拥有无与伦比的战斗能力，这一点毋庸置疑。你找不出第二个像她这样能够轻松制敌的人。

是时候将他们正式提拔为勇士了。

english.title: Into Our Ranks
english.objectives: Recruit Akama and Kor'vas Bloodthorn as your champions.
english.description:
I feel that we should quickly welcome Akama into our ranks. It's important that the others see him treated as one of us, rather than as an outsider.

Kor'vas Bloodthorn has proven herself invaluable, time and time again. Her skills in combat are unquestioned and unparalleled. You will find no champion better suited to destroying our enemies.

It is time to officially raise them up as champions.

text.title: 不屈的大地之环
text.objectives: 前往大漩涡协助大地之环的萨满。风暴召唤者米尔拉会帮你从达拉然的克拉苏斯平台飞过去。
text.description: 我们在破碎海滩的失利对这场战争有决定性影响。燃烧军团在艾泽拉斯建立了据点，我们的精锐部队正在仓皇撤退。$b$b大地之环长者们在我们世界的心脏——大漩涡发起了紧急议会。$n，你在艾泽拉斯和德拉诺的功绩铸就了一段佳话传奇。现在，我们比以往任何时候更需要你的帮助。$b$b到大漩涡去和我汇合吧。风暴召唤者米尔拉很快会飞往那里——到达拉然的克拉苏斯平台去找她。

english.title: A Ring Unbroken
english.objectives: Aid the shaman of the Earthen Ring at the Maelstrom. Stormcaller Mylra will fly you there from Krasus' Landing in Dalaran.
english.description: Our defeat at the Broken Shore was decisive. The Burning Legion has a foothold on Azeroth, and the best of our armies are retreating in tatters.$b$bThe elders of the Earthen Ring have called an emergency council near the heart of our world - the Maelstrom. $n, your triumphs throughout Azeroth and Draenor are the stuff of legend. We need you more than ever.$b$bJoin me at the Maelstrom. Stormcaller Mylra will be flying there shortly - find her at Krasus' Landing here in Dalaran.

objectiveDetails.description: 在大漩涡协助萨满祭司
和米尔拉一起飞往大漩涡

text.title: 计划周全
text.objectives: 选择你在破碎群岛的首个攻击目标。
text.description: 燃烧军团还以为我们在破碎海滩之役中萎靡不振。他们以为我们无力反击。$B$B我们要证明他们大错特错。$B$B我们一直正在努力调查破碎群岛的地形以及各个区域的情报，为即将发起的突袭做准备。$B$B等你查看地图以后，应该尽快前往达拉然，然后直捣黄龙。$B$B我们要彻底结束这疯狂的战争。愿圣光保佑我们。
text.completion: Good luck out there! We're all in this together.

english.title: A Sound Plan
english.objectives: Select your first assault point on the Broken Isles.
english.description: The Legion still believes us crippled from the Broken Shore. They think we are unable to fight back.$B$BLet's prove them wrong.$B$BWe've been hard at work mapping out the Broken Isles, learning everything we can about each region for our imminent assault.$B$BOnce you've had a chance to peruse the map, you should leave for Dalaran at once and charge into the maw of the beast.$B$BWe will end this madness for good. Light help us all.
english.completion: Good luck out there! We're all in this together.

enders.name: 格雷森·沙东布瑞克公爵

text.title: 保持领先
text.objectives: 在阿彻鲁斯与攻城锻造宗师科弗斯谈一谈。
text.description: 你好，死亡领主。你携带的武器虽然已经十分强大，但是仍然拥有可以挖掘的潜能。只要你不断收割敌人的灵魂，武器的威力就会随之增强。$b$b铁匠宗师科弗斯研究出了新的技术，或许对你有所帮助，领主大人。$b$b你可以在上层的熔炉那边看到他忙碌的身影。

english.title: Keeping Your Edge
english.objectives: Speak with Grand Master Siegesmith Corvus in Acherus.
english.description: Greetings, Deathlord. The blades you hold, while magnificent, have much untapped potential. As you harvest the souls of your enemies their power will continue to grow.$b$bGrand Master Corvus has studied new techniques that may be of use to you, $gmy lord:my lady;.$b$bYou can find him working the forges on the upper level.

objectiveDetails.description: 使用传送器前往阿彻鲁斯的第二层

text.title: 精进符刻
text.objectives: 用灵魂熔炉强化你的神器。
text.description:
多年以来，我一直在尝试改造熔炉。这把武器可以充分展现出他们的最新设计，灵魂熔炉的价值！

我们可以把你的神器放入熔炉加以锤炼，使它能够发挥出内在的力量，不过前提是武器已经吸收了足够的灵魂。要不要试试？

english.title: Advanced Runecarving
english.objectives: Use the Soul Forge to empower your Artifact.
english.description:
I've been working for many years to improve the forges. This weapon will be the perfect demonstration of the Soul Forge, their latest design!

We can take your artifact to the forge and shape it to make use of the power it contains, provided you've fed your weapon enough souls first. Let's give it a little try, eh?

objectiveDetails.description: 使用灵魂熔炉为你的神器灌魔

text.title: 邪能为谁鸣
text.objectives: 从苏拉玛的虫语爪牙身上取得$1oa个邪能之核。完成以后，把它们交给达拉然的马修。
text.description: <马修一边对你上下打量，一边小声嘀咕着>$b$b想让我教你认识这块矿石？你得先帮我做点事。$b$b燃烧军团带来了许多邪恶的机器，想要征服这个世界。那些机器由充满邪能的核心来供能，并且由最底层的恶魔负责配送。$b$b给我找些核心来，我就会把你想知道的事情告诉你。

english.title: For Whom the Fel Tolls
english.objectives: Obtain $1oa Fel Energy Cores from Wyrmtongue Minions in Suramar. Bring them back to Matthew in Dalaran when you are finished.
english.description: <Matthew eyes you up and down, growling slightly>$b$bYou wish me to help you understand this rock? First you do something for me.$b$bThe legion has brought many of its fel machines to conquer this world. Those machines are powered by cores filled with fel energy. And those cores are carried by the lowliest of their minions for distribution.$b$bBring me some cores and I'll give you the information you need.

text.title: 致命水晶
text.objectives: 从泥吻巢穴的狗头人身上找回灵魂牢笼。
text.description:
我和护魂者乌拉需要把恶魔俘虏移交给阿苏纳的阿莱利，但是我们在途中遭到了狗头人的袭击。

那些无脑的生物抢走了我们囚禁恶魔俘虏的灵魂牢笼。

那些水晶或许耀眼，但是它们相当致命。如果水晶有任何破损，里面的恶魔可能就会逃出来。

到附近的洞穴去找回灵魂牢笼，以免为时已晚。
text.completion: Is this all you could find?$b$bWhile I'm grateful to have these gems in my possession once again, it seems that there are still a few missing. I fear they've been broken, which means the demons within have escaped.

english.title: Shiny, But Deadly
english.objectives: Collect Soul Chambers from kobolds within Mucksnout Den.
english.description:
Soulkeeper Uriah and I were transporting demon prisoners to Allari in Azsuna when our caravan was attacked by kobolds.

Those mindless vermin made off with the soul chambers that house our demonic captives.

The crystals may be shiny, but they're also deadly. If they are damaged in any way, the demons trapped within may escape.

Head into the cave nearby and recover the soul chambers before it's too late.
english.completion: Is this all you could find?$b$bWhile I'm grateful to have these gems in my possession once again, it seems that there are still a few missing. I fear they've been broken, which means the demons within have escaped.

text.title: 取而“戴”之
text.objectives: 从蓝烛碎颅队长身上拿到指挥之颅。
text.description:
在我离世的数百年之中，墓地从未经受到过如此的骚扰……此地的狗头人首领盗走了我的颅骨，还把它带在自己的头上！

他就在下面的洞穴深处，不过那里有一扇门会拦住你的去路。狗头人通过佩戴的颅骨来辨认首领，不过他们智力底下——如果你也佩戴一个颅骨，他们肯定会把你当首领的。

去消灭一个碎颅队长，拿到他的指挥之颅之后也许他们就会让你进入洞穴。
text.completion: This will work perfectly, I believe.

english.title: Wax On, Wax Off
english.objectives: Recover the Skull of Bossing Around from the Bluewax Skullcaptain.
english.description:
I've been dead for centuries without having my grave so disturbed... The leader of the local kobolds has stolen my skull from my grave and wears it upon his head!

He's down in the cave below, but a gate blocks your path from retrieving it directly. Kobolds know their leadership by the skulls they wear, and they are unintelligent enough to believe you their leader if you have one yourself.

Kill one of their Skullcaptains and recover his Skull of Bossing Around, and they may let you into the cave.
english.completion: This will work perfectly, I believe.

text.title: 墓上蓝烛
text.objectives: 消灭$1oa个蓝烛盗墓贼。
text.description:
这些狗头人在对天角部族的袭击中尝到了甜头。他们骚扰我们的墓地，偷走一切能带走的东西。

但是我却无能为力！请帮忙把狗头人赶出这片神圣的墓地。
text.completion: Some of them seem to be digging less enthusiastically, at the very least.

english.title: Candle to the Grave
english.objectives: Slay $1oa Bluewax Graverobbers.
english.description:
These kobolds are taking advantage of the attacks against the Skyhorn tribe. They disturb our graves and steal anything they can get their paws on.

I can do nothing to stop them! Please rid this sacred burial ground of the kobold.
english.completion: Some of them seem to be digging less enthusiastically, at the very least.

text.title: 蜡烛大门
text.objectives: 和蓝烛守门人谈谈，看看他让不让你进去找蜡烛大王。
text.description: 去跟蓝烛守门人谈谈，看他让不让你进去找蜡烛大王。要是带上颅骨能让你进门的话，那忍受难闻的气味也是值得的。
text.completion: What you want, stinky?

english.title: The Gates of Wax
english.objectives: Speak with the Bluewax Gatekeeper and see if he will let you in to meet the Candleking.
english.description: Go talk to the Bluewax Gatekeeper and see if he will let you through to the Candleking. If you can get through by donning the skull, the smell will be worth it.
english.completion: What you want, stinky?

text.title: Burn the Candle at Both Ends [NOT USED]
text.objectives: Acquire the Yellow Candle and Green Candle.
text.description: You no come in yet! You need yellow candle and green candle before let in to Candleking!

english.title: Burn the Candle at Both Ends [NOT USED]
english.objectives: Acquire the Yellow Candle and Green Candle.
english.description: You no come in yet! You need yellow candle and green candle before let in to Candleking!

text.title: 雷霆之声
text.objectives: 前往白虎寺，证明你有能力驾驭风暴之神的武器！
text.description: 白虎为渴求风暴铸就的武器的人准备了一系列挑战。$b$b现在你已经知道它们的威力——那是莱登在泰坦时代所使用的武器。$b$b来吧！我曾经带领竞技队伍打遍三个大陆，从未遇上敌手。有我帮你，绝对输不了！

english.title: The Voice of Thunder
english.objectives: Travel to the Temple of the White Tiger and prove yourself worthy to wield the weapons of storm!
english.description: The White Tiger has prepared a series of challenges for everyone who wants to possess the weapons of the storm.$b$bNow you know of their power - these are the very artifacts that Ra-den himself wielded during the age of the Titans.$b$bCome! I have led arena teams to victory across three continents. With me in your corner, you cannot lose!

text.title: 熄灭蜡烛
text.objectives: 从蜡烛大王身上找回奥妮娅之颅。
text.description: 好吧，就让你进去跟蜡烛大王打个招呼。
text.completion: Thank the spirits! These kobolds do not honor their ancestors in the way we do. I can rest peacefully now.

english.title: Can't Hold a Candle To You
english.objectives: Recover Oenia's Skull from the Candleking.
english.description: Okay guess you can go say hi to Candleking now.
english.completion: Thank the spirits! These kobolds do not honor their ancestors in the way we do. I can rest peacefully now.

text.title: 护魂者的命运
text.objectives: 在泥吻巢穴中寻找护魂者乌拉。
text.description:
虽然护魂者乌拉在狗头人的袭击中受了伤，但是他坚持深入洞穴去找回失窃的灵魂碎片。他让我在这看着剩余的补给等他回来，但是我只怕天有不测风云。

请你去寻找乌拉。他是唯一一个知道如何困住恶魔的人。
text.completion: Uriah would not want me to waste time with tears. My mourning can wait until the escaped demons are trapped once again.

english.title: The Soulkeeper's Fate
english.objectives: Find Soulkeeper Uriah within Mucksnout Den.
english.description:
Soulkeeper Uriah was injured in the kobold attack, but insisted on venturing further into the cave to recover the stolen soul shards. He told me to wait here with our remaining supplies until he returned, but I fear the worst.

Please find Uriah. He is the only one who knows how to trap the demons.
english.completion: Uriah would not want me to waste time with tears. My mourning can wait until the escaped demons are trapped once again.

text.title: 恶魔羁押
text.objectives: 削弱恶魔，让学徒罗萨琳用灵魂牢笼困住它们。
text.description:
我们必须抓住逃跑的恶魔。不要把它们杀死，乌拉受托将俘虏移交给阿莱利进行审问，我会完成他的使命。

我看过乌拉困住许多恶魔。看起来……很复杂，不过我相信自己也能做到，只是需要你先制服它们。
text.completion: Thank you for you help, $n. I will honor Uriah's memory by completing our journey to Azsuna and delivering the demon prisoners to Allari as planned.

english.title: Demon Detainment
english.objectives: Weaken demons so Apprentice Rosalyn can trap them within a soul chamber.
english.description:
The demons that escaped must be detained. Killing them is not an option. Uriah was entrusted to deliver the prisoners to Allari for interrogation, and I will not let him fail.

I've seen Uriah trap many demons. It seems... complicated, but I think I can pull it off. I'll just need you to subdue them first.
english.completion: Thank you for you help, $n. I will honor Uriah's memory by completing our journey to Azsuna and delivering the demon prisoners to Allari as planned.

text.title: 雷铸爪钩枪
text.completion: This looks like one of the grapple launchers the local vrykul use to scale the steep ridges in Stormheim.$B$BThis could come in handy.

english.title: Stormforged Grapple Launcher
english.completion: This looks like one of the grapple launchers the local vrykul use to scale the steep ridges in Stormheim.$B$BThis could come in handy.

text.title: 蠕虫大军
text.objectives: 消灭纳克萨、阿萨克斯，以及泽斯特。
text.description: 我们后方的雪鬃村对这种规模的攻击毫无抵御之力。我会在这里拖住卓格巴尔的战线，尽量争取时间让村民们撤离。$b$b卓格巴尔利用蠕虫挖掘的地道钻出地面，发动强攻。$b$b我要你率领我们的部队，消灭蠕虫并切断敌人的增援。
text.completion: That should slow these invaders down.

english.title: Battle Worms
english.objectives: Slay Naxa, Arxas, and Xist.
english.description: Snowmane Village behind us was caught completely off guard by the scale of this attack. I will hold the drogbar line here so the civilians have time to prepare their evacuation.$b$bThe drogbar are using worms to burrow their way to the surface and deploy their troops.$b$bI am giving you command of our forces. Use them to slay these worms and cut off enemy reinforcements.
english.completion: That should slow these invaders down.

text.title: 争取时间
text.objectives: 消灭$1oa个巨石卓格巴尔。
text.description: 我们需要时间来疏散雪鬃村的人民。你可以去对抗巨石卓格巴尔，尽量削减他们的数量吗？$b$b我会派出治疗者去把所有无法战斗的百姓转移到安全的地方。
text.completion: Excellent. Thank you, Champion.$b$bWe have managed to get the children and the wounded to safety thanks to your efforts.

english.title: Buy Us Time
english.objectives: Slay $1oa Mightstone drogbar.
english.description: We need time to evacuate Snowmane Village. Can you take the fight to these Mightstone drogbar and cull their numbers?$b$bI will direct my healers to get everyone that is unable to fight to safety.
english.completion: Excellent. Thank you, Champion.$b$bWe have managed to get the children and the wounded to safety thanks to your efforts.

text.title: 地底之王
text.objectives: 攻击地底之王达古尔。
text.description: 梅拉已经追进地底之王的洞穴了。我们一直警告孩子们，千万不能做出这样危险的事情。$b$b真是鲁莽……但是，长命百岁有什么用？我们去和她并肩作战吧。
text.completion: Dargrul is just postponing the inevitable.

english.title: The Underking
english.objectives: Assault Dargrul the Underking.
english.description: Mayla already chased the Underking into his cave. That is something we tell our children never to do.$b$bReckless child, but hey, who wants to live forever? Let us join her in battle.
english.completion: Dargrul is just postponing the inevitable.

text.title: 奈萨里奥的巢穴
text.objectives: 夺回卡兹格罗斯之锤。
text.description: 我会带着我的人在乱石中开出一条道路，从正面攻击达古尔的部队。$b$b这是为了声东击西。$b$B我觉得纳瓦罗格的计划行得通。他知道一个侧面入口，从那可以直通达古尔的老巢。$b$b带上你的所有盟友，从侧面直捣黄龙。请赶在魔头把我们埋在深山地底之前，夺回卡兹格罗斯之锤。$b$b我们会尽量分散敌人的注意力，为你创造最佳的进攻机会。
text.giverWindow: 他拿着失窃的卡兹格罗斯之锤。

english.title: Neltharion's Lair
english.objectives: Recover the Hammer of Khaz'goroth.
english.description: I will direct my people to clear a path through this rubble and assault Dargrul's forces directly.$b$bIt will be a ruse.$b$BNavarrogg proposed a plan that I believe has merit. He knows of a side entrance that might lead directly to Dargrul.$b$bMuster what allies of yours you can and strike at them through this side passage. Recover the Hammer of Khaz'goroth before that villain brings the mountain down on top of us.$b$bWe will provide the distraction you need to get a shot.
english.giverWindow: He wields the stolen Hammer of Khaz'goroth.

text.title: 狩猎赌博
text.objectives: 在石痕峡谷从岩牙身上收集岩牙的颚骨。
text.description:
第二个目标是一只叫做岩牙的蜥蜴，它经常在附近的河边觅食。

我在它身上赌了更多的钱，如果你把它解决掉，我一定会给你分成。

把它的下巴交给我，证明你比那些牛头人先一步干掉它！
text.giverWindow: 一只让风暴峡湾的维库人惊恐万分的巨型蜥蜴。

english.title: A Stone Cold Gamble
english.objectives: Collect Stonefang's Jaw from Stonefang in Stonescar Gorge.
english.description:
The second target is a basilisk called Stonefang that lives off the bank of the nearby river. 

I put a bigger wager on him, so if you can take him out I'll make sure you get a cut.

I'll need his jaw to verify the kill. Hurry, before those tauren get him first!
english.giverWindow: A massive basilisk terrorizing the vrykul of Stormheim.

text.title: 重金赌注
text.objectives: 在裂风丘陵诱杀怨羽并取得怨羽的喙。
text.description:
好伙计，你愿意帮我赢得赌注吗？

那些牛头人属于天角部族，他们自诩是一流猎手。我花了一大笔钱跟他们打赌，赌他们没办法除掉风暴峡湾的一些强大野兽。

如果你在他们之前干掉那些野兽，我就把赢的钱分你一份。怎么样？

第一个目标是一只在丘陵筑巢的巨鹰，名叫怨羽。你可以用鲜肉诱杀它，不过它的巢很高，你需要一把爪钩枪才能上去。我记得这附近就有一把……
text.giverWindow: 一只在裂风丘陵上空捕猎的巨鹰。

english.title: Rigging the Wager
english.objectives: Lure down and defeat Spitefeather to collect Spitefeather's Beak in the Stormtorn Foothills.
english.description:
Care to help settle a bet, chum?

Those tauren are Skyhorn, and they fancy themselves big-time hunters. I bet them a pretty penny that they wouldn't be able to take out some of the biggest beasts in Stormheim.

If you take em out before they do, I'll split the wager. Deal?

The first is a big eagle nesting in the foothills. They call him Spitefeather. You can bait him with some meat, but he's up pretty high, so you'll need a grapple gun to get there. I think there's one of them layin around here...
english.giverWindow: A giant eagle that hunts the Stormtorn Foothills.

text.title: 符文林地的复仇
text.objectives: 在符文林地消灭8名骨语符文斧兵和8名骨语切割者。
text.description:
骨语者……他们被腐化了……并且极端渴求力量。

把他们赶出我的林地……
text.completion: The Runewood will know peace once more with these Bonespeakers removed from the land. $B$BIt is a good beginning.

english.title: The Runewood's Revenge
english.objectives: Kill 8 Bonespeaker Runeaxes and 8 Bonespeaker Carvers in the Runewood.
english.description:
The Bonespeakers...they are corrupt... hungry for power.

Cut them from my woods...
english.completion: The Runewood will know peace once more with these Bonespeakers removed from the land. $B$BIt is a good beginning.

text.title: 过度掠食
text.objectives: 在坠珀台地消灭10头暮皮啸狼。
text.description:
你好，旅行者！欢迎你在我们营地歇脚。如果你想多呆上一阵子的话，我倒是有一个提议。

如你所见，这片土地物产丰富，大自然赐予了我们肥美的食物。不过，最近啸狼过度掠食牲畜，已经成为一大祸患。

我没办法对付整个狼群，所以我将重金悬赏，请人消灭台地的啸狼。等你削减了狼群数量以后再回来找我。

english.title: Eating Into Our Business
english.objectives: Kill 10 Duskpelt worg in Amberfall Mesa.
english.description:
Greetings traveler! You are welcome to rest at our camp, but if you plan on sticking around a while, I have a proposition for you.

As you can see, the land here has been very good to us, providing a great natural bounty. Lately, however, the worg have become problematic, and are thinning the herds to unacceptable levels.

I can't take care of them all, so I will offer a bounty for every worg slain in the mesa. Return to me when you have culled their pack a bit.

text.title: 地狱硫磺理论
text.objectives: 把硫磺样本带给达拉然下水道的马修·莱比斯。
text.description: 我已经研究过你收集的报告，并且有了一个理论。如我们所知，这个世界的矿石都是经历压强和环境变化，长时间演变而来的。$b$b但是，你带来的这块地狱硫磺却被恶魔魔法加快了演变过程，很像是冰冠堡垒的萨隆邪铁。$b$b如果要验证这个理论，我们就需要魔法师的帮助。$b$b带着这块硫磺去找马修·莱比斯，他或许知道该怎么为它注入新的生命。

english.title: Infernal Brimstone Theory
english.objectives: Take the brimstone sample to Matthew Rabis in the Underbelly.
english.description: I've gone through all the research ye gathered for me and I've come up with a theory. As we know, the ore in this world develops over time, through pressure and environmental changes.$b$bBut the Infernal Brimstone ye gave me had its growth accelerated through demonic magic, much like the saronite of Icecrown.$b$bIf we're wantin' to test this out, we'll have to get the help of some magic-users.$b$bTake this brimstone back and go see Matthew Rabis. He may know how to breathe life into it.

text.title: 入土为安
text.objectives: 用符文木枝让8个弱化的无法安息的先祖重返大地。
text.description:
我想请你帮个忙，外来者。

在你经过先祖英雄之墓时，一定会遇到被骨语者的恶行所惊扰的不安灵魂。必须让他们回到埋葬的土地里，才能得到审判。

拿着这根木枝，它有符文林地的精华。把它的能量引入被削弱的灵魂，就可以让灵魂再次安息。
text.completion: I see you carry a branch of the Runewood. Then it was you who laid the spirits to rest? $B$BThough I do not know your purpose, outsider, I appreciate what you have done for our people.

english.title: Lay Them to Rest
english.objectives: Use the Branch of the Runewood to send 8 weakened Restless Ancestors back to the earth.
english.description:
I would ask a favor, outsider.

As you step through the graves of ancient heroes, you will no doubt come across spirits of the restless dead, agitated by the Bonespeakers misdeeds. They must be returned to the earth where they are buried, so that they may be judged as well.

Take this bough - it carries with it the essence of the Runewood. Channel its power into a weakened spirit, and it will return to rest.
english.completion: I see you carry a branch of the Runewood. Then it was you who laid the spirits to rest? $B$BThough I do not know your purpose, outsider, I appreciate what you have done for our people.

objectiveDetails.description: 让无法安息的先祖入土为安

text.title: 肉排储备
text.objectives: 在尤顿林地从健壮的高地符角牛身上收集$1oa块多肉的麝牛肋排。
text.description:
反正你还在等那些牛头人回来，不如顺便去找些食物。他们的肉快吃光了，如果你搞来一些鲜肉，他们一定会非常感激。

听说麝牛肋排是这里的特产。这边的野生麝牛瘦得可怜，身上没有什么好肉，不过河对面倒是有好些肥美的麝牛。你应该过去看看！

别担心，我很确定那里没有什么恶龙……

english.title: A Stack of Racks
english.objectives: Collect $1oa Meaty Racks of Musken Ribs from Stout Highland Runehorns in Jotunnwood.
english.description:
So while we're waiting here, maybe you could fetch us up some grub. Them tauren were runnin low on meats, so I'm sure they'd be thankful to have more.

I hear that musken ribs are the specialty here.  The wild musken here are too lean for any good meat, but across the river there are some nice fat ones. Maybe you should check those out!

Don't worry, I'm pretty sure there aren't any dragons over there...

text.title: 极品货物
text.objectives: 在纳斯托迪尔从银尾高山羊身上收集18堆上等山羊毛。
text.description:
这么说，你很擅长狩猎，是吗？或许你可以帮这些牛头人囤点稀有毛皮。我敢说，他们回来之后一定会感谢你的！

听说风暴峡湾的羊毛用途很广。最一流的要属银尾羊的毛皮。我好像在那座山上看到一些银尾羊。

不如你去搞一些回来？我保证牛头人会给你丰厚的报酬！

english.title: Only the Finest
english.objectives: Collect 18 Patches of Fine Goat Hair from Silvertail Mountain Goats in Nastrondir.
english.description:
Say, you're a pretty good hunter, eh? Maybe you could help these tauren out by stocking them with some rare furs. I'm sure they'd appreciate it when they got back!

I hear that Stormheim goat hair can be woven into all kinds of things. The rarest are from the silver-tail goats. I think I saw some in that mountain over there.

Why don't you go and fetch some? I'm sure them tauren would pay you handsomely!

text.title: 前往霍斯瓦尔德
text.objectives: 到符文林地去见维德哈尔。
text.description:
下一步非常明显，你的双脚知道怎么走。跟着直觉到霍斯瓦尔德去迎接你的命运！

你要寻找一颗树木——神秘的符文林地之心。他将给你指引，甚至给你他的枝叶。
text.completion: Bound... twisted... $B$BThe Bonespeakers...

english.title: To Haustvald
english.objectives: Meet with Vydhar in the Runewood.
english.description:
Your next steps are clear, your feet know the way. Follow them to Haustvald and meet your fate!

It is the tree you seek, the heart of the mystic Runewood. He will offer guidance, and probably leaves.
english.completion: Bound... twisted... $B$BThe Bonespeakers...

text.title: 下一步计划
text.objectives: 选出组织的首个攻击地点。
text.description: 你注意到环绕在身边的雾气了吗？阿彻鲁斯的寒风提供了一道完美的屏障，让我们躲过了燃烧军团窥探的眼睛！$b$b在雾气的掩饰之下，我们成功派出侦察小队，绘制出破碎群岛的完整地图。$b$b选出我们从哪里开始出击。当然，你将成为光荣的先锋力量，而黑锋骑士团的其他人将跟随你的领导。

english.title: Our Next Move
english.objectives: Select your order's first assault point.
english.description: Have you seen the fog that surrounds us? The chill winds of Acherus have provided us with a perfect concealment from the prying eyes of the Legion!$b$bUnder cover of this fog we've been able to send out scouting teams who've put together a fairly comprehensive map of the Broken Isles.$b$bChoose where we shall begin our assault.
