You, of course, shall have the honor of spearheading our efforts, but the rest of the Ebon Blade will follow your lead.

text.title: 格雷迈恩的尝试
text.objectives: 完成天火号上的格雷迈恩的任务。
text.description:
天火号已经准备好前往风暴峡湾了。一旦我们到达战场，我就会命令手下最为精锐的战士赶往前线。

这之中也包括了你，$c。
text.completion: It seems you were spared the brunt of the explosion. If only Greymane were so lucky...$B$BOn your feet! We had better get a move on before the Forsaken are on top of us!

english.title: Greymane's Gambit
english.objectives: Complete Greymane's mission aboard the Skyfire.
english.description:
The Skyfire is prepared to make way to Stormheim. Should we become engaged, I will require my best fighters on the front line.

This includes you, $c.
english.completion: It seems you were spared the brunt of the explosion. If only Greymane were so lucky...$B$BOn your feet! We had better get a move on before the Forsaken are on top of us!

text.title: 分裂的舰队
text.objectives: 完成希尔瓦娜斯的任务，将舰队带往风暴峡湾。
text.description:
我们已经准备周全，随时可以起航。

我们必须立刻出击。别再浪费时间了，否则就要丢下你了。

english.title: The Splintered Fleet
english.objectives: Complete Sylvanas' mission to bring the fleet to Stormheim.
english.description:
Preparations have been made, and we are ready to set sail.

We must strike out at once. Do not dally, or you will be left behind.

objectiveDetails.description: 完成希尔瓦娜斯的任务

text.title: 试炼继续
text.objectives: 在瓦狄斯丹与哈维见面。
text.description:
<乌鸦凝视着你，你的脑海中响起了哈维的声音>

想要试炼勇气，就得面对骨语！ 

不过，你必须做好周全的准备！
text.completion: Ah, the hero of the hour! We must waste no time! $B$BOur business at hand is most important if you wish to succeed in your trials!

english.title: The Trials Continue
english.objectives: Meet with Havi in Valdisdall.
english.description:
<Havi's voice continues in your head as the raven stares on>

If valor you seek, then to the bones you must speak! 

But first you must prepare!
english.completion: Ah, the hero of the hour! We must waste no time! $B$BOur business at hand is most important if you wish to succeed in your trials!

text.title: 话说骨语
text.objectives: 帮哈维切好鹿肉，并了解你的下一个试炼。
text.description:
勇气试炼是你的下一项考验，极其艰难！

但是只有傻子才会空着肚子就上战场。你是傻子吗，外来者？

不是？那就帮我这把老骨头一个忙，切好驼鹿给我们填饱肚子。我会跟你讲诉一个关于石头、树木和灵魂的故事。
text.completion: A fine cut, I must say. $B$BYes, you will do well against the Bonespeakers, I think.

english.title: Speaking of Bones
english.objectives: Help Havi butcher the moose and learn about your next trial.
english.description:
The Trial of Valor will be your next test, and test you it will!

But only a fool fights on an empty stomach. Are you a fool, outsider?

No? Then lend these old bones a hand and butcher the moose for our meal. I will spin you a tale of rocks, trees and spirits.
english.completion: A fine cut, I must say. $B$BYes, you will do well against the Bonespeakers, I think.

text.title: 勇士：萨萨里安
text.objectives: 迎接新骑士。
text.description: 死亡领主，我找到了那位特殊的骑士。他希望能够重回黑锋骑士团，而且他希望能和你谈谈。$b$b<莫格莱尼转身对旁边的一个守卫点了点头。>$b$b他一会儿就到。

english.title: Champion: Thassarian
english.objectives: Welcome your new knight.
english.description: Deathlord, I've found our wayward knight. He wishes to return to the Ebon Blade, in particular he wishes to speak with you himself.$b$b<Mograine turns and nods to a nearby guard.>$b$bHe should be here momentarily.

text.title: 硫磺的秘密
text.objectives: 把马修告诉你的事情转告给迪格丝大妈。
text.description: 在你帮我收集我要的东西时，我对硫磺做了一些测试。在我向它引导魔法的时候，它的反应十分剧烈。需要相当精妙的施法才能制造出它的母体。$b$b除非有一大群恶魔施法者来帮你，否则绝对不可能重新制造出这样的生物。$b$b我能告诉你的就这些了。快走吧，在我饿昏头之前，离我越远越好。

english.title: The Brimstone's Secret
english.objectives: Tell Mama Diggs what you learned from Matthew.
english.description: While you were gathering what I asked of you, I did a little testing on the brimstone. It reacted rather violently when I channeled onto it. Careful casting went into making the creature from whom you took this.$b$bUnless you have a host of demon spell-casters at your disposal, recreating such a creature would be impossible.$b$bThat's all I have to tell you. Go now and leave me before my hunger takes over.

text.title: 勇士：纳兹戈林
text.objectives: 迎接新骑士。
text.description: 死亡领主，我找到了那位特殊的骑士。他希望能够重回黑锋骑士团，而且他希望能和你谈谈。$b$b<莫格莱尼转身对旁边的一个守卫点了点头。>$b$b他一会儿就到。

english.title: Champion: Nazgrim
english.objectives: Welcome your new knight.
english.description: Deathlord, I've found our wayward knight. He wishes to return to the Ebon Blade, in particular he wishes to speak with you himself.$b$b<Mograine turns and nods to a nearby guard.>$b$bHe should be here momentarily.

text.title: 地狱火堡垒：地狱火和硫磺
text.objectives: 集结队伍，再次挺进地狱火堡垒。打败阿克蒙德并找到地狱火抄本。
text.description: 卡德加的队伍在攻打地狱火堡垒时遭遇了许多恶魔头目，其中最强大的莫过于阿克蒙德。$b$b或许他的尸体上会有一些线索，可以帮助我揭开这块硫磺最后的神秘面纱。

english.title: Hellfire Citadel: Hellfire and Brimstone
english.objectives: Gather a group and storm Hellfire Citadel once more. Defeat Archimonde and recover the Infernal Codex.
english.description: When Khadgar's group stormed Hellfire Citadel, they faced many foes that commanded demons, but none more powerful than Archimonde himself.$b$bPerhaps there's somethin' on his corpse that can answer the final questions of unlocking the mystery of this brimstone.

text.title: 计划与筹备
text.objectives: 与女妖希奥克丝谈一谈。
text.description: 你的武器现在无比强大，但是它还需要更多的灵魂才能发挥真正的潜力。$b$b希奥克丝一直在收集斥候的报告，她会告诉你敌人的位置，以便你索取他们尖叫的灵魂来进一步强化你的武器。

english.title: Plans and Preparations
english.objectives: Speak to Siouxsie the Banshee.
english.description: Your weapon is stronger than ever, but it will need many more souls in order to reach its true potential.$b$bSiouxsie has been collecting reports from the scouts, she will direct you to our enemies and their screaming souls will empower your weapon further.

text.title: 冥狱搜寻
text.objectives: 在冥狱深渊搜寻被囚禁的维库人，找到能帮你逃走的灵魂。
text.description:
这里是卑贱亡者的领域——冥狱深渊。在这里，渺小的灵魂永无止尽地战斗着，追求那永远无法获得的荣耀，其实一切都是徒劳。

我们不该留在这里。

我们必须找到出路。我会到前面去侦察，你应该尝试释放几个被囚禁在这里的灵魂，或许他们当中有人可以帮助我们。
text.completion: Free at last! $B$BThe kvaldir caught me while I was tryin' to put together a plan to sneak past that foul dog, Guarm, and have had me locked up ever since! $B$BI thought surely my fate was sealed.

english.title: An Unworthy Task
english.objectives: Search among the caged vrykul in Helheim for one who can help your escape.
english.description:
This place is Helheim, the realm of the unworthy dead. Here, the spirits of the dishonorable spend eternity in an endless futile battle, always seeking glory but never able to attain it.

We should not be here.

We must find a way out. I will scout ahead - you should try and release some of these captive spirits here. Perhaps one may have some answers for us.
english.completion: Free at last! $B$BThe kvaldir caught me while I was tryin' to put together a plan to sneak past that foul dog, Guarm, and have had me locked up ever since! $B$BI thought surely my fate was sealed.

text.title: Fire!
text.objectives: Use Camille Kleister's Water Buckets to put out the fire.
text.description: You! Adventurer! Give us a hand! The wagon's caught fire!

english.title: Fire!
english.objectives: Use Camille Kleister's Water Buckets to put out the fire.
english.description: You! Adventurer! Give us a hand! The wagon's caught fire!

text.title: 神秘粉尘
text.objectives: 与商人塞林、帕林教授，以及德崔斯·瓦德拉讨论神秘粉尘的事情。
text.description: 货车里的东西几乎被烧了个精光，只留下了一小堆粉尘。$b$b货车属于商人塞林，或许他会更清楚到底发生了什么。$b$b至于粉尘——铭文训练师和炼金训练师应该会有些见解。

english.title: Mysterious Dust
english.objectives: Speak with Trader Caelen, Professor Pallin, and Deucus Valdera about the Mysterious Dust.
english.description: Nearly everything in the wagon was obliterated by the fire. All that remains is a small pile of dust.$b$bThe cart belonged to Trader Caelen. Perhaps he knows more about what happened.$b$bAs for the dust - either the inscription trainers or the alchemy trainers might have some insight.

text.title: The Council's Approval
text.objectives: Speak with Khadgar in Dalaran, and ask for permission to build an Obliterum Forge.
text.description: Those results certainly were disappointing. Calcination is a tricky process, better reserved for alchemists and blacksmiths. Still, I thought we'd get more than a measly TWO GRAINS of obliterum.$b$bFor a more efficient reaction, we'll need a special forge, and to get that...$b$b...we'll need permission from the Council of Six.

english.title: The Council's Approval
english.objectives: Speak with Khadgar in Dalaran, and ask for permission to build an Obliterum Forge.
english.description: Those results certainly were disappointing. Calcination is a tricky process, better reserved for alchemists and blacksmiths. Still, I thought we'd get more than a measly TWO GRAINS of obliterum.$b$bFor a more efficient reaction, we'll need a special forge, and to get that...$b$b...we'll need permission from the Council of Six.

objectiveDetails.description: Gain approval to build an Obliterum Forge

text.title: Friends in Low Places
text.objectives: Report to Oxana Demonslay in the Underbelly.
text.description: My contact is one Oxana Demonslay. She has declined invitation to Dalaran proper, preferring to stay in the sewers of the Underbelly.$b$bIf there is anybody on this rock that knows how to properly build an Obliterum Forge, it is her.$b$bOh, and watch your back while you're down there, $n.

english.title: Friends in Low Places
english.objectives: Report to Oxana Demonslay in the Underbelly.
english.description: My contact is one Oxana Demonslay. She has declined invitation to Dalaran proper, preferring to stay in the sewers of the Underbelly.$b$bIf there is anybody on this rock that knows how to properly build an Obliterum Forge, it is her.$b$bOh, and watch your back while you're down there, $n.

text.title: 法师的垃圾
text.objectives: 找到一瓶炼金烈焰、一卷缚法隔离层，以及一个报废的加热器。$b$b只有在达拉然下水道守卫停止执勤时才能获取。
text.description: 我不仅可以帮你建造熔炉，甚至还能为你提供所需的金属。不过，我还需要一些……更难获取的材料。$b$b包括炼金热源、隔离材料和加热装置。这些东西都能在下水道找到……怕就怕那些守卫会来阻挠。

english.title: One Mage's Trash
english.objectives: Find a vial of Alchemical Flame, a roll of Spellbound Insulation, and a Decommissioned Calefactor.$b$bThese items can only be obtained while the Dalaran Sewer Guards are off duty.
english.description: I can help you build your forge. I can even supply the metal for it. I do, however, require a few more... difficult-to-acquire components.$b$bI need an alchemical heat source, some sort of insulator, and a calefactor. I'm certain that all of these can be found here in the Underbelly... if the guards are looking the other way.

text.title: 善用淤泥
text.objectives: 获取20瓶法术残渣。$b$b在达拉然下水道守卫执勤期间，可以从强大的下水道生物的身上获取法术残渣。
text.description: 我下一步准备拼合熔炉的各个零件，所以需要魔法黏合剂。我发现，达拉然下水道中积累的淤泥就是上好的材料。$b$b长年居住在达拉然的生物的脚上、靴子上和用来爬行的肚子上，黏着一层层的淤泥。刮些下来给我。

english.title: The Muck Stops Here
english.objectives: Obtain 20 vials of Spellsludge.$b$bSpellsludge can be found on the powerful Underbelly creatures that appear while the Dalaran Sewer Guards are on duty.
english.description: For my next project - sticking the forge's components to one another - I need a magical adherent. And I've found that the built-up sludge of Dalaran's sewers works perfectly for just that.$b$bIt cakes up on the feet, boots, and slithering bellies of Dalaran's more long-lived residents. Scrape some off and bring it here.

text.title: 冰冷硬币
text.objectives: 获取$1oa个盲目之眼。
text.description: 我对金子没兴趣。上面的钱在这下面可行不通。$b$b不过，我喜欢盲目之眼。给我这个当报酬就行。

english.title: Cold Hard Coin
english.objectives: Obtain $1oa Sightless Eyes.
english.description: I am not interested in gold. Your aboveground currencies have little use down here.$b$bI am, however interested in Sightless Eyes. I will gladly accept some as payment for my services.

text.title: The Obliterum Forge
text.objectives: Finalize the construction of the Obliterum Forge in Dalaran.
text.description: The components of the forge are assembled and, as I understand it, Archmage Karlain has secured a location for us to begin construction: aboveground, near the blacksmith.$b$bCome back and visit sometime, $n.

english.title: The Obliterum Forge
english.objectives: Finalize the construction of the Obliterum Forge in Dalaran.
english.description: The components of the forge are assembled and, as I understand it, Archmage Karlain has secured a location for us to begin construction: aboveground, near the blacksmith.$b$bCome back and visit sometime, $n.

text.title: 签署合同
text.objectives: 签署帕林教授的合同。
text.description: 啊，一个铭文师同行！$b$b你看起来不笨，不如我们一起合作，探索破碎群岛的无限可能？$b$b（就是我们脚下的一大片群岛。）$b$b不过，要是不完成必需的合法程序，我绝对不同意合作的事。把这个签一下，我们就可以谈生意了。

english.title: Sign This
english.objectives: Sign Professor Pallin's contract.
english.description: Ah, a fellow scribe!$b$bYou don't look too dim, so how 'bout you and I work together in an effort to discover what we can about the Broken Isles?$b$b(That's the big mass of islands we're floating over.)$b$bHowever! I never agree to a partnership without getting all the requisite legalities out of the way. Sign this for me and we're in business.

text.title: 孤注一掷
text.objectives: 去见海拉并要求她放你离开冥狱深渊。
text.description:
看来你的朋友没能过来。很遗憾，不过我们必须继续前进。

海拉是这里的统治者，你得找她放我们出去。虽然我也想跟你一起行动，但是恐怕我其实帮不上什么忙。

你完成以后再来找我。我要看看能不能找到女武神的下落。
text.completion: <Helya's voice fills the air as you stand>$B$BNobody leaves Helheim without my approval! Entertain me, and I may let you pass.

english.title: A Desperate Bargain
english.objectives: Confront Helya and ask to be freed from Helheim.
english.description:
It looks like your friend didn't make it. A pity, but we must move on.

You'll want to plead our case to Helya. She is the ruler here. I would accompany you, but I'm afraid I wouldn't help your case.

Meet me when you are finished. I will see if I can find the whereabouts of my shieldmaidens.
english.completion: <Helya's voice fills the air as you stand>$B$BNobody leaves Helheim without my approval! Entertain me, and I may let you pass.

text.title: 引魂之光
text.objectives: 从血须身上搞到一盏冥狱深渊引魂灯。
text.description:
海拉一定觉得没人能完成她的挑战。让我们来打破她的如意算盘。

我不确定她做了什么，竟然可以削弱你的力量。我的女武神也受到了这样的影响，现在她们被海拉的爪牙困住了。

不过，我或许知道一个办法。克瓦迪尔的船上有一种和此地紧密相连的灯笼，可以帮助他们在迷雾中航行。据说这些灯笼的光芒可以解脱灵魂的束缚。

附近有一艘克瓦迪尔的船只。看看你能不能搞到一盏灯笼。
text.completion: This appears to be what we need. $B$BNow, we can prepare for the battle ahead.

english.title: To Light the Way
english.objectives: Collect a Helheim Waylight from Bloodbeard in Helheim.
english.description:
Helya must think her challenge unwinnable. We will show her different.

I am unsure what she did, but Helya has weakened you somehow. I have seen similar effects on my shieldmaidens, and now they are trapped by Helya's minions.

I may know a way, however. The Kvaldir ships carry special lanterns bound to this place to navigate through the fog. It is said that the light of these lanterns can release bonds of the spirit.

There is a kvaldir ship nearby. See if you can find one there.
english.completion: This appears to be what we need. $B$BNow, we can prepare for the battle ahead.

text.title: 破碎灵魂
text.objectives: 在冥狱深渊寻找并释放意志碎片、力量碎片和勇气碎片。
text.description:
我认为你的武器的力量可以帮我们打败盖尔，不过你现在太虚弱了，根本无法出战。我们必须取回你失去的灵魂碎片。

海拉为了妨碍你，一定把碎片分散在她领域的各个角落。如果你能找到碎片，用灯笼照耀一下应该就能让它们得到释放。

不过，一定要多加小心，海拉一定会有重兵把守你的灵魂碎片。
text.completion: Yes, I can feel your power returned. $B$BHelya will regret the day she challenged one such as you.

english.title: Sundered
english.objectives: Find and release the Fragment of Will, Fragment of Might, and Fragment of Valor in Helheim.
english.description:
I imagine the power of your weapon will be what allows us to defeat Geir, but right now you are too weak for the confrontation. We must reclaim the missing pieces of your spirit.

Helya must have scattered them throughout her realm to keep them from you. If you can find them, shine the lantern and they should be set free.

Be careful, though. It is unlikely that Helya left your spirit fragments unguarded.
english.completion: Yes, I can feel your power returned. $B$BHelya will regret the day she challenged one such as you.

text.title: 生死盟友
text.objectives: 在冥狱深渊解救8名溺水的瓦尔基拉。
text.description:
单凭我们的力量或许难以对付巨人盖尔。幸运的是，法尔加十分好心，他把我们的盟友也送到了冥狱深渊来帮忙。

我之前发现他们中有一些人受到了冥狱深渊元素的折磨。你或许认为死者不会感受到溺水的痛苦，不过有了海拉的力量就可以实现。

当时我没法解救他们，不过现在你有了引魂灯，或许可以把他们救出来。

找到他们的下落并解开他们身上的束缚，外来者。
text.completion: It is good to have my shieldmaidens returned to my side. $B$BYou have gained allies today, but know you have also gained my gratitude.

english.title: Allies in Death
english.objectives: Release 8 Drowning Valkyra in Helheim.
english.description:
Our power alone may not be enough to fight the behemoth, Geir. Fortunately, Faljar was kind enough to send our allies into Helheim with us.

Earlier, I had discovered several of them being tortured by the elemental forces of Helheim. You may think the dead can't drown, but with Helya's power, this is not the case. 

I could not release them then, but now that you possess the waylight, you may be able to.

Seek them out and free them from an eternity of suffering!
english.completion: It is good to have my shieldmaidens returned to my side. $B$BYou have gained allies today, but know you have also gained my gratitude.

objectiveDetails.description: 解救被束缚的瓦尔基拉

text.title: 永恒的胜利
text.objectives: 在冥狱深渊的永恒战场打败盖尔。
text.description:
没什么好犹豫的了。现在就是进攻的时候。

我们会打败这个邪恶的巨人，完成与海拉的约定。冥狱深渊的出路在等着我们，外来者。 

做好准备。
text.completion: The day is won. Now, we must collect our reward. $B$BLet us hope that Helya keeps her side of the bargain.

english.title: Victory is Eternal
english.objectives: Defeat Geir in the Eternal Battlefield in Helheim.
english.description:
There is no more cause for hesitation. Now is the time to strike.

We will defeat this foul behemoth and meet Helya's bargain. The path out of Helheim awaits, outsider. 

Prepare yourself.
english.completion: The day is won. Now, we must collect our reward. $B$BLet us hope that Helya keeps her side of the bargain.

text.title: 清算血债
text.objectives: 与海拉对质，然后离开冥狱深渊。
text.description:
我们达成了海拉的约定。现在，我们要看看她会不会信守承诺。

你准备好之后，我们就该前往王座。如果你在这里还有其他事要做，最好尽快做完。

我会跟着你走，外来者。
text.completion: So the dead return from Helheim and back? An impressive feat. $B$BYour worth has been judged and the trial passed. $B$BNow, to your destiny. To the Halls of Valor!

english.title: Paid in Lifeblood
english.objectives: Confront Helya and leave Helheim.
english.description:
We have fulfilled Helya's bargain. Now, we see if she will keep to her word.

When you are ready, we should proceed to the throne. If you have any other business here, I would suggest finishing it now.

I will follow your lead, outsider.
english.completion: So the dead return from Helheim and back? An impressive feat. $B$BYour worth has been judged and the trial passed. $B$BNow, to your destiny. To the Halls of Valor!

text.title: 永恒之敌
text.objectives: 回去找艾希迪尔，并告诉她海拉的挑战。
text.description:
<海拉的声音在祭坛上空回荡>

你说自己不是无能之辈，外来者。你的灵魂能被轻易粉碎，我怎么知道你说的是真是假？ 

你必须证明给我看。

到永恒战场去挑战我的勇士吧。如果你能打败他，或许我会给你特赦。
text.completion: You do not look good. $B$BI take it Helya did not prove lenient?

english.title: The Eternal Nemesis
english.objectives: Return to Ashildir and inform her of Helya's challenge.
english.description:
<Helya's voice echoes in the sky above the altar>

You say that you do not belong here among the unworthy, outsider, but your spirit fragments so easily. How am I to know you speak the truth? 

I cannot, so you must show me.

Bring yourself to the eternal battlefield and face my champion. If you manage to defeat him, then I may grant you a pardon.
english.completion: You do not look good. $B$BI take it Helya did not prove lenient?

text.title: 吃手稿的羊
text.objectives: 从松岩盆地里吃饱的山地羊身上找回艾迪的手稿。
text.description:
我一直追随赫米特的狩猎旅程，从荆棘谷到纳格兰……又到纳格兰，记录他的伟大历险，然后写成经典的故事。

但是我内心向往的还是狩猎。我非常想放下纸笔，拿起猎枪！

赫米特答应，只要我完成了他的最新小说，就会教我狩猎。但是，我的初稿被这里的山羊给吃掉了！

如果找不回这些手稿，我的猎手梦就完了。
text.completion: I've been eager to get my hands on this manuscript! I was startin' to think the gnome had writer's block.

english.title: Note-Eating Goats
english.objectives: Recover Addie's manuscript from Sated Hillstriders within Pinerock Basin.
english.description:
I've followed Hemet on all his expeditions from Stranglethorn to Nagrand to... Nagrand again, taking notes on his grand adventures and turning them into timeless literary tales.

But my heart is really in the hunt. I want nothing more than to put down the pen, and pick up a rifle!

Hemet promised to teach me how to hunt once I finish his latest novel, but the goats around here ate my first draft!

I have no hope of becoming a hunter if my manuscript isn't recovered.
english.completion: I've been eager to get my hands on this manuscript! I was startin' to think the gnome had writer's block.

text.title: 鲜血试炼
text.objectives: 完成鲜血试炼
text.description:
作为河鬃部族的同胞，奥金·铁牛可以为你作保。而你自己也显示出了一定的实力，不过这还远远不够。

你已经开始鲜血试炼，完成之后就能在我们的领地上自由行动了。如果你能成功——这一点我严重怀疑——就来听我进一步的指引。

进入洞穴深处，消灭出现的任何敌人，然后回来找我。
text.completion: Thank you for saving me. I hope now we can trust each other. We must if we are to defeat these Feltotem.

english.title: Rite of Blood
english.objectives: Complete the Rite of Blood.
english.description:
Oakin Ironbull vouches for you. He's capable, for a Rivermane. You also brought with you proof of your own strength, albeit rather inconclusive proof.

Before we allow you to move freely within our territory, you must complete the Rite of Blood, which you have already begun. If you succeed--and I doubt you will--talk to me.

Enter the depths of the cave. Defeat whatever foe appears and return to me.
english.completion: Thank you for saving me. I hope now we can trust each other. We must if we are to defeat these Feltotem.

objectiveDetails.description: 接近纳瓦罗格，开始试炼

text.title: 整顿事态
text.objectives: 到克拉苏斯平台去找奥鲁丹·白云搭乘载具，到达洛拉希尔以后去找玛法里奥·怒风谈谈。
text.description: 玛法里奥·怒风成功抵达瓦尔莎拉，并且在那里展开了整顿。看来我们总算遇到好事了！$B$B在我们说话同时，他正在洛拉希尔等着你。当一切照计划进行时，生命是如此美妙。
text.completion: Elune-Adore, $n.

english.title: Tying Up Loose Ends
english.objectives: Speak to Aludane Whitecloud at Krasus' Landing to secure a flight to Val'sharah. Speak to Malfurion Stormrage after you arrive in Lorlathil.
english.description: Malfurion Stormrage managed to make landfall in Val'sharah and has already taken care of things there. It seems our fortune is finally turning around!$B$BHe's waiting for you as we speak in Lorlathil. Life is so magical when everything goes according to plan.
english.completion: Elune-Adore, $n.

text.title: 屠城蛮人
text.objectives: 消灭屠城蛮人奥古尔。
text.description: 蠕虫本身不好战也不喜欢在地面活动，它们的行动完全受控于主人。$b$b擒贼先擒王。$b$b屠城蛮人奥古尔是巨石卓格巴尔的蠕虫之主，从北面攻过来的就是他们。$b$b去杀了他。
text.completion: "Siegebrul." Bah!$b$bBefore this war we had no need for such titles.$b$BOlgrul was always just a brute who takes pleasure in the pain of others.
text.giverWindow: 巨石首领

english.title: The Siegebrul
english.objectives: Slay Siegebrul Olgrul.
english.description: Worms do not like battle or the surface. They only go where their master tells them.$b$bSo, when in war, kill the master.$b$bSiegebrul Olgrul is the master of worms for the Mightstone drogbar who attack us from the north.$b$bSlay him.
english.completion: "Siegebrul." Bah!$b$bBefore this war we had no need for such titles.$b$BOlgrul was always just a brute who takes pleasure in the pain of others.
english.giverWindow: The Mightstone Leader

text.title: 魔火试炼
text.objectives: 获取一副灌魔丝纹护腕、一副恐皮裹腕、一副刻鳞臂甲和一副邪钢护臂。
text.description: 你手里拿着的是一种被我们称为“抑魔金”的物质。我们虽然推测过它的存在，但是直到现在都没法制作出来。$b$b你说它是火灾现场留下的？当然了！加热！我怎么没早点想到这个？$b$b我们得先重现结果，才能进行下一步行动。请你帮我找更多的质量上乘的各类护甲。我知道这个要求有点过分，还请体谅。

english.title: Trial By Fel Fire
english.objectives: Obtain a set of Imbued Silkweave Bracers, Dreadleather Bindings, Gravenscale Armbands, and Demonsteel Armguards.
english.description: The substance you hold is something that we call "obliterum". We had theorized its existence, but until now, we had never actually been able to produce any.$b$bYou say this came from a fire? Of COURSE! Calefaction! Why hadn't I thought of that sooner?$b$bWe'll need to reproduce these results before we take any further action. I know it's asking a lot, but I'll need you to get me some more high-quality armor, in a variety of styles.

text.title: 风暴峡湾
text.objectives: 前往达拉然，在紫罗兰城堡与纳萨诺斯·凋零者谈一谈。
text.description: 黑暗女王的勇士，纳萨诺斯·凋零者要你到达拉然去见他。$B$B他会在紫罗兰城堡等你。听起来是有急事。
text.giverTarget: 格雷森·沙东布瑞克公爵

english.title: Stormheim
english.objectives: Speak to Nathanos Blightcaller at the Violet Citadel in Dalaran.
english.description: Nathanos Blightcaller, Champion of the Banshee Queen herself, sent for you in Dalaran.$B$BHe should be waiting for you in the Violet Citadel. It sounded urgent.

text.title: 我没说谎！
text.objectives: 从艾利亚斯宣称在松岩盆地见过的狮子身上取得战利品。
text.description:
我一生中猎捕过许多奇珍异兽，但我在侦察盆地时第一次遇到那样的一头狮子。

它的琥珀色眼睛直视着我，引诱我靠近。这头掠食者魔力般的凝视让人毫无抵抗之力，直到它突然猛扑过来，我才惊觉事情不妙。

我跟赫米特说过这头神奇的野兽，可是他却一笑了之。我没说谎，$n！那头狮子真的存在。

如果你找到那头野兽，就给我带回一件猎杀它的战利品，我会给你丰厚的报酬。
text.completion: So I was right! The lion with the amber eyes did exist.$b$bHere's the gold as promised. This is worth every copper. You can't put a price on proving that you're right!$b$bI'll keep this eye, but I wouldn't want the rest of our prize to go to waste. Let's eat!

english.title: I'm Not Lion!
english.objectives: Collect a hunting trophy from the lion that Ellias claims to have seen in Pinerock Basin.
english.description:
I've hunted many exotic beasts in my day, but I've never seen a lion like the one I encountered while scouting the basin.

The beast's amber eyes locked on mine, luring me closer. I was helpless to this predator's enchanting gaze. It was only when the lion pounced did the stupor break.

I've told Hemet of this magical beast, but he laughs. I'm not lying, $n! The lion exists.

If you find the beast, bring me a trophy of your kill, and I'll reward you handsomely.
english.completion: So I was right! The lion with the amber eyes did exist.$b$bHere's the gold as promised. This is worth every copper. You can't put a price on proving that you're right!$b$bI'll keep this eye, but I wouldn't want the rest of our prize to go to waste. Let's eat!

text.title: Toll for the Soul
text.objectives: Defeat Helya and free the Valarjar.
text.description:
[PH] As foretold, you have arrived... Helya is foolish to think I'll let her ferry me into Helheim. Odyn has already smiled upon me, my soul belongs in Valhallas. 

Make no mistake, I am not a prisoner. Before my death Odyn appeared to me in the form of a raven. He praised my battles in life and gave me a quest no vrykul could refuse. The Helerjar arrived... and I let them slay me.

Prisoner-- nay, I am a liberator, sent by Odyn to free the souls of Valarjar.

english.title: Toll for the Soul
english.objectives: Defeat Helya and free the Valarjar.
english.description:
[PH] As foretold, you have arrived... Helya is foolish to think I'll let her ferry me into Helheim. Odyn has already smiled upon me, my soul belongs in Valhallas. 

Make no mistake, I am not a prisoner. Before my death Odyn appeared to me in the form of a raven. He praised my battles in life and gave me a quest no vrykul could refuse. The Helerjar arrived... and I let them slay me.

Prisoner-- nay, I am a liberator, sent by Odyn to free the souls of Valarjar.

text.title: 不祥预感
text.objectives: 对纳瓦罗格的疑虑进行调查。
text.description:
如果你不愿相信我，我能够理解。我的兄弟们在达古尔的领导下被力量冲昏了头脑。

不过，请求你至少去调查一下。我有预感，图鲁克和他的鲜血图腾即将为至高岭带来灾难。

如果你不相信我，就到末路崖的北面去看看吧。
text.completion: <The cage is empty. Navarrogg is gone.>

english.title: I Have a Bad Feeling About This
english.objectives: Investigate Navarrogg's suspicions.
english.description:
You have no reason to trust me. My cousins led by Dargrul have gone mad with power.

But I ask you to investigate something. I have a feeling something terrible is about to befall Highmountain, and that Torok and his Bloodtotem are going to be responsible.

If you don't believe me, look for yourself at the northern side of Cliff's Edge.
english.completion: <The cage is empty. Navarrogg is gone.>

text.title: 魔力之夜
text.objectives: 在达拉然附魔商店里与伊尔蒂谈一谈。
text.description: 欢迎！看到熟人回到达拉然，真是太好了。你跟伊尔蒂、瓦妮萨还有我在诺森德就认识了，还记得吧？$b$b大法师星歌是这家店的负责人，不过他刚好要为肯瑞托办点事，所以外出了。总体来讲……他人还不错。$b$b你来得太好了。我们遇到一个问题，希望能在大法师回来之前尽快解决。你愿意帮个忙吗？

english.title: Some Enchanted Evening
english.objectives: Speak to Ildine Sorrowspear inside the enchanting shop in Dalaran.
english.description: Welcome! It's nice to see familiar faces returning to Dalaran. You might remember Ildine, Vanessa, and me from Northrend. $b$bArchmage Starsinger is in charge of the shop, but he's away on Kirin Tor business at the moment. He's a fine fellow... mostly.$b$bYour arrival is fortunate. We've run into a problem that we'd love to solve before the archmage returns. Interested in lending a hand?

text.title: 收尾工作
text.objectives: 为伊尔蒂制作$1oa张附魔戒指 - 全能真言卷轴。你可以从抄写员或拍卖行处获得羊皮纸。
text.description: 如你所见，$n，为了迎战燃烧军团，我们正在努力制作附魔物品。既然你来了，请帮我们完成一份订单的收尾工作。$b$b如果可以的话，找些羊皮纸，并为它们附上全能属性。过来，我会把公式告诉你。

english.title: The Last Few
english.objectives: Create $1oa Enchant Ring - Word of Versatility vellums for Ildine. You can acquire vellums from a scribe, or from the Auction House.
english.description: As you can see, $n, we're hard at work producing enchants for the battle against the Legion. Since you're here, we could really use your help wrapping up one of our orders.$b$bIf you could, acquire some vellums and start enchanting them with Versatility. Here, I'll teach you the formula.

text.title: 帮助恶魔猎手
text.objectives: 把装着羊皮纸的箱子交给阿苏纳的杰斯·织暗。
text.description: 我现在要继续处理剩下的订单，如果你愿意帮忙把这些羊皮纸交给阿苏纳的杰斯·织暗，我将感激不尽。$b$b他和其他的恶魔猎手一直在反击燃烧军团，他们越早用到这个越好。$b$b谢谢你，$n！

english.title: Helping the Hunters
english.objectives: Deliver the crate of vellums to Jace Darkweaver in Azsuna.
english.description: Now, while I continue to fill the rest of our orders, I'd really appreciate it if you would deliver these vellums to Jace Darkweaver down in Azsuna.$b$bHe and the other demon hunters have been fighting back the Legion for quite some time and could use this as quickly as possible.$b$bThanks, $n!

text.title: 得力帮手
text.objectives: 在伊利达雷哨所对$1oa名恶魔猎手使用附魔羊皮纸。
text.description: 这里需要你的帮助，$n。如果现在就可以用这些羊皮纸为戒指附魔，我们的恶魔猎手将会获益良多。$b$b你拿上一些。我会把剩下的交由另一位士兵派发。$b$b恶魔猎手们或许无法停止战斗，所以你只能在他们作战的同时进行附魔。

english.title: In the Loop
english.objectives: Use the enchanting vellums on $1oa Demon Hunters at the Illidari Stand.
english.description: We could use your help down here, $n. Some of our hunters would benefit greatly from having those vellums applied to their rings right now.$b$bHere take a few. I'll give the rest to one of my other soldiers to hand out.$b$bMy hunters probably won't stop to let you apply the enchants, so you'll just have to do your enchanting even if they're in the midst of battle.

text.title: 雷霆工艺
text.objectives: 在雷霆图腾与古隆·双尾谈一谈。
text.description: 我在至高岭找到一种潜在的新附魔源。雷霆图腾牛头人会操控灵魂为物品灌入强大的力量。$b$b去找一个名叫双尾的附魔师，看看他是否愿意跟我们分享他的知识。$b$b牛头人是出了名的大方……对吧？

english.title: Thunder Struck
english.objectives: Speak to Guron Twaintail in Thunder Totem.
english.description: I've made contact with a potential source of new enchantments down in Highmountain. The tauren of Thunder Totem command the spirits to imbue items with great power.$b$bSeek out an enchanter named Twaintail and see if he will share his knowledge with us.$b$bTaurens are known for their sharing... right?

text.title: 强如大地
text.objectives: 击败暴怒的琥珀碎片，收集$1oa个琥珀碎片水晶，并交给雷霆图腾的古隆。
text.description: 这世上有许多种灵魂，$n。有些平和亲善，有些躁动不安。$b$b它们会与我们用来为护甲附魔的各种材料产生共鸣，其中一种材料就是琥珀碎片的水晶。$b$b这种源于大地的暴力生物最近受到了卓格巴尔的惊扰。不过，不管有没有被惊扰，它们的水晶对我们的附魔都很有用处。给我找些回来，我会为你演示。

english.title: Strong Like the Earth
english.objectives: Defeat Enraged Ambershards and collect $b$1oa of their Ambershard Crystals. Bring them back to Guron in Thunder Totem.
english.description: There are many types of spirits in this world, $n. Some benevolent, some troubled.$b$bThey all resonate with different reagents which we use to enchant our armor. One such reagent are the crystals of the ambershards.$b$bThey are a violent creature born of the earth and have recently been disturbed by the drogbar. However, disturbed or not, the crystals they bear are of great use to my people for enchantments. Bring me some and I'll show you what I mean.

objectiveDetails.description: 能量充沛的琥珀碎片水晶

text.title: 绝不浪费
text.objectives: 前往水晶裂隙，寻找废弃的护甲。分解护甲并为古隆带回$1oa份雷霆之尘。
text.description: 在收集琥珀碎片水晶的战斗中，你或许看到过阵亡武士的附魔护甲。虽然琥珀碎片毫不在意这些东西，但是我们部族却一直坚持绝不浪费的原则。$b$b我要你取回武士的护甲，并把它们分解成附魔材料。$b$b把材料带回来，这样我们部族可以用它们为新的护甲附魔。

english.title: Waste Not
english.objectives: Go to the Crystal Fissure and search for discarded armor. Disenchant the armor and bring back $1oa Thunder Dust to Guron.
english.description: While fighting the ambershards for their crystals, you may come across enchanted armor from our fallen braves. The ambershards care not for such things, but our tribe does not believe in letting anything go to waste.$b$bI'd like you to retrieve our braves' armor and disenchant them into the components from which they were imbued.$b$bBring me back the reagents so my tribe may use them to enchant new armor.

text.title: 仙灵附魔
text.objectives: 在瓦尔莎拉的月神殿附近寻找娜拉米娅。
text.description: 我们在这里找到的新粉尘和水晶实在是太棒了，你一定也深有同感吧？它们一定能在我们的护甲上发挥更多的作用。$b$b我要你再出去一趟，跟瓦尔莎拉的一位树妖谈谈。她或许可以告诉我们一些关于肩甲附魔的线索。$b$b她名叫娜拉米娅。你可以在月神殿附近找到她。

english.title: Fey Enchantments
english.objectives: Seek out Nalamya near the Temple of Elune in Val'sharah.
english.description: The new dusts and crystals we've found in these lands are fascinating, as I'm sure you've already surmised. I'm positive we can expand their usefulness to more of our armor.$b$bI'd like you to go back out into the field and talk to a dryad in Val'sharah. Apparently she may be able to clue us into some enchantments for shoulder pieces.$b$bHer name is Nalamya. You'll find her near the Temple of Elune.

text.title: 黑心林地：时过境迁
text.objectives: 在黑心林地消灭大德鲁伊格兰达里斯并取回娜拉米娅的附魔之书。
text.description: 我曾教暗夜精灵为护甲附魔，让他们增强实力以对抗这片土地的邪恶。其中有一个精灵我特别喜欢。$b$b他就是大德鲁伊格兰达里斯，现在住在黑心林地里，企图用可怕的瘟疫毁灭这个世界。$b$b在他背叛之前，我曾把自己的附魔书借给他学习。我很想把书拿回来。$b$b这个任务就交给你了，附魔师。一定要把书拿回来给我。

english.title: Darkheart Thicket: The Glamour Has Faded
english.objectives: Kill Arch-Druid Glaidalis in the Darkheart Thicket and recover Nalamya's Book of Enchantments.
english.description: I once taught the night elves how to enchant their armor to strengthen themselves against the evils of this land. One elf in particular garnered my favor.$b$bArch-Druid Glaidalis is his name. He now resides in the forest known as the Darkheart Thicket, plotting to undo this world with this awful blight.$b$bBefore his betrayal, I gave him my book of enchantments to study. I would very much like it back.$b$bI trust you with this task, enchanter. Bring my book back to me.

text.title: 传统之礼
text.objectives: 把古隆的日志交给达拉然的纳萨尼斯。
text.description: 你已见识到雷霆图腾牛头人的行事方式……与灵魂沟通，收集大地的资源，对任何东西都绝不浪费。想要帮助破碎群岛的话，这些因素至关重要。$b$b拿上这本日记，回去交给你的附魔师朋友。这里面记录着我教给你的东西。$b$b或许它可以帮助我们完成打败燃烧军团的大业。

english.title: Cloaked in Tradition
english.objectives: Take Guron's Journal to Nalthanis in Dalaran.
english.description: You have seen the ways of the tauren of Thunder Totem... speaking with the spirits, gathering from the land, and letting nothing go to waste. These are potent forces crucial to your quest to aid the Broken Isles.$b$bHere, take this journal back to your enchanter friend. It contains the lessons I have imparted unto you.$b$bPerhaps it will serve to help the greater cause of defeating the Legion.

objectiveDetails.description: 把古隆的日记交给纳萨尼斯

text.title: 意外的背叛
text.objectives: 在黑鸦堡垒消灭暗夜精灵，并收集他们的魔法渡鸦徽记。分解徽记，然后把$1oa份渡鸦之尘交给娜拉米娅，作为你消灭他们的证据。
text.description: 黑鸦堡垒的精灵已经决定背叛我们。他们守在自己的堡垒里，攻击任何胆敢闯入的外人。$b$b这种行为简直不可容忍。更何况，我的族人以及这片土地的其他人一直对他们施以援助。$b$b我要你帮一个忙，$n。取得他们的魔法徽记并分解成粉尘。把那些粉尘交给我，以证明你的努力。

english.title: No Longer Worthy
english.objectives: Kill night elves within the grounds of Black Rook Hold and collect their Enchanted Raven Sigils. Disenchant the sigils and bring back $1oa Raven Dust to Nalamya as proof of their defeat.
english.description: The elves of Black Rook Hold have decided to turn their backs on us. They stay inside their keep, attacking any outsider who dare try to enter.$b$bSuch behavior is intolerable... especially after all the help they've received from my folk and the others of this land.$b$bI want you to do me a favor, $n. Take their enchanted sigils and reduce them to dust. Bring me back the dust as proof of your deeds.

text.title: 误入歧途
text.objectives: 消灭特兰·破盾以及斯塔丽丝·强弓。
text.description: 暗夜精灵可不是傻瓜，不过黑鸦堡垒的精灵盲目地听从他们首领的命令，完全是愚忠。他们之所以会变成这样，无疑要归咎于那些指挥官。$b$b我知道其中的两个首领，当邪恶吞噬我的家园时，他们却让自己的部队袖手旁观。$b$b到黑鸦堡垒去消灭特兰·破盾和斯塔丽丝·强弓。让那些明明有能力帮忙，却一直坐视不理的懦夫看看自己会得到什么下场。

english.title: Led Astray
english.objectives: Go to Black Rook Hold in Val'sharah and slay Trelan Shieldbreaker and Starlys Strongbow.
english.description: The night elves are no fools, but the elves of Black Rook follow their commanders with blind loyalty. I've no doubt that the blame for their apathy rests heavily upon their commanders.$b$bI know of two of their leaders, who as we speak continue to command their troops to do nothing against the blight encroaching upon my home.$b$bGo to Black Rook Hold and slay Trelan Shieldbreaker and Starlys Strongbow. Let them be an example for those who can help, but wish to remain cowardly.

text.title: 诅咒的好处
text.objectives: 在阿苏纳的倾颓王宫寻找附魔师伊兰娅。
text.description: 我要你立刻返回阿苏纳，$n。我刚刚得知，倾颓王宫里有一位女附魔师，她了解许多罕见的附魔。$b$b快到那里去找她，看看你能学到什么。

english.title: Cursed, But Convenient
english.objectives: Find Enchantress Ilanya at the Crumbled Palace in Azsuna.
english.description: I need you to return to Azsuna at once, $n. I've only just heard of an enchantress within the Crumbled Palace who knows of many rare enchantments.$b$bGo to her and see what you can learn at once.

text.title: 附魔居所
text.objectives: 在风暴峡湾调查提格德的居所。
text.description: 我对破碎群岛的了解越多，就越觉得这里充满了神奇！$b$b我和伊尔蒂刚刚在讨论一个传闻，说是曾经有个名叫提格德的维库女附魔师居住在风暴峡湾。据说她的居所保存完好，而她的附魔十分强大，效果到现在还经久不衰！$b$b去调查她的居所，也许能找到有价值的知识，$n。

english.title: An Enchanting Home
english.objectives: Investigate Tigrid's home in Stormheim.
english.description: The more I learn about the Broken Isles, the more convinced I am that it is a land of wonders!$b$bIldine and I were just discussing rumors of a dwelling in Stormheim that was once the home to a vrykul enchantress called Tigrid. It is said the site is perfectly preserved, and her enchantments were so potent that they persist to this day!$b$bInvestigating the home might uncover valuable knowledge, $n.

text.title: 英灵殿：附魔师的复仇
text.objectives: 从英灵殿取回提格德的附魔棒，并带到风暴峡湾交给她。
text.description: 数个世纪以来，即便是在死后，我都可以施加经久不衰的附魔效果。可是一个贪婪的国王偷走了我的附魔棒，使我难以维持所剩无几的魔力。$b$b如果你能从神王的幽灵那里拿回我的附魔棒，我就会给你丰厚的奖励。

english.title: Halls of Valor: Revenge of the Enchantress
english.objectives: Retrieve Tigrid's Enchanting Rod from the Halls of Valor and return it to her in Stormheim.
english.description: For many centuries, even after death, I was capable of weaving enduring enchantments. But since the theft of my enchanting rod by a greedy king, I can barely sustain the little magic I have left.$b$bIf you can recover my enchanting rod from the god-king's ghost, I will reward you in kind.

text.title: 赞誉有加
text.objectives: 回达拉然找纳萨尼斯。
text.description: 虽然你可以在这里继续帮忙，不过你在达拉然的导师正在找你。$b$b再次感谢你对我们的帮助。你让我的恶魔猎手们知道，在这场战争中，他们并非孤立无援。

english.title: Ringing True
english.objectives: Return to Nalthanis in Dalaran.
english.description: While your presence here would continue to be of value to us, your master in Dalaran has called for you.$b$bI'd like to thank you again for all you've done for us. My hunters have been reminded that they're not alone in this war.

text.title: 战前准备
text.objectives: 为艾林贝兹制作一张附魔披风 - 力量真言卷轴，一张附魔戒指 - 爆击真言卷轴，以及一张附魔戒指 - 精通真言卷轴。
text.description: 想要得到我的印记，你必须先在战斗中证明自己，$c。我想消灭一个纳迦，无奈自己能力有限。$b$b在我们宣战之前，我需要你通过附魔使我变得更加强大。我相信，到现在你已经具备多种附魔能力。$b$b为我制作一些附魔物品以增强我的战斗力，让我为这个世界做点贡献。

english.title: Prepping For Battle
english.objectives: Craft an Enchant Cloak - Word of Strength vellum, an Enchant Ring - Word of Critical Strike vellum and an Enchant Ring - Word of Mastery vellum for Alynblaze.
english.description: To earn my mark, $c, you must first prove yourself in battle to me. There is a naga I wish to kill, but I am not strong enough to slay him.$b$bBefore we go into battle together, I need your help as an enchanter to become stronger. I'm sure by now you have a bevy of enchantments in your repertoire.$b$bMake some for me so that I may become strong enough again to make a difference in this world.

text.title: 精灵附魔
text.objectives: 回达拉然找纳萨尼斯。
text.description: 你从我最信任的伙伴那里赢得了印记，而且还带回了我的挚爱。$b$b遇见你是我的幸运，$n。$b$b现在，回去找你的导师，告诉他你了解到的东西。

english.title: Elven Enchantments
english.objectives: Return to Nalthanis in Dalaran.
english.description: You have earned the marks of my most trusted companions. You have also returned my love to me.$b$bI am fortunate to have met you, $n.$b$bNow return to your master and let him know of what you have learned.

text.title: 德鲁伊的职责
text.objectives: 找到麦鲁斯的熊掌神像、利爪神像和月亮神像，并带回倾颓王宫交给他。
text.description: 想要得到我的印记，$c，你必须先帮我增强实力，这样我才能在你需要的时候提供帮助。$b$b我的神像就在纳萨拉斯废墟里。如我所说，我没有能力把它们取回来。$b$b不过你很强大，我感觉得到。你的力量足以对付那些玷污我家园的卑鄙纳迦。$b$b帮我找回我的神像，完成以后我就会给你印记。

english.title: The Druid's Debt
english.objectives: Find Merrus' Idol of the Paw, Idol of the Claw and Idol of the Moon and return them to him at the Crumbled Palace.
english.description: In order to grant you my mark, $c, I must first be made strong enough to come to your aid should you need it.$b$bWithin the ruins of Nar'thalas, my idols sit dormant. As I've said, I'm not strong enough to get them myself.$b$bBut you are strong, I can sense it. Strong enough to take on those honor-less naga who plague my home.$b$bFind my idols and return them to me. Do this and I will grant you my mark.

text.title: 哨兵的最后职责
text.objectives: 消灭深海指挥官伊克西斯。完成以后回倾颓王宫找艾林贝兹。
text.description: 我更加强大了，现在该考验一下我们的实力了。我之前提过，我要消灭一个强大的纳迦。$b$b这个叫做伊克西斯的深海指挥官杀害了我的众多族人。现在他已退回深海，藏在暗中指挥他的部队。$b$b我终于找到了他的下落，就在东边的一个洞穴里。我们一起去找他算账，为我死去的弟兄姐妹们报仇。
text.giverWindow: 这只凶猛的纳迦一路打拼，现在的头衔是深海指挥官。

english.title: Sentinel's Final Duty
english.objectives: Slay Fathom-Commander Eksis. Return to Alynblaze at the Crumbled Palace when you are through.
english.description: Now that I'm stronger, it's time to test your mettle, and mine. As I mentioned earlier, there is a powerful naga I wish to kill.$b$bHis name is Fathom-Commander Eksis. He was responsible for slaying many of my kin before he retreated into hiding, commanding his troops from the shadows.$b$bI've finally discovered his whereabouts in a cave just east of here. Let us bring vengeance upon him for my lost brothers and sisters.
english.giverWindow: A fierce naga who has moved up the ranks and gained the title of Fathom-Commander.

text.title: 背叛的逆转
text.objectives: 在邪焰隘口消灭恶魔。取得他们的邪壳符文并分解出$1oa份邪污谎言之尘。完成以后回去找堕落的女祭司。
text.description: 附魔师伊兰娅记得我？$b$b<萨特沉默了一会，抹了抹眼泪。>$b$b一万年前，我做了笔愚蠢的交易。我得知女王和燃烧军团结盟之后，背叛自己的良心加入了他们。我被变成了一个怪物，最后在和凡人的战斗中死去。$b$b现在，燃烧军团回来了，但我却只是一个虚弱的幽灵。为我消灭前面的恶魔，拿走他们的恶魔符文并分解成粉尘。

english.title: Turnabout Betrayal
english.objectives: Defeat demons at the Felblaze Ingress. Take their Fel-crusted Runes and disenchant them into $1oa Dust of Foul Lies. Return to where you met the Fallen Priestess when you are done.
english.description: Enchantress Ilanya remembers me?$b$b<The satyr pauses to wipe a tear away.>$b$bI made a fool's bargain ten millennia ago. I learned of the queen's alliance with the Legion and betrayed my heart to join their side. I was transformed into a monstrosity, only to die in battle against the mortals.$b$bNow the Legion returns, but I linger as an impotent spirit. Be my vessel and slay the demons ahead of us. Take their demonic runes and render them to dust.

text.title: 祭司归来
text.objectives: 回阿苏纳的倾颓王宫找附魔师伊兰娅。
text.description: 背叛以后，我无法面对我的挚爱。多亏了你，$n，我终于可以回去了。$b$b跟附魔师伊兰娅谈谈。我会让她知道你有资格得到我的印记。

english.title: The Absent Priestess
english.objectives: Return to Enchantress Ilanya at the Crumbled Palace in Azsuna.
english.description: After my betrayal, I never thought I could bear to look upon my love again. But thanks to you, $n, I can at last return.$b$bGo and speak to Enchantress Ilanya. I will let her know that you are worthy of my mark.

text.title: 蔚蓝之翼
text.objectives: 在阿苏纳的蓝翼栖地与巨龙卡米拉谈一谈。
text.description: 我有好消息要告诉你，$n。我和伊尔蒂远行阿苏纳，找到了蓝翼栖地的蓝龙。$b$b其中一位叫做卡米拉的蓝龙附魔师表示愿意与你合作，让我们的附魔更加完美。$b$b我知道，你才跟那里的精灵打过交道。如果你愿意再去一趟，卡米拉也会非常高兴与你共事。

english.title: On Azure Wings
english.objectives: Speak to the dragon Kharmeera at Azurewing Repose in Azsuna.
english.description: I have some exciting news of my own to report, $n. Ildine and I had an excursion to Azsuna and made contact with the blue dragons at the Azurewing Repose.$b$bOne of the dragons, Kharmeera, is an enchanter who expressed interest in working with you to perfect some of our enchantments.$b$bI understand you were just down there working with the elves, but if you wouldn't mind returning, Kharmeera would enjoy working with you too.

text.title: 奈萨里奥的巢穴：蔚蓝之杖
text.objectives: 前往奈萨里奥的巢穴，从地底之王达古尔手中取得一根苍穹石魔棒。前往巨石之核，从欧泽鲁克处取得一块发光的泽菲蓝晶石。前往通灵学院，取得一堆古代阿卡纳精华。
text.description: 我们开始之前，我想请你帮个小忙。老实说，我有点难为情，不过我们得等这件事办完才能合作。$b$b我被召到这个地方的时候，根本没机会先收拾东西。要命的是，我落下了我的附魔棒。$b$b我觉得，重新制作一根比回去拿要容易得多。$b$b所以我需要一些东西……

english.title: Neltharion's Lair: Rod of Azure
english.objectives: Retrieve a Skystone Rod from Dargrul the Underking in Neltharion's Lair, a Radiant Zephyrite from Ozruk in The Stonecore and a pile of Ancient Arkhana from Scholomance.
english.description: Before we can begin though, there is a small favor I need to ask of you. I'm rather ashamed about this matter, to be honest, but it must be done in order for us to work together.$b$bWhen I was summoned to this land, I hadn't been given a chance to collect my things. Most importantly, I left behind my enchanting rod.$b$bInstead of retrieving it I believe it would be much simpler to reconstruct it.$b$bHere's what we'll need...

text.title: 能量核心
text.objectives: 从奥杜斯、奥瑞尔、奥摩尔和奥伊森身上取得能量核心。取得四枚核心之后，交给卡米拉。
text.description: 你的戒指附魔能力十分强大，不过我的技巧更加娴熟。我的意思是，我知道如何提升戒指附魔的效果。$b$b相传有四个构造体，它们的核心都灌注了魔法。这些构造体会在苏拉玛城的街道上巡逻。$b$b如果你叫上几个朋友，合力打败这些构造体，你就可以把它们的核心拿回来做研究。

english.title: Down to the Core
english.objectives: Retrieve the Power Cores from Oldus, Or'ell, Olmoore, and Oll'ison. Bring them back to Kharmeera when you have all four.
english.description: The ring enchantments you know now are good, but I know of better ones that exist. That is to say, I know of stronger enchantments that would be suitable for rings.$b$bAccording to legend, there are four constructs whose cores were imbued with magical enchantments. These constructs now patrol the streets of Suramar City.$b$bIf you were to gather some friends and defeat these constructs, you could take their cores for us to study.

text.title: 研磨草药
text.objectives: 取得$1oa份玫红颜料和$2oa份蜡黄颜料。颜料可以通过研磨草药获得。
text.description: 我们之间不用那么拘束，现在给你找点真正派得上用场的活儿吧。$b$b我们脚下的群岛上有很多新奇的草药，我们接下来就用它们来做实验。$b$b我要你找些草药来做成新的颜料。做好足够的颜料以后，就回来找我，看看你做得怎么样。

english.title: Smashing Herbs
english.objectives: Obtain $1oa Roseate Pigments and $2oa Sallow Pigments. Pigments are obtained by milling herbs.
english.description: Now that the formalities are out of the way, let's have you do something actually useful.$b$bOn the islands below, there's a plethora of new and exotic herbs that we've yet to experiment with.$b$bI'd like you to get some of those herbs and create some new pigments from them. Once you have enough, come back to me and I'll see what you've come up with.

text.title: 鱼油墨水
text.objectives: 取得$1oa份玛拉纳油脂，$2oa份积怨之鳞碎片和$3oa份盐目油脂，然后调配成鱼鳞颜料。
text.description: 你知道吗，药草并非墨水的唯一来源。其他的材料也能制成墨水。$b$b说点别的！我一直在寻思如何创造自己专属的暗月卡片。如果那些土包子都办得到，我当然也可以。$b$b这么一来，我们就需要一些特殊的材料。到阿苏纳去帮我收集一些油脂，然后研磨出适合的墨水。

english.title: Fish Ink
english.objectives: Obtain $1oa Mak'rana Oil, $2oa Hatecoil Naga oil, and $3oa Salteye Oil, then combine them into a Piscine Pigment.
english.description: You know, herbs aren't the only ways to obtain ink. Other materials can be inkified.$b$bSlightly related! I've been tinkering with the idea of creating my own type of Darkmoon card. Surely if those troggish carnival people can do it, then so can I.$b$bTo do so, we'll need some special reagents. Go down to Azsuna and collect some oils for me, then mill them into a suitable ink.

text.title: 集卡狂人
text.objectives: 在魔术旅馆收集$1oa张炉石卡牌。
text.description: 现在颜料有了，我们还需要一种材料。$b$b魔术旅馆的客人总爱玩卡牌游戏，偶尔他们会丢掉一些卡牌。去看看你能不能找几张比赛期间掉落的卡牌。

english.title: The Card Shark
english.objectives: Collect $1oa Hearthstone Cards at the Legerdemain Lounge.
english.description: We have the pigment, but we still require one more ingredient.$b$bVisitors at the Legerdemain Lounge will often play card games, and occasionally their cards are discarded. Go see if you can find some loose cards that players may have gotten rid of between matches.

text.title: 新盟友
text.objectives: 到阿苏纳找食魂者阿莱利。
text.description: 你看到那些恶魔猎手了吗？我不太相信他们的忠诚，不过既然他们现在是盟友，我们何不好好“利用”他们。$b$b你知道的，每个人都需要雕文。$b$b去看看你在他们身上会有什么发现。阿苏纳是个开始行动的好地方。$b$b恐怕我已经没什么可以教你的了，但是你肯定能够学以致用，创造出自己的配方。

english.title: Our New Allies
english.objectives: Go to Azsuna and find Allari the Souleater.
english.description: Have you seen those demon hunters yet? I'm not entirely sold on their allegiance to our cause, but while we have them, we may as well exploit them.$b$bEverybody needs glyphs, you know.$b$bGo see what you can discover about them. Azsuna is as good a place as any to start.$b$bPerhaps my genius has worn off on you and you'll be able to create your own recipes based on what you learn.

text.title: 力量的代价
text.objectives: 在伊利达雷哨所消灭$1oa个恶魔。
text.description: 你想知道身为恶魔猎手是什么体验？这可能需要花点时间。$b$b首先，你可以跟我们一起战斗。观察我们如何利用恶魔的力量进行反制。$b$b完成之后再回来找我。

english.title: The Price of Power
english.objectives: Slay $1oa demons at Illidari Strand.
english.description: You wish to learn what it is to be a demon hunter? That may take some time.$b$bThe first thing you can do is fight alongside us. Battle the demons with us and observe how we use their strength against them.$b$bReturn to me when you are finished.

text.title: 纹身
text.objectives: 在扎赫纳尔魔网废墟附近寻找巴瑞克·疾风。
text.description: 恶魔猎手必须克制内心的黑暗，以免向邪恶屈服而变成真正的恶魔。所以，我们会以这种方式进行纹身。$b$b在北边，有一位名叫巴瑞克·疾风的恶魔猎手，他正在准备强化自己的纹身。去找他了解我们克制心魔的方式。

english.title: Inscription of the Body
english.objectives: Find Baric Stormrunner near the Ley-Ruins of Zarkhenar.
english.description: We demon hunters must keep our darkness at bay, lest we succumb to it and become demons ourselves. That is the purpose of marking our skin the way we do.$b$bUp to the north, a demon hunter by the name of Baric Stormrunner is preparing to strengthen his markings. Go to him and learn how we keep our demons at bay.

text.title: 克制之力
text.objectives: 从扎赫纳尔魔网废墟的堕夜精灵和枯法者身上收集$1oa份魔尘，然后调配成魔力颜料。
text.description: 成为恶魔猎手时，必然会打破平衡，$n。为了维持平衡，我们必须在体内注入相对的自然之力。$b$b因为奥能可以抵制邪能，所以我们会在身上纹刻奥术符文以控制邪能。$b$b你是铭文师，对吗？到前面的废墟去，收集那些生物身上的魔尘并调配一种合适的邪能颜料。这件事对你来说应该没有问题。

english.title: Opposites Repel
english.objectives: Collect $1oa Ley Dust from the nightfallen and withered in the Ley-Ruins of Zarkhenar, then mix it into a Ley Pigment.
english.description: There's a balance that must be struck, $n, when becoming a demon hunter. In order to maintain that balance, we must infuse ourselves with opposite forces of nature.$b$bFel energy is counteracted by arcane energy. We mark our bodies with arcane runes to keep our fel forces in check.$b$bYou are a scribe, yes? Then you should have no trouble mixing a suitable ley pigment from the ley dust on the creatures in the ruins up ahead.

text.title: 克制心魔
text.objectives: 帮助巴瑞克完成仪式。
text.description: 现在准备工作已经完成了，我们这就开始仪式。$b$b我会教你怎么帮我。你一定要完全遵循我的指示，否则仪式就会失败。

english.title: Containing the Demon Within
english.objectives: Assist Baric in completing the ritual.
english.description: Now that we have all the essential pieces, let's begin the ritual.$b$bI'll instruct you on how to help me. It is pivotal that you follow my instructions when I give them, or the ritual will fail.

text.title: 纹刻知识
text.objectives: 在阿苏纳的邪焰隘口附近寻找扎莉娅·影心。
text.description: 我们不只是和恶魔作战那么简单，$n，我们还需要观察他们。$b$b我有一位优秀的恶魔猎手，扎莉娅·影心，她正在邪焰隘口收集恶魔的情报。$b$b到那里去找她，她会向你介绍那片地区的恶魔入侵情况。

english.title: Scribal Knowledge
english.objectives: Find Zaria Shadowheart near the Felblaze Ingress in Azsuna.
english.description: We do not simply fight the demons, $n. We observe them.$b$bOne of my best demon hunters, Zaria Shadowheart, is currently gathering intel on the demons in Felblaze Ingress.$b$bGo to her. She will teach you what she has learned from the demons invading that region.

text.title: 能量符文
text.objectives: 研究$1oa个邪能符文。
text.description: 铭文师，仔细看，好好学。当某个地区被邪恶占据时，一些较为狡诈的恶魔会在地上铭刻符文。整片山区都被污染了，不过符文周边区域的腐化程度最强，以至于那里再也无法长出任何纯净的生命。$b$b好好研究一下这些符文。

english.title: Runes of Power
english.objectives: Study $1oa Fel Power Runes.
english.description: Look closely, scribe, and you may learn. As the demons spread out over a region, the more clever ones will inscribe runes upon the ground. The fel taint pervades this entire hillside, but the corruption is darkest around these runes, disallowing anything pure to grow ever again.$b$bStudy these runes.

text.title: 秩序是关键
text.objectives: 摧毁保护监督者费罗拉克斯的水晶，然后消灭他。
text.description: 恶魔猎手牺牲自己的肉眼是为了能更清楚地看见恶魔，这对我们来说是一种仪式。$b$b下面有一个恶魔指挥官，就藏身在他的部队之中，这是常人的视力所无法看到的。他负责在混乱中维持秩序，正如我们必须控制自身的混乱一样。$b$b摧毁他的结界水晶，然后消灭他。

english.title: Control is Key
english.objectives: Destroy the crystal protecting Overseer Felorax, then slay him.
english.description: We demon hunters ritualistically remove our eyes in order to see the demons more clearly.$b$bDown below, a demon commander walks amongst his troops, unseen by normal eyes. He keeps the chaos in order, as we must keep our chaos in check.$b$bDestroy his warding crystal, then slay him.

text.title: 安瑟瑞尔水晶
text.objectives: 把安瑟瑞尔水晶带给达拉然的帕林教授。
text.description: <大多数安瑟瑞尔花的中间区域都有明显的晶化纤维，不过这朵花的纤维长得特别完美。>$b$b<帕林教授应该会很感兴趣。>

english.title: Aethrem Crystal
english.objectives: Bring the Aetherem Crystal to Professor Pallin in Dalaran.
english.description: <Most aethril has a sharp crystalline fiber in the center of the bloom, but this one is particularly well-developed.>$b$b<Professor Pallin would be interested in seeing this.>

text.title: 猎魔重任
text.objectives: 向帕林教授复命。
text.description: 我已经对你倾囊相授，铭文师。在与燃烧军团的斗争中，伊利达雷是你坚强的后盾。

english.title: The Burdens of Hunting
english.objectives: Report back to Professor Pallin.
english.description: There is nothing more I have to teach you, scribe. The Illidari stand behind you in the battle against the Legion.

text.title: 神秘信息
text.objectives: 把石板交给风暴峡湾的尼古拉·快索。
text.description: 考古商店的女人刚刚留下一些需要破译的石板。傻子都看得出上面刻着古代维库文字，不过我把法典借给一个徒弟了，所以我没办法在这里破译。$b$b他叫尼古拉·快索，就在风暴峡湾。$b$b告诉他，如果他破译不了的话，我就和他断绝师徒关系。$b$b就这样。

english.title: Mysterious Messages
english.objectives: Deliver the tablets to Nicholo Swiftfuse in Stormheim.
english.description: The woman at the archaeology shop just dropped off some tablets to be deciphered. Any fool can see they're written in ancient vrykul, but I lent my codex to one of my students, so I'm unable to decipher them here.$b$bHis name is Nicholo Swiftfuse, and he is in Stormheim. Let him know that if he fails to decipher them, his apprenticeship shall be terminated.$b$bThat is all.

text.title: 废墟中的符文
text.objectives: 在霍斯瓦尔德收集$1oa块古代维库符文石板。
text.description: 很不幸，帕林的法典并不全面。我们了解的东西非常有限，根本无法破译这上面的一些符号。$b$b看来我们需要到那个被维库人称为霍斯瓦尔德的地方，收集更多的石板。

english.title: Runes Within the Ruins
english.objectives: Collect $1oa Ancient Vrykul Rune Tablets within Haustvald.
english.description: Unfortunately, Pallin's codex isn't complete. There are many symbols here that simply cannot be deciphered with what we've learned.$b$bLooks like we'll need to go and collect more tablets down in the area that the vrykul call Haustvald.

text.title: 特制工具
text.objectives: 获取一把符文骨刀。
text.description: 从我破译出的有限资料中可以看出，雕刻石板的工具十分特别。$b$b如果我们能拿到那种工具，再加上一本完整的法典，就能轻易制作出自己的石板。$b$b那样也能证明我在破译他们语言的工作上十分成功。$b$b请帮我找来一把特制工具，$n。

english.title: Right Tool for the Job
english.objectives: Acquire a Runic Bone Knife.
english.description: From what little I have been able to decipher, I know that the tablets are created using a special carving tool.$b$bIf we had one of those tools, along with a complete codex, we could easily create our own tablet.$b$bThat would also serve to prove that my deciphering of their language has been successful.$b$bRetrieve one of those tools for me, $n.

text.title: 没那么简单？
text.objectives: 帮助尼古拉制造符文石板。
text.description: 好吧，我应该已经把遗漏的信息补充到法典里了。而且我们也拿到了大刀……呃，小刀。$b$b现在只需要制造我们自己的石板，并查证这些石板的其他疑点。$b$b我觉得它们不只是刻有文字的石板那么简单，而是某种魔法装置。

english.title: Not So Complex?
english.objectives: Assist Nicholo with the creation of a rune tablet.
english.description: Alright, I believe I've finished adding the missing entries into the codex. And we have the machete... err, knife.$b$bAll that's left is to make our own tablet and verify my other suspicion about these tablets:$b$bI believe that they're not just simple texts, but a sort of magical device.

text.title: 妙笔生花
text.objectives: 把合同交给达拉然下水道的莱杉。
text.description: $n，我需要你帮我送一份急件。$b$b是的，虽然这些琐事对你是大材小用，不过我现在实在是忙得不可开交，而且你和我都很清楚，我的时间比你的宝贵得多。$b$b快把这些合同交给达拉然下水道的守卫队长莱杉。

english.title: The Ink Flows
english.objectives: Deliver the contracts to Raethan in the Underbelly.
english.description: $n, I need you to make a quick delivery for me.$b$bYes, I've learned by now that such trivial tasks are beneath your skills... but I'm rather busy right now and we both know my time is much more important than yours.$b$bDeliver these contracts to Raethan, the Guard Captain in Dalaran's Underbelly.

text.title: 昔日铭文师
text.objectives: 消灭伊克罗特并取得失窃的暗影紫玉。
text.description: 达拉然的许多人无法承受规律生活的压力，他们把这些下水道当成某种……“安身处”。这份特殊合同的目标就是如此。$b$b他叫伊克罗特，以前是一个铭文师，就跟你一样。不过，他因为无法承受和教授相处的压力而被逼疯了。$b$b<莱杉把合同递给你。>$b$b上面说他偷走了卡蒂亚精品珠宝店的珠宝。把珠宝交给我，他身上的其他东西都归你。

english.title: Once a Scribe Like You
english.objectives: Kill Inkrot and obtain the Stolen Shadowruby.
english.description: These sewers are something of a... "settling place" for many who can't cope with the stresses of regular Dalaran life. Take, for example, the target of this particular contract.$b$bHis name is Inkrot. He was once a scribe like you, but the stresses of dealing with the Professor drove him mad.$b$b<Raethan hands you the contract.>$b$bThis says he's stolen a jewel from Cartier and Co. Bring me the jewel. Whatever else you find on him is yours.

text.title: 古怪饰品
text.objectives: 把腐烂的塔罗牌交给帕林教授。
text.description: 等等，$n，先别走……你没看到这个吗？$b$b<莱杉从珠宝底面剥下一张纸。>$b$b这不是报失的东西，反倒像是什么卡片。一定和铭文有关系。$b$b或许你能用得上。

english.title: An Odd Trinket
english.objectives: Give the Rotting Tarot Card to Professor Pallin.
english.description: Wait, $n, before you leave... did you not notice this?$b$b<Raethan peels a small piece of paper from the bottom of the jewel.>$b$bThis wasn't reported stolen. It appears to be a card of some kind. Must be a scribe thing.$b$bPerhaps it may be of some use to you.

text.title: 玫红精华
text.objectives: 把玫红精华带给达拉然的帕林教授。
text.description: <用这种花研磨出来的颜料品质非同一般。>$b$b<帕林教授应该会很感兴趣。>

english.title: Roseate Essence
english.objectives: Bring the Roseate Essence to Professor Pallin in Dalaran.
english.description: <The pigment milled from this flower is of an exceptionally high quality.>$b$b<Professor Pallin would be interested in seeing this.>

text.title: 蜡黄精华
text.objectives: 把蜡黄精华带给达拉然的帕林教授。
text.description: <邪能球茎凝结成了一块厚厚的颜料。所有邪能球茎制成的颜料都很不稳定，这批颜料更是散发出邪恶的能量。>$b$b<帕林教授应该会很感兴趣。>

english.title: Sallow Essence
english.objectives: Bring the Sallow Essence to Professor Pallin in Dalaran.
english.description: <The felwort is reduced to a thick, clotted pigment. While all felwort-begotten pigment is somewhat offensive, this batch practically glows with a malevolent energy.>$b$b<Professor Pallin would be interested in seeing this.>

text.title: 英灵殿：勇气愿景
text.objectives: 从英灵殿取得$1oa个瓦拉加尔符印。
text.description: 是时候再来次实地考察了，$n。前往英灵殿！$b$b瓦拉加尔精通各种符文制作工艺。我们或许可以为新配方找些灵感。

english.title: Halls of Valor: Vision of Valor
english.objectives: Retrieve $1oa Valarjar Rune-Sigils from the Halls of Valor.
english.description: I think it's time for another field trip, $n. To the Halls of Valor!$b$bThe Valarjar are masters of all types of runecraft. Perhaps we can find something useful for a new recipe.

text.title: 批量研磨技术
text.objectives: 在达拉然的铭文商店寻找研磨大师的手册。
text.description: 我以前的很多学徒对研磨都颇有微词。他们认为这道工序即“重复性高”又“无脑”，甚至非常“痛苦”。难道他们对悠久的铭文传统毫无敬意吗？$b$b我猜，你同意他们的想法，是吗？好吧。一直以来你的表现都十分优秀，所以应该没什么大碍。$b$b我有一本关于批量研磨的书，就放在店里的某个地方。你能找到的话它就归你了。

english.title: Mass Milling Techniques
english.objectives: Find The Masterful Miller's Manual in Dalaran's inscription shop.
english.description: A number of my previous students have been vocal in their displeasure regarding milling. They find the process "repetitive", "mindless", and even "painful". Have they no respect for the time-honored traditions of inscription?$b$bI suppose you count yourself among their number. Am I right? Very well. You've been a fine student so far, so I suppose there's no harm.$b$bI have a book about mass milling somewhere around the shop here. Find it, and it's yours.

text.title: 错综复杂
text.objectives: 到铁炉堡寻找B·比亚莎士。
text.description: 好吧，我不否认。这本《催人泪下的言情小说》是我的。$b$b我看这本书完全是为了学习书法，我向你保证！他写的“B”线条优美……“D”的笔法饱满圆润！$b$b其实……书法课会让你受益良多。这些书的作者叫B·比亚莎士。我相信你可以在铁炉堡的图书馆里找到他。$b$b别看了，徒弟。快走。把书还给我！

english.title: The Plot Thickens
english.objectives: Go to Ironforge and look for B. Spearshaker.
english.description: Very well, I won't deny it. The Steamy Romance Novel is mine.$b$bI only read it for the penmanship, I assure you! He writes such curvy "B"s... and such ample "D"s!$b$bIn fact... you might benefit from a penmanship lesson. The author of these books is one B. Spearshaker. I believe he can be found in the library in Ironforge.$b$bStop reading, student. You are dismissed. And give me my book back!

text.title: 传承经典
text.objectives: 写完催人泪下的言情小说（未完本）。
text.description: 我已经没有激情了，铭文师。我再也无法进入角色的内心。$b$b那边桌上有本没写完的小说，你看看吧。我写不下去了。或许你可以接着发挥。

english.title: The Legacy Passed On
english.objectives: Complete the Unfinished Steamy Romance Novel.
english.description: I've lost my passion, scribe. I just can't get into the voice o' the characters anymore.$b$bTake a look at that unfinished book over there on the table. I can't seem to finish it. Maybe ye'll have an easier time with it.

text.title: 恶魔墨水
text.objectives: 取得$1oa瓶邪魂鲜血和$2oa份萨格拉斯之血，并把它们混合成邪魂墨水。
text.description: 这些符印可以做成一张绝妙的塔罗牌。实际上，是非常强大的塔罗牌。我们只需要一种足够稳定的墨水进行铭文就行。$b$b所幸，我有学徒跟你一样，擅长取得难以获取的东西。$b$b这项工程要用到由恶魔血液混合而成的墨水。邪魂堡垒那些恶魔的血液就很合适。当然，你也需要萨格拉斯之血。

english.title: Demon Ink
english.objectives: Collect $1oa Vials of Felsoul Blood and $2oa Blood of Sargeras, then mix them into Felsoul Ink.
english.description: These sigils would make for a fantastic new tarot card. Quite powerful, in fact. We simply require an ink sturdy enough to inscribe them.$b$bFortunately, I have students like you that excel at fetching hard-to-get items.$b$bFor this project, I require ink mixed from demonic blood. The blood of the demons at Felsoul Hold will serve as a suitable base. You will also need Blood of Sargeras, of course.

text.title: 虚有其表
text.objectives: 收集$1oa张石皮皮革和$2oa份风暴之鳞。如果你不是剥皮师，那么可以通过拍卖行或者其他玩家来获取材料。
text.description: 欢迎，$n。能和你这么厉害的人一起共事，真是荣幸之至。$b$b在我们开始合作之前，首先得收集一些材料。$b$b破碎群岛上有许新奇的生物，拿它们的毛皮做实验的话一定会非常有趣。而且我们也需要用来制作锁甲的鳞片。$b$b去收集一些材料，这样我们才能开始工作。

english.title: Skin Deep
english.objectives: Acquire $1oa Stonehide Leather and $2oa Stormscales. If you are not a skinner, you may acquire them from the auction house or other players.
english.description: Welcome, $n. It's an honor to be working with someone of your caliber.$b$bIn order for us to begin our work together, we'll first need to collect some materials.$b$bThe Broken Isles are home to many strange, exotic creatures which no doubt have interesting hides to experiment with. We'll need scales to make mail armor with as well.$b$bGo and collect some materials for us so we may begin working.

text.title: 错综复杂
text.objectives: 到幽暗城去寻找F·赛培根
text.description: 好吧，我不否认。这本《催人泪下的言情小说》是我的。$b$b我看这本书完全是为了学习书法，我向你保证！他写的“B”线条优美……“D”的笔法饱满圆润！$b$b其实……书法课会让你受益良多。这些书的作者叫F·赛培根。我相信你可以在幽暗城的图书馆里找到他。$b$b别看了，徒弟。快走。把书还给我！

english.title: The Plot Thickens
english.objectives: Go to the Undercity and look for F. Serbacon.
english.description: Very well, I won't deny it. The Steamy Romance Novel is mine.$b$bI only read it for the penmanship, I assure you! He writes such curvy "B"s... and such ample "D"s!$b$bIn fact... you might benefit from a penmanship lesson. The author of these books is one F. Serbacon. I believe he can be found in the library in Undercity.$b$bStop reading, student. You are dismissed. And give me my book back!

text.title: 传承经典
text.objectives: 写完催人泪下的言情小说（未完本）。
text.description: 我已经没有激情了，铭文师。我再也无法进入角色的内心。$b$b那边桌上有本没写完的小说，你看看吧。我写不下去了。或许你可以接着发挥。

english.title: The Legacy Passed On
english.objectives: Complete the Unfinished Steamy Romance Novel.
english.description: I've lost my passion, scribe. I just can't find the voice of my characters anymore.$b$bTake a look at that unfinished book over there on the table. I can't seem to finish it. Maybe you'll have an easier time with it.

text.title: 尴尬的发现
text.objectives: 把《催人泪下的言情小说》交给帕林教授。
text.description: 这根本不像铭文课本……反倒更像一部催人泪下的言情小说。里面写的全是肉麻的爱情故事。$b$b这和铭文有关吗？不管怎么说，你应该跟帕林教授谈谈。

english.title: An Embarrassing Revelation
english.objectives: Bring the Steamy Romance Novel to Professor Pallin.
english.description: This doesn't appear to be an inscription textbook at all... it's more of a steamy romance novel. The pages are just FILLED with tawdry tales of carnality.$b$bCould it have something to do with inscription? Either way, Professor Pallin should be confronted.

text.title: Trouble for Okuna
text.objectives: Search for Okuna Longtusk.
text.description:
<You open the bottle and find a message inside.>

Help! I need somebody... but not just anybody. I need a champion! I finally escaped the grasp of Prince Oceanus only to be hunted by his father, King Deepbeard.

I was enjoying my freedom and decided to go fishing when that giant attacked. I've been running around these islands trying to avoid that creature ever since... if anyone gets this message, please send help!

english.title: Trouble for Okuna
english.objectives: Search for Okuna Longtusk.
english.description:
<You open the bottle and find a message inside.>

Help! I need somebody... but not just anybody. I need a champion! I finally escaped the grasp of Prince Oceanus only to be hunted by his father, King Deepbeard.

I was enjoying my freedom and decided to go fishing when that giant attacked. I've been running around these islands trying to avoid that creature ever since... if anyone gets this message, please send help!

text.objectives: xxxxx
text.description: xxxxx

english.title: Kill Azshara
english.objectives: xxxxx
english.description: xxxxx

text.title: 胡恩之战——来临
text.objectives: 消灭$2oa个燃烧军团恶魔。
text.description:
胡恩·高岭是我们部族力量的源头。在上一次燃烧军团威胁到我们的生死存亡之时，胡恩联合众多分散的部族，最后击败了那些恶魔。

了解他的故事，你就会明白为什么他的名字能让气馁的人鼓起勇气，让敌人闻风丧胆。
text.completion: [In broken Common] Feathered one said you come. Unng Ak not hope for you come. Tauren have thanks.

english.title: Huln's War - The Arrival
english.objectives: Defeat $2oa Legion.
english.description:
Huln Highmountain is the origin of our strength as a tribe. He bested the Legion when last they threatened our survival and unified many disparate tribes.

Live his story, and you will know why his name imbues courage in the cowardly and sows fear in the fearless.
english.completion: [In broken Common] Feathered one said you come. Unng Ak not hope for you come. Tauren have thanks.

objectiveDetails.description: 向黑角打听胡恩的故事

text.title: 过去的残影
text.objectives: 寻找线索，了解蔑潮港的命运。
text.description: <日记似乎是在仓促之间写下的。>$B$B我不知道村里出了什么事。从迷雾淹没海港开始，我的亲人们都变得不一样了。$B$B有的人变得野蛮暴力，有的人变得疯狂。很多人冒险进入迷雾，但是他们再也没能回来。$B$B在困难的时候，我们通常会去寻求塔本首领的指引，但是这次他也没能逃出迷雾的阴影。$B$B我不知道等待着我的会是什么。现在，我只能待在岗哨里并且保持警醒。

english.title: Remnants of the Past
english.objectives: Locate clues to discover the fate of Tideskorn Harbor.
english.description: <The journal entry appears hastily written.>$B$BI do not know what has become of my village. Ever since the mists engulfed the harbor, my kinsfolk have changed.$B$BSome have grown violent and savage, while others have fallen into madness. Many have ventured into the mists and have yet to return.$B$BIn these times, we can usually turn to our leader, Jarl Tarben. Alas, the mists have taken him as well.$B$BI do not know what will become of me. For now, I can only stay at my post and remain vigilant.

text.title: 卡德加的发现
text.objectives: 在达拉然与大法师卡德加谈一谈。
text.description: 勇士！请立刻前往紫罗兰城堡。$B$B我有了一个新发现，希望能在六人议会召开前与你分享。

english.title: Khadgar's Discovery
english.objectives: Speak with Archmage Khadgar in Dalaran.
english.description: Champion! Please come to the Violet Citadel immediately.$B$BI have made a discovery that I would like to share with you before the Council of Six.

text.title: 魔法信息
text.objectives: 在达拉然调查奥术畸体。
text.description: 过去的一万年里，精灵城苏拉玛一直被密封在奥术屏障之中，就像以前的达拉然一样。$B$B后来那道屏障轰塌了。$B$B从那时起，城市中就不断传出魔法能量的波动，仿佛池中的涟漪。我在阵阵波动中感觉到了一种规律。$B$B那是一个法术，隐藏在混沌之中。$B$B我在这里重现了那个法术。它并不危险，但除此以外……我完全不知道它有什么用处！

english.title: Magic Message
english.objectives: Examine the Arcane Anomaly in Dalaran.
english.description: For the last 10,000 years, the elven city of Suramar has been sealed in an arcane barrier, much like Dalaran once was.$B$BThat barrier has come down.$B$BSince then, waves of magical energy have been emanating from the city like ripples in a pond. It was in these waves that I sensed a pattern.$B$BA spell, encrypted among the chaos.$B$BI have recreated the spell here. It's not dangerous, but beyond that... I have no idea what it does!

text.title: 回响轨迹
text.objectives: 使用卡德加的魔杖找到奥术回响，并找出首席奥术师塔莉萨。
text.description:
夜之子可以成为我们对抗燃烧军团的强大盟友。我们必须尽力协助这个塔莉萨。

我们应该可以通过追踪魔法回响找到她的下落，就像我发现她的求救信息一样。

我可以将你传送到她录制信息的地点附近。你必须从那里开始寻找奥术能量中的特殊涟漪。

我的魔杖可以帮上忙。跟着它的火花走——它们应该可以把你带到塔莉萨使用魔法的地方。

english.title: Trail of Echoes
english.objectives: Use Khadgar's Wand to find Arcane Echoes and track down First Arcanist Thalyssra.
english.description:
The Nightborne could prove powerful allies against the Legion. We must aid this Thalyssra if we can.

We should be able to find her by tracking her magical echoes, the same way I found her distress call.

I can teleport you near the location where she recorded that message. From there, you must search for ripples in the very fabric of the arcane itself.

My wand should do the trick. Follow the sparks it creates--they should lead you to places where Thalyssra used her magic.

objectiveDetails.description: 找到首席奥术师塔莉萨

text.title: 胡恩之战——怒风
text.objectives: 与玛法里奥见面。
text.description: <艾特洛用鼻子蹭蹭你的手，然后转身。它回头看看，要你往南走。>
text.completion: You bring with you Eche'ro, and... what is this? The blessing of Cenarius?!

english.title: Huln's War - Stormrage
english.objectives: Meet Malfurion.
english.description: <Eche'ro nuzzles your hand and turns around. It looks back, beckoning you to the south.>
english.completion: You bring with you Eche'ro, and... what is this? The blessing of Cenarius?!

text.title: 胡恩之战——援军
text.objectives: 保护玛法里奥。
text.description:
塞纳留斯冒着巨大的风险来到这里，虽然没有停留多久，不过他为你赐予了祝福。他看到了你的能力，并选择你在这场战争中成为他的勇士。我稍后再跟你细谈此事。这份祝福实在难得。

现在我需要你的帮助，胡恩·高岭。我必须完成咒语，让屏障以外的树妖进入这里，为我们提供帮助。
text.completion: The ritual is complete. Reinforcements will be able to push through the portal and assist against the demonic hoard.

english.title: Huln's War - Reinforcements
english.objectives: Defend Malfurion.
english.description:
Cenarius himself has risked much in coming here, if only briefly, to bestow a blessing upon you. He has seen what you are capable of, and has chosen you as champion in this battle. I would speak with you on this later. It is a rare gift indeed.

But now, I ask for your help, Huln Highmountain. I must finish my incantations to allow dryads from beyond the veil to enter this place and lend us their aid.
english.completion: The ritual is complete. Reinforcements will be able to push through the portal and assist against the demonic hoard.

text.title: Blessing of Cenarius
text.objectives: Meet with Cenarius.
text.description:
Cenarius himself has risked much in coming here, if only briefly, to bestow a blessing upon you. He has seen what you are capable of, and has chosen you as champion in this battle.

Speak with him in the grove to the south.

english.title: Blessing of Cenarius
english.objectives: Meet with Cenarius.
english.description:
Cenarius himself has risked much in coming here, if only briefly, to bestow a blessing upon you. He has seen what you are capable of, and has chosen you as champion in this battle.

Speak with him in the grove to the south.

text.title: 胡恩之战——纳斯雷兹姆
text.objectives: 消灭提克迪奥斯。
text.description:
我要在这里整编部队并为即将到来的战斗做准备，实在分身乏术。

虽然我想亲手对付恐惧魔王提克迪奥斯，不过我要把这份荣耀交给你，胡恩·高岭。
text.completion: You see now, that Huln was mighty? He united the tribes and defeated terribly powerful foes.

english.title: Huln's War - The Nathrezim
english.objectives: Defeat Tichondrius.
english.description:
I am fully occupied here organizing my troops and planning for the battle to come.

While I would like to slay the Dreadlord Tichondrius myself, I will allow that honor to be yours, Huln Highmountain.
english.completion: You see now, that Huln was mighty? He united the tribes and defeated terribly powerful foes.

text.title: 真正的猎手
text.objectives: 在骄阳林地猎杀骨喙鹰，证明你是一位货真价实的猎手。
text.description:
我不知道赫米特为什么会和拉兹克一起狩猎。他的装置根本不可靠！ 

真正的猎手不会依赖于工具。他们靠的是直觉、技巧和敏捷。

告诉我，$n，你拥有真猎手的本事吗？最好还是证明给我看。

到附近的牧地去猎杀骨喙鹰吧。
text.completion: Now that's how a real hunter does it.

english.title: A True Hunter
english.objectives: Prove you're a worthy hunter by hunting Bonebeak Hawks in Sunfrost Glade.
english.description:
I don't know why Hemet hunts with Razik. His contraptions are unreliable at best! 

A true hunter doesn't need gadgets to hunt. They rely on instinct, skill, and agility.

So tell me, $n, do you have the skills of a true hunter? Better yet, prove it.

Take down some of the Bonebeak Hawks that circle the nearby meadow.
english.completion: Now that's how a real hunter does it.

text.title: 敲开勇者之门
text.objectives: 到蔑魔营地寻找维瑟尔。
text.description:
你与英灵殿有着不解之缘，然而已经有人捷足先登。神王靠着恶魔和邪恶玷污了它的阶梯。

你的龙族盟友正在奋力保卫大殿，他们需要你的帮助。维库人抓走了风暴巨龙的首领，维瑟尔。

救出你的巨龙朋友，勇士，把蔑魔者赶出勇者之门！
text.completion: What is this... I see? $B$BA friendly face... in a sea of foes?

english.title: Knocking on Valor's Door
english.objectives: Find Vethir in the Felskorn Camp.
english.description:
The Halls of Valor is your destiny to claim, but it is already in the claiming. The God-King befouls its steps with demons and wickedness.

Your dragon allies have come to Halls' defense, but they need your aid. The vrykul have taken the leader of the storm dragons, the one you call Vethir.

Free your dragon friend, champion, and wash the Felskorn from the Gates of Valor!
english.completion: What is this... I see? $B$BA friendly face... in a sea of foes?

text.title: 命运多舛
text.objectives: 从达瓦克斯身上拿到狱卒的碎片，然后把维瑟尔救出牢笼。
text.description:
我们赶来保卫英灵殿……我从天上被抓下来……

我无法挣脱束缚。找到制作这个牢笼的狱卒……

救我出去，朋友……
text.completion: You still manage to surprise me, outsider. Your trials are complete, and yet you still have challenges to face. $B$BThe God-King's forces are many, but in your weapon you possess the powers of Stormheim herself! Approach the gates, and these powers will lay low the enemies of this land!$B$BNow, let us take the fight to the God-King, and cleanse the Gates of Valor of his fel taint!

english.title: A Familiar Fate
english.objectives: Collect the Jailer's Shard from Dravax and free Vethir from his prison.
english.description:
We had come to defend the Halls of Valor... I was taken from the sky...

I cannot break free of my bindings. Find the jailer who made this cell...

Set me free, friend...
english.completion: You still manage to surprise me, outsider. Your trials are complete, and yet you still have challenges to face. $B$BThe God-King's forces are many, but in your weapon you possess the powers of Stormheim herself! Approach the gates, and these powers will lay low the enemies of this land!$B$BNow, let us take the fight to the God-King, and cleanse the Gates of Valor of his fel taint!

text.title: 力挽狂澜
text.objectives: 在勇者之门使用雷铸之角摧毁三个邪缚传送门。
text.description:
靠着他的恶魔盟友，斯科瓦尔德亵渎了勇者之门。他部队中那些扭曲的秘法师打开了传送门，引来了他们在荒芜世界的邪恶盟友。 

如果我们要阻止这股浪潮，就必须摧毁这些传送门。 

我会集结我的盟友。拿上这把号角，你找到传送门的时候就通知我们，我们会从空中发起攻击！
text.completion: I do not understand, the portals are closed and yet Skovald's demonic forces still assault the gates! $B$BWe must find where they are coming from!

english.title: Stem the Tide
english.objectives: Use the Stormforged Horn to destroy the three Felbound Portals in Gates of Valor.
english.description:
Skovald has profaned the Gates of Valor with his demonic allies. Among his forces his twisted mystics have conjured portals to ferry his fel allies from their blighted worlds. 

If we wish to stem this tide, these portals must be destroyed. 

I will gather my allies. Take this horn and signal when you have found a portal, and we will strike from the skies!
english.completion: I do not understand, the portals are closed and yet Skovald's demonic forces still assault the gates! $B$BWe must find where they are coming from!

text.title: 削弱攻势
text.objectives: 在勇者之门消灭加泽雷斯、卡鲁艾斯、摩尔戈，以及拉瓦塞斯。
text.description:
神王招募了强力的恶魔出任军官，以领导自己的腐化大军。要想终结他的攻击，就必须除掉这些军官首领。

这些恶魔过于强大，少有凡人能够与之匹敌。不过，你拥有风暴峡湾的力量，他们肯定不是你的对手。 

去消灭他们，削弱斯科瓦尔德的攻势！
text.completion: With their fel leaders slain, the God-King's forces will scatter. $B$BStill, we are not finished here. So long as the demons continue to assault the gates, Stormheim will not be safe.

english.title: Break the Spine
english.objectives: Defeat Garzareth, Karuas, Muorg and Ravathes in Gates of Valor.
english.description:
To lead his tainted forces,  the God-King has enlisted demons of great power to act as his lieutenants. If we wish to end his assault, we will need to take their leaders.

These demons are too powerful for most mortals to face, but with the power of Stormheim at your disposal, they will prove no match for you. 

Take them down, and shatter the spine of Skovald's offensive!
english.completion: With their fel leaders slain, the God-King's forces will scatter. $B$BStill, we are not finished here. So long as the demons continue to assault the gates, Stormheim will not be safe.

text.title: 风暴峡湾的救赎
text.objectives: 在勇者之门打败神王斯科瓦尔德。
text.description:
看来我们并没有摧毁所有的传送门。在神王的召唤之下，恶魔仍然源源不断地从勇者之门的建筑顶部倾泻而出。

我无法独自对抗斯科瓦尔德。来吧，勇士，我们联手向他出击，结束这场威胁！

为了风暴峡湾！
text.completion: It's unfortunate that the God-King escaped, but his defeat has stemmed the flow of the Legion into Stormheim.$B$BNow, the Halls of Valor await you.

english.title: Stormheim's Salvation
english.objectives: Defeat God-King Skovald in the Gates of Valor.
english.description:
It would seem that the portals we destroyed down here were not the only ones. Demons still pour in from the top of the Gates of Valor's edifice, summoned by the God-King himself!

I cannot face Skovald alone. Come, champion, let us take the battle to him and end this threat!

For Stormheim!
english.completion: It's unfortunate that the God-King escaped, but his defeat has stemmed the flow of the Legion into Stormheim.$B$BNow, the Halls of Valor await you.

text.title: 唯一出路
text.objectives: 护送塔莉萨到安全地带。
text.description:
我有很多事要告诉你，但这里说话不安全。我无法支撑这个屏障太久。

<塔莉萨托起一个精致的小瓶子凑到唇边。啜饮时她的眼波不断流动。>

如果我们往前推进，可以找到避难所。

english.title: The Only Way Out is Through
english.objectives: Escort Thalyssra to safety.
english.description:
I have much to tell you, but it is not safe to speak here. I cannot hold this barrier forever.

<Thalyssra lifts a delicate flask to her lips. Her eyes shimmer as she takes a sip.>

If we push through, we may find shelter up ahead.

objectiveDetails.description: 护送塔莉萨到安全地带

text.title: 魔瘾
text.objectives: 进入沙尔艾兰，寻找可以满足塔莉萨的渴求的东西。
text.description:
数千年来，我的族人一直受到暗夜井的滋养。远古魔力是我们的命脉，没有它，我们会……唉，你在那里看到他们的惨状了。

<塔莉萨拿起她的药瓶，慢慢喝掉最后几滴珍贵的井水。>

恐怕今天我是太过鲁莽。 

我的感官已经开始麻木。没有魔法的滋养，我会变得非常糟糕。

拜托你……帮我找些东西来续命……任何东西……

english.title: Arcane Thirst
english.objectives: Enter Shal'Aran and find something to sate Thalyssra's thirst.
english.description:
My people have subsisted on the Nightwell for millennia. Ancient mana is our lifeblood - without it, we become... well, you saw them out there.

<Thalyssra holds her flask aloft, gently shaking free the last precious drops.>

I'm afraid I have been rather reckless today.
