Already, my senses are dulling. Without magic to feed upon, I will turn. 

Please... find me something to feed upon... anything...

text.title: 引流魔网能量
text.objectives: 探索安诺拉山谷并找到魔网节点。
text.description: 建造地下大厅是为了利用苏拉玛地底的魔网能量线。我们慢慢学会以暗夜井维生，古老的设施也逐渐停用。$B$B这个房间显然正在从其他地方接收能量。$B$B现在只有涓涓细流，不过如果你可以引来更多的魔网能量，就可以让我们支撑下去。$B$B最近的能量源就在北边，位于安诺拉山谷附近。

english.title: Tapping the Leylines
english.objectives: Explore Anora Hollow and find the Ley Station there.
english.description: The arcways were built to tap into the magical leylines beneath Suramar. As we learned to subsist on the Nightwell, the old facilities fell out of use.$B$BThis chamber is clearly receiving power from elsewhere.$B$BThere is only a trickle now, but if you can direct more leyline energy here it will help to sustain us.$B$BThe closest source is to the north, near Anora Hollow.

objectiveDetails.description: 与奥术师瓦尔托伊交谈

text.title: 欧库勒斯的工作室
text.objectives: 把首席奥术师的徽记交给首席传送师欧库勒斯。
text.description:
我们必须找到首席传送师欧库勒斯，苏拉玛的传送网络就是他设计的。

在大分裂之前，欧库勒斯在苏拉玛旧城有一间工作室。他可能躲到那里去了。

<塔莉萨郑重其事地把一枚硬币放到你的手里。>

如果你找到他，就把这个给他看。希望是你先看到他，而不是他先看到你……

english.title: Oculeth's Workshop
english.objectives: Give the First Arcanist's Token to Chief Telemancer Oculeth.
english.description:
We need to make contact with Chief Telemancer Oculeth, the man who developed Suramar's teleportation network. 

Oculeth had a workshop in old Suramar, from the age before the Sundering. He may be taking refuge there.

<Thalyssra presses a small coin into your palm.>

If you find him, show him this. Hopefully you see him before he sees you...

text.title: 旧时盟友
text.objectives: 在琥珀谷寻找奥术师凯尔丹纳斯的藏身处。
text.description:
我本来想去琥珀谷，希望能找到一位老同事。

奥术师凯尔丹纳斯沉迷于枯法者研究。多年来，他一直在摸索如何平息他们的凶蛮天性，甚至是治好他们。

他有一个实验体逃了出来，跑到皇家花园胡作非为。所以，他被勒令停止研究，并且消灭手里的所有枯法者。他因为拒绝执行而遭到了流放。

如果凯尔丹纳斯还活着，他应该也快变成枯法者了。枯法者通常会被丢到废旧的居住地去，比如琥珀谷。

english.title: An Old Ally
english.objectives: Find Arcanist Kel'danath's hideout in Ambervale.
english.description:
I was on my way to Ambervale in hopes of finding an old colleague.

Arcanist Kel'danath was fascinated by the withered. He studied them for years hoping to calm their feral nature or even cure them.

When one of his subjects escaped and ran amok in the royal gardens, Kel'danath was ordered to cease his research and kill all withered in his possession. He refused, and was exiled.

If Kel'danath lives, he is near withered. And withered are drawn to old settlements like Ambervale.

text.title: 安瑟瑞尔花样本
text.objectives: 把安瑟瑞尔花样本带给达拉然的奎茵·柔步。
text.description: 这株药草明显吸收了土地的魔力。魔网能量沿着根茎流向叶脉。$b$b达拉然的草药学训练师肯定想看看它。

english.title: Aethril Sample
english.objectives: Bring the Aethril Sample to Kuhuine Tenderstride in Dalaran.
english.description: This herb has clearly been absorbing magical energy from the land. Filaments of ley energy course from root to leaf.$b$bYour herbalism trainer in Dalaran will want to see this.

text.title: 辣手摧花
text.objectives: 获取新鲜的雌蕊和完美的雄蕊。
text.description: 它的根茎、枝叶和花瓣都十分炫目，没错吧……但是看看这里的授粉茎丝，还有花朵中心的繁育器官，它们蕴含的能量比其余部分的总量还要多。$b$b据我推断，重点处理这些部位的话，可以提高安瑟瑞尔花的利用率和采集效率。$b$b话说回来，这朵花已经受损了，要确认我的推断就需要一些没有受损的样本。

english.title: Spayed by the Spade
english.objectives: Obtain a Pristine Pistil and a Stainless Stamen.
english.description: The stem, leaves, and petals are dazzling, to be certain... but look at the pollination filaments, here, and the reproductive organs in the center of the bloom. They contain more energy than the rest of the plant put together.$b$bI suspect that we can more responsibly and efficiently harvest aethril by focusing on these parts.$b$bStill, it looks like this bloom has been damaged. I need undamaged parts if I'm to be sure.

text.title: 破烂的丝带
text.objectives: 跟奎茵·柔步谈谈枯法者和安瑟瑞尔花的事情。
text.description: 这些做工精良的布条已经变得破破烂烂、肮脏不堪，明显跟枯法者有关。$b$b那些堕落而凶残的枯法者是夜之子一族的流亡者，他们也在采集安瑟瑞尔花……为什么？

english.title: Ragged Strips of Silk
english.objectives: Speak with Kuhuine Tenderstride about aethril and the withered.
english.description: Finely made strips of clothing, torn, tattered, and dirty: telltale signs of the withered.$b$bThe feral, degenerate outcasts of nightborne society must also be harvesting the aethril... but why?

text.title: 实践出真知
text.objectives: 从阿苏纳的枯法者身上取得$1oa块被咬过的安瑟里尔根茎。
text.description: 我们说不定可以利用这条线索，$n。$b$b枯法者对法力的饥渴臭名远播，他们会不遗余力地夺取法力。或许我们可以研究他们如何使用安瑟瑞尔花，借此改良我们的采集方式。

english.title: Desperation Breeds Ingenuity
english.objectives: Obtain $1oa Chewed Aethril Stems from Withered in Azsuna.
english.description: I believe we may be able to use this clue to our advantage, $n.$b$bThe withered are notoriously thirsty for mana, and will stop at nothing to get it. Perhaps we can study how they use the aethril and use the results to improve our own harvesting methods.

text.title: 意外发现
text.objectives: 就安瑟瑞尔花的快速繁育性与奎茵·柔步进行讨论。
text.description: 采集安瑟瑞尔花的时候，你的手无意间让花朵的授粉部位互相接触，使它们产生了反应。$b$b你也许发现了一项新的草药学技术。你可以跟达拉然的那位训练师好好讨论一下。

english.title: A Slip of the Hand
english.objectives: Speak with Kuhuine Tenderstride about the quick-reproducing property of aethril.
english.description: As you harvest the aethril, your hand brushes the flower's pollinating organs against one another, creating a reaction.$b$bYou may have discovered a new herbalism technique. Your trainer in Dalaran would be a good person to discuss this with.

text.title: 入梦叶样本
text.objectives: 把入梦叶带给达拉然的奎茵·柔步。
text.description: 这株亮绿的药草薄如蝉翼，还带有一定的粘性。$b$b达拉然的草药学训练师肯定想看看它。

english.title: Dreamleaf Sample
english.objectives: Bring the Dreamleaf Sample to Kuhuine Tenderstride in Dalaran.
english.description: The herb is brilliantly green, paper-thin, and somewhat sticky.$b$bYour herbalism trainer in Dalaran will want to see this.

text.title: 敏感药草
text.objectives: 获取$1oa株健康的入梦叶和$2oa株染病的入梦叶。
text.description: 这株入梦叶好像有点不一样。它不够纯净。$b$b我有一个推测。$b$b瓦尔莎拉的环境遭到了梦魇诅咒的污染。像这种敏感的药草可能很容易受到感染。$b$b我需要更多的信息才能得出结论。帮我找一些健康的样本和一些染疫的样本，进行后续研究。

english.title: An Empathetic Herb
english.objectives: Obtain $1oa Healthy Dreamleaf and $2oa Blight-Infested Dreamleaf.
english.description: Something is different about this dreamleaf, though. It is less than pure.$b$bI have a theory.$b$bThe wilds of Val'sharah have been blighted by a nightmarish curse. Sensitive herbs like this may be susceptible to such a blight.$b$bI need more information before I can draw any conclusions. Find me some healthy samples and some blight-infested samples, and we can continue.

text.title: 扭曲至死
text.objectives: 在洛拉希尔寻找一位专家，帮助你了解瘟疫对药草的影响。
text.description: 这株药草已经被彻底污染了。$b$b这场瘟疫是一股神秘的力量，其复杂程度已经远超普通草药学的范畴。你需要找到一位研究疫病的专家来帮你分析这里的确切情况。

english.title: Twisted to Death
english.objectives: Find someone in Lorlathil to teach you about the blight's effects on herbs.
english.description: The corruption has completely taken this herb.$b$bThis blight is a mysterious force whose complexities transcend the teachings of simple herbalism. An expert in such infestation will need to tell you what's really going on here.

text.title: 每株植物的死亡都是沉重的损失
text.objectives: 在瓦尔莎拉消灭$1oa个萨特。
text.description: 我们必须展开报复行动。我虽明白翡翠梦境与梦魇之间维持平衡的重要性，但是这场腐化已经完全失控！$b$b萨特。这一切都是萨特造成的。一定要让他们付出代价！完成之后艾露恩将赐予你丰厚的奖励！

english.title: One Dead Plant is One Too Many
english.objectives: Slay $1oa satyrs within Val'sharah.
english.description: We must exact VENGEANCE for this. While I understand the importance of the balance between the Emerald Dream and the Nightmare, this time it's corruption has gone TOO FAR!$b$bSatyrs. I blame the satyrs for this. Make them pay! Make them pay, and Elune will reward you with her bounty!

text.title: 梦魇的扼杀
text.objectives: 将被瘟疫扼杀的草药带给瓦尔莎拉的荒野工匠奥斯默。
text.description: 又一株死于瘟疫的植物。它完全萎缩，无法接触阳光。$b$b你应该把它带到洛拉希尔，交给荒野工匠奥斯默。他也会为之痛惜。

english.title: Choked by Nightmare
english.objectives: Bring the Blight-Choked Herb to Wildcrafter Osme in Val'sharah.
english.description: Another plant, killed by the blight. This one coiled so hard that it starved itself of sunlight.$b$bYou should bring it to Wildcrafter Osme in Lorlathil. He won't be happy.

text.title: 忍无可忍
text.objectives: 用图索兰的召唤石召唤并消灭图索兰。
text.description: 我们必须立即对抗这场腐化，$n。$b$b这是我们应尽的责任，否则我们就不配成为英雄，成为草药师。$b$b成为英雄草药师。$b$b只是消灭萨特还不够，我们必须除掉他们的首领。带着这株被扼杀的草药前往东北方的沙拉尼尔。找到图索兰的召唤石，把草药放在石头前面。然后……砍下恶魔的头颅。$b$b为这些植物报仇。

english.title: The Last Straw
english.objectives: Use Tur'xoran's Summoning Stone to summon and slay Tur'xoran.
english.description: We cannot falter in our crusade against this corruption, $n.$b$bIt is our duty as heroes. As herbalists.$b$bAs hero-balists.$b$bSlaying simple satyrs will not do. We must attack their leaders. Bring this fallen herb to Shala'nir, in the northeast. Find Tur'xoran's summoning stone, and place this herb in front of it. Then... rip off his head.$b$bDo it for the plants.

text.title: 狐尾花样本
text.objectives: 获取$1oa株狐尾花样本，带给达拉然的奎茵·柔步。
text.description: 这株药草的模样……和气味引起了你的注意。$b$b达拉然的草药学训练师肯定有兴趣研究这种刺鼻的新品种。

english.title: Foxflower Sample
english.objectives: Obtain $1oa samples of Foxflower, then bring them to Kuhuine Tenderstride in Dalaran.
english.description: Something about this herb catches your eye... and your nose.$b$bYour herbalism trainer in Dalaran would certainly be interested in studying some samples of this piquant new flower.

text.title: 细齿咬痕
text.objectives: 把被咬过的狐尾花根茎带给达拉然的奎茵·柔步。
text.description: 这株药草被本地的野生动物咀嚼过。$b$b什么动物会吃狐尾花呢？熊么？$b$b或许达拉然的训练师会知道答案。

english.title: Teeny Bite Marks
english.objectives: Bring the Nibbled Foxflower Stem to Kuhuine Tenderstride in Dalaran.
english.description: This herb has been chewed by some of the local wildlife.$b$bWhat kind of animal would eat foxflower? A bear?$b$bPerhaps your trainer in Dalaran will know.

text.title: 追踪元凶
text.objectives: 找出进食狐尾花的生物，追踪它们并拿到12个咬过的狐尾花碎片。
text.description: 这是一株强大的药草，$n。某些生物偶尔会吞食弱性药草，但是它们通常会避免接触这种强效的植物。$b$b我禁不住好奇，到底什么动物会吃狐尾花呢？是驼鹿吗？$b$b你应该进一步调查。去找出食用狐尾花的生物，想办法在它逃跑之前从它嘴里抢下一些狐尾花。

english.title: Chase the Culprit
english.objectives: Find out what creature has been eating Foxflower, then chase it and catch 12 Chewed Foxflower Bits.
english.description: This is a powerful herb, $n. Creatures will occasionally snack on some simpler herbs, but usually they avoid plants of such potency.$b$bI'm intrigued. What kind of animal would eat foxflower? A moose?$b$bYou should investigate further. Find out what creature has been snacking on foxflower, and then see if you can wrestle some of the flowers from its mouth, before it escapes.

objectiveDetails.description: 找出进食狐尾花的生物

text.title: 火眼精睛
text.objectives: 把狐尾花臭腺带给达拉然的奎茵·柔步。
text.description: 你采好狐尾花之后，发现花朵上有一个特别的地方。$b$b在一片叶子与根茎相连的地方，有个凸起的小包。仔细查看之后，你发现这里就是狐尾花异味的来源。$b$b你的草药学训练师肯定有兴趣知道。

english.title: The Pied Picker
english.objectives: Bring the Foxflower Scent Gland to Kuhuine Tenderstride in Dalaran.
english.description: As you finish gathering the foxflower, a particular part of the bloom catches your eye.$b$bOne of the leaves has a small protuberance, right where it meets the stem. Further investigation suggests that this is where the foxflower's unusual smell comes from.$b$bYour herbalism trainer would be interested in seeing this.

text.title: 夏斯卡格草样本
text.objectives: 把$1oa个夏斯卡格草带给达拉然的奎茵·柔步。
text.description: 对那些没有受过草药学训练的人来说，这株多刺灌木一点也不起眼。而以你在草药学上的经验，足以发现它的特别。$b$b多找些这种植物的样本，达拉然的训练师肯定想看看。

english.title: Fjarnskaggl Sample
english.objectives: Bring $1oa Fjarnskaggl to Kuhuine Tenderstride in Dalaran.
english.description: To one not trained in herbalism, this brambly bush might appear to be entirely useless. Your training, however, reveals this to be a very special plant indeed.$b$bYour herbalism trainer in Dalaran will want to see some more samples of this.

text.title: 羊角铲
text.objectives: 把羊角铲带给达拉然的奎茵·柔步。
text.description: 从铲柄上的符文标记可以看出，这是维库草药师所遗落的工具。$b$b显然，维库人也在采集夏斯卡格草。你的训练师奎茵提到过，她曾在书里看到这种药草。$b$b或许她会有兴趣看看维库人的收割工具。

english.title: Ram's-Horn Trowel
english.objectives: Bring the Ram's-Horn Trowel to Kuhuine Tenderstride in Dalaran.
english.description: The rune markings along the tool's grip suggest that it was left behind by a vrykul herbalist.$b$bApparently, the vrykul are also gathering this fjarnskaggl. Your trainer, Kuhuine, mentioned that she had read about this herb in the past.$b$bPerhaps she might be interested in seeing the tools that the vrykul use to harvest it.

text.title: 维库草药知识
text.objectives: 在风暴峡湾找出三本维库草药学书籍。
text.description: <奎茵继续研究羊角铲。>$b$b这是标准的挖掘工具。没有什么特别的，除了……$b$b……这确实表示维库人还在积极地采集这种草药。$b$b他们应该比我们更了解这种草药。我们要做的，就是找出他们把这些资讯放在哪里。

english.title: Vrykul Herblore
english.objectives: Find three vrykul Herbology books in Stormheim.
english.description: <Kuhuine studies the trowel further.>$b$bThis is a standard digging tool. There is not much to be learned here, except...$b$b...this DOES suggest that the vrykul are still actively gathering this herb.$b$bThe vrykul likely know much more about this herb than we do. All we need to do is find out where their knowledge is stored.

text.title: 遗失的书页
text.objectives: 把符文日志残页带给达拉然的奎茵·柔步。
text.description: <这张书页像是从一本书里撕掉的。上面写着：>$b$b”……海之石冢，自古以来的众神钟爱之地。$b$b他把夏斯卡格草作为祭品放在石冢边，口中念道‘‘圣草复始，生生不息’，然后接受他所需的祝福。”$b$b这可能与你带给草药学训练师的那本书有关。

english.title: The Missing Page
english.objectives: Bring the Runed Journal Page to Kuhuine Tenderstride in Dalaran.
english.description: <The page appears to be ripped out of a larger book. It reads:>$b$b"...the Cairn of the Sea, a place long-known to be beloved by the gods.$b$bHe placed his offering of fjarnskaggl at the foot of the cairn, mouthed the words 'Herbs beget herbs', and received the blessing he desired."$b$bThis may be related to the books you brought back to your herbalism trainer.

text.title: 夏斯卡格草
text.objectives: 带上20株夏斯卡格草前往风暴峡湾，找到风化的石冢并寻求圣草的祝福。
text.description: 看啊！好像有一个叫做托古斯的维库草药师曾经把夏斯卡格草贡品带到了海边的石冢处——应该就在风暴峡湾——然后他就获得了祖先的祝福。$b$b<奎茵耸了耸肩。>$b$b值得一试，但是不知道你会有什么样的遭遇，所以最好带上几个朋友一起去。

english.title: Fjarnskaggl
english.objectives: Bring 20 Fjarnskaggl to the Wind-Worn Cairn in Stormheim, then earn the Blessing of Fjarnskaggl.
english.description: There! It seems that there was a vrykul herbalist, Torgus, who brought a gift of fjarnskaggl to a seaside cairn - presumably in Stormheim - and by doing so received a blessing from his ancestors.$b$b<Kuhuine shrugs.>$b$bIt's worth a shot, though without knowing what you're getting into, you may want to bring friends with you.

objectiveDetails.description: 获取夏斯卡格草的祝福

text.title: 星光玫瑰粉尘
text.objectives: 把星光玫瑰粉尘带给达拉然的奎茵·柔步。
text.description: 尽管你已经接受了诸多训练，但玫瑰还是在你手中化为了粉尘。$b$b达拉然的草药学训练师肯定想看看。

english.title: Starlight Rosedust
english.objectives: Bring the Starlight Rosedust to Kuhuine Tenderstride in Dalaran.
english.description: Despite all your training, the rose disintegrated in your hand.$b$bYour herbalism trainer in Dalaran will want to see this.

text.title: 轻柔的触碰
text.objectives: 尝试采集$1oa株星光玫瑰。
text.description: 很遗憾，我这里没有能够帮助你的特殊技术。你只能磨练自己的手法。回去处理星光玫瑰时一定要格外轻柔。

english.title: The Gentlest Touch
english.objectives: Attempt to harvest $1oa more Starlight Roses.
english.description: Sadly, I don't have any special techniques that can help you here. You'll simply need to practice your methods. Get back out there, and focus on a gentle touch when dealing with starlight roses.

text.title: 嵌宝铲柄
text.objectives: 把嵌宝铲柄带给达拉然的奎茵·柔步。
text.description: 玫瑰旁边放着一把精工雕刻的铲柄。铲刃已经脱落，显然这铲柄有点华而不实。达拉然的草药学训练师可能有兴趣看看这个。

english.title: Jeweled Spade Handle
english.objectives: Bring the Jeweled Spade Handle to Kuhuine Tenderstride in Dalaran.
english.description: An immaculately carved spade handle lies beside the rose. Apparently the spade was more beautiful than it was durable, as the blade has completely fallen off.$b$bYour herbalism trainer may be interested in seeing this.

text.title: 铲刃
text.objectives: 寻找断掉的草药师铲子。
text.description: 你注意到铲柄基座上的字迹了吗，$n？上面写着“草药师塔里隆”，使用的是夜之子的书写方式。$b$b这个铲柄对我们无甚用处，不过它的铲刃或许能给我们提供更多的信息，让我们了解如何提高采集星光玫瑰的成功率。$b$b我建议在苏拉玛搜寻断掉的铲子。

english.title: The Spade's Blade
english.objectives: Find the Broken Herbalist's Blade.
english.description: Did you notice the script along the base of the handle, $n? It says "Herbalist Tharillon," in the writing of the nightborne.$b$bThe handle does little for us, but perhaps the blade of this spade will give us some information on how to harvest the starlight rose without failing quite so often.$b$bI would start my search for it in Suramar.

text.title: 疯狂涂鸦
text.objectives: 把潦草涂鸦带给达拉然的奎茵·柔步。
text.description: 一张肮脏的牛皮纸上潦草地写满了愤怒的话。一段文字引起了你的注意：$b$b     “$g他:她;以为自己知道怎么采集草药$b $n$N$b$N$N    偷走了我的铲刃$b  我要撕碎$g他的:她的;喉咙$b$b我只需要$b      一点点法力$b也许安瑟瑞尔花，没错……”$b$b草药学训练师可能会想看看这个。

english.title: Insane Ramblings
english.objectives: Bring the Scribbled Ramblings to Kuhuine Tenderstride in Dalaran.
english.description: Scribbled, angry phrases on a dirty scrap of vellum. One part catches your eye:$b$b     "thinks $gHE:SHE; knows how to gather herbs$b $n$N$b$N$N    steal my blade$b  slit $ghis:her; THROAT when I$b$b        just need$b      a bit more mana$b    maybe aethril, yes..."$b$bYour herbalism trainer may be interested in seeing this.

text.title: 塔里隆的灭亡
text.objectives: 将20堆星光玫瑰粉尘带到阿苏纳，用它们引出藏匿的草药师塔里隆，然后从他身上搜寻有关草药学的信息。
text.description: 他提到了你的名字……他的铲刃……安瑟瑞尔花……$b$b以我看，这肯定出自草药师塔里隆的手笔。而且看样子，他可能陷入了堕夜精灵的困境。此外，如果他在找安瑟瑞尔花，那他可能就在阿苏纳的某个地方。$b$b塔里隆现在是我们认识星光玫瑰的唯一希望。去找到他，最好带上几个朋友一起……看情况免不了一场恶斗。

english.title: Tharillon's Fall
english.objectives: Bring 20 piles of Starlight Rosedust to Azsuna, use them to taunt Herbalist Tharillon out of hiding, then search him for information about herbalism.
english.description: He mentions your name... his blade... aethril...$b$bI'd say that this is absolutely from Herbalist Tharillon, and by the look of it, he may have succumbed to the plight of the nightfallen. Furthermore, if he's looking for aethril, he's probably in Azsuna somewhere.$b$bTharillon is currently our only hope for learning more about starlight roses. Seek him out, but you may want to bring friends... he likely won't go without a fight.

text.title: 邪能球茎样本
text.objectives: 把邪能球茎样本带给达拉然的奎茵·柔步。
text.description: 这株药草充满了沸腾的邪能。它十分光滑、干燥、凉爽，不过摸起来会感到疼痛。$b$b达拉然的草药学训练师肯定想看看。

english.title: Felwort Sample
english.objectives: Bring the Felwort Sample to Kuhuine Tenderstride in Dalaran.
english.description: This herb bubbles and seethes with a foul energy. It is smooth, dry, and cool, yet somehow quite painful to touch.$b$bYour herbalism trainer in Dalaran will want to see this.

text.title: 邪能球茎分析报告
text.objectives: 收集雷诺·布鲁菲尔德的分析报告，达妮·地触的分析报告，以及罗霍尔的分析报告。
text.description: 我曾把邪能球茎样本寄给一些草药师同事帮忙研究，但是还没有收到他们的报告。能不能请你去问问他们的进展，并取回他们的报告。$b$b雷诺·布鲁菲尔德目前正在安戈洛环形山工作。$b$b达妮·地触正在索拉查盆地研究弗蕾亚的影响。$b$b最后还有一位，罗霍尔一直在戈尔隆德的繁茂地区工作。

english.title: Felwort Analysis
english.objectives: Collect Ryno Bloomfield's Analysis, Dani Earthtouch's Analysis, and Lohor's Analysis.
english.description: I sent felwort samples to some of my fellow herbalists, but haven't heard back from them yet. Could you please follow up with them and collect their analyses.$b$bRyno Bloomfield is currently working in Un'goro Crater.$b$bDani Earthtouch is researching Freya's influence in Sholazar Basin.$b$bFinally, Lohor has been working in the overgrown portion of Gorgrond.

text.title: 翡翠梦魇：邪能球茎精通
text.objectives: 前往翡翠梦魇，清除塞纳留斯的腐化。然后返回达拉然，向奎茵报告你的发现。
text.description: 我有个关于提高邪能球茎收割效率的理论，$n。你也知道，为了理解事物的原理，有时候需要逆向操作。我近来听说我们伟大的神灵之一，塞纳留斯遭到了腐化。我相信，这些草药中的腐化也同样存在于他的体内。$b$b如果你可以清除他的腐化，并设法了解腐化的运作和移除方式，我就可以利用这方面的知识来改进草药的收割方式。

english.title: The Emerald Nightmare: Felwort Mastery
english.objectives: Travel to the Emerald Nightmare and cleanse Cenarius of his affliction. Bring back anything you discover to Kuhuine in Dalaran.
english.description: I have a theory on how we can better harvest this felwort, $n. You see, sometimes in order to understand how something comes into being, you have to work backwards.$b$bI've recently heard of the corruption of one of our greatest gods, Cenarius. I have no doubt the same corruption that lives in these herbs also resides within him now.$b$bIf you were able to cleanse that corruption, find a way to understand how it works and remove it, I think we can apply that to how we harvest these herbs.

text.title: 英雄猎杀者
text.objectives: 消灭维格弗斯·刀风的战队，并夺得他的武器。
text.description:
为了嘲讽我的组织，海拉搞了个“海拉加尔”出来。这支军队由强大的亡灵组成，专门猎杀英勇的战士，并抢在我的瓦格里之前夺走他们的灵魂。其中有一个叫维格弗斯·刀风的，是海拉的亲卫勇士。他的武器是我多年前亲手锻造的，被他偷走并占为己有。

他已经返回蔑潮港，准备把一批窃取的灵魂送到冥狱深渊。去那里干掉他和其他的海拉加尔，那武器就归你了。

english.title: The Hunter of Heroes
english.objectives: Deal with Vigfus Bladewind's warband and claim his blades.
english.description:
Helya has made a mockery of my order by creating her own "helarjar", powerful undead tasked with hunting down heroic warriors and taking their souls before my val'kyr can claim them. Among them is her personal champion, Vigfus Bladewind, who wields stolen blades I forged myself long ago.

He has returned to Tideskorn Harbor with a full cargo of stolen souls to take to Helheim. Go there, kill him and his helarjar, and make the swords yours.

objectiveDetails.description: 消灭维格弗斯·刀风以及他的战队
与艾瑞莉娅交谈以前往蔑潮港

text.title: 迷雾阴影
text.objectives: 在冥口浅湾击败斯坦、希格里德、柯吉尔、和哈维尔四名船长。
text.description:
海湾里大多数克瓦迪尔以前都是港口的居民，后来遭到了海巫海拉的诅咒，永世为她效力。

你读到的那些人依然在死水中徘徊。但是好心人可以用利剑让他们暂时休息一下。

你是个好心人吗？

english.title: Shadows in the Mists
english.objectives: Defeat Captain Sten, Sigrid, Kjell and Halvir in Helmouth Shallows.
english.description:
Many of the Kvaldir here in the bay are former denizens of this harbor, cursed by the sea-witch Helya to do her bidding for all time.

The ones you read about, they still walk the stagnant waters. They could be given respite, should a kind soul bring it to them at the tip of a blade.

So tell me, how kind is your soul?

text.title: 本性与塑造
text.objectives: 和$1oa只沼岩蝌蚪谈一谈。
text.description:
我太欣赏鱼人了，所以不会让你消灭所有的成年鱼人。

我们应该做的是让下一代鱼人更加崇尚平和。奔波尔霸最适合这种任务了。

让他跟鱼人蝌蚪谈谈，他肯定会让那些蝌蚪加入我们的。
text.completion: Murky's gained quite the following, hasn't he? Perhaps they can help him out.

english.title: Nature vs. Nurture
english.objectives: Talk to $1oa Swamprock Tadpoles.
english.description:
I appreciate murloc-kind far too much to tell you to go kill all the adults.

What we should be doing is setting up the next generation to be more peaceful; Murky is the best representative for this. 

Bring him to talk to the murloc tadpoles. He'll get them on our side.
english.completion: Murky's gained quite the following, hasn't he? Perhaps they can help him out.

text.title: 浅滩拾荒
text.objectives: 在冥口浅湾的船只残骸中搜寻哈维的线索。
text.description:
克瓦迪尔存在的意义就是妨害奥丁。他们就在这里进行妨害工作。他们抢夺尚未接受审判的生者灵魂，这就相当于抢走了奥丁的勇士。

他们把灵魂带到这里，之后运给海拉。但因为雾气的遮掩，运输方式不得而知。

你似乎并不受雾气的影响。如果你在海湾的沉船中搜索一下的话，或许就能找到答案。你们这些外来者啊，不管秘密隐藏得多深，你们似乎都能发掘出来。

english.title: Scavenging the Shallows
english.objectives: Search the Shipwreck Debris in Helmouth Shallows for Havi's clue.
english.description:
The kvaldir exist to spite Odyn, and it is here their spiteful work is done. They rob the souls of the living - the souls not yet judged - thus robbing Odyn of his champions.

They bring them here to transport to Helya, though the mists obscure any indications of how.

You seem to fare the mists well. Perhaps if you search the wreckage in the bay, the answer may present itself. You outsiders seem to have a knack for uncovering the most hidden of secrets.

text.title: 会爆炸的鱼
text.objectives: 收集$1oa个河豚鱼卵。
text.description:
我最喜欢奔波尔霸这小家伙了。不过要想改变这里的鱼人族群，他还需要一些厉害的能力。

附近的水域里有许多河豚鱼，应该对他有用。 

消灭一些河豚鱼，然后帮奔波尔霸收集他们的鱼卵。
text.completion:
The pufferfish will be a perfect resource for Murky! I'll just whip up a spell to make them grow more quickly.

All he'll have to do is throw, then boom!

english.title: I'll Huff, I'll Puff...
english.objectives: Collect $1oa Pufferfish Eggs.
english.description:
Murky is my favorite little fella. However, in order to lead a change in the murloc population here, he needs some awesome abilities.

There are a lot of pufferfish around in the water, and I think that they could be a good resource for him. 

Kill a few and collect their eggs for Murky.
english.completion:
The pufferfish will be a perfect resource for Murky! I'll just whip up a spell to make them grow more quickly.

All he'll have to do is throw, then boom!

text.title: 操控大师的手段
text.objectives: 从军团营地：混沌的恶魔身上取得一枚支配符文。
text.description: 虽然我知道你只是来这里送羊皮纸的，不过一位$c的能力对我们大有帮助。我们力量有限，只能在这里阻挡恶魔的入侵，根本没有多余的人手可以深入敌军营地。$b$b阵线后方有更强大的敌人，他们正在从远处发号施令。他们携带着魔法符文，以此控制前线的恶魔。$b$b我想对这种符文进行研究。请为我取得一枚符文，这样我们就可以想办法用它来对付燃烧军团。

english.title: Strings of the Puppet Masters
english.objectives: Acquire a Rune of Dominance from the demons at Legion Camp: Chaos.
english.description: I understand you were just here to deliver the vellums, but we could use your skills as a $c. Our forces can only hold back the demon invasion, disallowing us to send anyone further into the enemy's camp.$b$bThe stronger of their forces stay in the back, commanding from a distance. They carry enchanted runes to keep control over the frontline demons.$b$bI would very much like to study one of these runes. Please retrieve one for me, so we may learn from it and use it against the Legion.

text.title: 进食时间
text.objectives: 在污泥草中穿梭游弋，用$1oa束污泥草给奔波尔霸喂食。
text.description:
奔波尔霸正在长身体，他需要进食！对于年轻鱼人来说，没有比污泥草更合适的食物了。

在鱼人的水域里就有很多，游过去喂饱奔波尔霸吧！
text.completion: Murky seems to have gotten a very strong slime ability due to this slimeweed. Fantastic!

english.title: Slime Time
english.objectives: Feed Murky $1oa Bunches of Slimeweed by swimming through them.
english.description:
Murky's a growing boy, he needs to eat! What better than slimeweed for a young murloc?

There's plenty of it around in the water amongst the murlocs; swim through it and feed Murky!
english.completion: Murky seems to have gotten a very strong slime ability due to this slimeweed. Fantastic!

text.title: 邪魔之秘
text.objectives: 阅读邪魔之秘魔典，选择浩劫专精或者复仇专精。
text.description:
恶魔的致命失误就是把秘密记入魔典。它散发出的邪能相当强大。

不过，我们只能执行其中的一个仪式。在那之后，魔典就会能量尽失。

你来决定我们将利用哪个秘密来对付燃烧军团。

english.title: Fel Secrets
english.objectives: Read the Tome of Fel Secrets to choose between the Havoc and Vengeance specializations.
english.description:
The demons made a grave error inscribing their secrets into this book. The fel energy emanating from it is potent.

But there's only enough to enact one of the rituals. After that, the book will be consumed.

It's up to you to choose which secrets we want to use against the Burning Legion.

objectiveDetails.description: 选择浩劫专精或者复仇专精

text.title: 古代维库知识精通
text.objectives: 把石板和法典还给帕林教授。
text.description: 给你石板和破译文本，你也可以把这本法典一起带回去交给帕林。$b$b我会开始收拾东西，等他叫我回达拉然。$b$b<尼古拉叹了口气。>$b$b拿我的事引以为戒吧，$n。我要是你的话，肯定会尽早远离帕林的“任务”。

english.title: Ancient Vrykul Mastered
english.objectives: Return the tablets and codex to Professor Pallin.
english.description: Here are those tablets back, along with their deciphered writing. You can take this codex back to Pallin, too. I'll start getting my things ready for when he calls me back to Dalaran.$b$b<Nicholo sighs.>$b$bLearn from my example, $n. If I were you, I'd break free from Pallin's "requests" as soon as you can.

text.title: 新盟友
text.objectives: 向阿苏纳的食魂者阿莱利汇报。
text.description: 徒弟！你在阿苏纳的恶魔猎手同胞在找你。$b$b抵抗燃烧军团的举动当然值得敬重，但这不是荒废研究的借口。$b$b我要你在那边的时候，针对自己的技能设计一些新的雕文。$b$b恐怕我已经没什么可以教你的了，但是你肯定能够学以致用，创造出你自己的配方。

english.title: Our New Allies
english.objectives: Report to Allari the Souleater in Azsuna.
english.description: Student! Your fellow demon hunters in Azsuna have sent for you.$b$bI can certainly appreciate your time being spent fending off the Legion, but it doesn't excuse you from your studies.$b$bWhile you're down there, I'd like you to come up with some new glyphs for your abilities.$b$bSurely my genius has worn off on you and you'll be able to create your own recipes based on what you learn.

text.title: 力量的代价
text.objectives: 消灭$1oa个恶魔，减轻入侵的威胁。
text.description: 我知道了，你希望通过铭文来提升自己的力量。我们应该可以一石二鸟。$b$b我需要有人帮忙减轻恶魔的威胁；而你与敌人多一些接触的话，或许也能得到一些启发。

english.title: The Price of Power
english.objectives: Slay $1oa demons to help lessen the invasion.
english.description: I see, you wish to augment your powers through script. I believe we can kill two birds with one stone then.$b$bI need help here reducing the demon threat. Perhaps some more engagement with our enemy will inspire you.

text.title: 克制之纹
text.objectives: 在扎赫纳尔魔网废墟附近寻找巴瑞克·疾风。
text.description: 如你所知，$n，恶魔猎手必须克制内心的黑暗，以免向邪恶屈服而变成真正的恶魔。$b$b在北边，有一位名叫巴瑞克·疾风的恶魔猎手，他正在准备强化自己的纹身。请你去帮助他进行仪式。

english.title: Defense Symbology
english.objectives: Find Baric Stormrunner near the Ley-Ruins of Zarkhenar.
english.description: As you know, $n, we demon hunters must keep our darkness at bay, lest we succumb to it and become demons ourselves.$b$bUp to the north, a demon hunter by the name of Baric Stormrunner is preparing to strengthen his markings. He could use your assistance with his ritual.

text.title: 克制之力
text.objectives: 从扎赫纳尔的堕夜精灵身上收集魔尘。
text.description: 邪能从附近的废墟里喷涌而出。此时此刻，称为“堕夜”的扭曲暗夜精灵正在那片地区肆虐。$b$b到前面的废墟去，从堕夜精灵身上为我收集魔尘。要完成我的仪式，就需要粉尘中蕴含的奥术能量。

english.title: Opposites Repel
english.objectives: Collect ley dust from the nightfallen in Zarkhenar.
english.description: The ruins nearby have had an eruption of ley energies. Twisted night elves deemed "Nightfallen" are scavenging the area as we speak.$b$bCollect ley dust for me from the nightfallen in the ruins up ahead. The dust is infused with arcane energy that I'll need to complete my ritual.

text.title: 克制心魔
text.objectives: 帮助巴瑞克完成仪式。
text.description: 现在万事俱备，我们这就开始进行仪式。$b$b我会告诉你如何协助我完成仪式。你一定要完全遵循我的指示，否则仪式必定失败。

english.title: Containing the Demon Within
english.objectives: Assist Baric in completing the ritual.
english.description: Now that we have all the essential pieces, let's begin the ritual.$b$bI'll instruct you on how to help me throughout it. It is pivotal that you follow my instructions when I give them, or the ritual will fail.

text.title: 知己知彼，百战不殆
text.objectives: 在邪焰隘口附近寻找扎莉娅·影心。
text.description: 我们与恶魔斗争的同时，也会不断研究他们。$b$b情报收集可以加深我们对敌人的认识。我有一位恶魔猎手正在邪焰隘口附近收集恶魔的情报。$b$b到那里去找她了解一下入侵恶魔的情况。

english.title: To Know Your Enemy
english.objectives: Find Zaria Shadowheart near the Felblaze Ingress.
english.description: As we fight the demons, we've also been studying them.$b$bGreat understanding can come from gathering intel. I have a demon hunter near the Felblaze Ingress now gathering intel on the demons there.$b$bGo to her and see what she has learned from the demons invading that region.

text.title: 饱满的梦魇孢囊
text.objectives: 将饱满的梦魇孢囊带给达拉然的帕林教授。
text.description: <这朵花儿向内卷曲，以保护自己免受被包裹在其中的梦魇能量的影响。>$b$b<帕林教授肯定会对这个感兴趣的。>

english.title: Bulging Nightmare Pod
english.objectives: Bring the Bulging Nightmare Pod to Professor Pallin in Dalaran.
english.description: <The flower has folded inward, to protect itself from the nightmare energy trapped within.>$b$b<Professor Pallin would be interested in seeing this.>

text.title: 秩序是关键
text.objectives: 摧毁保护监督者费罗拉克斯的水晶，然后消灭他。
text.description: 你应该还记得你之所以移除肉眼的原因吧？$b$b虽然我们可以看得更加清楚，但是恶魔也找到了隐藏邪能的办法。$b$b有一个恶魔指挥官正在下面巡视部队，他有一个能量水晶为自己的斗篷供能，使他能够藏匿在暗影中发号施令。$b$b找到并摧毁那个水晶，然后消灭指挥官。

english.title: Control is Key
english.objectives: Destroy the crystal providing protecting Overseer Felorax, then slay him.
english.description: I trust you remember why you removed your eyes?$b$bEven though we can see more clearly now, the demons have found ways to mask even their fel energies from us.$b$bA demon commander walks amongst the troops below, commanding them from the shadows. His cloak is powered by an energetic crystal.$b$bFind and destroy that crystal, then kill the commander.

text.title: 木质种子簇
text.objectives: 将木质种子簇带给达拉然的帕林教授。
text.description: <采集这种花儿比你想象中难。在花朵的正中是一撮密集的种子。>$b$b<帕林教授会对这东西感兴趣的。>

english.title: Woody Seed Cluster
english.objectives: Bring the Woody Seed Cluster to Professor Pallin in Dalaran.
english.description: <Attempting to mill this flower has proven more difficult than usual. Located in the bushy center of the bloom is a densely-packed cluster of seeds.>$b$b<Professor Pallin would be interested in seeing this.>

text.title: 夏斯卡
text.objectives: 把夏斯卡带给达拉然的帕林教授。
text.description: <花朵中渗出了黏液。这并非墨水……而是某种完全不同的东西。>$b$b<帕林教授应该有兴趣看看这个。>

english.title: Fjarnsk
english.objectives: Bring the Fjarnsk to Professor Pallin in Dalaran.
english.description: <A goopy substance seeps from the interior of the bloom. It's not ink... it is something else entirely.>$b$b<Professor Pallin would be interested in seeing this.>

text.title: 7.0 Stormheim - Vignette: Egyl the Enduring - twh

english.title: 7.0 Stormheim - Vignette: Egyl the Enduring - twh

text.title: 幼虫肠子
text.objectives: 在潜岩者裂谷的幼年潜岩者身上获取蠕虫肠子。
text.description:
卓格巴尔在这些洞穴里驯养幼虫。

虽然潜岩者幼虫十分脆弱，但是假以时日，它们的体型和力量就会不断增长。如果我们不插手，它们将变成巨型坐骑，让卓格巴尔在战场上如虎添翼。

而且，它们的肠子十分有用，给我带些回来。这简直是一石二鸟的好事。

english.title: Fledgling Worm Guts
english.objectives: Collect Worm Guts from Fledgling Rockcrawlers within Rockcrawler Chasm.
english.description:
The drogbar use these caves as a place to train fledgling worms.

The rockcrawlers are young and fairly weak, for now, but in time they will grow in size and strength. Without our intervention, the worms will morph into the monstrosities that the drogbar ride into battle.

Their guts are also known to be quite useful, and I have need of them. Two worms, one stone.

text.title: 鹰蛋大救援
text.objectives: 前往潜岩者裂谷，拿回鹰蛋。
text.description:
天角部族崇敬雄鹰，但是它们的数量越来越少。 

卓格巴尔用鹰蛋喂食幼虫，好让它们长成健壮的战斗坐骑。

如果卓格巴尔一直盗走鹰蛋，雄鹰就可能会绝种。 

深入洞穴，取回你找到的鹰蛋。

english.title: Eagle Egg Recovery
english.objectives: Head into Rockcrawler Chasm and recover eagle eggs.
english.description:
Eagles are revered by the Skyhorn tribe, but their numbers are dwindling.

The drogbar feed their fledgling worms eagle eggs so they'll grow strong enough to ride into battle. 

If the drogbar continue to pilfer these eggs, the eagles may become extinct.

Head deeper into the cave and recover any eagle eggs you can find.

text.title: 除掉驯服者
text.objectives: 消灭潜岩者裂谷的驯服者考古尔。
text.description:
只要驯服者不死，卓格巴尔就会不断制造邪恶的虫子。

把潜岩者幼虫驯养成可以参战的可怕攻城蠕虫，考古尔是罪魁祸首。

深入裂谷，了结他的性命，或许我们可以彻底摆脱这些蠕虫孽种。

english.title: Tamer Takedown
english.objectives: Kill Tamer Korgrul within Rockcrawler Chasm.
english.description:
The drogbar will continue to breed vicious worms as long as their tamer lives. 

Korgrul is responsible for turning fledgling rockcrawlers into the monstrous siege worms that are ridden into battle.

Head deep into the chasm and end his life, so that we may also see the end of these unnatural creatures.

text.title: 英灵殿：获取神盾
text.objectives: 在英灵殿打败斯科瓦尔德并夺取阿格拉玛之盾。
text.description:
虽然蔑魔者已经溃不成军，但是他们的首领还活着。如果不采取行动，神王仍然会争夺圣盾。

你已经通过了重重试炼，现在绝不能让悲剧发生。你必须踏过斯科瓦尔德的尸骨，取得圣盾！

英灵殿等待着你！

english.title: Halls of Valor: Securing the Aegis
english.objectives: Defeat God-King Skovald in the Halls of Valor and claim the Aegis of Aggramar.
english.description:
The Felskorn may be broken, but the head of the beast yet lives. The God-King will still vie for the Aegis if left unchecked.

You, who have completed trials upon trials, must not let this come to pass. You must claim the Aegis over Skovald's broken bones!

The Halls of Valor await!

text.title: 入侵开始
text.objectives: 消灭$1oa个恶魔，并换掉燃烧军团的旗帜以控制绝望岭。
text.description:
我们的恶魔猎手先遣部队已经到了，他们正在和燃烧军团交战。

让他们知道我们来了。我们要让每一个恶魔都心惊胆战。升起我们光荣的战旗吧，$n。

english.title: The Invasion Begins
english.objectives: Slay $1oa demons and change the Legion banner to take control of Despair Ridge.
english.description:
Our advance force of demon hunters is here and has engaged the Legion.

Make our presence known. Let's send a shiver down every demon spine. Raise our colors with pride, $n.

text.title: 重任
text.objectives: 把哈维鱼桶里的鱼放到火堆上的长矛上烧烤。
text.description:
通过艾希迪尔的审判后，你最终的试炼已经完成。 

不过就算是英灵殿也要等一会，我们先得吃点东西！这么一番折腾之后，真让人胃口大开。

来吧，拿几条鱼拿到火上烤烤。太重了，我搬不动。
text.completion: It is clear that your cooking prowess is only matched by your might in combat. $B$BNow, on full bellies, we ride to Valhallas!

english.title: A Heavy Burden
english.objectives: Take the fish from Havi's Fish Barrel and skewer it on the spear above the fire.
english.description:
With Ashildir's judgment, your final trial is complete. 

But even Valhallas can wait, for now we must eat! Being dead works up quite an appetite.

Come now, bring some of that fish to roast over the fire. It is far too heavy for me to carry.
english.completion: It is clear that your cooking prowess is only matched by your might in combat. $B$BNow, on full bellies, we ride to Valhallas!

objectiveDetails.description: 把哈维的鱼拿到火上烤

text.title: "Enter the Illidari: Shivarra" - Sevis Brightflame Sacrificed Tracking Event

english.title: "Enter the Illidari: Shivarra" - Sevis Brightflame Sacrificed Tracking Event

text.title: 7.0 Stormheim - Vignette: Eileen the Raven - twh

english.title: 7.0 Stormheim - Vignette: Eileen the Raven - twh

text.title: 鱼人：下一代
text.objectives: 与奔波尔霸精神交流，并消灭$2oa个苔穴龙虾。
text.description:
是时候了！奔波尔霸及其追随者们需要远离成年鱼人从而“闭关修炼”，以备今后能够独当一面。

有一个不错的洞穴离这不远……唯一的问题是那里被龙虾人霸占着。 

那里可以成为蝌蚪们的绝佳基地。奔波尔霸必须去撵走龙虾人！

在奔波尔霸的蛋里与他进行精神交流，告诉他该怎么做！
text.completion: This cave will make a great base for the young tadpoles!

english.title: Murlocs: The Next Generation
english.objectives: Mindmeld with Murky and slay $2oa Cavemoss Clackers.
english.description:
The time has come! Murky and his followers need a place to hide out and train--away from the mature murlocs--so that they can prepare to take over in the future.

There's a nice cave not too far away... only problem is that it's filled with makrura.

This would be a good base for the tadpoles. Murky must go show them what for!

Mindmeld with Murky in his egg and show him how it's done!
english.completion: This cave will make a great base for the young tadpoles!

text.title: 胡恩之战——玛洛恩的爱将
text.objectives: 援救艾特洛。
text.description:
[不流畅的通用语]大导师找你。派艾特洛送了信。

昂克听艾特洛打架的声音。你找到野兽？来帮忙，有羽毛的夜精灵会高兴。
text.completion: <Eche'ro looks up briefly, then lowers its head before you. This creature is thankful for your aid.>

english.title: Huln's War - Malorne's Favored
english.objectives: Rescue Eche'ro.
english.description:
[In broken Common] Shan'do ask for you. Sent Eche'ro beast with message on rack.

Unng Ak hear Eche'ro sound fighting. You find beast? Give help, maybe feathered night elf be relieve.
english.completion: <Eche'ro looks up briefly, then lowers its head before you. This creature is thankful for your aid.>

text.title: 凄惨命运
text.objectives: 在墨尔海姆使用阴燃的火把焚烧8具腐烂的尸体。
text.description:
你也许不知道，你现在正站在墨尔海姆的土地上，这里是最伟大的战士的家园。我们曾经拥有传奇般的勇气，也曾创造出诸多功绩。这样的终结实在让我痛心疾首。

那些生物趁着夜幕来袭，我们英勇御敌，无奈寡不敌众。没有葬礼来祭奠阵亡的战士，他们的遗体也曝露在烈日之下慢慢腐烂。

墨尔海姆的光荣战士们不该遭受这样的不敬。请去带给他们一点点体面，我们将感激不尽。

english.title: A Murky Fate
english.objectives: Use the Smoldering Torch to burn 8 Decaying Corpses in Morheim.
english.description:
You may not know, but you stand upon the grounds of Morheim, home to the greatest warriors of the land. Our deeds were great, our valor legendary. It pains me that we see such an end.

The creatures set upon us at nightfall. Our men fought bravely, but were vastly outnumbered. Now their corpses lie rotting in the sun, with no burial and no rites.

This is not an end befitting to the glorious warriors of Morheim. Make it right, and you will have our thanks.

text.title: 森林守护者，塞纳留斯
text.objectives: 在瓦尔莎拉的洛拉希尔与玛法里奥·怒风谈一谈。
text.description: 啊，瓦尔莎拉。$b$b我上次踏入这片神圣的林地，已经是上个时代的事了。时光荏苒……$b$b这次的工作很简单，$c。我们需要拜访我的导师塞纳留斯，并询问他保管艾露恩之泪的位置。有了这件圣物，离封印萨格拉斯之墓并瓦解燃烧军团，就更近了一步。$b$b你以后会面对许多艰难险阻，不如在这里稍稍喘口气。$b$b来吧，这不需要花太久时间。
text.completion: This corruption - I've never seen it before.$b$bAnd yet, it seems somehow familiar...

english.title: Cenarius, Keeper of the Grove
english.objectives: Speak to Malfurion Stormrage at Lorlathil in Val'sharah.
english.description: Ahh, Val'sharah.$b$bIt has been an age since I have set foot in these sacred woods. Too long...$b$bOur work here is simple, $c. We must call upon my mentor, Cenarius, and learn where he safeguards the Tears of Elune. With them, you will be one step closer to sealing Sargeras' Tomb and thwarting the Legion.$b$bYou have many treacherous tasks in front of you. Consider your visit here a brief respite.$b$bCome, this will not take long.
english.completion: This corruption - I've never seen it before.$b$bAnd yet, it seems somehow familiar...

text.title: 夜之子
text.objectives: 帮塔莉萨包扎。
text.description:
<塔莉萨蜷缩着，捂住她的腹部。>

啊……我没办法继续无视这个伤口了。

帮我包扎一下。我会解释一切。

english.title: The Nightborne Pact
english.objectives: Bandage Thalyssra.
english.description:
<Thalyssra winces and holds her abdomen.>

Ngh... I can ignore this wound no longer.

Help me patch this up. I will explain everything.

text.title: 阿坎多尔的树枝
text.objectives: 与塔莉萨对话。
text.description:
你已经使用凯尔丹纳斯的法术石安抚了无数枯法者。然而它只包含了阿坎多尔之力的冰山一角，这力量取自它沉睡的种子。

<塔莉萨举起一根闪闪发光的白色树枝。>

这根树枝掉落自树上。虽然被切断了，但它并没有枯死——无形的魔法线将阿坎多尔的所有碎片捆绑在一起。

我为这根树枝施加了新版本的凯尔丹纳斯魔咒。有了它，你就可以修补更多枯法者的奥术精华。好好使用它。

english.title: Branch of the Arcan'dor
english.objectives: Speak with Thalyssra.
english.description:
You have used the spellstone of Kel'danath to soothe countless withered. Yet it contains merely a shade of the arcan'dor's power, drawn from its slumbering seed. 

<Thalyssra holds aloft a gleaming white branch.>

This fell from the tree. Though it is severed, it is not dead - invisible threads of magic bind all pieces of the arcan'dor together.

I have enchanted this branch with a new iteration of Kel'danath's charm spell. With it, you can mend the arcane essence of even more withered. Use it well.

text.title: Repairing the Source
text.objectives: You have found a damaged power core for an arcane construct. It seems like you could repair the device.
text.description: <A glint catches your eye in the dirt. A brief excavation yields a mostly intact piece of an arcane construct's power core. The breaks appear to be clean, perhaps you could repair it if you find the other fragments.>

english.title: Repairing the Source
english.objectives: You have found a damaged power core for an arcane construct. It seems like you could repair the device.
english.description: <A glint catches your eye in the dirt. A brief excavation yields a mostly intact piece of an arcane construct's power core. The breaks appear to be clean, perhaps you could repair it if you find the other fragments.>

text.title: 净化余罪
text.objectives: 到诺达尼尔圣泉与堕落的女祭司见面。旁观女祭司进行净化仪式。
text.description: 虽然燃烧军团实力雄厚，但是他们并非艾泽拉斯最强大的力量。$b$b我和附魔师伊兰娅在一个特别的地方度过了无数美好时光。那里所倾注的爱意，比邪能魔法更具威力，$n。$b$b前往诺达尼尔圣泉。泉水可以净化你收集的邪能粉尘……或许连我也可以得到净化。$b$b我会在那里等你。

english.title: Washed Clean
english.objectives: Meet the Fallen Priestess at the Nor'Danil Wellspring. Watch as the priestess attempts the purification ritual.
english.description: Mighty though the Legion is, theirs is not the strongest power in Azeroth.$b$bThere is a place where Enchantress Ilanya and I spent many blissful hours together. The love that infuses such a place is more potent than fel magic, $n.$b$bGo to the Nor'Danil Wellspring. Its waters can purify the fel dust you have collected... and perhaps purify me as well.$b$bI will meet you there.

text.title: 石皮皮革样本
text.objectives: 把石皮皮革样本以及额外的$1oa块石皮皮革交给达拉然的孔达尔·猎誓。
text.description: 这块皮革的质量可以代表那些在破碎群岛所发现的兽皮。$b$b达拉然的剥皮训练师肯定有兴趣看看。

english.title: Stonehide Leather Sample
english.objectives: Bring the Stonehide Leather Sample, along with $1oa additional pieces of Stonehide Leather, to Kondal Huntsworn in Dalaran.
english.description: The quality of this leather scrap appears representative of the beast hides found in the Broken Isles.$b$bYour skinning trainer in Dalaran would be interested in seeing this.

text.title: 完整无缺
text.objectives: 为破碎群岛的野兽剥皮，获取20张完整的皮革。
text.description: <你的训练师仔细检查了皮革。>$b$b它还能派上用场，可惜就是太小了。你这样的剥皮方法是对那头野兽的不敬，$n。你糟蹋了自然的礼物。$b$b到下方的荒野去吧，这次在剥皮的时候要更加小心，给我带回完整的皮革。

english.title: In One Piece
english.objectives: Obtain 20 Undivided Hides by skinning the beasts of the Broken Isles.
english.description: <Your trainer looks over the hide.>$b$bThis hide is usable, but it is mournably small. You disrespect the beast by chopping it up like this, $n. You make light of the gift that it gave to you.$b$bGo out into the wilds again. Skin the leathery beasts below us, and this time, bring me hides in one piece.

text.title: 长裤残片
text.objectives: 把长裤残片带给至高岭的赫米特·奈辛瓦里。
text.description: 这头野兽嘴里含着一块手工缝纫的布料。上面有“辛瓦”两字。$b$b虽然不知道“辛瓦”是什么，不过艾泽拉斯有位著名的剥皮师，他的名字里刚好就有这两个字。

english.title: Scrap of Pants
english.objectives: Bring the Scrap of Pants to Hemet Nesingwary in Highmountain.
english.description: The mouth of this particular beast contained a piece of handsewn cloth. The fabric bears the word "singwa".$b$bWhile the term "singwa" is unfamiliar, it DOES happen to be the middle of the last name of a fairly notable Azerothian skinner.

text.title: 至高岭的皮革
text.objectives: 对至高岭的生物进行剥皮，获取$1oa张熊皮，$2oa张大角鹿皮，以及$3oa张刃豹皮。
text.description: 这么说你也是剥皮师？$b$b真是个好消息，$n！没想到我们之间还有这样的共同点。$b$b你一定要看看至高岭的皮革。为什么？我愿意用备用的单片眼镜作为交换，只要给我找些上好的，柔顺的毛皮……

english.title: Highmountain Hides
english.objectives: Obtain $1oa Bear Hides, $2oa Elderhorn Hides, and $3oa Saber Hides by skinning the creatures of Highmountain.
english.description: So, ye're a skinner too, aye?$b$bThat's great news, $n! I don't think I ever knew we shared that in common.$b$bYe've GOT ta see some o'the hides we've got here in Highmountain. Why, I'd give me spare monacle just t'get me hands on some o'those fine, silky hides...

text.title: 旅行的自由
text.objectives: 获取$1oa张麝牛皮、$2oa张海狮皮、$3oa张鹿皮，以及$4oa张狼皮。
text.description: 还记得我年轻的时候，没有负担……无拘无束。你呢，$n？现在，我在至高岭几乎时时得跟着我的狩猎队一起行动。$b$b可是，破碎群岛的其他地方还有那么多有趣的生物。我帮你标在地图上，去那里剥些毛皮回来！

english.title: The Freedom to Roam
english.objectives: Obtain $1oa Musken Hides, $2oa Lion Seal Hides, $3oa Boar Hides, and $4oa Wolf Hides.
english.description: I remember bein' young, $n. D'ye remember it? So much less responsibility... I could just run around as I pleased. Now, I'm pretty much stuck with my hunting crew, here in Highmountain.$b$bThere're so many interestin' creatures in the other regions o'the Broken Isles, though. I'll mark yer map, you get out there and do some skinnin'!

text.title: 完美的石皮皮革
text.objectives: 把完美的石皮皮革带给达拉然的孔达尔·猎誓。
text.description: 你从事剥皮已经有一段时间了，但却从未见过如此优质的皮革。它结实、柔韧、色泽亮丽……$b$b达拉然的训练师肯定很有兴趣看看。

english.title: Immaculate Stonehide Leather
english.objectives: Bring the Immaculate Stonehide Leather to Kondal Huntsworn in Dalaran.
english.description: You have been skinning for a long time now, but never have you seen a leather specimen as fine as this. Durable, pliable, beautifully colored...$b$bYour trainer in Dalaran would be VERY interested in seeing this.

text.title: 剥皮犀利哥斯克瑞特
text.objectives: 去找苏拉玛的斯克瑞特。
text.description: 从这张皮可以看出你的手艺已经好到不用我教了，$n。从我在这里开店以后，手艺就慢慢退化了。$b$b我以前有个叫斯克瑞特的学徒，他能为苏拉玛的生物剥皮。他的技术就和他的刀子一样犀利，要是还有谁能教你的话，就非他莫属。

english.title: Leather for Ske'rit
english.objectives: Report to Ske'rit in Suramar.
english.description: This hide certifies that you have learned everything about leather that I can teach you, $n. My skills have dulled since I set up shop here in town.$b$bI have a former protege who skins the creatures of Suramar. His name is Ske'rit. His skills remain as sharp as his blade, and if there is anyone out there who can teach you, it is him.

text.title: 十字军的试炼：传说中的毛皮
text.objectives: 通过十字军的试炼取得冰吼的皮。$b$b在巴拉丁监狱取得欧库塔尔的皮。$b$b在雷电王座取得赫利东的皮。
text.description: 没错，我可以训练你。问题是，我还要在苏拉玛继续钻研我的技术。老实说，你或许可以帮上忙。$b$b我需要一些特殊的皮革来进行比较：一张结实的白色雪人毛皮，一大张恶魔皮革，还有一张你能找到的最厚实的恐角皮。$b$b给我这些毛皮，我就会跟你还有城里的孔达尔分享我的研究成果。

english.title: Trial of the Crusader: Hides of Legend
english.objectives: Obtain the Hide of Icehowl from the Trial of the Crusader.$b$bObtain the Hide of Occu'thar from Baradin Hold.$b$bObtain the Hide of Horridon from the Throne of Thunder.
english.description: Ya, I can train you. Ting is, I'm still workin' on my techniques 'ere in Suramar. In fact, you can probably help.$b$bI need ta look at a few special skins, for comparison. I need a strong white yeti pelt, a really big demon skin, and da thickest direhorn skin you can find.$b$bDo that, and I'll share my results with you and' ol' Kondal up in de city.

text.title: 英灵殿：芬雷尔的皮
text.objectives: 对英灵殿的芬雷尔进行剥皮，以获取它的毛皮。
text.description: 既然你在这里，我就想请你帮个忙。$b$b我一直听说，有头巨大的恶狼在维库人的地盘惹出了各种麻烦，它的名字叫芬雷尔。$b$b我想要它的狼皮。
text.giverWindow: 维库狩猎圣地中那头几近无敌的狼。

english.title: Halls of Valor: The Hide of Fenryr
english.objectives: Obtain the Hide of Fenryr by skinning Fenryr in Valhallas.
english.description: While you be here, I got a favor t'ask you.$b$bI been hearin' whispers about one big, nasty wolf dat's been causin' all kinds of trouble up in de vrykul lands. His name be Fenryr.$b$bI want his hide.
english.giverWindow: The nigh-unkillable wolf of the vrykul's holy hunting grounds.

text.title: 斯克瑞特的皮革手册
text.objectives: 把斯克瑞特的皮革手册带给达拉然的孔达尔·猎誓。
text.description: 我的研究终于完成了。$b$b<斯克瑞特递给你一个卷轴。>$b$b这是我在苏拉玛的工作成果。把它带给孔达尔吧，这样他就能传授给其他的剥皮师了。$b$b鉴于你帮了很大的忙，所以我把你的名字也加进去了，$n。希望你不要介意。

english.title: Ske'rit's Leather Handbook
english.objectives: Bring Ske'rit's Leather Handbook to Kondal Huntsworn in Dalaran.
english.description: An' wit dat, my research be done.$b$b<Ske'rit hands you a scroll casing.>$b$bDis is what I been workin' on here in Suramar. Bring it to Kondal, so dat he can teach it to all you other skinnahs.$b$bSince you been helpin' so much, I put your name on it, $n. Hope you don't mind.

text.title: 风暴之鳞样本
text.objectives: 把风暴之鳞样本带给达拉然的孔达尔·猎誓。
text.description: 这块鳞片闪烁着电能。$b$b达拉然的剥皮训练师肯定有兴趣看看。

english.title: Stormscale Sample
english.objectives: Bring the Stormscale Sample to Kondal Huntsworn in Dalaran.
english.description: This scale shimmers with electrical energy.$b$bYour skinning trainer in Dalaran would be interested in seeing this.

text.title: 风暴之鳞的核心
text.objectives: 对破碎群岛上长有鳞片的生物进行剥皮，获取$1oa个风暴之鳞电弧。
text.description: 啊，没错，难得一见的风暴之鳞。$b$b我在诺森德和天空之墙见过类似的鳞片，不过在这里好像比较常见。这会让专研锁甲的同僚们非常开心。$b$b想要更有效地采集这种鳞片，你就得先了解它的力量。从你的猎物身上寻找破损的特殊鳞片，然后移除里面的电弧。见识过那些电弧以后，你就能更好地认识风暴之鳞了。

english.title: The Core of the Stormscale
english.objectives: Obtain $1oa Stormscale Sparks by skinning scaled creatures in the Broken Isles.
english.description: Ahh, yes. The elusive stormscale.$b$bI have seen similar scales in Northrend, and some in Skywall, but it would appear that such a scale is common here. My colleagues that specialize in mail armor will be happy to learn this.$b$bTo more efficiently harvest this type of scale, you must first understand its power. Look for broken, unusable scales on your quarry, and remove the sparks within them. Once you have seen the sparks, you will better understand the stormscale.

text.title: 未完成的风暴之鳞特性论文
text.objectives: 把未完成的风暴之鳞特性论文稿纸带给达拉然的孔达尔·猎誓。
text.description: 这张动物毛皮的褶皱中夹着一张稿纸，上面似乎写着风暴之鳞的采集指导，但是稿纸残破不堪，难以识别。$b$b达拉然的剥皮训练师或许可以帮你找出它的作者。

english.title: Unfinished Treatise on the Properties of Stormscale
english.objectives: Bring the Unfinished Treatise on the Properties of Stormscale to Kondal Huntsworn in Dalaran.
english.description: Tucked between the folds of this animal's hide, you find a scrap of paper. It appears to be a handwritten guide to harvesting stormscales, but too much of the manuscript has been lost to be of use.$b$bPerhaps your skinning trainer in Dalaran could help you find its owner.

text.title: 葛丽乐
text.objectives: 在阿苏纳找到葛丽乐。
text.description: 有一个剥皮师以阿苏纳的野外为家。她名叫葛丽乐，是个暗夜精灵——好吧，她活着的时候曾经是暗夜精灵。$b$b卷轴可能是她的。

english.title: Glielle
english.objectives: Find Glielle in Azsuna.
english.description: One skinner makes the wilds of Azsuna her home. Her name is Glielle, and she is a night elf - or at least, she was, in life.$b$bPerhaps the scroll was hers.

text.title: 羽毛之下
text.objectives: 获取$1oa块角鹰兽鳞片。
text.description: 我可以训练你。$b$b大家都知道角鹰兽的尾部有闪亮的风暴之鳞，不过你知道它们的羽毛下面也有一些鳞片吗？你只需要找对地方就看得到了。$b$b<暗夜精灵幽灵指了指角鹰兽翅膀连体处的几个地方。>$b$b现在，去看看你能不能靠自己的力量采集鳞片吧。

english.title: Under Down
english.objectives: Obtain $1oa Hippogryph Scales.
english.description: I can train you, though.$b$bEveryone knows about the bright stormscales on the hippogryph's hindquarters, but did you know that they also have a few scales beneath their feathers? You just need to know where to look.$b$b<The night elf spirit indicates a few places near the hippogryph's wing joints.>$b$bNow go see if you can get some on your own.

text.title: 塞莫尔与艾格尼丝
text.objectives: 在风暴峡湾寻找塞莫尔。
text.description: 说实话，你给我看这个卷轴的时候我想起了一个，哦不，是两个剥皮师——我的学徒塞莫尔以及他的母亲艾格尼丝。$b$b我上次听说他们还在风暴峡湾猎捕风暴幼龙。

english.title: Seymour and Agnes
english.objectives: Find Seymour in Stormheim.
english.description: The other skinner - pair of skinners, to be honest - that comes to mind when you show me this scroll is a student of mine, named Seymour, and his mother Agnes.$b$bLast I heard, they were in Stormheim, hunting the storm drakes.

text.title: 老妈的珍贵小刀
text.objectives: 获取艾格尼丝的剥皮小刀。
text.description: 有一次我和老妈在附近的高山顶峰的时候，因为可视度不好，所以她只能凭感觉把剥皮刀扔给我。$b$b那把小刀从此就留在了那里的某个地方，这让我的内心非常不安。

english.title: Mother's Prized Knife
english.objectives: Obtain Agnes' Skinning Knife.
english.description: The other day, Mother and I were up at the top of the nearby mountain, and she threw her skinning knife at me because the view wasn't good enough.$b$bHer knife is still up there, somewhere. I'd feel horrible just leaving it.

text.title: 为了报仇杀红眼
text.objectives: 消灭$1oa条成年猎风者。
text.description: 不知道它是从哪里冒出来的。我当时正等着老妈剥完她那一半的幼龙，突然飞来了一条风暴巨龙，我从没见过那么大的龙……然后……$b$b<塞莫尔下定了决心。>$b$b我要你消灭尽可能多的风暴巨龙。剥不剥皮随便你。我只想帮老妈报仇！

english.title: Red-Eyed Revenge
english.objectives: Slay $1oa Adult Squallhunters.
english.description: It came out of nowhere. I was waiting for mother to finish skinning her half of the drake when the biggest storm dragon I'd ever seen came and... and...$b$b<Seymour finds his resolve.>$b$bI want you to kill as many of them as you can. Skin them, don't skin them, I don't care. Just get revenge for mother!

text.title: 达考尼尔必须死
text.objectives: 获取达考尼尔的鳞片。
text.description: 杀害老妈的那条巨龙名叫达考尼尔。$b$b老妈以前总想拿它的鳞片当坠饰，但是我们还没有机会去剥它的龙鳞——因为老妈只对剥皮感兴趣，完全没心思去消灭达考尼尔，而我又没办法单靠自己的力量去对付它。$b$b你……愿意去采集巨龙的鳞片来祭奠她吗？
text.giverWindow: 母亲希望能够终结它的生命。

english.title: Drakol'nir Must Die
english.objectives: Obtain the Scale of Drakol'nir.
english.description: The dragon that took Mother's life was named Drakol'nir.$b$bMother always wanted to wear his scale as a pendant, but we never got a chance to skin him because I couldn't kill him alone, and she didn't care much for killing. Only skinning.$b$bYou... you wouldn't mind bringing it for her, would you?
english.giverWindow: Mother would have wanted him dead.

text.title: 完美的风暴之鳞
text.objectives: 把完美的风暴之鳞带给达拉然的孔达尔·猎誓。
text.description: 你从事剥皮已经有一段时间了，但却从未见过如此优质的鳞片。$b$b达拉然的训练师肯定很有兴趣看看。

english.title: Immaculate Stormscale
english.objectives: Bring the Immaculate Stormscale to Kondal Huntsworn in Dalaran.
english.description: You have been skinning for a long time now, but never have you seen a scale specimen as fine as this.$b$bYour trainer in Dalaran would be VERY interested in seeing this.

text.title: 刮鳞犀利哥斯克瑞特
text.objectives: 去找苏拉玛的斯克瑞特。
text.description: 你的手艺比我好，$n。我从没见过这样的鳞片……更别说这完美的移除手法了。$b$b你还想深造的话，就得找一个比我更犀利的师傅了。他的名字叫斯克瑞特，以前是我的学徒。$b$b你在苏拉玛的荒野里就能找到他。

english.title: Scales for Ske'rit
english.objectives: Find Ske'rit in Suramar.
english.description: Your skills surpass mine, $n. I have never even SEEN a scale such as this... let alone remove one so expertly.$b$bIf you still wish to learn more, you will need to seek an even greater skinner than I. His name is Ske'rit, and he was once my student.$b$bYou will find him in the wild areas of Suramar.

text.title: 重返卡拉赞：传说中的鳞片
text.objectives: 在卡拉赞获取虚空幽龙的鳞片；在黑曜石圣殿获取萨塔里奥的鳞片；在恐惧之心获取加拉隆的鳞片。
text.description: 我对鳞片有一定的了解，不过现在已经大不如前。我专注风暴之鳞的时间太久了，以至于忘记了其他的知识。$b$b我需要一些特殊的鳞片来进行对比：一块虚空龙鳞，一块上好的炽热黑龙龙鳞，还有一块你能找到的最厚实的昆虫甲壳。

english.title: Return to Karazhan: Scales of Legend
english.objectives: Obtain the Scale of Netherspite from Karazhan, the Scale of Sartharion from the Obsidian Sanctum, and the Scales of Garalon from the Heart of Fear.
english.description: I know a ting or two about scales, but I'm losin' my edge. I been starin' at stormscales so long, I be forgettin' what de other kinds look like.$b$bI need ta look at a few special scales, for comparison. I need a nether dragon scale, a nice hot black dragonscale, and da thickest piece o' insect chitin you can find.$b$bGotta get dese stormscales outta my head, bruddah.

text.title: 艾萨拉之眼：瑟芬崔斯克的鳞片
text.objectives: 在艾萨拉之怒地下城中，对瑟芬崔斯克进行剥皮以获取它的鳞片。
text.description: 我想请你帮个忙。$b$b我没去过阿苏纳，最近也没打算离开苏拉玛。问题是，有一条巨大的古老毒蛇正等着谁去剥皮呢。就这么干等着呢。
text.giverWindow: 生活在雷电之王宫殿地下的可怕生物之一。

english.title: Eye of Azshara: The Scales of Serpentrix
english.objectives: Obtain the Scales of Serpentrix by skinning Serpentrix in the Wrath of Azshara dungeon.
english.description: I got ta ask you a favor.$b$bI haven't been ta Azsuna, and I don't see myself leavin' Suramar anytime soon. Problem is, dere's a big ol' serpent out dere dat's just beggin' ta be skinned. Just BEGGIN' for it.
english.giverWindow: One of the many horrible things living beneath the Thunder King's palace.

text.title: 斯克瑞特的刮鳞建议
text.objectives: 把斯克瑞特的刮鳞建议带给达拉然的孔达尔·猎誓。
text.description: 这些鳞片让我想起来很多东西。$b$b<斯克瑞特递给你一些手稿。>$b$b这是我在风暴之鳞上的最新发现。拿给孔达尔，你们好好研究研究吧。

english.title: Ske'rit's Scale-Skinning Suggestions
english.objectives: Bring Ske'rit's Scale-Skinning Suggestions to Kondal Huntsworn in Dalaran.
english.description: Now dat I got all dese scales, I tink I know what I need to know.$b$b<Ske'rit hands you a few pages of handwritten notes.>$b$bHere's my latest findin's on stormscales. Bring 'em to Kondal, an' read through em' togethah.

text.title: 魔皮样本
text.objectives: 把魔皮样本带给达拉然的孔达尔·猎誓。
text.description: 这张恶魔皮和你经常接触到的普通兽皮截然不同。$b$b达拉然的剥皮训练师肯定有兴趣看看。

english.title: Felhide Sample
english.objectives: Bring the Felhide Sample to Kondal Huntsworn in Dalaran.
english.description: This demonic hide is completely unlike any standard beast hide you are accustomed to.$b$bYour skinning trainer in Dalaran would be interested in seeing this.

text.title: 能力有限
text.objectives: 在苏拉玛找斯克瑞特。
text.description: 你在这种地方搞到的毛皮给我留下了深刻的印象，尤其是魔皮。$b$b我在这方面的剥皮知识非常有限，不过我知道一个人，他或许已经掌握了对这种生物进行剥皮的技巧。$b$b你可以在苏拉玛找到我曾经的学徒斯克瑞特。问问他恶魔皮要怎么剥更好。

english.title: An Unseemly Task
english.objectives: Find Ske'rit in Suramar.
english.description: I'm quite impressed with what you've been able to skin in these lands, felhide in particular.$b$bBut as my knowledge is limited in this area of skinning, I know of one who may have increased his skill in skinning such beasts.$b$bYou can find my old apprentice, Ske'rit in Suramar. Ask him if he knows how to yield better results from skinning demons.

text.title: 黑心林地：恶魔的特殊性
text.objectives: 前往黑心林地，消灭德萨隆。对它进行剥皮并把它的毛皮带回苏拉玛，交给斯克瑞特。
text.description: 没错，我在这里见过不少恶魔，剥他们的皮可不容易。$b$b他们的外皮比一般动物的更坚韧，纤维也更粗，懂吗？如果你想尽可能完整地剥下恶魔的外，就需要勤加练习。$b$b我听说黑心林地里有一种生物，它的外皮跟恶魔的一样坚韧。在剥它的皮时，你要顺着肌理下刀，用力也要均匀。$b$b把它的皮带回来给我，让我看看你有没有理解我的话。
text.giverWindow: 它曾是一条绿龙，如今被梦魇所吞噬。

english.title: Darkheart Thicket: Demons Be Different
english.objectives: Go to Darkheart Thicket and kill Dresaron. Skin him and bring his hide back to Ske'rit in Suramar.
english.description: Oh yes, I've seen me fair share of demons while in dese lands. And skinnin' dem ain't no easy task.$b$bTheir hides are tougher than normal animals, fibrous, see? But if you be wantin' to make da most of their skins, den ya need to be practicin' more.$b$bThere be a creature I've heard of in da Darkheart Thicket whose hide's as tough as a demon's. When ya go ta skin him, try cutting with da grain in one even stroke.$b$bBring me his skin to show me you be picking up on what I'm sayin'.
english.giverWindow: Once a green drake, now engulfed in Nightmare.

text.title: 翡翠梦魇：尼珊德拉的瘟疫之皮
text.objectives: 获得尼珊德拉的瘟疫之皮。
text.description: 我们还需要再收集一张恶魔皮……但它并不算是一头恶魔，而它是一头龙。$b$b尼珊德拉是一头了不起的绿龙，它几乎被梦魇完全吞噬。只有大师级别的剥皮师才能剥除她躯体上被虫豸啃噬后剩余的皮。$b$b去吧，$n。让我看看你的学习成果。

english.title: The Emerald Nightmare: The Pestilential Hide of Nythendra
english.objectives: Obtain the Pestilential Hide of Nythendra.
english.description: There is one more demon hide to gather... but it isn't that of a demon. It's a dragon.$b$bNythendra, great green dragon, has nearly been eaten up by the Nightmare. Only a master skinner would be able to remove what bits of bug-eaten hide remain on her body.$b$bGo on then, $n. Show me what you've learned.

text.title: Magic Clams
text.objectives: Collect Infused Clams from Seerspine murlocs in the Murloc Shoals.
text.description: <The clam resonates with a arcane energy.>$B$BWhat are murlocs doing with arcane clams?$B$BPerhaps your Nightfallen allies could make use of them.

english.title: Magic Clams
english.objectives: Collect Infused Clams from Seerspine murlocs in the Murloc Shoals.
english.description: <The clam resonates with a arcane energy.>$B$BWhat are murlocs doing with arcane clams?$B$BPerhaps your Nightfallen allies could make use of them.

text.title: Tapping the Underground
text.objectives: Destroy Seerspine Conduits in the Murloc Shoals.
text.description: Have you seen them, $n?$B$BThese are not ordinary murlocs. They have been drawn by the ley line that flows from Azsuna into this land. $B$BSomehow they have managed to tap into its arcane current and are tapping its power for their own devious purposes.$B$BThese disturbances must be stopped if the ley line is to remain intact.

english.title: Tapping the Underground
english.objectives: Destroy Seerspine Conduits in the Murloc Shoals.
english.description: Have you seen them, $n?$B$BThese are not ordinary murlocs. They have been drawn by the ley line that flows from Azsuna into this land. $B$BSomehow they have managed to tap into its arcane current and are tapping its power for their own devious purposes.$B$BThese disturbances must be stopped if the ley line is to remain intact.

text.title: Leying with Murlocs
text.objectives: Infuse yourself with ley energies located in the Murloc Shoals.
text.description: I have seen these Seerspine summon minor elementals, which is no small feat for a murloc, but their high summoner, Blargrrrl, is trying to summon Torretus from the river.$B$BI doubt a mere murloc has the capabilities to control an entity as powerful as Torrentus.$B$BBlargrrrl will be deeply entranced if he is trying such a feat. We'll need something powerful to halt his ritual.$B$BInfuse yourself with ley energies and return to me.

english.title: Leying with Murlocs
english.objectives: Infuse yourself with ley energies located in the Murloc Shoals.
english.description: I have seen these Seerspine summon minor elementals, which is no small feat for a murloc, but their high summoner, Blargrrrl, is trying to summon Torretus from the river.$B$BI doubt a mere murloc has the capabilities to control an entity as powerful as Torrentus.$B$BBlargrrrl will be deeply entranced if he is trying such a feat. We'll need something powerful to halt his ritual.$B$BInfuse yourself with ley energies and return to me.

text.title: 胡恩传奇
text.objectives: 与灵魂行者黑角对话，了解胡恩·高岭的历史。
text.description:
你的目标是让各个部族团结一心。这可不是一件容易的事。这片山岭有史以来也只成功过一次。

胡恩·高岭曾在数千年前让所有部族联合起来，在上古之战时期齐心对抗燃烧军团。
text.completion: You have seen only a taste of what Huln Highmountain accomplished during his lifetime. Let us delve deeper into the past...

english.title: The Story of Huln
english.objectives: Speak with Spiritwalker Ebonhorn to learn about Huln Highmountain.
english.description:
You work to unite the tribes. That is no small task. It has only been done once before in the history of this mountain.

Huln Highmountain last united the tribes thousands of years ago to take on the Legion during the War of the Ancients.
english.completion: You have seen only a taste of what Huln Highmountain accomplished during his lifetime. Let us delve deeper into the past...

text.title: 漩涡之瓶
text.objectives: 将旋转的时空扭曲之瓶交给沙塔斯中央穹顶下的凯普丽。
text.description: 当你触摸这个瓶子时，无数的记忆如潮水般袭来，其中还包括并不属于你的记忆。其中最为清晰的，就是在背后阿达尔光芒的照耀下，你和某人在沙塔斯城交换一个类似的瓶子的记忆。尽管你努力回想，但你无法确定那究竟发生在什么时候—也许那根本就没发生过，而是即将发生的事情？

english.title: The Swirling Vial
english.objectives: Bring the Swirling Timewarped Vial to the central dome in Shattrath.
english.description: As you touch the vial, your mind is flooded with memories, not all of which are your own. The most vivid is a memory of exchanging a similar vial with someone in Shattrath, with A'dal's light shining behind you. Despite your best efforts however, you can't pinpoint when that might have been - maybe it hasn't been, and is yet to be?

text.title: 岔路口的相会
text.objectives: 在邪焰隘口附近寻找女祭司的踪迹。
text.description: 战争期间，我曾经的一位学徒刚好在所有人受到诅咒之前离开了。$b$b最近，我听说有人在邪焰隘口附近发现了她的踪迹。我很想再跟她谈一谈。$b$b找到她。把日志还给她，并且让她知道，对于她的所作所为，我一概既往不咎。$b$b如果她愿意的话，就带她来见我。

english.title: Crossroads Rendezvous
english.objectives: Search for signs of the priestess near the Felblaze Ingress.
english.description: An old apprentice of mine left during the war, shortly before we were all cursed.$b$bI've recently heard that she's been seen near the Felblaze Ingress. I would very much like to speak to her once more.$b$bGo and find her. Take her journal to her and let her know that I don't blame her for what she did.$b$bAnd if she's willing, please bring her back to me.

text.title: 业余时间
text.objectives: 在松岩盆地对付业余猎手。
text.description:
猎人小屋吸引了众多自诩猎人的菜鸟。他们拙劣的伎俩只会把猎物都吓走。

虽然我是神射手，但对交涉却不在行。

不如你帮我们去找那些菜鸟猎人谈谈，让他们到山丘去，怎么样？
text.completion: Ya seem to have a gift when it comes to dealin' with amateurs. Maybe ya can help my ghostwriter, Addie?$b$bI've promised to teach her how to hunt, but I don't have time to show her the basics.

english.title: Amateur Hour
english.objectives: Confront Amateur Hunters within Pinerock Basin.
english.description:
The hunters' lodge has attracted a lot of amateurs who call themselves hunters. They're scarin' away all the prize game with their antics.

While I'm a known expert with my rifle, I've yet to manage the art of negotiation.

How about ya do us all a favor and tell those novice hunters to head for the hills?
english.completion: Ya seem to have a gift when it comes to dealin' with amateurs. Maybe ya can help my ghostwriter, Addie?$b$bI've promised to teach her how to hunt, but I don't have time to show her the basics.

text.title: 不稳定的棱镜
text.objectives: 将冰冷的时空扭曲棱镜交给达拉然的一位对此感兴趣的法师。
text.description: 这块棱镜努力想在某个单一的时间流里稳定下来，同时散发出一股阴冷的气息。你只在诺森德感受过类似的寒气。达拉然的某位法师肯定会对这件遗物感兴趣的。

english.title: The Unstable Prism
english.objectives: Deliver the Frigid Timewarped Prism to an interested mage in Dalaran.
english.description: As the prism struggles to stabilize in a single time flow, it bleeds a shadowy chill, the likes of which you haven't felt since Northrend. Surely some mage in Dalaran would be interested in this relic.

text.title: 面面俱到
text.objectives: 制作一双结实的石皮长靴。$b$b你需要使用娜穆的制皮架和工作台，它们就在传说皮甲店里。
text.description: 你可真是个大忙人，$n。看来你学会了一些新图样！$b$b要不要再多学一些？

english.title: From Head to Toe
english.objectives: Craft a pair of Sturdy Stonehide Boots.$b$bYou will need to use Namha's Tanning Rack and Namha's Workbench, located in Legendary Leathers.
english.description: You've been busy, $n. And you have some new patterns in your repertoire, I see!$b$bHow about we add another?

text.title: 皮革专家
text.objectives: 与蒂亚妮·坎宁斯见面。
text.description: 我希望你开始跟我的学徒们合作。$b$b第一位学徒叫蒂亚妮·坎宁斯，她的专长是制作软皮护甲，但是她在锁甲方面的兴趣则不如那对双胞胎兄弟。$b$b去跟她聊聊这种新皮革的事情。

english.title: Leather Lady
english.objectives: Meet with Diane Cannings.
english.description: I'd like you to start working with my apprentices.$b$bThe first is Diane Cannings, who has focused her expertise on the softer leather armors. She's just not that into mail armor, like the twins are.$b$bGo talk to her about this new type of leather.

text.title: 护甲商机
text.objectives: 取得一件塑皮者外套。
text.description: 诺森德的维库人喜欢穿戴坚固的防具，他们的工匠往往有质量上乘的护甲。$b$b前往风暴峡湾，寻找一个了解皮甲的人，并给我带回一件他们的胸甲。

english.title: Vestment Opportunity
english.objectives: Obtain a Hideshaper's Vestment.
english.description: While the vrykul of Northrend wore strong armor, their craftsmen always had the strongest.$b$bGo to Stormheim, search for someone who knows about leather armor, and bring their chest piece back to me.

text.title: 勇闯风暴峡湾
text.objectives: 取得$1oa条维库皮革腰带。
text.description: 下面有个被称为风暴峡湾的地方，那里是维库人的地盘。当年我在诺森德时，对维库人就有了一定的认识。$b$b让我印象最深刻的就是他们精良的护甲。$b$b如果这里的维库人也像诺森德的维库人一样手艺精湛的话，我敢肯定，只要对他们的装备进行研究，我们就可以学到一些东西。

english.title: Stormheim Savagery
english.objectives: Obtain $1oa Vrykul Leather Bindings.
english.description: There's a land below - Stormheim, they call it - that's inhabited by vrykul. I remember the vrykul from my days in Northrend.$b$bWhat I remember most was how well-crafted their armor was.$b$bIf the vrykul here are as skilled as the ones in Northrend, then I'm certain we can learn something by studying their armaments.

text.title: 锁甲专家
text.objectives: 与泰尼德·怒金见面。
text.description: 我后面那两个矮人是怒金兄弟，他们是我的常任锁甲专家。$b$b兰尼德决定把精力放在挣钱上面，而他的兄弟泰尼德则更愿意潜心制造。$b$b向泰尼德做一下自我介绍。你可以跟他合作，进一步研究如何用这种新皮革制作出不同凡响的成品。

english.title: Mail Men
english.objectives: Meet with Thanid Glowergold.
english.description: The two dwarves behind me are the Glowergold brothers. They're my resident mail armor experts.$b$bWhile Ranid has decided to focus his skills towards lining his pockets, his brother, Thanid, still enjoys the crafting side of the trade.$b$bIntroduce yourself to Thanid. You may work with him to further our knowledge of turning these stormscales into something extraordinary.

text.title: 黑鸦盗宝
text.objectives: 取得$1oa件黑鸦护甲。
text.description: 据说瓦尔莎拉有一座巨大的城堡，里面驻扎着一支精锐部队。当然，他们穿戴的护甲也应该不是随便乱做的。$b$b我敢打赌，他们一定为将士们量身打造了特殊的锁甲。它们就在里面等着谁去“拿”呢。$b$b不如你到那里去一趟，看看能不能从他们的军械库里“拿”点东西。

english.title: Black Rook Bandit
english.objectives: Obtain $1oa pieces of Black Rook Armor.
english.description: I've heard rumors of a grand castle in Val'sharah that's known to house an impressive army. Surely, the armor they wear ain't made of sticks and hay.$b$bI'm willing to bet they've fashioned some mail armor at some point fer their troops and it's just sitting there, ripe for the taking.$b$bHow about ye head over there and see what ye can "borrow" from their armory.

text.title: 完美难自制
text.objectives: 取得一件黑鸦锁子甲。
text.description: 黑鸦堡垒出产的护甲，品质都相当精良，不过我最感兴趣的是他们的胸甲。$b$b可以的话，试着找到里面的重要人物并取得他们的胸甲……减轻他们的负担。$b$b我听说他们都受到了诅咒，所以你不用觉得于心不忍，了结他们也算是帮他们得到解脱。

english.title: Too Good To Pass Up
english.objectives: Obtain a Black Rook Hauberk.
english.description: All types of Black Rook Hold armor are intriguing, but I'm most interested in their chest pieces.$b$bIf ye can, try to find someone of importance there and... relieve them of their shirt.$b$bIf it makes ye feel any better, I've heard they're all cursed, so puttin' them out of their misery is the least ye could do.

text.title: 头顶之上
text.objectives: 制作一个粗糙的战甲面具。$b$b你需要使用娜穆的制皮架和工作台，它们就在传说皮甲店里。
text.description: 好吧，$n。我要你协助我制作头盔。$b$b首先，我们需要刮掉皮上的毛发，然后进行鞣制，最后剪裁成合用的皮革。$b$b按我说的做就好。

english.title: Over Your Head
english.objectives: Craft a Rough Warhide Mask.$b$bYou will need to use Namha's Tanning Rack and Namha's Workbench, located in Legendary Leathers.
english.description: Alright, $n, I'd like you to assist me with creating a helm.$b$bFirst we'll need to shave the hides, then tan them, and finally cut them into usable pieces.$b$bFollow my lead.

text.title: 牛头人制皮技术
text.objectives: 向何鲁尔·锐蹄报到。
text.description: 你听说过至高岭的牛头人部族吗？他们和我们所知的卡利姆多牛头人不尽相同。$b$b听说那里有一个制皮大师，他或许可以帮我们研发一些新的图样。$b$b到至高岭去，看看他们愿不愿意教你如何制作护甲。

english.title: Tauren Tanning
english.objectives: Report to Hrul Sharphoof.
english.description: Have you heard of the Highmountain tauren tribes? They're not unlike the tauren we know on Kalimdor.$b$bI've heard they have a leatherworking master there who might be able to help us come up with some new patterns.$b$bTravel to Highmountain and see if they're willing to teach you how they craft their armor.

text.title: 肩负重任
text.objectives: 取得洛胡恩的护肩。
text.description: 我的兄弟洛胡恩在最近的一场战斗中壮烈牺牲。卓格巴尔抢走了他的护甲。$b$b如果你找回他的护甲，那无疑是对他的衷心缅怀。我会给你丰厚的回报，皮革匠。

english.title: Shoulder the Burden
english.objectives: Obtain Lohrumn's Shoulderguard.
english.description: During one of our recent battles, my brother, Lohrumn, was slain. His armor was taken by the drogbar.$b$bYou would honor his memory by retrieving what has been stolen. I will make it worth your while, leatherworker.

text.title: 耐打的卓格巴尔
text.objectives: 消灭$1oa个卓格巴尔，向何鲁尔证明你的能力。
text.description: 我们正在和一个叫做卓格巴尔的种族交战。我们曾与他们有过很长一段时间的和平，不过近来他们完全不把其他人放在眼里。$b$b消灭他们，证明你有资格成为牛头人的盟友。如果你能做到这一点，我就会把我们的知识传授给你。

english.title: Drogbar Durability
english.objectives: Kill $1oa drogbar to prove your worth to Hrul.
english.description: We are currently at war with a race known as the drogbar. We have long maintained peace with the drogbar, but lately, they have no respect for anyone but themselves.$b$bSlay them. Prove your worth as an ally of the tauren. Do this, and I will reward you with knowledge.

objectiveDetails.description: 在白水溪消灭卓格巴尔

text.title: 填补工艺链
text.objectives: 在阿苏纳寻找制皮大师。
text.description: 哎呀，$g小伙子:小姑娘;，恐怕我已经把所有关于这些鳞片的知识都教给你了。我也不太清楚怎么把剩下的材料做成套装。$b$b听说阿苏纳的精灵城市里曾经有一些技艺精湛的制皮大师，或许其中的一两个现在还活着。$b$b到那里去找位大师帮忙吧，也许他们能够补齐我们缺少的图样。

english.title: Links in the Chain
english.objectives: Find a leatherworking master in Azsuna.
english.description: Well, $glad:lass;, I'm afraid I'm at me wits' end with these scales. Not quite sure how to fashion the remaining pieces fer a full set.$b$bHowever, I've heard that the elves of Azsuna had some great crafters in their cities. Perhaps one or two of them still exist.$b$bGo there and search fer a master. Maybe they can fill in the missing patterns fer us.

text.title: 大刑伺候
text.objectives: 在艾达尼尔浅滩消灭拉纳里斯。
text.description: 大分裂让我和我的搭档吃尽了苦头。我们被一位备受信赖的朋友背叛和抛弃。$b$b那位“朋友”名叫拉纳里斯，最近常在东边的废墟出没。$b$b去那里为我们报仇，然后我就会把我的知识传授给你。

english.title: Best Served Cold
english.objectives: Kill Ranaris in the El'dranil Shallows.
english.description: My partner and I both fell victim to the fallout of the Sundering. We were betrayed and abandoned by a trusted friend.$b$bThat "friend" has recently appeared in the ruins to the east. His name is Ranaris.$b$bGo to and take revenge for us and I will grant you some of my wisdom.

text.title: 纳迦好手艺
text.objectives: 取得$1oa件纳迦护肩。
text.description: 这片地区的纳迦穿戴着极少的护甲，不过它们都特别耐用。$b$b如果你想制作一副坚韧的护甲，就得先把纳迦的护甲拿给我研究研究，这样我才能做出拥有类似结构的图样。$b$b附近有一个纳迦肆虐的城市，到那里去消灭纳迦并带回他们的护甲，然后我会让你看个明白。

english.title: Naga Know-How
english.objectives: Obtain $1oa Naga Shoulderguards.
english.description: The naga of this region wear little armor, but what they do wear is particularly durable.$b$bIf you wish to make a strong shoulder piece, I would first study the naga's armor and then create a pattern of similar construct.$b$bThe city nearby is overrun by naga. Slay them and bring me their armor and I will show you what I mean.

text.title: 精深制皮技术
text.objectives: 回至高岭找何鲁尔·锐蹄。
text.description: 回至高岭去吧，$n！听说他们知道怎样更有效地制作我们的图样。$b$b你到那里的时候，可以多帮我美言几句吗？我想和牛头人搞好关系，这样就不用老让你来回跑腿了。

english.title: Hardening the Hide
english.objectives: Return to Highmountain and talk to Hrul Sharphoof.
english.description: Back to Highmountain for you, $n! I hear they know even more efficient ways to craft our patterns.$b$bWhen you get there, put in a good word for me, will ya? I'd like to start a relationship the tauren, so I don't have to keep sending you back and forth.

text.title: 皮革上的故事
text.objectives: 阅读每个制皮架上的故事。
text.description: 我身后的制皮架上有一些皮革，上面印着我们部族制皮匠的古老工艺。$b$b上面记载着许多大师的故事。这些大师靠着坚持不懈的努力和一点点运气，开创了我们独有的制皮先河。$b$b阅读这些故事，并从中吸取经验教训。或许你可以找到一点灵感，改善自己的手艺。

english.title: Stamped Stories
english.objectives: Learn from the stories of each of the tanning racks.
english.description: Stamped onto the leather of the tanning racks behind me are the ancient ways of out tribe's leatherworkers.$b$bThey tell the stories of masters who, through perseverance - and luck, in some cases - pioneered our way of leatherworking.$b$bRead the stories and learn from them. Perhaps you'll find some insight on how to better your own methods.

text.title: 大地之爪
text.objectives: 取得$1oa个追猎者的爪子。
text.description: 以我的个人经验，制作护甲时最好使用坚硬的材料。它们更加耐用，而且比较省料。$b$b比如，我会使用松岩追猎者的爪子。如果你能帮我取得一些，或许我可以教你如何用上乘的材料来提高你的效率。

english.title: Claw of the Land
english.objectives: Obtain $1oa Stalker Claws.
english.description: Personal experience has taught me to use stronger materials when crafting armor pieces. They last longer, and you don't need quite as many of them.$b$bFor example, I utilize the claws of the pinerock stalkers. If you acquire some for me, perhaps I can show you how better materials can increase your efficiency.

text.title: 茅塞顿开
text.objectives: 回阿苏纳找塞莉娅。
text.description: 听好了，$g小伙子:小姑娘;。你制作出来的东西都有改进的空间。问题是，我还没完全想好怎么用这些漂亮的新鳞片来加以改进。$b$b或许你那位鬼魂一般的精灵朋友可以帮你。如果她真的知道什么，你可以回来告诉我们。$b$b那一定会让店里财源滚滚。

english.title: Getting the Kinks Out
english.objectives: Go back to Celea in Azsuna.
english.description: Now listen, $glad:lass;. Everything ye make can always be done better. I just haven't quite worked out the way to do it with these fancy new scales.$b$bPerhaps that ghost-like elf friend of yours can help ye. An' if she DOES know somethin', perhaps ye can relay that information back to us.$b$bIt would certainly go towards making the shop more lucrative.

text.title: 货物回收
text.objectives: 取得$1oa份锁甲货物。
text.description: 在我的兄弟乘坐的那艘船上还运送着一批精良的锁甲。我了解那些巨人，他们很可能完全用不上这些锁甲并随意地将其四处丢弃在他们的洞穴里。$b$b如果你能将那些货物收集起来并带回这里，我就愿意向你解释锻造它们的技巧。如果你想提升你的技术，这应该能给你一些不错的启示。

english.title: Reclaimed Cargo
english.objectives: Obtain $1oa Mail Armor Shipments.
english.description: The same ship that my brother was on also carried shipments of exceptional mail armor. Knowing the giants, they probably had no use for them and left them scattered around their caves.$b$bIf you could recover those shipments and bring them here, I can explain the techniques used to fashion them. That should give you a good idea of how to improve your processes.

text.title: 大胆的营救
text.objectives: 前往欧逊努斯海窟，寻找塔尔达尼斯并把护甲交给他。
text.description: 我的兄弟塔尔达尼斯登上了一艘开往阿苏纳的船。海巨人伏击了他们的船只，还俘虏了我的兄弟。$b$b我认为他还活着，而且肯定在那些可怕的洞穴里给巨人当牛做马。拜托你去营救他。$b$b把这个拿去，你遇到麻烦的时候它会保护好我的兄弟。你自己也小心点，别被抓走了。

english.title: A Daring Rescue
english.objectives: Find Taldranis in Oceanus Cove, and deliver the armor to him.
english.description: My brother, Taldranis, was on a ship headed here to Azsuna. The ship was ambushed by the sea giants and my brother was taken captive.$b$bI believe he still lives out his days in those horrible caves, slaving away for the giants. Go and free him, please.$b$bTake this with you, it may give him enough protection should you run into any trouble. And be careful not to get captured by the giants yourself.

objectiveDetails.description: 把护甲交给塔尔达尼斯

text.title: 冒险者的后顾之忧
text.objectives: 与梅尔·弗兰希斯一起探讨她的骑甲构思。
text.description: $n！我最近跟坐骑商人梅尔谈过。她问我能不能制作出一种骑甲，防止冒险者从坐骑上摔下来。$b$b我要你去找她深入探讨一下这个想法。$b$b谈好以后就回来找我，或许我们可以一起解决这个问题。

english.title: Adventuring Anxieties
english.objectives: Speak with Mei Francis about her barding idea.
english.description: $n! I was recently talking with Mei, the mount trader, and she asked me if it was possible to make a barding that could prevent adventurers from being dismounted.$b$bI'd like you to go and discuss this idea with her further.$b$bReturn to me when you're finished. Perhaps we can solve this issue together.

text.title: 必要的材料
text.objectives: 收集$1oa块石皮皮革。
text.description: 为了制作这种骑甲，我们需要大量……超大量的皮革。$b$b我会确定组装部件的方案，你负责收集皮革。$b$b完成以后，我们就可以开始制作了。

english.title: The Necessary Materials
english.objectives: Gather $1oa Stonehide Leather.
english.description: In order to make this barding, we'll need a lot of leather. And I mean a LOT of leather.$b$bI'll solidify our plans on fitting the pieces together. You go gather the leather.$b$bOnce that's done, we can begin crafting.

text.title: 过街老鼠！
text.objectives: 前往达拉然下水道，找回$1oa份至高岭制皮图样。
text.description: 不瞒你说，$n，我有时候真是倒霉透顶。$b$b何鲁尔最近送来了一个装着皮甲图样的包裹。结果我一转身，一些肮脏的老鼠就跑了进来，带着那些图样跑进下水道了！$b$b我们说话这会儿，说不定它们就在用图样来筑巢。$n，拜托你到下面去一趟，看看能不能帮我找回一些？

english.title: Rats!
english.objectives: Go into the Underbelly and recover $1oa Highmountain Leatherworking Patterns.
english.description: I tell you, $n, I have the worst luck sometimes.$b$bA package recently arrived from Hrul containing leatherworking patterns, and while my back was turned, some filthy rats came in and ran off with them down into the sewers!$b$bProbably building nests with them as we speak. Please, $n, can you go down there and see if you can retrieve any of them?

text.title: 制皮的跑腿工作
text.objectives: 给泰尼德拿一根撬棍。
text.description: 好消息，$n！兰格鲁的皮加锁最近将一批锁甲运送到了我这里。$b$b这批货的质量都是最顶级的，我想让你也看看它们，不过我好像把撬棍丢了，所以没法打开这些箱子。$b$b如果你能跑到他们的商店那里给我再拿一根撬棍的话，我们就能够打开箱子，然后复习一遍这些铠甲的锻造流程了。

english.title: Leather Legwork
english.objectives: Get a crowbar for Thanid.
english.description: Good news, $n!
