Langrom's Leather and Links recently delivered a shipment of mail armor to me.$b$bIt's of the finest quality and I'd love to show it to ye, but it seems I've lost me crowbar and can't open the crate.$b$bIf ye could run over to their shop and grab an extra one fer me, we can get this crate opened and go over the construction.

objectiveDetails.description: 把护甲架交给布拉古德·明火
把裙子还给伊曼蒂尔·锋歌
支付2枚金币给山迪·格罗斯
请山迪·格罗斯清洗裙子
向伊曼蒂尔·锋歌询问护甲架的事情

text.title: 趣味玩具
text.objectives: 到魔法动物店去找“母狮”丽奥聊聊，然后回去找娜穆。
text.description: 你喜欢宠物吗，$n？我非常喜欢。它们实在是太可爱了！$b$b我需要一些能让我陪着宠物们玩耍的物件。$b$b魔法动物店的丽奥肯定了解趣味玩具。你去找她聊聊吧！

english.title: Battle Bonds
english.objectives: Talk to Lio the Lioness at the Magical Menagerie shop. Then return to Namha.
english.description: Do you like pets, $n? I love pets. They're so cute!$b$bBut what I really want is more things with which to play with them.$b$bI'm sure Lio over at the Magical Menagerie has some ideas for fun toys. You should go talk to her!

text.title: 杂耍玩具
text.objectives: 制作宠物床的原型。
text.description: 好吧，她说了束带、床和火圈？！$b$b这是要搞个马戏团之类的吗？不管怎么说，这些东西我统统喜欢，等你准备好了我们就赶紧开始吧。$b$b不如你来制作床，我来弄火圈的部分。

english.title: Playthings
english.objectives: Craft a prototype for the pet bed.
english.description: Ok, so her ideas were a leash, a bed, and a FLAMING HOOP?!$b$bIt sounds like they want to start a circus or something. Regardless, I love all those ideas and we should get started as soon as you're ready.$b$bWhy don't you work on making the bed, and I'll work out the details for the flaming hoop.

text.title: 最后一课
text.objectives: 到至高岭去找何鲁尔·锐蹄。
text.description: $n，何鲁尔要见你。从他的讯息来看，他已经准备好把他关于这片土地的制皮知识传授给你。$b$b我真羡慕你，$n……你能赢得他的尊敬，也让我感到骄傲。$b$b去吧，祝你好运！

english.title: The Final Lessons
english.objectives: Go to Hrul Sharphoof in Highmountain.
english.description: $n, Hrul has requested your presence. From his message it seems as though he's ready to impart to you all the wisdom he has gained from working with the skins of this land.$b$bI envy you, $n... but I'm also proud to see that you've gained so much respect with him.$b$bGo now, and good luck!

text.title: 过去的力量
text.objectives: 为何鲁尔找回一片死亡之翼的鳞片。
text.description: 如你所知，材料的强韧性决定了护甲的耐久度。$b$b很久以前，黑龙死亡之翼就住在这座山里。他的身体随其对力量的追求而逐渐龟裂，所以他让仆从们制作了金属鳞片来缝合伤口。$b$b黑龙自身的鳞片脱落并一直留在了这个巢穴之中。请你去拿一片龙鳞给我。$b$b你必须全力以赴，才有可能成功。

english.title: Strength of the Past
english.objectives: Return a scale of Deathwing to Hrul.
english.description: As you know, the durability of your armor is only as strong as the materials you use to make them.$b$bLong ago, the black dragon, Deathwing once inhabited this very mountain. In his quest for power, his body began to tear and he had creatures make metal scales to stitch his wounds.$b$bHis natural scales fell to the ground in his lair and have been there ever since. Go retrieve a scale and bring it to me.$b$bThis will take all your strength to accomplish.

text.title: 过去的进步
text.objectives: 取得$1oa张蜥蜴皮。
text.description: 随着我们的护甲越来越精良，我们所对抗的生物也跟着适应，并且逐渐学会了反制的方法。所以我们只能进一步提升护甲的质量，然而敌人也在不断进化。$b$b我的族人与下面台地里的蜥蜴对抗了几百年，它们和我们已经达到了互相制衡的状态。$b$b消灭这些蜥蜴，然后把它们的皮剥下来，我会告诉你它们进化到了什么地步。

english.title: Evolution of the Past
english.objectives: Obtain $1oa Basilisk Hides.
english.description: As we make stronger armor, the creatures we battle adapt and learn to defeat us. We in turn create better armor, and they in turn learn to defeat it yet again.$b$bFor centuries, my people have battled the basilisks of the mesas below. They have adapted to us as thoroughly as we have to them.$b$bGo, kill these basilisks and take from them their hides. Return them to me so I may show you how they have evolved.

text.title: 过去的敬拜
text.objectives: 到至高岭的四处制皮架圣地，学习皮革上的故事。
text.description: 我们记录过去的错误，以提醒自己不要重蹈覆辙。但是，记录历史的目的不止于此，那也是为了庆祝我们的成就。$b$b至高岭有很多神圣的地方，那里散布着类似于这个带有刻印皮革的制皮架，它们记载着许多故事。$b$b前往这些圣地，献上你的敬意，学习其中的智慧。

english.title: Respect for the Past
english.objectives: Go to the four tanning racks around Highmountain and hear their stories.
english.description: We record the mistakes of the past so we can learn to avoid them in the present. However, recording history is not just about preventing missteps, but also to celebrate our successes.$b$bScattered around Highmountain at sacred locations are racks with stamped leather, much like the ones here, with stories to tell.$b$bGo to these locations, pay your respect, and learn their lessons.

text.title: 还清人情
text.objectives: 到阿苏纳去找塞莉娅。
text.description: 天啊，我从没听说过鬼魂会寄信，结果我刚才还真收到这么一封，吓死人了。$b$b塞莉娅要见你，$g小伙子:小姑娘;。如果我是你，肯定会立刻赶过去。让鬼魂久等的话，肯定会倒大霉。

english.title: A Debt Paid
english.objectives: Go to Celea in Azsuna.
english.description: Now, I've never heard of a ghost sending a letter before, but I'll be damned if'n I didn't just receive one now.$b$bCelea has sent fer ye, $glad:lass;. I'd best be on me way if I were ye. Might be bad luck to keep a spirit waiting.

text.title: 魔法之鳞
text.objectives: 与蓝龙军团交涉以索取龙鳞。
text.description: 以个人经历来看，龙鳞是我有幸能够使用的最强韧的材料。它坚硬耐久还不废料。$b$b我希望能够再次体验制作龙鳞的感觉，$n。不过我现在这副样子，没办法离开这里去探索世界。$b$b听说蓝龙军团盘踞了阿苏纳的部分区域，或许你能去跟他们进行交涉，让他们提供一两片龙鳞。

english.title: Scales of the Arcane
english.objectives: Speak with the blue dragonflight and acquire one of their scales.
english.description: In my experience, dragon scale has been the strongest material I've ever had the privilege of working with. It's hard, durable and very little can go a long way.$b$bI wish to work with it again, $n. Being in this form, I'm bound to this area, unable to experience the world any longer.$b$bI've heard rumor of the blue dragonflight occupying parts of Azsuna. Perhaps you can speak with them and see if they can shed a scale or two.

text.title: 艾萨拉之眼：海洋之鳞
text.objectives: 前往艾萨拉之眼并取得督军帕杰什的锁子甲。
text.description: 初次见面的时候，我提到过纳迦以及他们制作的护甲。他们的首领所穿戴的护甲品质最为上乘。$b$b艾萨拉之眼里就驻守着一个纳迦首领——督军帕杰什，他穿着传奇般的锁子甲。$b$b击退他的部队，并取得他的护甲。完成之后，我会把更多阿苏纳的制皮知识传授给你。
text.giverWindow: 指挥纳迦军团的勇猛战士。

english.title: Eye of Azshara: Scales of the Sea
english.objectives: Go to the Eye of Azshara and obtain Warlord Parjesh's Hauberk.
english.description: When we first met, I spoke of the naga, and the armor they're able to craft. No grander armor is worn, however, than by their top warlords.$b$bOne in particular resides within the Eye of Azshara itself. His name is Warlord Parjesh, and the hauberk he wears is one of legend.$b$bRepel his forces, and obtain his armor. Do this, and I will teach you more of the Azsunian way of leatherworking.
english.giverWindow: A fierce warrior who commands legions of naga.

text.title: 大地之鳞
text.objectives: 取得斧尾蜥蜴主母的鳞片。
text.description: 皮甲本身有一定的强韧度，不过镶嵌鳞片的皮甲更是出类拔萃。$b$b想让护甲为穿戴者提供全面的保护，就需要根据鳞片的类型来区分用量。蜥蜴的鳞片是最强韧的鳞片之一。$b$b成年蜥蜴的鳞片自然最为强韧。洛希恩村庄附近有一个蜥蜴巢穴。消灭蜥蜴主母并带回她的鳞片。
text.giverWindow: 当心她的尾巴。那就跟巨龙的獠牙一样锋利。

english.title: Scales of the Earth
english.objectives: Obtain the Axetail Basilisk Matriarch Scales.
english.description: While leather armor is strong on its own, integrating scales into the design is what truly sets it apart.$b$bThe type of scales you use will determine how many you'll need to fully protect the wearer. And one of the strongest type of scales are basilisk scales.$b$bA fully matured basilisk has the strongest of course. Near the village of Llothien is a basilisk den. Kill the matriarch and return her scales to me.
english.giverWindow: Beware her tail. It's as sharp as a dragon's fang.

text.title: 获益良多的经历
text.objectives: 向娜穆讲述你在阿苏纳期间与暗夜精灵之间发生的事情。
text.description: 很不幸，$n，我已经没什么可以教你的了。我很高兴我们在这次合作中实现了我们双方的目标。$b$b现在去和你的达拉然盟友们分享你学到的知识吧。我确定他们会十分渴望分享你的训练成果的。

english.title: Time Well Spent
english.objectives: Tell Namha of your time with the night elves in Azsuna.
english.description: Unfortunately, $n, you have learned all that I have to teach. I am pleased we were each able to achieve our goals in this partnership.$b$bGo now and share what you've learned with your allies in Dalaran. I'm sure they'd be eager to share in your training.

text.title: 恶魔皮囊
text.objectives: 在苏拉玛寻找一位制皮大师。
text.description: 我们还没有研究过苏拉玛的生物，$n，尤其是那里的恶魔。$b$b我对他们绝无好感，不过谁也无法忽略一个事实，有些恶魔的外皮十分强韧。$b$b我们可以学习恶魔猎手以其道还其身的精神，把他们的外皮纳为己用。苍天可鉴，我一点也不知道怎么处理恶魔的外皮。$b$b说不定在苏拉玛会有人知道呢……

english.title: Demon Flesh
english.objectives: Search for a master leatherworker in Suramar.
english.description: Something we haven't really explored yet, $n, are the creatures of Suramar. Specifically, the demons.$b$bNow I certainly don't praise what they are, but you can't ignore the fact that some of their creatures have especially tough hides.$b$bWe could take a lesson from the demon hunters and use those hides to our advantage against the demons. I'll be damned though if I know the first thing about working with demon hide.$b$bPerhaps there's someone in Suramar who can help...

text.title: 惹错了对象
text.objectives: 消灭皮革匠叛徒：菲奥莱斯、塔里安，以及赛亚娜。
text.description: 他在那儿，他不在那儿！他……他！$b$b等等……不对。抱歉，我最近总是稀里糊涂的，从我被流放以来就每况愈下。$b$b如果你想在我失去理智之前学点东西的话，就请帮我一个忙吧，去消灭那些与恶魔为伍并驱逐我的叛徒。

english.title: Wrong End of the Knife
english.objectives: Kill the traitor leatherworkers, Feorias, Tallian, and Syana.
english.description: There he is! The man that isn't there! He's... he's...$b$bWait... no, I'm sorry. My thoughts, they're just all over place lately. Ever since my exile, things have been a bit fuzzier than normal.$b$bIf you wish to learn from me before I completely lose my mind, then do me a favor, and kill those traitors who sided with the demons and exiled me.

text.title: 泛滥的恶魔犬
text.objectives: 取得$1oa具恶魔犬尸体。
text.description: 我要请他来饮茶，这样就能给他看好玩的了！他看到皮革娃娃之后肯定会问“她什么时候出现的？！”$b$b我的意思是……抱歉，$n。我的脑子里总有些奇怪的想法。你想了解那些拥有结实外皮的恶魔？$b$b我在被驱逐之前在我们的城市里见过那种野兽，它们被称为恶魔犬。去消灭它们并带回尸体。$b$b然后我们就来讨论讨论那些外皮。

english.title: Hounds Abound
english.objectives: Obtain $1oa Fel Hound Corpses.
english.description: I'll invite him to tea. That'll show him! He'll see the leather doll and say, "When did SHE get here?!"$b$bI mean... sorry, $n. My mind goes to strange places. You want to know about the demons, the ones with durable hides?$b$bBefore I was exiled I saw such beasts roaming our cities. Fel hounds, they are called. Slay them and bring me their corpses.$b$bWe can discuss their hides afterwards.

text.title: 邪能制皮
text.objectives: 使用制皮架制作一对护腕。
text.description: 你给我听好了。我不知道自己疯狂的那一面什么时候又会出现，所以我们相处的时间越少越好。$b$b你想学习怎么制作那些可以抵御恶魔攻击的护甲？好好听我的指导，你肯定能学会的。

english.title: Fel Tanning
english.objectives: Craft a pair of bracers for Stalriss using the tanning rack.
english.description: Listen, you. I'm not sure when the crazy side of me will come out again, so let's make our time together short.$b$bYou want to learn how to make armor to rival the demons? Follow my instructions and you'll have an excellent grasp on the procedures.

text.title: 轻松驾驭
text.objectives: 捕获巨型北地大角鹿。
text.description: $n，你在这里真是太好了。我承认，我一直在背着你进行一项秘密工作。那就是：石皮皮革挽具！这件护甲堪称艺术品，现在我们只需要找到配得上它的坐骑。$b$b维库人传唱着关于一头雪白大角鹿的歌谣，据说它的有着无穷的精力。找到它，为它套上挽具并驯服它。

english.title: Mounting Made Easy
english.objectives: Capture the Great Northern Elderhorn.
english.description: $n, I'm glad you're here. I confess: I've been working on a secret project behind your back. Behold: the Stonehide Leather Harness! Now, we simply need to find a mount worthy of such a piece of art.$b$bThe vrykul sing songs of a snow-white elderhorn with endless stamina. Find it, place the harness on it, and tame it.

text.title: 猎人之心
text.objectives: 在松岩盆地猎杀野生动物，帮助艾迪学习如何狩猎。
text.description:
艾迪写得一手好文章，但我从没看过她拿枪。她非常希望学习狩猎，但是有谁听过侏儒猎人啊？ 

你似乎很擅长应付业余人士，不知道你愿不愿意带这个侏儒去进行一次狩猎？跟着像你样技术高超的人实践学习，她一定会有所长进。

最好从小型猎物开始。我们可不想打击小姑娘的信心。
text.completion: You haven't got any holes in ya, I guess that means Addie's aim isn't as bad as I thought!

english.title: A Hunter at Heart
english.objectives: Help Addie learn to hunt by killing wildlife in Pinerock Basin.
english.description:
Addie's one heck of a writer, but I've never seen her hold a rifle. She's keen on learning how to hunt, but who's ever heard of a gnome hunter? 

You seem to have a knack dealin' with amateurs, so maybe you'd be willin' to let the gnome tag along on a hunt? She could learn a thing or two by shadowing someone with your skill.

Ya best start off with some small game. We don't want the lass to get discouraged.
english.completion: You haven't got any holes in ya, I guess that means Addie's aim isn't as bad as I thought!

text.title: 箭矢供应
text.objectives: 把箭囊拿到奈辛瓦里小屋，交给赫米特·奈辛瓦里。
text.description:
有许多新的旅行者在山岭间穿梭，其中的一些人不理解我们的传统。

对于最近在附近盆地里出现的一些猎人，虽然首领们无暇顾及，但是罗索尔和我却实在不能无视。

他们放弃了传统的弓箭，转而使用火枪和器械进行狩猎。

虽然我知道有些人不会改变自己的习惯，但是如果我们为他们提供箭矢的话，也许就能鼓励这些外来者采用我们传统的狩猎方式。
text.completion: We gave up usin' that kind of ammo long ago! Don't worry though, we won't let the gift go to waste. I'm sure we can use the arrows for kindling.

english.title: An Offering of Ammo
english.objectives: Deliver the Quiver of Arrows to Hemet Nesingwary at Nesingwary's Retreat.
english.description:
The mountains have seen many new travelers pass through their valleys, some without an understanding of our traditions.

Our leaders have turned their focus to more pressing matters, but Losro and I cannot ignore the recent arrival of hunters in the nearby basin.

They hunt with guns and gadgets, forgoing the experience of hunting with a bow and arrow.

While I know that some will remain stuck in their ways, perhaps an offering of arrows will encourage these outsiders to hunt the way we always have.
english.completion: We gave up usin' that kind of ammo long ago! Don't worry though, we won't let the gift go to waste. I'm sure we can use the arrows for kindling.

text.title: 报恩
text.objectives: 与雷特森·焰怒谈一谈。
text.description:
我需要处理一些紧急事务，不过我会在处理好之后尽快赶到恐痕裂隙，帮助你进行召唤。

你应该警告雷特森，让他保持距离。我到那里去是为了报答你的恩情，而不是跟那个选择了议会而放弃自己朋友的伪君子聊天的。

english.title: Debt Repaid
english.objectives: Speak to Ritssyn Flamescowl.
english.description:
I have a few urgent matters to take care of, but soon after I will make my way to Dreadscar Rift and aid you with your summoning.

You should warn Ritssyn to keep his distance. I'll be there to repay my debt to you, not to speak to the hypocrite who chose the council over his friends.

text.title: 对抗死亡之翼
text.objectives: 见证3段幻像。
text.description: 很久以前，胡恩·高岭就是在这里挑战强大的死亡之翼。$b$b今天，我们将通过先祖的眼睛重温当时的情形。$b$b灵魂之旅的下一个部分，我们需要找到在多年前放置的三个火盆。有了它们，跟随胡恩足迹的后人就可以见证他的事迹。
text.completion: And so it was that Huln Highmountain came to this mountain, freeing the drogbar slaves of Deathwing, and came into possession of the Hammer of Khaz'goroth.

english.title: In Defiance of Deathwing
english.objectives: Witness 3 Visions.
english.description: It was in this place, ages ago, that Huln Highmountain challenged the great Deathwing.$b$bToday we shall re-live moments of that day through the eyes of our ancestors.$b$bFor this next part of the spirit journey, we must seek out the three braziers set down many ages ago so that those who would follow in the footsteps of Huln might witness his deeds.
english.completion: And so it was that Huln Highmountain came to this mountain, freeing the drogbar slaves of Deathwing, and came into possession of the Hammer of Khaz'goroth.

text.title: 棘刺之舞
text.objectives: 在月翼浅滩击败$1oa个蓟叶刺舞者。
text.description: 蓟叶林精已经彻底疯了。$b$b我怀疑某些非常顽劣的刺舞者可能在背后操纵它们。$b$b拜托了，森林的朋友，请找出那些教唆骚乱的麻烦精，将和平还给浅滩。

english.title: Thorny Dancing
english.objectives: Defeat $1oa Thistleleaf Thorndancers in the Lunarwing Shallows.
english.description: The Thistleleaf sprites have gone completely mad.$b$bI suspect they are being manipulated by some very mischievous Thorndancers.$b$bPlease, friend of the forest, seek out these seductive troublemakers and bring peace to the shallows.

text.title: 放飞精灵龙
text.objectives: 在月翼浅滩解救8只被俘的月翼精灵龙。
text.description: 这些可怜的精灵龙正饱受折磨！$B$B更可怕的是，等这些蓟叶厌倦之后，它们会把受害者困住，将来再继续折磨。$b$b这种行为决不能容忍。$B$B请四处找一找，释放那些被困的月翼精灵龙。

english.title: Spread Your Lunarwings and Fly
english.objectives: Save 8 Trapped Lunarwings in the Lunarwing Shallows.
english.description: These poor faerie dragons are being tortured!$B$BWhat's worse, when the thistleleaf become bored they ensnare their victims to continue their torment later.$b$bThis behavior is simply unacceptable.$B$BPlease free any trapped Lunarwings you can find.

text.title: 鬼母魔典
text.objectives: 夺取邪魔之秘魔典。
text.description:
看到那个巨大的洞穴了吗？里面有一个无比强大的鬼母。

虽然她不好对付，但是我们需要她手里的东西。

显然，她是邪魔之秘的守护者。她在洞穴里通过邪恶的军团仪式把秘密记入魔典。

我们需要那种力量！我们需要她的魔典！
text.giverWindow: 夺取邪魔之秘魔典，让你和你的伊利达雷变得更加强大。

english.title: The Imp Mother's Tome
english.objectives: Obtain the Tome of Fel Secrets.
english.description:
See this giant cave? There's a terrifyingly powerful imp mother inside.

But that's not the good part. The good part is what she has.

Apparently, she's some kind of keeper of fel secrets. She's in there performing profane Legion rites and scribing them into a book.

We need that power! We need her tome!
english.giverWindow: Steal her Tome of Fel Secrets so that you and your Illidari can become more powerful.

text.title: 深渊中的战锤
text.objectives: 使用塞拉赞恩的传送门前往碎岩之渊。与风暴召唤者米尔拉和萨尔一起取回毁灭之锤。
text.description: <萨尔竖耳倾听。>$b$b你找到了！毁灭之锤掉进了碎岩之渊……不过我们被燃烧军团抢先了一步。如果我们快点行动，就可以赶在这里遭到进一步腐化之前追上格斯逊并取回神锤。$b$b塞拉赞恩会打开一道通往那里的传送门。我们走吧！

english.title: The Hammer in the Deep
english.objectives: Use Therazane's Portal to travel to the Crumbling Depths. Accompany Stormcaller Mylra and Thrall to recover the Doomhammer.
english.description: <Thrall listens intently.>$b$bYou found it! The Doomhammer fell to the Crumbling Depths... But the Legion remains a step ahead of us. If we hurry, we can follow the demon Geth'xun and retrieve the hammer before any more of this realm is corrupted.$b$bTherazane will open a portal directly there. Let's go!

text.title: 重铸大地之环
text.objectives: 与努波顿交谈，并接任大地之环的领袖。
text.description: 去跟努波顿谈谈，并接管大地之环，$n。我们将在你的带领之下重振旗鼓！$b$b艾泽拉斯之心位于这些石山之内，它可以成为我们的行动基地。或许你的神器的力量能够揭露隐藏的空间……

english.title: A Ring Reforged
english.objectives: Speak with Nobundo and take your place as the head of the Earthen Ring.
english.description: Speak with Nobundo, and take your place around the circle, $n. The Earthen Ring will rise again, with you as its leader!$b$bWithin these stones stands the legendary Heart of Azeroth, which we can use as a base of operations. Perhaps the power of your artifact can unseal the hidden chambers...

text.title: 恶意
text.objectives: 在泰安诺与泰德里斯·羽歌谈一谈。
text.description: 苏拉玛失陷了。$b$b领袖们和燃烧军团达成了一项黑暗的交易，和他们结为了盟友。这里的人本该成为英雄，守护者。我们跟他们不一样，我也没办法接受他们。$b$b但是与暗夜井隔绝以后，我们逐渐衰弱并退化成一种失去理智的存在，一种备受束缚并且毫无尊严的存在，你甚至在这里也能看到……$b$b我拒绝接受这两种情况，然后我就来到了这里。我要找到第三条出路。
text.end: 与泰德里斯·羽歌谈一谈。

english.title: Bad Intentions
english.objectives: Speak with Thaedris Feathersong in Tel'anor.
english.description: Suramar is lost.$b$bOur leaders struck a dark bargain, accepting the Legion as our allies. We were meant to be heroes, guardians - the people resting here. We are not like them any more. I cannot live with them.$b$bBut cut off from the Nightwell, we wither and devolve into a mindless existence. An existence without release or dignity, as you can see even here...$b$bI rejected both of these options and found myself here. I will find a third way.

text.title: 定位猎杀
text.objectives: 发射厄文位置的信号，然后猎杀这只大鸟。
text.description:
你证明了那个侏儒会使枪，这可不简单。不过得看艾迪能否追踪到一只神出鬼没的野兽，这才是对她技艺的真正考验。

传言说有一只受到鹰身人诅咒的贪婪大鸟在盆地上空盘旋，但是没有人能够在近距离观察这只野兽。

拿上这个信号弹，一旦你找到这只大鸟就往天空发射信号。狩猎队看到信号之后会立即赶到，把那巨大的野兽给打下来！
text.completion: That was a kill I won't soon forget!$b$bAddie will write the tale of our adventures here today, but not many will believe that a gnome hunter took down a beast ten times her size.

english.title: Scout It Out
english.objectives: Kill Irewing after sending up a flare, signaling his location.
english.description:
You've proven that a gnome can shoot a rifle, and that's no easy feat, but a true test of Addie's skill will be to see if she can track down an elusive beast.

Rumor has it that a ravenous roc circles the basin, cursed by harpy magic, but no one's seen the beast up close.

Take this flare, and shoot it into the sky once you've spotted the roc. When we see the signal, the huntin' party will rush in and help bring down that magnificent bird!
english.completion: That was a kill I won't soon forget!$b$bAddie will write the tale of our adventures here today, but not many will believe that a gnome hunter took down a beast ten times her size.

text.title: 踏入黑暗
text.objectives: 在黯石岩洞与纳瓦罗格谈一谈。
text.description:
威胁着我们部族的危险已经平息，是时候把你引荐给我的同胞们了。

到黯石岩洞找我，那里是我们的居所。
text.completion: Welcome to our humble home. You are free to move about here from now on.

english.title: Step into the Dark
english.objectives: Speak with Navarrogg at Stonedark Grotto.
english.description:
With the threat to my people quelled, I believe it is time to introduce you to my kin.

Meet me at Stonedark Grotto, and you will see where we live.
english.completion: Welcome to our humble home. You are free to move about here from now on.

text.title: 猖狂龙虾人
text.objectives: 与奔波尔霸精神交流，并击败克劳德舒斯。
text.description:
苔穴龙虾人的首领克劳德舒斯不断派兵掠夺苔穴村，掳走幼年鱼人当点心。

不能再这么下去了。奔波尔霸和蝌蚪们必须去消灭他，以此证明他们的力量。

这是鱼人的工作。

在奔波尔霸的蛋里与他进行精神交流，告诉他该怎么做！
text.completion:
You did it! Murky will make a great leader for the next generation of the murlocs here.

I can't help but feel sad over losing my little buddy, but you've got to let them go sometime.
text.giverWindow: 海边最肆意妄为的龙虾人。

english.title: Oh, the Clawdacity!
english.objectives: Mindmeld with Murky and defeat Clawdayshus.
english.description:
The leader of the Cavemoss makrura, Clawdayshus, has been ordering raids into the Cavemoss village to steal the young for snacks.

This isn't going to do at all. In order to prove their power, Murky and the tadpoles must destroy him as well!

This is a job for murlocs.

Mindmeld with Murky in his egg and show him how it's done!
english.completion:
You did it! Murky will make a great leader for the next generation of the murlocs here.

I can't help but feel sad over losing my little buddy, but you've got to let them go sometime.
english.giverWindow: The most audacious makrura by the sea.

text.title: The Brood Queen's Court: Count Nefarious

english.title: The Brood Queen's Court: Count Nefarious

text.title: The Brood Queen's Court: King Voras

english.title: The Brood Queen's Court: King Voras

text.title: The Brood Queen's Court: Overseer Brutarg

english.title: The Brood Queen's Court: Overseer Brutarg

text.title: The Brood Queen's Court: General Volroth

english.title: The Brood Queen's Court: General Volroth

text.title: 废止仲裁员
text.objectives: 库克库克要你为他带$1oa块埃匹希斯水晶来。
text.description: 悬槌堡里的蠢货们拒绝接受事实。我要趁机好好捞上一笔。你越快给我搞到一大堆埃匹希斯水晶，我就能越快离开这个无聊的小岛。我要的水晶数量可是非常精确的！

english.title: Abrogator Arbitrator
english.objectives: Kluk'kluk wants you to bring him $1oa Apexis Crystals.
english.description: Da bums in Highmaul refuse to see dey are on da way out. Me, I'm gettin' while da gettin' is good. Da sooner youse bring me a bunch of Apexis Crystals, da sooner I can get off dis stupid island. Da amount required is very precise!

text.title: 曙光
text.objectives: 跟随蒋震魂并等候大师们宣布决定。
text.description: 你的生还是一个奇迹，$n。我怀着无比沉重的心情告诉你，海特宗师没有得到命运的眷顾，他的灵魂与祖先同在。$b$b现在，我们必须为我们的组织——残寺派，寻找一个新的领袖。我已经和其他大师们商讨过了，所有人都达成了共识。$b$b我们一致推举你为领袖，$n。你展现出了无比的力量、智慧、勇气和仁慈。$b$b请随我们前往寺院，我们将宣布这一决定。

english.title: The Dawning Light
english.objectives: Accompany Fearsome Jang and await the masters' announcement.
english.description: It was a miracle that you were able to survive, $n. It is with great sorrow that I have to say that Grand Master Hight was not so lucky. His spirit now rests with the ancestors.$b$bNow we must look to a new leader for our order, our broken temple. I have spoken with the other masters and we are all of one mind on this.$b$bWe all agree that new leader should be you, $n. You have shown strength, wisdom, courage, and kindness beyond measure.$b$bWalk with us to the temple and we will announce our decision.

text.title: 努力罢工
text.objectives: 将$1oa块埃匹希斯水晶交给变节的钢铁工人。
text.description: 我们已经受够了。铸造厂的工作环境简直无法忍受，到处都是烈火、独眼魔、火元素、地狱火和强盗一样的冒险者！但最可恨的还是高温。$b$b我已经受够了！我和我的小伙子们准备罢工，可我们需要雇佣一些保镖，可我在悬槌堡里找到的唯一一个愿意接受这份工作的家伙只收埃匹希斯水晶作为报酬。

english.title: Work Work Stoppage
english.objectives: Bring $1oa Apexis Crystals to the Renegade Ironworker.
english.description: We've had enough! The working conditions in the Foundry are intolerable with all the fire and the ogron and the flames and the fire elementals and infernos and marauding adventurers! But especially the heat.$b$bI've had enough! Me and the boys are going to start a work stoppage but we need to hire some security muscle and the only goon from Highmaul I could get to agree to the job only takes payment in Apexis Crystals.

text.title: 恐怖的转化
text.objectives: 摧毁破碎之野的3个灵魂之匣。
text.description: 我们坠毁的时候，他们早有准备。建立这个小哨站是我们当时唯一能做的事情。$b$b现在他们还在吸取我们阵亡将士的灵魂来为他们的攻击提供能量。$b$b摧毁他们的灵魂之匣，让我们的战友回归圣光吧。$b$b等你完成任务后，就去战场上找伊米拉吧。大家都很想念她，她绝不会倒在这里。这一点我可以肯定。

english.title: A Grim Equation
english.objectives: Destroy the three Soul Coffers on the Shattered Fields.
english.description: They were waiting for us when we crashed. It was all we could do to establish our small outpost.$b$bEven now they drain the souls of our fallen to fuel their attacks.$b$bDestroy their soul coffers. Free our comrades and let them join the Light.$b$bWhen you have finished, find Y'mera in the field. She has been sorely missed, but she will not have fallen. Of this I am certain.

text.title: 趣味玩具
text.objectives: 到魔法动物店去找萨拉聊聊，然后回去找娜穆。
text.description: 你喜欢宠物吗，$n？我非常喜欢。它们实在是太可爱了！$b$b我需要一些能让我陪着宠物们玩耍的物件。$b$b魔法动物店的萨拉肯定了解趣味玩具。你去找她聊聊吧！

english.title: Battle Bonds
english.objectives: Talk to Serr'ah at the Magical Menagerie shop. Then return to Namha.
english.description: Do you like pets, $n? I love pets. They're so cute!$b$bBut what I really want is more things with which to play with them.$b$bI'm sure Serr'ah over at the Magical Menagerie has some ideas for fun toys. You should go talk to her!

text.title: 奇装异服
text.objectives: 与塔玛拉交谈并飞往沉船海湾。
text.description:
嘿，我们在海岸狩猎的时候碰到一个穿着戏服的怪人。他说想混进鱼人里面……我很确定他的脑子有问题。

我们回营的时候留了一个人在那看着他……想去见识一下吗？

你可以请那边的塔玛拉送你一程。
text.completion: Hello, adventurer! Here to help me and Murky out?

english.title: That Guy in the Costume
english.objectives: Speak to Tamara and fly to Shipwreck Cove.
english.description:
Aye, when we were out huntin' on the coast, we ran into this ridiculous lad in in a costume. He says he's tryin ta blend in with the murlocs... but I'm pretty sure he's just not right in the head.

One of ours stayed behind to keep an eye on him when we headed back to camp... mind checkin' it out?

Ye can ask Tamara over there for a ride.
english.completion: Hello, adventurer! Here to help me and Murky out?

text.title: 请求帮助
text.objectives: 找卡德加索要一个军团联络器的能量源。
text.description: 凯丽娅·邪魂在投靠燃烧军团之前，曾是我们当中的佼佼者。$B$B奥达奇战刃在她手上，那副足以撕裂灵魂的武器原本属于一位伟大的勇士，他来自一支古老的种族，最后被萨格拉斯亲手消灭。$B$B我们派了一支队伍追踪凯丽娅，可是已经很久没有他们的消息。杰斯还差一点就可以修好一部军团联络器，我们可以用它来联系搜查队伍，不过还需要一个能量源。$B$B你可以请卡德加帮个忙吗？我们在这个世界没有什么朋友。

english.title: Asking a Favor
english.objectives: Ask Khadgar for a source to power the Legion communicator.
english.description: Caria Felsoul was one of our best... before she answered the Legion's foul call.$B$BShe now wields the Aldrachi Warblades - the soul-rending armaments of the ancient race's greatest champion, who fell only to Sargeras himself.$B$BWe sent a party to track Caria down, but we have not heard from them in some time. Jace has nearly repaired a Legion communicator so we can make contact - we need only a power source.$B$BCould you ask Khadgar for assistance? Our friends in this world are few.

text.title: 大仇必报
text.objectives: 从凯丽娅·邪魂的手中夺走奥达奇战刃。
text.description: 我们的部队只要稍微靠近破碎海滩就会被击落。$B$B我认为最好是由你来解决这个问题——我们之中没有人比你更擅长战斗。$B$B可以的话，你要尽量救出阿莱利和她的手下。不过跟这些无关紧要的将士比起来，奥达奇战刃在这场战争中的用处要大得多。

english.title: Vengeance Will Be Ours
english.objectives: Take the Aldrachi Warblades from Caria Felsoul.
english.description: We aren't going to get our forces anywhere near the Broken Shore without getting knocked out of the sky.$B$BI think it best if you handle this matter yourself - there are none among us more capable on the field of battle.$B$BSave Allari and her men if you can, but the Aldrachi Warblades will do far more for this war than warm bodies.

text.title: 阻止古尔丹！
text.objectives: 进入背叛者地窟，消灭库拉什和斯勒基，并夺取他们的邪能。
text.description:
伊利丹在黑暗神殿溃败之后，我们把他的遗体带到了这里，想将他永远埋葬在守望者地窟之中。

古尔丹突破了我们的防线，企图夺走背叛者的遗体。

就算失去了生命，伊利丹的躯体还能被燃烧军团所利用。绝不能让古尔丹得逞。
text.giverWindow: 尽全力阻止他。

english.title: Stop Gul'dan!
english.objectives: Enter the Vault of the Betrayer, kill Crusher and Sledge, and take their fel power.
english.description:
After his defeat at the Black Temple, we brought Illidan's lifeless body here, to be interred forever within the Vault of the Wardens.

Gul'dan has found his way through our defenses and is trying to steal the Betrayer's corpse.

Even in death, Illidan's body can be used by the Burning Legion. Gul'dan CANNOT succeed.
english.giverWindow: Stop him if you can.

objectiveDetails.description: 消灭库拉什和斯勒基并获取力量

text.title: 战火锤炼
text.objectives: 消灭伊莫拉斯，夺取他的力量。
text.description:
可怕的恶魔伊莫拉斯带领着一支燃烧军团的部队，征服并统治了一个遥远的枢纽世界。

守望者们费尽艰辛才把他制服，并关在了左边的密室里。虽然他被控制住了，但这种情况持续不了太久。

如果有恶魔猎手能够打败他，那么他的恶魔力量就会成为一份宝贵的战利品，让胜利者获得难以想象的力量。

我相信你可以做到，$n。
text.giverWindow: 伊莫拉斯凝聚着纯粹的邪能。

english.title: Forged in Fire
english.objectives: Kill Immolanth and take his power.
english.description:
The fearsome demon, Immolanth, led a Legion army that conquered and eventually ruled a distant nexus world. 

Somehow, the Wardens imprisoned him, then kept him locked up in the chamber to our left. He is contained, but not for long.

The demon's power is a valuable prize to any demon hunter who can defeat him. Whoever can do so will gain power beyond imagining.

I believe that person could be you, $n.
english.giverWindow: Immolanth is full of pure, coalesced fel power.

objectiveDetails.description: 消灭伊莫拉斯并获取力量

text.title: 自由的绊脚石
text.objectives: 消灭巴斯提拉克斯，夺走他的力量。
text.description:
剩下的兄弟们已经杀到最后一个房间，他们就在前面。

通往地窟出口的障碍就只剩下这次恶魔入侵的领导者，巴斯提拉克斯。

消灭他并夺取他的力量，为我们争取自由。
text.giverWindow: 他守卫着地窟出口。

english.title: Between Us and Freedom
english.objectives: Kill Bastillax and take his power.
english.description:
The last of our survivors have fought their way into the final chamber ahead.

Only one obstacle stands between us and the vault's exit - the leader of this demon invasion, Bastillax.

Kill him, take his power, and claim our freedom.
english.giverWindow: He guards the vault exit.

text.title: 魔法的触碰
text.objectives: 为提格德居所里的休眠物品撒下阿卡纳精华。
text.description: 我曾一度以自己的居所和附魔成就为傲，而现在它们皆已化为泡影。$b$b我能感受到你是一位强大的附魔师，$n。如果你在我原来的附魔物品上撒下一点魔法粉尘，应该能够激活它们的生命力。

english.title: A Touch of Magic
english.objectives: Sprinkle Arkhana on dormant objects in Tigrid's house.
english.description: I always took great pride in my home... and my enchantments. Now it seems both have fallen into ruin.$b$bI can sense the power of a potent enchanter in you, $n. If you would but sprinkle a bit of magic dust on my once-enchanted belongings, I'm sure you can bring them to life again.

objectiveDetails.description: 收集提格德的阿卡纳精华

text.title: 迷失的顾问
text.objectives: 收集8根悬崖棘。
text.description: 你在这里的时候，可以帮我做点事。我需要制作一种药水，它可以让一切都恢复正常。$b$b为了完成我的任务，我必须保存能量，以免让自己也变成在地上苦苦挣扎的可怜虫。我会付给你酬劳，因为我快用不到了。$b$b附近的鹰身人无法抗拒悬崖棘的诱惑，这也是她们被吸引到泰安诺的原因。$b$b你在这栋房子外面应该就能找到不少。

english.title: The Lost Advisor
english.objectives: Collect 8 Cliffthorn.
english.description: You may as well assist me while you are here. I require a potion to be made, one that will set things right.$b$bI must conserve my energy until my task is finished, lest I become like these miserable wretches scrabbling at the cobblestones. There is coin in it for you, since I will not be needing it soon.$b$bThe harpies around here cannot resist cliffthorn. It is what drew them to Tel'anor in the first place. $b$bYou should find plenty just outside this building.

text.title: 意外讯息
text.objectives: 使用发光的共鸣水晶，了解大法师茉德拉的信息。
text.description:
啊，烈焰之击。我很熟悉这把武器。

多少年来，提瑞斯法议会一直试图找回这把宝剑。它可以控制原始的火焰之力，如果落到坏人手里，后果将不堪设想。

所幸我的一位同胞，大法师茉德拉最近发现了这件神器的线索。她传来的信息就在这块水晶里。

不如你就从这开始着手调查。那边的传送门可以送你回城。

english.title: An Unexpected Message
english.objectives: Discover Archmage Modera's message by using the Glowing Resonate Crystal.
english.description:
Ah, Felo'melorn. I am familiar with this weapon. 

For ages the Council of Tirisfal attempted to recover the blade. Its control over the primal forces of fire would be devastating in the wrong hands. 

As luck would have it, an associate of mine, Archmage Modera has recently uncovered some information on this artifact. This crystal contains a message from her.

I suggest you start your search there. The portal over there will bring you back to the city.

objectiveDetails.description: 在希尔斯布莱德与大法师茉德拉见面
在希尔斯布莱德与大法师茉德拉见面

text.title: 救赎之路
text.objectives: 在希尔斯布莱德丘陵的达拉然巨坑与大法师茉德拉的助手谈一谈。
text.description: 烈焰之击，奎尔萨拉斯国王的符文宝剑。据说它有驾驭烈焰精华的力量。经过凯尔萨斯重铸之后，这把剑甚至能够与传说中的霜之哀伤匹敌。$b$b我们一度以为这把剑随着凯尔萨斯的死亡而销声匿迹，但是我有位熟人发现了它下落的线索。$b$b我们必须获得尽可能多的优势，如果你能拿到烈焰之击，燃烧军团必将闻风丧胆！$b$b啊，我们等的人来了。

english.title: The Path of Atonement
english.objectives: Speak to Archmage Modera's associate at the Dalaran Crater within Hillsbrad Foothills
english.description: Felo'melorn, the runeblade of the kings of Quel'Thalas. It was said to harness the very essence of flame and after being reforged by Kael'thas could even stand against the legendary Frostmourne.$b$bWe thought that the blade was lost with Kael'thas's death but an associate of mine has a lead on where it may be located.$b$bWe need every advantage we can get and with Felo'melorn in your hand the Legion surely will tremble!$b$bAh, our company is here.

text.title: Two Axes to Grind DISABLED
text.objectives: Retrieve Brandolf's axes, Hack and Slash, from Tar'jira in Azuregale Bay.
text.description: I managed to slay a mob of these serpents during the ambush, but one bashed my skull from behind.$B$BKnocked me cold as a stone.$B$BWhen I woke, my beloved axes were gone, taken by one of the serpents.$B$BIt churns my guts to think of one of those serpents using my own weapons against my kin.$B$BReturn them to me, and you will have earned my gratitude.

text.title: 大漩涡的召唤
text.objectives: 找到古代元素祭坛并为你的神器灌注新的力量。
text.description: 你能感受到吗，萨满？在这艾泽拉斯之心，大地、疾风和海浪交融碰撞——好似有人可以直接与世界进行对话。$b$b你手里的神器无比强大，而且拥有无限的潜能。把它拿到下面去，找到俯视大漩涡之怒的古代元素祭坛。你可以在那里与艾泽拉斯进行交流，并为你的神器灌入更强大的力量。完成以后，回来告诉我你的收获！

english.title: The Maelstrom Beckons
english.objectives: Locate the Ancient Elemental Altar and imbue your artifact with a new power.
english.description: Can you feel it, shaman? Here, in the heart of Azeroth, where earth and wind and waves clash together - it is as if one can speak directly with the world.$b$bThe artifact you wield houses great power but even greater potential. Carry it below and seek out the ancient elemental altar overlooking the fury of the maelstrom. From there, you can commune with Azeroth and imbue your artifact with even greater abilities. Do so, and then share with me what you have learned!

objectiveDetails.description: 为你的神器灌注新的力量

text.title: 莉安娜·悲夜
text.objectives: 摧毁灵魂收割器。
text.description:
<一个恶魔猎手俘虏静静地浮在你的面前，她的灵魂被缓缓地吸入收割器水晶之中。>

<想要让她脱离静滞状态，你就必须摧毁灵魂收割器。>

english.title: Lyana Darksorrow
english.objectives: Destroy the Soul Harvester.
english.description:
<A captive demon hunter floats in stasis in front of you; her soul slowly draining into the harvester crystal.>

<In order to release her from stasis, you will need to destroy the soul harvester.>

text.title: 履行使命的工具
text.objectives: 为泰德里斯取回冥器。
text.description: 我在屏障设立之前经常来这里。执政议会和大魔导师在这里进行政治斗争时，我看过守护者举行仪式祭奠逝者。$b$b我想在这里最后一次祭奠先灵。我要到墓地去，如果你能找到留存下来的圣油、葬礼裹布或者熏香，就拿来给我。

english.title: Tools of the Trade
english.objectives: Retrieve burial objects for Thaedris.
english.description: I used to visit here before the barrier was raised. While the ruling council and the Grand Magistrix argued and politicked I watched the caretakers  perform their rituals and venerate the dead.$b$bI would honor the spirits here one last time. I am headed to the tombs. If some of the sacred oils, burial shrouds, or incense survived the ages then bring them to me.

text.title: 重要书籍
text.objectives: 找到《植物百科大全》。
text.description: 接下来，我需要一本书。但是，看着这里逐渐荒废，我还是没办法坐视不理。$b$b你去找书的时候，我会把纪念品稍作清理。那本书叫做《植物百科大全》，你在大广场附近的图书馆里就能找到它。

english.title: The Last Chapter
english.objectives: Find the Encyclopedia Botanica.
english.description: The next step of my journey requires a tome, but I find that I am still unable to idly sit by as this place continues to fall into disrepair.$b$bI will tidy up the memorials while you go fetch me the tome. It is called the Encyclopedia Botanica and you can find it in the library near the main plaza.

text.title: 战刃之难
text.objectives: 找到莉安娜·悲夜的战刃。
text.description: 我奉命前来消灭恶魔艾瑞达，阿佐兰。在骑乘魔蝠潜入时，我被击落了，接着就遭到了俘虏。$b$b我就不跟你拐弯抹角了，$n。阿佐兰打算用燃烧军团的指挥舰摧毁达拉然。$b$b我被击落时，战刃也遗失了，想要阻止阿佐兰的话，我必须找到它们。虽然我想自己去寻找，但是我被禁锢了太久，现在仍然十分虚弱。$b$b我是在大坑的北面被击落的，到那里去找回我的武器。
text.end: 找到莉安娜·悲夜的战刃。

english.title: Glaive Circumstances
english.objectives: Retrieve Lyana Darksorrow's glaives.
english.description: I came here on a mission to slay the demon eredar, Azoran. During my infiltration, I was shot down from my felbat and captured.$b$bI'm not going to mince words, $n. Azoran plans to use the Burning Legion command ship to destroy Dalaran.$b$bTo stop him, I will need my warglaives that were lost during my fall from the sky. I would retrieve them myself, but I'm still weakened from my imprisonment.$b$bSearch for the warglaives on the northern side of the crater, where I was shot down.

text.title: 记忆的碎片
text.objectives: 找回15件泰安诺纪念品。
text.description: <这个漂亮的精灵骨灰坛已经摔碎了。它显然受到了粗暴的对待，不过上面没有鹰身人的抓痕。>$b$b<你发现散落的碎片一直延伸到一个洞穴里。罪魁祸首肯定就在里面。如果能取回圣物，泰德里斯一定会感兴趣的。>

english.title: Fragments of Memory
english.objectives: Retrieve 15 Tel'anor Mementos.
english.description: <The beautiful elven burial urn is shattered carelessly on the ground. It was clearly handled roughly, but not scratched by the talons of the harpies.>$b$b<You find a trail of shards leading towards a cave. Those responsible are certainly within. Thaedris would be interested in the relics and their safe return.>

text.title: 海难俘虏
text.objectives: 在宠物战斗中击败海难俘虏。
text.description: 我生前就是任人摆布的宠物。现在是我翻身成为驯服者的时候了！死亡的最大好处就是我可以一直当驯宠师！

english.title: Shipwrecked Captive
english.objectives: Defeat Shipwrecked Captive in a pet battle.
english.description: I spent my life playing the pet in other peoples battles. Now it's my time to be the pet tamer! Best part of being dead is I can do this forever!

text.title: 缘尽
text.objectives: 在泰安诺上层与泰德里斯对话。
text.description: 苏拉玛再也不是我的家园，而且我也拒绝变成一个被人唾弃的枯法者。我无路可走，你明白吗？$b$b我们只需要最后一样材料来完成药水。你会帮我的，是吗？
text.end: 与泰德里斯·羽歌谈一谈。

english.title: End of the Line
english.objectives: Speak with Thaedris at the upper landing of Tel'anor.
english.description: I cannot call Suramar my home any more, and I refuse to become a withered abomination. There is no place for me anymore, don't you understand?$b$bWe only need one last ingredient to complete the elixir. You will help me, won't you?

objectiveDetails.description: 净化响风峭壁的鹰身人诅咒

text.title: Jarl Come Back Now DISABLED
text.objectives: Find Jarl Throndyr in Azuregale Bay.
text.description: <Brandolf looks up at you, bloody and beaten.>$B$BSo you are the one I heard Toryl bellowing about.$B$BMy kin and I were tracking Jarl Throndyr when we were ambushed by a group of these vile serpents. They left me for dead, and when I came to, my kin were gone.$B$BFinding Throndyr is vital. Press forward and search for him.$B$BI will catch up after I finish tending to my wounds.

english.title: Jarl Come Back Now DISABLED
english.objectives: Find Jarl Throndyr in Azuregale Bay.
english.description: <Brandolf looks up at you, bloody and beaten.>$B$BSo you are the one I heard Toryl bellowing about.$B$BMy kin and I were tracking Jarl Throndyr when we were ambushed by a group of these vile serpents. They left me for dead, and when I came to, my kin were gone.$B$BFinding Throndyr is vital. Press forward and search for him.$B$BI will catch up after I finish tending to my wounds.

text.title: 最后的原料
text.objectives: 寻找拉塔娜的长弓。
text.description: 药水完成了，$n。我们的旅程很快就会结束。我还需要你做最后一件事，然后我就给你报酬。$b$b我妻子的长弓还留在这里，可是我怎么找都找不到。它蕴含着强大的魔法。$b$b我担心它被某个躁动的幽灵拿走了。但是，想要拿起这样的一把弓，需要强大的力量。小心点。

english.title: The Final Ingredient
english.objectives: Find Latara's bow.
english.description: The potion is complete, $n. Soon our journey will be over. There is one last thing I would have you do for me, then you shall have your reward.$b$bMy wife's bow was kept here, but I have not been able to find it after searching everywhere. There is potent magic in it.$b$bI fear one of the restless spirits may have taken it, but it would take a powerful force to pick up an item such as this. Be careful.

text.title: 血脉相依
text.objectives: 在深浊洞穴寻找卡特琳、弗里克和斯托卡弗。
text.description: 托尔里整天吼叫的那个名字就是你？或许你可以帮我。$B$B我开始寻找索迪尔的时候，有三位忠诚于索迪尔的维库人跟着我一起行动。但是你可以清楚地看到，现在只剩我一个人了。$B$B去寻找我的族人，$n。$B$B我无法想象他们是不是遭遇了和索迪尔一样的厄运。

english.title: Band of Blood Brothers
english.objectives: Locate Katarine, Fjolrik, and Stokalfr in Muddledeep Cavern.
english.description: You are the one that Toryl was bellowing about? Perhaps you can help me.$B$BWhen I set out to search for Throndyr, I was not alone. Three vrykul loyal to Throndyr also accompanied me. As you can plainly see, I now stand alone.$B$BFind my kin, $n.$B$BI cannot bear to think that they also share Throndyr's fate.

text.title: 羽歌的救赎
text.objectives: 消灭崖爪主母。
text.description: 我得向你坦诚，我有事瞒着你，$n。我本来打算喝下药水，追随我的妻子而去。$b$b就算她从安息中被唤醒……我也不能再让她失望。我要活下去，竭尽所能阻止即将到来的灾难，这样我才有资格去陪伴她。$b$b来吧，年轻人。我们去解决那个鹰身人主母，让泰安诺恢复往日的荣光。我们别浪费这瓶毒药，怎么样？

english.title: Feathersong's Redemption
english.objectives: Slay the Cliffclutch Matriarch.
english.description: I must confess I was not entirely honest with you, $n. I meant to drink the potion and join my wife.$b$bAnd even she was taken from her rest... I cannot fail her again. I must live and do what I can to stop this coming storm to be worthy of joining her.$b$bCome, young one. Let us take care of the harpy matriarch and restore Tel'anor to its former glory. We cannot let this poison go to waste, eh?

text.title: Cave of the Blood Trial Treasure

english.title: Cave of the Blood Trial Treasure

text.title: 奥术传动
text.objectives: 给泰林喂食300份远古魔力。
text.description:
凯尔丹纳斯进行了各种实验，希望能够与枯法者进行沟通，但全部都宣告失败，一部分实验甚至让那些枯法者变得更加危险。

直到他发现泰林，情况才有了转机。

他的奥术精华——也就是这个夏多雷的灵魂本身，已经接触到了某种特殊的东西。但这又怎么样呢？

如果将我的奥术精华与泰林的结合到一起，我就能建立起一道心灵的联系。这道联系会将他的灵魂——或者说残余的灵魂，完全地展现在我们面前。

我们唯一要做的就是为他提供魔力，大量的魔力。这样我们才能正式开始。

english.title: Arcane Communion
english.objectives: Feed Theryn 300 Ancient Mana.
english.description:
All of Kel'danath's experiments to connect with the withered failed, and some even made them more dangerous.

Until he found Theryn.

His arcane essence - the very soul of the shal'dorei - had been touched by something special. But what? 

By weaving my arcane essence together with Theryn's, I can create an empathic bond. This communion will bare his soul to us all - or what's left of it. 

We need only to feed him mana, and lots of it, in order to begin.

text.title: 记忆场景
text.objectives: 帮助塔莉萨建立起与泰林的联系。
text.description:
泰林支配着他自己的意志。不管我们发现了什么东西，都可能难以把控。

我需要你的帮助才能理清这些幻象，所以你也得准备好应对各种突发情况。

如果走运的话，我们就能找到泰林变得如此特殊的原因。以及……他的身体中是否还留有他曾经的灵魂。

english.title: Scenes from a Memory
english.objectives: Help Thalyssra complete the arcane communion with Theryn.
english.description:
Theryn is at the mercy of his own mind. Whatever we find in there, it may be difficult to control.

I will need your help to sort through the visions, so be ready for anything.

With any luck, we will discover what makes Theryn special. And... whether there is anything left of who he used to be.

text.title: 散落的记忆
text.objectives: 阅读$1oa张凯尔丹纳斯的笔记。
text.description:
<随着你的指尖掠过纸张上的优雅符号，你的脑海里响起了与之相应的声音。

看来夜之子把简单的书写也升华成了魔法的艺术。

奥术师凯尔丹纳斯绝对在这里工作过。附近一定还有他散落的笔记。>

english.title: Scattered Memories
english.objectives: Inspect $1oa pages of Kel'danath's Notes.
english.description:
<As your fingers trace the elegant symbols on the page, a voice dictates the words in your mind.

It seems the nightborne have elevated even simple note-taking to a sorcerous art.

Arcanist Kel'danath was definitely working in this area. There must be more of his notes scattered around.>

objectiveDetails.description: 阅读凯尔丹纳斯的笔记

text.title: 对护甲的考验
text.objectives: 护送塔尔达尼斯到达安全的地方。
text.description: 太好了。如果我们要离开这里，就得和纳迦以及海巨人周旋。$b$b对于有你这种能耐的人来说，纳迦构不成什么威胁，不过海巨人的实力简直超乎想象。$b$b你只用把我安全地带出这个洞穴就可以了，我自己会找到回去的路。$b$b希望塞莉娅做的这件护甲能够给我足够的保护，让我熬过难关。

english.title: Testing the Metal
english.objectives: Escort Taldranis to safety.
english.description: Alright, if we're going to get out of here, we're going to have to maneuver around the naga and the sea giants.$b$bThe naga probably won't pose much trouble for someone of your skill, but those sea giants are strong beyond belief.$b$bJust get me out of this cave safely and I can find my own way home.$b$bHopefully this armor Celea made for me will protect me long enough to see this through.

objectiveDetails.description: 把塔尔达尼斯护送到安全的地方

text.title: 比死亡更惨的命运
text.objectives: 打开$1oa个灵魂引擎牢笼。
text.description: 燃烧军团并不是出于仁慈才留下俘虏的活口。$b$b死亡只是摧毁肉体……但是如果你被燃烧军团抓住了，他们将摧毁你的灵魂。$b$b燃烧军团用灵魂作为祭品为他们的战争机器充能。灵魂引擎的用处就是获取和储存被收割的灵魂。$b$b虽然无数的灵魂已经在引擎中消逝，但是你或许可以救出尚未消逝的灵魂。$b$b快去把他们放出来，以免为时已晚！

english.title: A Fate Worse Than Dying
english.objectives: Open $1oa Soul Engine Cages.
english.description: When the Burning Legion takes a prisoner, it is not an act of mercy.$b$bWhile death is the destruction of the mortal body... if you are captured by the Legion, they will seek to destroy your soul.$b$bThe Burning Legion uses sacrificial souls to power their demonic machinations of war. The soul engine is where the harvested souls are collected and stored.$b$bThough countless have already perished in the soul engine, you may yet save those still alive inside.$b$bHurry and release them before it is too late!

text.title: 战斗宠物训练师：德拉诺之王
text.objectives: 在德拉诺击败5位战斗宠物训练师。
text.description: 你之前已经证明过自己的实力了，但德拉诺的荒野又是另一回事了。快去击败野外的驯宠师以证明你在宠物对战界的霸主地位吧：戈尔隆德的凯米尔·辉刃、阿兰卡峰林的维沙尔、纳格兰的可怕的塔尔、塔拉多的塔拉鲁恩，还有霜火岭的加戈拉或影月谷的阿什雷。你还可以在你的要塞中击败一位来访的驯宠师：收藏家爱瑞斯或库拉·雷蹄。$B$B击败他们后，你就可以在德拉诺横着走了。

english.title: Battle Pet Tamers: Warlords
english.objectives: Defeat 5 pet battle trainers in Draenor.
english.description: You have proven yourself before but the wilds of Draenor are on another level. Defeat tamers in the wilds to prove your pet battle supremacy: Cymre Brightblade in Gorgrond, Vesharr in Spires of Arak, Tarr the Terrible in Nagrand, Taralune in Talador, Gargra in Frostfire Ridge, or Ashlei in Shadowmoon Valley. You can also defeat a visiting tamer: Erris the Collector or Kura Thunderhoof in your garrison.$B$BBy defeating them will show your dominance in Draenor.

text.title: 萨吉塔的牙齿
text.objectives: 从蓝风海湾的萨吉塔纳迦身上收集8个萨吉塔獠牙。
text.description: 如果索迪尔和纳迦作战时我在他身边，那他或许就不会死。$B$B这些毒蛇将来一定会后悔从水窟里爬出来。$B$B光杀了他们还不够，远远不够！我要用纳迦的獠牙做成项链，祭奠索迪尔！

english.title: Bite of the Sashj'tar
english.objectives: Collect 8 Sashj'tar Fangs from Sashj'tar naga in Azuregale Bay.
english.description: If I had been by Throndyr's side when he fought the naga, he might still be alive.$B$BThese serpents will regret the day that they decided to slither from their watery hole!$B$BKilling them is not enough. No! I will honor Throndyr with a necklace of naga fangs!

text.title: 沙滩上的火葬
text.objectives: 在蓝风海湾收集6块浮木，然后为索迪尔族长搭建一个火葬柴堆。
text.description: 不要让……我的身体躺在……泥里。$B$B把我的肉身……火化。

english.title: Beach Bonfire
english.objectives: Collect 6 Driftwood in Azuregale Bay and build a funeral pyre for Jarl Throndyr.
english.description: Do not let... my body lie in... the mud.$B$BSet my flesh... aflame.

objectiveDetails.description: 为索迪尔族长搭建火葬柴堆

text.title: 渔夫的药水
text.objectives: 在蓝风海窟从斧尾蜥蜴身上收集4颗斧尾眼球，从萨吉塔纳迦身上收集一个萨吉塔气囊，从海妖纳兹祖尔身上收集海妖之血样本。
text.description: 如果你跟我们一样憎恨这些毒蛇，那么我请求你继续跟他们斗争下去。$B$B这意味着前往他们的水域，向他们开战。我看你身上没有腮，所以我们需要制作维库渔夫所使用的一种古老的药水。$B$B这附近就有丰富的原料，你应该不介意在内脏里面找东西吧。

english.title: Fisherman's Tonic
english.objectives: Collect 4 Axetail Eyes from Axetail Basilisks, a Sashj'tar Air Bladder from Sashj'tar Naga, and a Sample of Siren Blood from Siren Naz'jul in Azuregale Cove.
english.description: If you detest these serpents as much as we do, I ask that you continue the fight against them.$B$BThat will mean fighting them in their watery domain. I don't see any gills on you, so we're going to have to concoct an old tonic used by vrykul fishermen.$B$BThe ingredients are plentiful around here, taken that you do not mind picking through entrails.

text.title: Sashj'tar Accord DISABLED
text.objectives: Show the stone tablet to Toryl.
text.description: <This stone tablet appears to be a contract between Tidemistress Sashj'tar and King Forgalash.$B$BAs far as you can decipher, the naga are recruiting the sea giants on behalf of Queen Azshara.>

english.title: Sashj'tar Accord DISABLED
english.objectives: Show the stone tablet to Toryl.
english.description: <This stone tablet appears to be a contract between Tidemistress Sashj'tar and King Forgalash.$B$BAs far as you can decipher, the naga are recruiting the sea giants on behalf of Queen Azshara.>

text.title: 改变潮汐
text.objectives: 建造一辆临时弩车然后在萨吉塔废墟消灭潮汐主母萨吉塔。
text.description: 潮汐主母逃回了精灵废墟，她正在舔舐自己的伤口。$B$B毫无疑问，她的守卫一定会严加防守。要打倒她的话，你必须先突破他们的防御。$B$B用你回收的零件建造一个投石车，然后彻底消灭潮汐主母。

english.title: Turning the Tidemistress
english.objectives: Construct a Makeshift Ballista and kill Tidemistress Sashj'tar in the Sashj'tar Ruins.
english.description: The Tidemistress has fallen back to the elven ruins and is licking her wounds.$B$BHer guard is undoubtedly protecting her. To best her, you will have to break her defenses.$B$BConstruct a ballista using the parts that you salvaged and end her once and for all.

text.title: 蜡烛号令
text.objectives: 坐上指挥之座向靠近的狗头人发号施令。
text.description: 还不能让你进去！想进去的话，就到指挥之座上对其他狗头人下命令，然后我们再谈。
text.completion: What you doing back so soon?

english.title: Candle of Command
english.objectives: Sit upon the Throne of Ordering Around and give orders to kobolds that approach.
english.description: You no come in yet! Give orders to other kobold on Throne of Ordering Around if you want in, then maybe we talk.
english.completion: What you doing back so soon?

text.title: 潮汐王座：艾萨拉的力量
text.objectives: 前往潮汐王座，获取莎拉达尔权杖。
text.description: 波涛语者安德莉在深渊之喉之中的潮汐王座那里找到了莎拉达尔权杖，然后她就消失了。$n，如果我们尾随她继续前进，十有八九会落入陷阱之中。$b$b不过，元素之力是站在我们这一边的，我的朋友。纳迦可料不到会遇上你这么强大的萨满！$b$b你得游到西北边的潮汐王座，它就位于无底海渊之中。我们在那里汇合。我们得找到失踪的萨满并拿到那个神器！

english.title: Throne of the Tides: Azshara's Power
english.objectives: Travel to the Throne of Tides and acquire Sharas'dal.
english.description: Wavespeaker Adelee tracked Sharas'dal to the Throne of Tides within the Abyssal Maw, then disappeared. $n, if we go after her, we are almost certainly walking into a trap.$b$bBut the elements are with us, my friend. The naga will not expect a shaman of your caliber!$b$bSwim to the Throne of Tides to the Northwest, within the Abyssal Depths. I will join you once you are inside. Let's find our missing shaman and get that artifact!

text.title: Surprise the Sashj'tar
text.objectives: Kill 12 Sashj'tar Champions or Sashj'tar Deep Witches in Azuregale Bay.
text.description: The naga are preoccupied with recruiting the sea giants for Queen Azshara's battles in other lands.$B$BNow is the time to strike!

english.title: Surprise the Sashj'tar
english.objectives: Kill 12 Sashj'tar Champions or Sashj'tar Deep Witches in Azuregale Bay.
english.description: The naga are preoccupied with recruiting the sea giants for Queen Azshara's battles in other lands.$B$BNow is the time to strike!

objectiveDetails.description: Sashj'tar Champions or Sashj'tar Deep Witches slain

text.title: 蜡烛两头烧
text.objectives: 确保狗头人的活都干完了。
text.description:
你怎么就回来了？必须等到活干完，不然不让你通过！

返回指挥之座，确保活都干完了！
text.completion: What that?! You have Candleking's Special Candle!

english.title: Burn the Candle at Both Ends
english.objectives: Ensure that all of the kobold jobs are done.
english.description:
Why you come back already? Have to wait until jobs are done or I no let you through!

Go back to Throne of Ordering Around and make sure they finish!
english.completion: What that?! You have Candleking's Special Candle!

text.title: Pilfered Provisions
text.objectives: Collect 8 Pilfered Provisions from shipwrecks in Azuregale Bay.
text.description: The sea giants are sifting through the shipwrecks looking for treasure. Anything of value that can be found would be better off in the hands of the vrykul.

english.title: Pilfered Provisions
english.objectives: Collect 8 Pilfered Provisions from shipwrecks in Azuregale Bay.
english.description: The sea giants are sifting through the shipwrecks looking for treasure. Anything of value that can be found would be better off in the hands of the vrykul.

text.title: 水源污染
text.objectives: 消灭12个被法力腐蚀的水之子。
text.description: 有东西在污染水源，$c。$b$b我们必须净化水源，好让废墟下面的元素恢复平衡。$b$b这里的魔法让元素的扭曲超过了能够复原的程度。只有让它们从腐化形态中解脱，才能从纯净中重生。
text.end: 消灭12个被法力腐蚀的水之子。

english.title: Something in the Water
english.objectives: Slay 12 Mana-corrupted Waterspawn.
english.description: There is something fouling these waters, $c.$b$bWe will need to purify the waters in order to restore balance to the elemental forces below this ruin.$b$bThe magic here has warped the elementals and they are beyond restoration. Release their corrupted forms so that they may be reborn pure.

text.title: 古朴的紫色琉璃器皿
text.objectives: 将遗物进行展览。
text.description: 这件遗物的恢复状况极为良好，非常适合放在达拉然的考古商店进行展览。

english.title: Pristine Violetglass Vessel
english.objectives: Put the artifact on display.
english.description: This artifact has been restored to a remarkably excellent condition, suitable for display in Dalaran's archaeology shop.

text.title: 古朴的惰性魔石护符

text.title: 气泡的麻烦
text.objectives: 在蓝风海湾找到一个针刺珊瑚，并救出5个被俘的维库人。
text.description: $C！海巨人已经吃掉了我一半的族人。$B$B我们在这些该死的气泡里毫无还手之力。求求你放我们出去。$B$B务必当心，这些气泡非常厚实。你需要一件特别锐利的东西才能刺穿它们。

english.title: Bubble Trouble
english.objectives: Collect a piece of Needle Coral and then rescue 5 Captured Vrykul in Azuregale Bay.
english.description: $C! The sea giants have already eaten half of my kin.$B$BWe are helpless in these accursed bubbles. I beseech you to get us out of here.$B$BTake heed. These bubbles are strong. You will need something that is extremely sharp to pierce them.

text.title: 海龟动力
text.objectives: 收集7份闪光的钳嘴鳞片。
text.description: 为了找到并净化污染的源头，我需要借助元素焦镜的帮助。$b$b这附近的乌龟进化出了可以聚焦并增强它们魔力的鳞片。$b$b去搞些钳嘴鳞片回来，我们就可以马上净化水源！
text.end: 收集7份闪光的钳嘴鳞片。

english.title: Turtle Powered
english.objectives: Collect 7 Shimmering Snapper Scales.
english.description: In order to locate and purify the source of the corruption I am going to need an elemental focus.$b$bThe turtles around here have developed scales that can focus and amplify their innate magics. Bring back some snapper scales and we will have these waters purified in no time!

text.title: 净化污染
text.objectives: 净化堕蓝卫士的污染。
text.description: 你感觉到了吗，$r？现在已经万事俱备，就等我们将一切导向正轨。$b$b你去忙活的时候，我找到了统治水域的古老元素。它名叫堕蓝卫士，就住在泰安诺的地下通道里。$b$b拿上仪式焦镜，它可以在战斗中助你一臂之力。
text.giverWindow: 使用净化仪式焦镜寻找腐化的源头！

english.title: Purge the Unclean
english.objectives: Defeat the corruption in the Azurefall Guardian.
english.description: Do you feel it in the air, $r? The stage is set for us to make things right.$b$bWhile you were busy I was able to track down the elder elemental that rules these waters. Its name is the Azurefall Guardian and it resides within the channels below Tel'anor.$b$bTake the ritual focus, it should help you during the battle.
english.end: Defeat the corruption in the Azurefall Guardian.
english.giverWindow: Use the Cleansing Ritual Focus to find the source of the corruption!

text.title: 新的方向
text.objectives: 在凯恩和奥图里斯之间做出选择。
text.description:
$n，伊利丹大人不在，你是伊利达雷的领袖，必须由你选择你的副手。

凯恩或奥图里斯，你只能选择其中一人。

选定之人将成为你个人的勇士，他们的理念将影响到伊利达雷未来的决策。不管你选择谁，我们的使命都不会改变。

如果需要回顾我们的过去，请凝视审判之池。请铭记我们被锤炼为恶魔猎手的路上的种种牺牲。准备选择的时候请告诉我。

english.title: A New Direction
english.objectives: Choose between Kayn and Altruis.
english.description:
$n, as leader of the Illidari in Lord Illidan's absence, you must choose your second-in-command.

Kayn or Altruis. You can only choose one.

The chosen shall become your personal champion, and their ideology will color our decisions for the Illidari going forward. No matter who is chosen, our mission remains unchanged.

If you need a reminder of our past, gaze into the Pool of Judgment. Remember the sacrifices that forged us into demon hunters. Speak to me when you are ready to choose.

objectiveDetails.description: 选择凯恩或者奥图里斯

text.title: 加入伊利达雷：灰舌
text.objectives: 激活军团传送门，召集灰舌部队。
text.description:
伊利丹大人安排你来负责一切。现在，我们需要集结其余的伊利达雷攻击部队。

前面有三个燃烧军团传送门。启动传送门就可以让伊利达雷从黑暗神殿倾巢而出。

和大多数军团构造体一样，它们的动力来源是灵魂。我想我们现在足以启动第一个传送门了，对吧？我们来召集灰舌部队。

english.title: Enter the Illidari: Ashtongue
english.objectives: Summon in your Ashtongue forces by activating the Legion Gateway.
english.description:
Lord Illidan has placed you in charge. Now, we just need the rest of our Illidari attack force.

There are three Burning Legion gateways ahead. Activate them and our Illidari will pour through from the Black Temple.

Like most Legion constructs, the gateways are powered by souls. I think we have provided enough to activate this first one, don't you? Let us bring in our Ashtongue forces.

text.title: 加入伊利达雷：库斯卡
text.objectives: 将能量灌入军团传送门激活器内，然后用它召唤你的库斯卡部队。
text.description:
下一个传送门位于熔火之滨。我们的库斯卡部队在另一边的黑暗神殿里待命。

我个人是不会选择召唤纳迦盟友的，不过他们的首领曾经向伊利丹大人宣誓效忠，我们就等着看吧。

我们得想办法为传送门激活器供能。

<瑟维斯说话时，食魂者阿莱利咧嘴而笑。>

english.title: Enter the Illidari: Coilskar
english.objectives: Feed a soul into the Legion Gateway Activator and then use it to summon in your Coilskar forces.
english.description:
The next gateway's down on the Molten Shore. Our Coilskar forces are waiting at the Black Temple on the other side.

Personally, I wouldn't have chosen to bring our naga allies. But, their leader did swear fealty to Lord Illidan. I suppose we'll see.

We'll have to find a way to power the gateway's activator. Like this last gateway, it runs on souls.

<Allari the Souleater grins as Sevis says this.>

text.title: 猎人的需求
text.objectives: 在达拉然与伊墨瑞尔·影卫谈一谈。
text.description:
雄鹰给你带来了一个消息：
$B|cFF660000             致：$n|r$b$b反击燃烧军团的时候到了。$b$b尽快到达拉然的猎人用品店找我。$B$B|cFF660000 |r-伊墨瑞尔·影卫
text.completed: 在达拉然与伊墨瑞尔·影卫谈一谈。

english.title: Needs of the Hunters
english.objectives: Speak with Emmarel Shadewarden in Dalaran.
english.description:
The eagle appears to have a message for you:
$B|cFF660000             To: $n|r$b$bThe time has come to strike back at the Legion.$b$bMeet me at Hunter's Reach in Dalaran as soon as you can.$B$B|cFF660000             |r-Emmarel Shadewarden
english.completed: Speak with Emmarel Shadewarden in Dalaran.

text.title: 迷雾中的圣矛
text.objectives: 猎杀至高岭灾星。
text.description: 很多年前，有一头受到腐化的夜刃豹杀害了我的许多族人。我们的大酋长多罗·高岭拿起雄鹰之爪，前去追捕那头野兽，但却从此一去不回。$b$b听说有一头强大的夜刃豹潜藏在风暴峡湾的迷雾之中，我和我的兄弟相信，它就是我们古老的仇敌。$b$b神器肯定也在那里！如果我们能消灭野兽并取回长矛，对我们与燃烧军团的战斗一定大有裨益。

english.title: The Spear in the Shadow
english.objectives: Hunt down Highmountain's Bane.
english.description: Many years ago, a corrupted nightsaber hunted my people. Our chieftain, Dorro Highmountain, took Talonclaw and pursued the beast, but never returned.$b$bI have heard tales of a fearsome nightsaber that now stalks the mists of Stormheim. My brother and I believe this to be our ancient foe.$b$bThe weapon must be there too! If we kill the beast and reclaim the spear, it will be of great use against the Legion.

objectiveDetails.description: 消灭至高岭灾星并取得雄鹰之爪
搭乘雄鹰之魂前往港口

text.title: 胡恩之战——影歌
text.objectives: 在战场上与加洛德·影歌见面。
text.description:
有人在下面指挥着战场，我相信你已经认识他了。

加洛德·影歌对你评价很高，他要你和他一同参战。

他有一个计划，可以给这场战斗画上句号。
text.completion: I am happy to see you, great ally.

english.title: Huln's War - Shadowsong
english.objectives: Meet with Jarod Shadowsong in the battlefield.
english.description:
Someone with whom I believe you are familiar commands in the battlefield below.

Jarod Shadowsong speaks highly of you, and has requested that you join him in battle.

He has plans to put an end to this fight.
english.completion: I am happy to see you, great ally.

text.title: 领袖会晤
text.objectives: 到苏拉玛与卡德加见面。
text.description: 我很高兴你能来，$n。$b$b这个……大法师卡德加收到了我的消息，并提议会面。他想尽快在城门口跟我们见面。$b$b你能跟我一起去见他吗？我有种奇怪的预感，那里可能不只他一个人。
text.end: 到苏拉玛与卡德加见面。

english.title: Take Me To Your Leader
english.objectives: Meet with Khadgar in Suramar.
english.description: I am glad you are here, $n.$b$bThis... Khadgar, the archmage who found my message, has called a meeting.$b$bHe wishes to meet us at the entrance to the city as soon as possible.$b$bWill you accompany me? I have the strangest feeling that he will not be alone.

text.title: 神射手的召唤
text.objectives: 搭乘角鹰兽，从克拉苏斯平台前往破碎海滩与温蕾萨·风行者见面。
text.description: 时间紧迫！如果奥蕾莉亚和萨斯多拉在燃烧军团手里，我们失去她们只是时间问题。$b$b如果你准备好了，就到破碎群岛去找风行者将军。$b$b她特地让她的专用角鹰兽来载你飞往海滩。

english.title: Call of the Marksman
english.objectives: Take the hippogryph from Krasus' Landing down to the Broken Shore and meet with Vereesa Windrunner.
english.description: Time is of the essence! If Alleria and Thas'dorah are in Legion hands, it is only a matter of time until both are forfeit.$b$bIf you are ready, head to the Broken Shore to meet with Ranger-General Windrunner.$b$bShe has lent her personal hippogryph to fly you down to the surface.

objectiveDetails.description: （可选）搭乘角鹰兽前往破碎海滩

text.title: 秘密行动
text.objectives: 与温蕾萨·风行者谈一谈。
text.description: 你一直是联盟信赖的英雄，$n。你和我们其他人一样，历经千辛万苦才有今天。$b$b现在，我不得不向你提出更多的请求。你愿意听我说个故事吗？

english.title: Clandestine Operation
english.objectives: Speak to Vereesa Windrunner.
english.description: You have long been a trusted hero of the Alliance, $n. And like the rest of us, you have endured many hardships to reach this point.$b$bNow, I must ask even more of you. Will you hear me out?

objectiveDetails.description: 倾听温蕾萨·风行者说话

text.title: 归乡
text.objectives: 寻找走私者。
text.description: 我必须回到苏拉玛。$b$b对我的流放实在有欠公允！我没办法在这种地方苟活。我需要暗夜井的能量……$b$b我几天前看到刻在墙上的信息，水之园里面有人可以把流放者偷渡进城。$b$b信息里说“我们可以重新得到圣井的惠泽。”$b$b但是如果再和守卫起冲突的话，我就死定了。你可以帮我跑一趟吗？我一回城就会报答你。

english.title: A Way Back In
english.objectives: Find the smuggler.
english.description: I must get back into Suramar.$b$bI was exiled unfairly! I cannot live out here like this. I need the Nightwell's energies...$b$bI saw a message carved into a wall a few days ago. There is someone in the Water Gardens who can smuggle people into the city.$b$bIt said "We shall drink of the Well again."$b$bI cannot survive a confrontation with the guards again. Will you go in my stead? Once I am back in the city I can repay you.

text.title: 秘密行动
text.objectives: 倾听温蕾萨·风行者的故事。
text.description: 你肯定知道，我数次与部落为敌。兽人从我手和我家人手里……夺走了太多。$b$b但是，我亲眼见识到了你的所作所为，$n。你一再挺身而出，为了艾泽拉斯而战。而且，你和我们其他人一样，历经千辛万苦和无数考验才有今天。$b$b现在，我不得不寻求你的帮助。你愿意听我说个故事吗？

english.title: Clandestine Operation
english.objectives: Listen to Vereesa Windrunner's tale.
english.description: As you well know, I have opposed the Horde at many turns. The orcs have taken... so much from me. From my family.$b$bYet I have witnessed your deeds firsthand, $n. I have seen you fight for Azeroth time and again. And like the rest of us, you have endured many trials and hardships to reach this point.$b$bNow, I must ask your help. Will you hear me out?

objectiveDetails.description: 倾听温蕾萨·风行者说话

text.title: 秘密行动
text.objectives: 与温蕾萨·风行者谈一谈。
text.description: 要寻求血精灵的帮助，这对我并非易事。我的家族和众多的同胞做出了巨大的牺牲，然而却遭到了你们领袖的背弃。$b$b但是，我亲眼见识到了你的所作所为，$n。你一再挺身而出，为了艾泽拉斯而战。而且，你和我们其他人一样，历经千辛万苦和无数考验才有今天。$b$b现在，我不得不寻求你的帮助。你愿意听我说个故事吗？

english.title: Clandestine Operation
english.objectives: Listen to Vereesa Windrunner.
english.description: It is no small matter for me to seek the aid of a blood elf. Your leaders have turned their backs on the sacrifices made by my family and so many others.$b$bYet I have witnessed your deeds firsthand, $n. I have seen you fight for Azeroth time and again. And like the rest of us, you have endured many trials and hardships to reach this point.$b$bNow, I must ask your help. Will you hear me out?

objectiveDetails.description: 聆听温蕾萨·风行者的话

text.title: 传说武器
text.objectives: 选择追求哪件神器。
text.description: 我们的同胞了解到几把威力巨大的武器。如果运用得当，这些神圣的武器将为我们对抗燃烧军团的战争带来转机。$B$B我们无法同时追求所有的神器，否则会让人手过度分散，带来巨大的风险。现在，我们必须决定把注意力放在哪里。$B$B这就是我需要你的原因，$n。身为我们最伟大的勇士之一，我们需要你做出理性的判断，决定我们的下一步行动。
text.completion: Excellent choice! There's no time to waste.

english.title: Weapons of Legend
english.objectives: Select an artifact weapon to pursue.
english.description: Our gathering has identified several weapons of immense power. In the right hands, these holy artifacts give us a fighting chance against the Legion.$B$BWe cannot pursue all of them at once. We risk too much if we spread ourselves that thin. We must agree on where our efforts are best focused.$B$BThat is why I asked you here, $n. As one of our greatest champions, you must be our voice of reason and decide our next move.
english.completion: Excellent choice! There's no time to waste.

enders.name: 玛克斯韦尔·泰罗索斯男爵

text.title: 阿佐兰必须死
text.objectives: 在邪魂堡垒击败阿佐兰。
text.description: 燃烧军团很快就会发现你在船上，你的时间不多。$b$b收到警报之后，无数的燃烧军团恶魔就会尝试通过这道传送门登船。$b$b我不会让他们得逞的。$b$b我会守住传送门，阻止敌军增援，直到你回来为止。你必须消灭阿佐兰并摧毁他的舰船。$b$b时间紧迫……你必须迅速发起攻击，千万不要手下留情。

english.title: Azoran Must Die
english.objectives: Defeat Azoran in Felsoul Hold.
english.description: You won't have much time before the Legion is aware of your presence on the ship.$b$bWhen the alarm is raised, countless Burning Legion forces will attempt to board the ship through this portal.$b$bI will not let them succeed.$b$bI will guard this portal from enemy reinforcements until you return. It is up to you to slay Azoran and lay waste to his ship.$b$bWe don't have much time... you must attack swiftly and without mercy.

text.title: 获益良多的经历
text.objectives: 向娜穆汇报你与至高岭牛头人相处的经历。
text.description: 你对我们工艺的敬重为你赢得了学习的机会，并且你也学会了我们所能传授的一切。现在该上路了，$n，去用我们的知识帮助盟友对抗燃烧军团吧。$b$b或许这能让我们的世界在这场战争中获得优势。

english.title: Well Spent Time
english.objectives: Tell Namha of your time with the tauren in Highmountain.
english.description: Your respect for our ways has earned you all the knowledge we have to teach. Go now, $n, and spread our ways to those who fight against the legion.$b$bPerhaps it will help to turn the tide in this war for our world.

text.title: 前往塔纳安！
text.objectives: 与要塞议政厅中的沃金酋长谈一谈。
text.description: 祝贺你升到了100级！有一件事情对你来说十分重要：在你被其它事务缠身之前，你应该专注于塔纳安丛林并在那里建立起一个立足点。$b$b酋长正在你的议政厅中等候你。你最好别让他等得太久……
text.completed: 与要塞议政厅中的沃金酋长谈一谈。

english.title: To Tanaan!
english.objectives: Speak with Warchief Vol'jin inside the Town Hall of your garrison.
english.description: Congratulations on your recent advancement to level 100!$b$bIt is vital that you set your focus on Tanaan Jungle and establish a foothold there, before you are distracted with other matters.$b$bThe Warchief is ready for you inside your Town Hall. It would be wise not to keep him waiting....
english.completed: Speak with Warchief Vol'jin inside the Town Hall of your garrison.

text.title: 前往塔纳安！
text.objectives: 与要塞议政厅中的瓦里安·乌瑞恩国王谈一谈。
text.description: 祝贺你升到了100级！有一件事情对你来说十分重要：在你被其它事务缠身之前，你应该专注于塔纳安丛林并在那里建立起一个立足点。$b$b国王和他的全体随从们正在你的城镇大厅中等候你。你最好别让他等得太久……
text.completed: 与要塞议政厅中的瓦里安·乌瑞恩国王谈一谈。

english.title: To Tanaan!
english.objectives: Speak with King Varian Wrynn inside the Town Hall of your garrison.
english.description: Congratulations on your recent advancement to level 100!$b$bIt is vital that you set your focus on Tanaan Jungle and establish a foothold there, before you are distracted with other matters.$b$bThe King is ready for you inside your town hall along with his full retinue. It would be wise not to keep him waiting...
english.completed: Speak with King Varian Wrynn inside the Town Hall of your garrison.

text.title: 营救任务
text.objectives: 进入传送门，营救奥蕾莉亚·风行者。
text.description: 恶魔说奥蕾莉亚被抓住了，他还告诉了我们该怎么打开一扇通往那个世界的传送门。我们俩可以进去看看恶魔的话到底是真是假。$b$b为了预防这是一个圈套，魔导师索尔加兹给了我一块传送石，它可以把我们传回达拉然。$b$b这种恶魔魔法对于法师来说是一种诅咒，所以我们必须迅速行动。你准备好了就告诉我，$n。

english.title: Rescue Mission
english.objectives: Travel through the portal and rescue Alleria Windrunner.
english.description: The demon has told us how to open a portal to the world where he says Alleria is being held. You and I can go through and see if there is any truth to his claims.$b$bIn case it's a trap, Magus Solgaze has given me a portal stone to get us back to Dalaran.$b$bThis demonic magic is anathema to the mage, so we must move quickly. I'm ready when you are, $n.

objectiveDetails.description: 与温蕾萨交谈，然后离开尼斯卡拉
穿过传送门前往尼斯卡拉
与温蕾萨交谈以开始任务

text.title: 绝命之旅
text.objectives: 寻着路灯带艾德瑞斯去找阿斯托里尔。
text.description: 城市入口有重兵把守。他肯定有秘道溜进去。$b$b幸好有这酒，让我有足够的力气去找他。但是如果遭到攻击的话，恐怕我没有办法自保或者逃跑。$b$b你跟我一起走，$r。你和这个阿斯托里尔是我活命的唯一机会。$b$b记得在离开城市的时候，我是沿着路灯走到这里来的。如果跟着路灯走，我们应该可以走回去。
text.end: 带艾德瑞斯去找阿斯托里尔。

english.title: A Desperate Journey
english.objectives: Follow the lamp posts to take Iadreth to Astoril.
english.description: The city's entrances are under heavy guard. He must have another way.$b$bThanks to this wine I am strong enough to make the journey to him. I fear that I will not be able to defend or run if I come under attack.$b$bYou will accompany me, $r. You and this Astoril are my only chance at surviving now. $b$bI remember when I was leaving the city that there were lamps guiding me here. We should be able to retrace our steps by following them.

text.title: 最后的准备
text.objectives: 拿回6份藏起来的补给品。
text.description: 我们在苏拉玛之旅中需要一些补给品。总不能带着你们俩在城门口找吃的，对吧？$b$b水之园是社交和休憩的地方。我们赶在巡逻兵过来之前，藏了些法力酒以便不时之需。这么做非常有必要。$b$b该你出马了。去拿些补给品回来给你的朋友，然后到城市北边的废墟里找我。我们很快就可以出发了。
text.end: 拿回6份藏起来的补给品。

english.title: Final Preparations
english.objectives: Recover 6 stashed supplies.
english.description: We will need supplies for our trip into Suramar. We cannot exactly stop for refreshments at the gate with you two in tow, can we?$b$bThe water gardens were a place to socialize and relax. Before the patrols arrived it was rather trivial to hide some mana wine for later retrieval.$b$bThat's where you come in. Fetch some supplies and bring them to your friend, then meet me at the ruins north of the city. We will be ready to depart soon.

text.title: 生命之重
text.objectives: 跟随艾德瑞斯。
text.description: 我好害怕，$n。我们离家乡如此接近，救赎近在咫尺……$b$b阿斯托里尔说他知道后面的路，还说他可以让我们安全进入。我相信他，不过这一路都是你在保护我们。你愿意帮忙帮到底吗？

english.title: Quality of Life
english.objectives: Follow Iadreth.
english.description: I am afraid, $n. We're so close to home, so close to salvation...$b$bAstoril says he knows the rest of the way through and can get us there safely. I believe him, but you've come this far to see us safe. Will you see this through to the end?

text.title: 乌萨勒斯，逆风收割者
text.objectives: 在暮色森林的密斯特曼托庄园搜寻逆风收割者。
text.description:
书上说，黑暗骑士最后出现在一个叫做密斯特曼托庄园的地方。如果朋友能够找到这些骑士，就可以拿到乌萨勒斯！

卡里杜斯会躲在这里等你回来。找到乌萨勒斯，朋友！

english.title: Ulthalesh, the Deadwind Harvester
english.objectives: Start your search for the Deadwind Harvester at Manor Mistmantle in Duskwood.
english.description:
The book says the Dark Riders were last seen in a place called Manor Mistmantle. If friend can find these riders, then $Ghe:she; can get Ulthalesh!

Calydus will wait here and await your return. Find Ulthalesh, friend!

objectiveDetails.description: 在暮色森林调查密斯特曼托庄园
（可选）使用达拉然的传送门前往卡拉赞

text.title: REUSEME_40501
text.objectives: Infiltrate Bladefury's Command with Garona's help. Use her talents to eliminate guards without being seen. Locate Iron Horde intelligence and then spy on Gul'dan.
text.description: If Garona's intelligence is correct, Gul'dan will be inside this Iron Horde compound. With Garona's help, slip inside, gather any info you find, and learn what Gul'dan intends to do.$b$bThe guards are on high alert. Garona can "liquidate" individual guards for you, but she must not be seen! You will have to choose your targets carefully and pick your way through the bastion undetected. Don't let anyone sound the alarm.$b$bIf things get too hot, I'll teleport you to safety. At least... I'll try.

english.title: REUSEME_40501
english.objectives: Infiltrate Bladefury's Command with Garona's help. Use her talents to eliminate guards without being seen. Locate Iron Horde intelligence and then spy on Gul'dan.
english.description: If Garona's intelligence is correct, Gul'dan will be inside this Iron Horde compound. With Garona's help, slip inside, gather any info you find, and learn what Gul'dan intends to do.$b$bThe guards are on high alert. Garona can "liquidate" individual guards for you, but she must not be seen! You will have to choose your targets carefully and pick your way through the bastion undetected. Don't let anyone sound the alarm.$b$bIf things get too hot, I'll teleport you to safety. At least... I'll try.

text.title: 7.0 Highmountain - Treasure 099 - Path of Huln - S (RKS)

english.title: 7.0 Highmountain - Treasure 099 - Path of Huln - S (RKS)

text.title: 与灵魂同行
text.objectives: 与灵魂行者黑角谈一谈。
text.description: 你在河湾救下的那位灵魂行者来这儿以后就一直坐立难耐。他强烈要求向你展示我们的族人之道，让你了解自己将面临什么样的挑战。$b$b他是个怪人，比一般的灵魂行者都怪。$b$b尽管如此，只有傻瓜才会忽略他的睿智。有时间的话，就请去和他谈谈吧。
text.completion: You made Mayla smile. That is the first time I have seen her smile in... ever?

english.title: A Walk With the Spirits
english.objectives: Speak with Spiritwalker Ebonhorn.
english.description: The spiritwalker you saved from Riverbend has been insufferable since his arrival. He is insisting on showing you the ways of our people so that you better understand what is to come.$b$bHe is a strange one, even by spiritwalker standards.$b$bEven so, only a fool would discard his insight. Please, go to speak with him when you get a moment.
english.completion: You made Mayla smile. That is the first time I have seen her smile in... ever?

text.title: 陨落的雄狮
text.objectives: 把瓦里安国王的信件交给安度因国王。
text.description: 我们回来以后我就没离开过甲板。舰队必须做好战前准备。虽然不知道我们会被派到哪里，不过我们必须做好万全的准备，以便随时响应号召。$b$b老实说……我倒希望有些事情来分心。其他人都在追悼瓦里安，不过……我无法面对他的灵柩，无法面对他的儿子。$b$b瓦里安有封信让我转交给安度因。请帮我代劳。
text.completion: <Anduin sighs and reads the letter from his father. Tears well in his eyes. He is silent for several moments.>$b$bThank you for bringing this to me, $n, it means... more than I can say. I wish Greymane felt he could present it himself, but his mind is fixed on revenge.$b$bI cannot blame him... or Jaina, for that matter, but we must find a better way.$b$bEnough of such talk. It is good you are here. We will need heroes like you in the many battles to come.

english.title: The Fallen Lion
english.objectives: Deliver King Varian's letter to King Anduin.
english.description: I haven't left the deck of this ship since we got back. The fleet must be made ready for war. Don't know where we will be needed, but when the call comes, we'll be ready.$b$bTruth be told... I welcome the distraction. The others are paying their respects to Varian, but I... I cannot bring myself to face that casket. To face his son.$b$bVarian gave me a letter he wrote to Anduin. Please, take it to him on my behalf.
english.completion: <Anduin sighs and reads the letter from his father. Tears well in his eyes. He is silent for several moments.>$b$bThank you for bringing this to me, $n, it means... more than I can say. I wish Greymane felt he could present it himself, but his mind is fixed on revenge.$b$bI cannot blame him... or Jaina, for that matter, but we must find a better way.$b$bEnough of such talk. It is good you are here. We will need heroes like you in the many battles to come.

objectiveDetails.description: 把瓦里安的信件交给安度因国王并倾听他的讲话
（可选）搭乘狮鹫前往暴风要塞

text.title: 破碎海滩之战
text.objectives: 将鲁索船长的船带到破碎海滩。
text.description:
你的战舰正在码头尽头等着你，$n。愿你手中的兵器为你带来辉煌的战绩。

酋长已经登陆，我敢打赌，你只要沿着恶魔的血迹前行，就能找到他了。

english.title: The Battle for Broken Shore
english.objectives: Take Captain Russo's ship to the Broken Shore.
english.description:
Your warship awaits at the end of the dock, $n. May your weapon bring you many kills today.

The Warchief has already made landfall, I will wager you will simply need to follow the trail of demon blood.

objectiveDetails.description: 搭乘舰船前往破碎海滩

text.title: 卷土重来
text.objectives: 到暴风城港口向征募官李报到。
text.description:
联盟的英雄，在艾泽拉斯最黑暗的时刻，我提笔写下这封信。地狱之门已经打开，燃烧军团卷土重来。

我们的舰队即将挺进破碎群岛。我们要以破竹之势冲击军团的阵线，把他们赶回扭曲虚空。

你的舰船正在暴风城港口准备起航，请尽快动身。
text.completion: Hail, $n. I've got your ship assignment right here.$b$bBut first, a bit of readiness is in order!

english.title: The Legion Returns
english.objectives: Check in with Recruiter Lee at Stormwind Harbor.
english.description:
Heroes of the Alliance, I write to you in Azeroth's darkest hour. From the maw of hell, the burning armies of the Legion have returned.

Our fleets depart for the Broken Isles at once. As a grand lance, we will pierce the Legion's lines and drive them back to the nether that spawned them.

Your ship awaits in the Stormwind Harbor, make haste.
english.completion: Hail, $n. I've got your ship assignment right here.$b$bBut first, a bit of readiness is in order!

text.title: 回顾过去
text.objectives: 寻找一瓶大气之火 、一些穆莎之泪和一块暗裂水晶。
text.description:
我想让你亲眼看看在上古之战期间，胡恩·高岭在对决中的英勇表现。

为此，我需要一些特殊的材料。你在雷霆图腾附近就能找到，应该不难。
text.completion: Ah, these will be perfect for what is in store.

english.title: To See the Past
english.objectives: Collect a Bottle of Airspark, Mu'sha's Tears, and Darkshard Crystal.
english.description:
I would like for you to experience firsthand what Huln Highmountain was able to accomplish in a single battle during the War of the Ancients.

To do so, I will need very specific ingredients. They are not too difficult to obtain--you can find all of them near Thunder Totem.
english.completion: Ah, these will be perfect for what is in store.

text.title: Tracking Quest - W1 - Demon Attack Complete

english.title: Tracking Quest - W1 - Demon Attack Complete

text.title: 部落的命运
text.objectives: 前往格罗玛什要塞，了解部落的命运。
text.description: 我们竟然有士兵能够从破碎海滩的那场血战中存活下来，这无疑是一个奇迹。如果不是希尔瓦娜斯……$B$B萨鲁法尔大王一直在格罗玛什要塞等你。他不愿意说出原因……但他坚持要我来请你去见他。

english.title: Fate of the Horde
english.objectives: Go to Grommash Hold and learn the fate of the Horde.
english.description: It is a wonder any of our troops survived that bloodbath on the Broken Shore. If not for Lady Sylvanas...$B$BHigh Overlord Saurfang has been asking for you at Grommash Hold. He will not say why... but he was insistent that I send you to him.

objectiveDetails.description: 向大酋长希尔瓦娜斯宣誓

text.title: 珠宝匠朋友
text.objectives: 向提莫斯·琼斯和斯米克斯·璃目介绍自己。
text.description: 打扰一下，$g先生:女士;。你确定自己没有走错地方？我们这里只做高级珠宝生意。$b$b啊，我懂了……你也是珠宝匠。我们或许可以合作。$b$b先去见见我的同事，让他们认识你，看看你能做些什么。

english.title: Facet-nating Friends
english.objectives: Introduce yourself to Timothy Jones and Sminx Glasseye.
english.description: Excuse me, $gsir:madam;. Are you sure you're in the correct shop? We only deal in the finest of jewels here.$b$bAhh, I see... you're a fellow lapidary. Then perhaps we can work together.$b$bIntroduce yourself to my associates, so they're aware of who you are and what you may have to offer.

objectiveDetails.description: 向斯米克斯·璃目介绍自己
向提莫斯·琼斯介绍自己

text.title: 戒指的传言
text.objectives: 在阿苏纳的倾颓王宫附近找到艾迪尔祭坛，并了解它的传说。
text.description: $n！跟你说个事，我在找戒指。$b$b听着，阿苏纳的精灵以前十分擅长珠宝加工……至少传闻是这么说的。很多书里都记载着一枚叫做“法罗迪斯之戒”的戒指。我们不妨去打探一下。$b$b我们到阿苏纳去。我打赌我会比你先到。

english.title: A Familiar Ring to It
english.objectives: Find the Shrine of Aldiir near the Crumbling Palace in Azsuna and read about its legend.
english.description: $n! Let's talk bling. I'm looking for a ring.$b$bSee, the elves down in Azsuna were some fine master jewelcrafters back in the day... or so they say. The books all talk about a ring called the "Band of Farondis". Can't hurt to ask around for it.$b$bLet's head to Azsuna. Bet I'll get there sooner!

objectiveDetails.description: 找到了解法罗迪斯之戒的人

text.title: 拼凑碎裂的戒指
text.objectives: 找到法罗迪斯之戒的三块碎片，然后交给提莫斯·琼斯。
text.description: 我喜欢我们的相处方式，$n。你负责出力，我负责出主意！$b$b下一个任务就全靠你了。尽量找到戒指，不管鱼人把它怎么样了，都要带回来。

english.title: Getting the Band Back Together
english.objectives: Find the three pieces of the Band of Farondis and bring them back to Timothy Jones.
english.description: I like our dynamic, $n. You're the muscle with all the hustle! And I'm the brains who entertains!$b$bI think this next task is all on you. Try to find that ring, or whatever the murlocs left of it.

text.title: 画龙点睛
text.objectives: 用提莫斯的宝石钳切割苍穹石。
text.description: 我已经修好戒指，不过宝石还没有处理。$b$b话说回来……你是珠宝匠，$n。工具已经有了，你来切割一下宝石吧！

english.title: Finishing Touches
english.objectives: Use Timothy's Gem Vise to obtain a Cut Skystone.
english.description: Well, I've managed to repair the ring, but the gem still needs work.$b$bSay... you're a gemcutter, $n. You've got the tools, so cut those jewels!

text.title: 画龙点睛
