text.objectives: 用提莫斯的宝石钳切割深海琥珀。
text.description: 我已经修好戒指，不过宝石还没有处理。$b$b话说回来……你是珠宝匠，$n。工具已经有了，你来切割一下宝石吧！

english.title: Finishing Touches
english.objectives: Use Timothy's Gem Vise to obtain a Cut Deep Amber.
english.description: Well, I've managed to repair the ring, but the gem still needs work.$b$bSay... you're a gemcutter, $n. You've got the tools, so cut those jewels!

text.title: 画龙点睛
text.objectives: 用提莫斯的宝石钳切割阿苏奈特黄晶。
text.description: 我已经修好戒指，不过宝石还没有处理。$b$b话说回来……你是珠宝匠，$n。工具已经有了，你来切割一下宝石吧！

english.title: Finishing Touches
english.objectives: Use Timothy's Gem Vise to obtain a Cut Azsunite.
english.description: Well, I've managed to repair the ring, but the gem still needs work.$b$bSay... you're a gemcutter, $n. You've got the tools, so cut those jewels!

text.title: 精挑细选
text.objectives: 帮蒂凡妮·卡蒂亚收集$1oa块宝石碎片。宝石碎片可以通过选矿获得，也可以通过拍卖行购买。
text.description: 选矿是我们获取宝石的主要方式。在选矿的过程中……总会产生一些用处不大的宝石碎片。$b$b许多珠宝店会把这些小碎片直接丢掉，但是卡蒂亚珠宝店不会浪费一分一毫。

english.title: Truly Outrageous
english.objectives: Gather $1oa Gem Chips for Tiffany Cartier. Gem chips can be acquired through Prospecting raw ore or purchased off the auction house.
english.description: Ore prospecting is our primary method of gem acquisition. And while prospecting... you're bound to find small, unusable gem chips.$b$bMany gem shops simply discard the small gem chips they find, but we here at Cartier & Co. let nothing go to waste.

text.title: 明察秋毫
text.objectives: 在达拉然拜访珠宝店的客户，然后向蒂凡妮汇报情况。
text.description: $n，我最瞧不起诽谤这种行为。有传言说我最近出手了一件假货。$b$b我们必须尽快平息这些谣言。$b$b我要你去拜访一下我近期的客户，并且检查他们的宝石。既然你自称是货真价实的珠宝匠，那你应该可以轻易辨别宝石的真伪。$b$b这是我的客户名单。如果你查到传言所说的东西，就立刻回来告诉我。

english.title: An Eye for Detail
english.objectives: Visit the patrons of the jewelcrafting shop in Dalaran and report back to Tiffany.
english.description: $n, if there's one thing I despise, it's slander. A rumor is spreading that one of my recent commissions is a fake.$b$bWe need to quell these rumors as quickly as possible.$b$bI need you to visit the customers I recently worked for and examine their gems. If your claim of being a jewelcrafter is true, then you will be able to spot a fake gem from a mile away.$b$bHere's the list of my patrons. Return immediately if you find any truth to these rumors.

objectiveDetails.description: 把珠宝袋交给蒂凡妮·卡蒂亚
与卡翠欧娜·麦克雷交谈

text.title: 快刀斩乱麻
text.objectives: 在达拉然下水道寻找哈罗德·温斯顿。
text.description: 我发誓，找到他的时候……$b$b<蒂凡妮对上你的目光，逐渐恢复冷静。>$b$b$n，我要你找到我的前同事，哈罗德·温斯顿。我猜他已经跑远了。$b$b你找到他以后，就没收他盗走的珠宝并交还给我。$b$b采取一切必要的手段。另外，不要担心摩尔女士的珠宝，我会亲自送新货过去。

english.title: Swift Vengeance
english.objectives: Find Harold Winston in Dalaran's Underbelly.
english.description: I swear, when I find him...$b$b<Tiffany catches your eye and regains her composure.>$b$b$n, I need you to track down my FORMER associate, Harold Winston. I doubt he's gotten far, given our location.$b$bWhen you find him, I would like you to recover the stolen property and return it to me.$b$bUse any means necessary. And don't worry about Ms. Moore's jewels, I'll redeliver a fresh supply to her personally.

text.title: 宝石切割
text.objectives: 使用蒂凡妮的切割工具加工出一块致命深海琥珀。
text.description: 看到你既可靠又有能力，我很乐意教你如何切割一块深海琥珀。$b$b这需要用到我的切割工具，你准备好之后就到前面去坐好。

english.title: Making the Cut
english.objectives: Craft a Deadly Deep Amber using the Tiffany's cutting tool.
english.description: Seeing as how you've been quite a reliable resource, I'm willing to teach you how to cut a Deadly Deep Amber.$b$bWe'll be using my cutting tool to do this, so whenever you're ready, go ahead and sit yourself in front of it.

text.title: 宝石切割
text.objectives: 使用蒂凡妮的切割工具加工出一块迅捷阿苏奈特黄晶。
text.description: 看到你既可靠又有能力，我很乐意教你如何切割一块迅捷阿苏奈特黄晶。$b$b这需要用到我的切割工具，你准备好之后就到前面去坐好。

english.title: Making the Cut
english.objectives: Craft a Quick Azsunite using the Tiffany's cutting tool.
english.description: Seeing as how you've been quite a reliable resource, I'm willing to teach you how to cut a Quick Azsunite.$b$bWe'll be using my cutting tool to do this, so whenever you're ready, go ahead and sit yourself in front of it.

objectiveDetails.description: 切割迅捷阿苏奈特黄晶

text.title: 宝石切割
text.objectives: 使用蒂凡妮的切割工具加工出一块精湛之女王猫眼石。
text.description: 看到你既可靠又有能力，我很乐意教你如何切割一块精湛之女王猫眼石。$b$b这需要用到我的切割工具，你准备好之后就到前面去坐好。

english.title: Making the Cut
english.objectives: Craft a Masterful Queen's Opal using the Tiffany's cutting tool.
english.description: Seeing as how you've been quite a reliable resource, I'm willing to teach you how to cut a Masterful Queen's Opal.$b$bWe'll be using my cutting tool to do this, so whenever you're ready, go ahead and sit yourself in front of it.

objectiveDetails.description: 切割精湛之女王猫眼石

text.title: 壮大卓格巴尔
text.objectives: 向瓦尔莎拉的拉苏妮·星刃打听珠宝大师的下落。
text.description: 达拉然的消息传得特别快，$n。最新消息指出，在瓦尔莎拉的某处有一位珠宝大师。$b$b我要你跑一趟，找到这位大师。说不定他手上有什么设计图，可以让我们的店生意兴隆。$b$b我听说这些传言都跟一个叫做“拉苏妮·星刃”的人有关。你或许可以从她着手。

english.title: Raising the Drogbar
english.objectives: Talk to Lasune Starblade in Val'sharah as to the whereabouts of the jewelcrafting master.
english.description: Word travels fast around Dalaran, $n. And the latest word is that there's a master jewelcrafter somewhere in Val'sharah.$b$bI want you to go down there and find this master.  Perhaps they have designs that can help bolster business here at the shop.$b$bI've heard the name "Lasune Starblade" tied to these rumors. She might be a good place to start looking.

objectiveDetails.description: 把贾布尔的珠宝交给他

text.title: 珠宝匠兄弟
text.objectives: 在贾布尔拿取鹰身人项链的时候保护他，然后护送他返回附近的暗夜精灵营地。
text.description: 所以你是想跟贾布尔学习珠宝加工？$b$b好吧，贾布尔需要你的帮助。在我们离开这里之前，贾布尔还想弄一些鹰身人项链。$b$b在贾布尔拿取她们的项链的时候，你要控制住她们，然后贾布尔就会和你分享知识。

english.title: Bruls Before Jewels
english.objectives: Protect Jabrul while he finds harpy necklaces and escort him back to the nearby night elf camp.
english.description: So, you wish to learn what Jabrul knows about jewels?$b$bWell, Jabrul needs your help. Before we leave this place, Jabrul still needs harpy necklaces.$b$bKeep those harpies off of Jabrul while he takes their necklaces and Jabrul will reward you with his knowledge.

objectiveDetails.description: 护送贾布尔前往暗夜精灵营地
帮贾布尔找到第二块石头
帮贾布尔找到第一块石头

text.title: 宝石加工课
text.objectives: 使用蒂凡妮的切割工具加工出一块精心切割的漩涡蓝玉。
text.description: 很高兴又见面了，$n。$b$b看来从上次聊过以后，我们都非常忙碌。我有些东西或许会让你感兴趣。$b$b有一批叫做漩涡蓝玉的稀有宝石，最近总算送到店里来了。$b$b我为它们想出了一种精美的设计，我想教你怎么把它们切割成可以使用的形状。

english.title: Lapidary Lessons
english.objectives: Craft a Well-Cut Maelstrom Sapphire using Tiffany's cutting tool.
english.description: It's good to see you again, $n.$b$bIt seems we've both been busy since last we spoke. I have something that you may be interested in.$b$bA recent shipment of rare jewels called maelstrom sapphires have finally arrived here at the shop.$b$bI came up with a beautiful design for them and would like to show you how to cut them into something useful.

text.title: 秘密企图
text.objectives: 为克莱夫·柯森制作一套钻石开锁器。
text.description: 传言说你很会解决问题，而且非常谨慎。$b$b找你办件事。我需要一套新的开锁工具。原来的那些开锁器都不合我的胃口。$b$b我需要一种特别的，哪怕用力过猛也不会被弄坏的东西。$b$b我觉得一套钻石开锁器应该可以满足我的要求。我说的是用钻石制作的开锁器，而不是做成钻石形状的工具。$b$b那么，你干不干？

english.title: Hidden Intentions
english.objectives: Collect a set of Diamond Lockpicks for Clive Cozen.
english.description: Word on the street is, yer a reliable resource for getting things done, let's say, discreetly.$b$bSo here's the job. I need a new set of lock picking tools. But not just any old lock picks will do.$b$bI need something special, something that won't break if ye apply too much pressure.$b$bI'm thinking a set of diamond lock picks might do the trick. That would be lock picks made out of diamond, not the ones shaped like a diamond.$b$bLook, ye in or what?

objectiveDetails.description: 把黑市钻石切割成钻石开锁器
解决伊克罗特或者支付费用
在达拉然下水道询问钻石的事情
问蒂凡妮·卡蒂亚到哪找钻石

text.title: 来啊，兄弟
text.objectives: 在风暴峡湾寻找贾布尔。
text.description: $n，我收到……一块刻着信息的石板，勉强可以算是一封“信”。$b$b原来是你在瓦尔莎拉认识的那位珠宝设计大师寄来的，他想见你。他说他最近会在风暴峡湾。$b$b你见到他的时候帮我带个话，叫他不要老是找你。我们烦都烦死了。

english.title: Come at Me, Brul
english.objectives: Find Jabrul in Stormheim.
english.description: $n, I received a... well, what can only be constituted as a "letter", carved into a piece of flat rock.$b$bThat jewelcrafting master you found in Val'sharah has sent for you. He said he's in Stormheim currently.$b$bWhen you see him, would you be so kind as to inform him that we don't wish to receive any more of his requests for your presence. They just make a mess.

text.title: 内部充能
text.objectives: 对$1oa具猎风龙的尸体使用传导珠宝。
text.description: 在跟你分享设计图之前，贾布尔有个特别的任务需要你帮忙。$b$b贾布尔有一块能禁锢风暴能量的宝石。它禁锢的闪电越多，发出的光芒就越亮。$b$b贾布尔认为，风暴幼龙应该把它们的力量用在这块宝石上，而不是在风暴峡湾上空吓唬人。$b$b你觉得呢？

english.title: The Charge Within
english.objectives: Use the Conducting Jewel on the corpses of $1oa Squallhunter storm drakes.
english.description: Before Jabrul shares his designs with you, he needs you to help him with a special project.$b$bJabrul has a jewel that can trap storm energy. The more lightning it traps, the brighter it shines.$b$bJabrul thinks the storm drakes' power would be better spent in his jewel than terrorizing the skies of Stormheim.$b$bDon't you?

objectiveDetails.description: 收集风暴巨龙释放的能量

text.title: 纳沙尔之眼
text.objectives: 取得$1oa颗纳沙尔之眼。
text.description: 致命先知之眼……选得好。不过我们得先弄到宝石才可以开始切割。$b$b这里有一座古代维库人纳沙尔的巨大雕像。我们需要他眼眶里镶着的两颗宝石。$b$b爬上雕像，取出宝石眼睛，然后带回来交给贾布尔。

english.title: Eyes of Nashal
english.objectives: Obtain $1oa Eyes of Nashal.
english.description: Deadly eye of prophecy... a good choice. Before we can cut, though, we need gems.$b$bHere stands a giant statue of Nashal, an ancient vrykul. Laid in its eye sockets are two of the stones we need.$b$bAscend the statue, take its jeweled eyes, and return them to Jabrul.

text.title: 纳沙尔之眼
text.objectives: 取得$1oa颗纳沙尔之眼。
text.description: 迅捷晨光石……选得好。不过我们得先弄到宝石才可以开始切割。$b$b这里有一座古代维库人纳沙尔的巨大雕像。我们需要他眼眶里镶着的两颗宝石。$b$b爬上雕像，取出宝石眼睛，然后带回来交给贾布尔。

english.title: Eyes of Nashal
english.objectives: Obtain $1oa Eyes of Nashal.
english.description: Quick dawnlight... a good choice. Before we can cut, though, we need gems.$b$bHere stands a giant statue of Nashal, an ancient vrykul. Laid in its eye sockets are two of the stones we need.$b$bAscend the statue, take its jeweled eyes, and return them to Jabrul.

text.title: 纳沙尔之眼
text.objectives: 取得$1oa颗纳沙尔之眼。
text.description: 精湛暗影紫玉……选得好。不过我们得先弄到宝石才可以开始切割。$b$b这里有一座古代维库人纳沙尔的巨大雕像。我们需要他眼眶里镶着的两颗宝石。$b$b爬上雕像，取出宝石眼睛，然后带回来交给贾布尔。

english.title: Eyes of Nashal
english.objectives: Obtain $1oa Eyes of Nashal.
english.description: Masterful shadowruby... a good choice. Before we can cut, though, we need gems.$b$bHere stands a giant statue of Nashal, an ancient vrykul. Laid in its eye sockets are two of the stones we need.$b$bAscend the statue, take its jeweled eyes, and return them to Jabrul.

text.title: 噢，糟糕！
text.objectives: 把枪械箱带到达拉然下水道，交给菲果·碎底。
text.description: 简直是灾难！不，不，是阴谋！$b$b听说我们又得跟燃烧军团打仗了，所以我心想“霍巴特，你发光的时候到了”。$b$b我为大家制作了很多枪械，足以把那些恶魔轰回老家！$b$b但是等我们来到这里之后，你猜发生了什么？人人都碰巧“发现”了一堆可以跟恶魔对抗的上古神器！$b$b长话短说，我的枪太多了，我得赶快脱手。
text.completion: Now that's quite the haul of guns! I suppose these fell off the back of a gryphon, right?$b$b<Filgo gives you a sly wink.>

english.title: Aww Scrap!
english.objectives: Take the Crate of Guns down to Filgo Scrapbottom in the Underbelly.
english.description: It's a catastrophe! No, even worse, a conspiracy!$b$bI heard the Legion was back again, and I thought to myself, "Hobart, now's your time to shine."$b$bI made us enough guns to blow those demons back to the beginning of time!$b$bBut then we get here, and what happens? Everyone just happens to "find" all these ancient artifacts to fight the demons with!$b$bLong story short, I have too many guns and need to get rid of 'em.
english.completion: Now that's quite the haul of guns! I suppose these fell off the back of a gryphon, right?$b$b<Filgo gives you a sly wink.>

text.title: 自然的奥秘
text.objectives: 取回一块龙晶。
text.description: 贾布尔想把一些特殊的水晶给你看看。没人知道它们有什么用。非常神秘。$b$b如果你想知道怎么制作，贾布尔很乐意教你。$b$b山顶住着一些风暴幼龙，它们会对着崖壁喷吐闪电，有时候威力甚至可以大到让岩石转化成水晶。$b$b帮贾布尔拿一块那样的水晶回来。

english.title: Mysteries of Nature
english.objectives: Recover a piece of Dragon Glass.
english.description: Jabrul wants to show you his special crystals. Nobody knows what they do. Very mysterious.$b$bIf you want to learn how to make one, Jabrul would be happy to show you.$b$bHigh in the mountains live storm drakes. They blast the cliffs with their lightning breath and sometimes blast so hard, they turn the rock to crystal.$b$bGet a piece of that crystal and bring it back to Jabrul.

text.title: 去往达拉然的爱
text.objectives: 把贾布尔装箱，然后邮寄到卡蒂亚珠宝店。
text.description: 贾布尔想到达拉然去，和那里的大师讨论珠宝设计的事情。$b$b但是贾布尔不知道怎么上去。贾布尔想到一个有趣的主意，可能会有用。$b$b如果你把贾布尔寄到达拉然，那他一定能平安抵达。

english.title: To Dalaran, With Love
english.objectives: Crate up Jabrul and mail him to the Cartier & Co Fine Jewelry shop.
english.description: Jabrul was thinking that he'd like to come up to Dalaran and discuss jewel designs with the masters.$b$bBut Jabrul doesn't know how to get up to it. Jabrul did have an interesting idea that might work.$b$bIf you mailed Jabrul to Dalaran, then surely he'd arrive safe and sound.

text.title: 贾布尔需要你
text.objectives: 在阿苏纳找到贾布尔。
text.description: 你好，$n。$b$b贾布尔需要你的帮助。你可以来阿苏纳找贾布尔吗？$b$b谢谢！$b$b贾布尔

english.title: Jabrul Needs You
english.objectives: Find Jabrul in Azsuna.
english.description: Hello $n,$b$bJabrul needs your help with something. Could you please come to Azsuna and find Jabrul?$b$bThank you,$b$bJabrul

text.title: 镶给我看
text.objectives: 在世界各地获取全部6个零件。翻阅蒂凡妮的笔记本，查看关于每个零件获取地点的提示。
text.description: 你很欣赏柜台上的精巧装置。上面有一个按钮，但是按下去之后没有任何反应。$b$b蒂凡妮告诉你，那是一个旧玩具盒，里面的水晶零件都坏掉了。$b$b如果你能找到新的零件，她就可以修复装置并且教你怎么为自己也制作一个。

english.title: Socket to Me
english.objectives: Obtain all 6 components from around the world. Refer to Tiffany's notebook for reference on where to acquire each piece.
english.description: You admire the contraption sitting on the counter. There's a button on it, but pressing it seems to warrant no response.$b$bTiffany tells you that it's an old toy box, but the crystal components are all broken.$b$bIf you were to find new ones, she could repair it and teach you how to make one for yourself.

text.title: 黑鸦堡垒：渡鸦的秘密
text.objectives: 前往黑鸦堡垒找到一本有关珠宝加工的书，并将其带回达拉然交给提莫斯·琼斯。
text.description: $n，我听这位朋友谈到了许多关于黑鸦堡垒的事情，他提起过一个房间，里面拥有几乎囊括一切的丰富资料。$b$b我敢打赌，那里肯定有我们用得上的珠宝加工方面的书籍。$b$b到那里去带回你能找到的任何东西。等你回来的时候，我会和你分享我新想出来的超棒设计。

english.title: Black Rook Hold: The Raven's Wisdom
english.objectives: Go to Black Rook Hold and locate a book on jewelcrafting and bring it to Timothy Jones in Dalaran.
english.description: $n, I've been hearing a lot of talk about Black Rook Hold from our friend here, about a room which contains volumes of texts on just about every type of craft there is.$b$bI'm willing to bet there's a book in there on jewelcrafting that could come in handy for us.$b$bGo there and bring me back anything you find. I'll share a sweet new design I came up with you when you return.

text.title: 噬魂之喉：灵魂的神隐
text.objectives: 到噬魂之喉找到亡者之戒，然后把它交给达拉然的提莫斯·琼斯。
text.description: 我要交给你任务很不简单，$n。$b$b我需要你经历死亡。但是，你肯定能回来的！$b$b有一艘叫做纳格法尔号的船，它会把灵魂从这个世界送往下一个世界。据说有一件名为亡者之戒的古老宝物就在那艘船里。$b$b你了解我的，$n，没有什么比一枚漂亮的戒指更能引起我的兴趣了。$b$b想办法登上那艘船，为我带回那件古老的宝物。

english.title: Maw of Souls: Spiriting Away
english.objectives: Go to the Maw of Souls and bring back the Ring of the Fallen to Timothy Jones in Dalaran.
english.description: What I'm about to ask you to do is no easy task, $n.$b$bI need you to die. But, you'll be able to come back of course! $b$bThere's a ship, the Naglfar, that ferries souls from this world to the next. It's said that an ancient treasure called the Ring of the Fallen rests in the bowels of that ship.$b$bYou know me, $n, and nothing catches my interest more than a sweet looking ring.$b$bFind a way onto that boat and bring me back that ancient treasure.

text.title: 英灵殿：天堂珠宝
text.objectives: 在英灵殿消灭奥丁，然后把他的戒指交给达拉然的提莫斯·琼斯。
text.description: 国王和王后所佩戴的戒指是最好的！另外，我听说众神之王已经现身了。$b$b英灵殿里的主宰者奥丁拥有任何人都无法比拟的宝藏。如果你碰巧到那里去的话，尽量帮我搞到……比如说，他的一枚戒指。$b$b恐怕他是不会轻易给你的，你或许会遭遇这辈子最艰难的战斗。

english.title: Halls of Valor: Jewel of the Heavens
english.objectives: Kill Odyn in the Halls of Valor and bring back his ring to Timothy Jones in Dalaran.
english.description: Queens and kings wear the best rings! And I've heard that a certain king of gods has made his presence available.$b$bIn the Halls of Valor, the ruler Odyn has treasures unlike anyone in existence. If you happen to go there, try and... obtain, let's say, one of his rings for me.$b$bI doubt he'll just hand it over, so you may have the fight of a lifetime in store.

text.title: 匠心独运
text.objectives: 获得一个夜之子透镜、一份定制珠宝订单，以及$2oa个夜之子珠宝匣。
text.description: $n，很高兴又见面了。我感觉，距离我们上次的见面已经过去太久了。$b$b我们收到了一些消息，据说在苏拉玛那里，有一群夜之子珠宝匠能够制作出梦幻般的项链。我希望见识一下他们所使用的宝石。$b$b还有他们的设计。$b$b以及……他们的透镜。听说这座城市的检查员身上带着这些东西。

english.title: A Personal Touch
english.objectives: Obtain a Nightborne Loupe, a Custom Jewelry Order, and $2oa Nightborne Jewelry Cases.
english.description: $n, great to see you again. It feels like forever since last we spoke.$b$bWe've received some information about a group of jewelcrafting nightborne in Suramar that are doing fantastic things with necklaces. I'd like to take a look at some of their gems.$b$bAnd their designs.$b$bAnd... a new loupe might be nice, too. I hear the city inspectors carry them.

text.title: 黑心林地：进入梦魇
text.objectives: 进入黑心林地地下城，消灭萨维斯之影。
text.description:
虽然我们对伊瑟拉已经无力回天，但我们终究还是成功阻止了她，没让她摧毁神殿。

现在我终于能转头来关心一下我的丈夫了。

我并不知道他正遭受何等的折磨。但我知道，只要我们有一丝救出他的机会，你就应该马上出发。

请追踪萨维斯进入翡翠梦魇，并找到玛法里奥。

求求你，救救我的丈夫吧。

english.title: Darkheart Thicket: Enter the Nightmare
english.objectives: Enter Darkheart Thicket and Slay the Shade of Xavius.
english.description:
We could not save Ysera, but we did prevent her from destroying the temple.

Now I can finally turn my attention to my husband.

I do not know what fate he suffers now. I only know that if we stand any chance of saving him, you must go now.

Follow Xavius into the Nightmare and find Malfurion.

Please, save my husband if you can.

text.title: 风暴之怒
text.objectives: 在托里姆峰消灭10个蔑魔维库人。
text.description:
伤害我孩子的蔑魔者曾经是德克加尔人——那个部落和我们缔结过古老的契约。如今由于神王的影响，他们背弃了自己的誓言，向他们垂涎已久的幼龙的祖先发动了攻击。

他们要为自己的蔑视付出代价。

唤醒你的愤怒吧，$c，和他们战斗到底！
text.completion: The Felskorn have witnessed true strength today. $B$BThey will think twice before raising their blades to you again.

english.title: Fury of the Storm
english.objectives: Kill 10 Felskorn vrykul in Thorim's Peak.
english.description:
The Felskorn who ravage my brood were once Drekirjar - a tribe with whom we shared an ancient pact. Now, under the influence of the God-King, they forsake their oaths and strike at the forebears of their coveted drakes.

They should answer for this slight.

Awaken your fury, $c, and take the battle to them!
english.completion: The Felskorn have witnessed true strength today. $B$BThey will think twice before raising their blades to you again.

text.title: 沙漠传奇
text.objectives: 与丽丽·风暴烈酒谈一谈。
text.description: 什么都没有！我们的资料里几乎没有关于这把武器的任何记载！$b$b我再三查证过，连相关的传说都没有。这只能说明，故事的起源不在潘达利亚。$b$b丽丽·风暴烈酒虽然年轻，但是纵观全岛，她云游四海的经历仅次于你。如果有人可能知道这把武器的事情，那肯定非她莫属。

english.title: The Legend of the Sands
english.objectives: Speak with Li Li Stormstout.
english.description: Nothing! There is next to nothing in our records about this weapon!$b$bI've checked and re-checked, and can find barely a shred of a tale. This can only mean that the story comes from a land outside Pandaria.$b$bLi Li Stormstout is young, but she is the most traveled on the entire isle except for you. If anyone might know of this weapon, it is she.

text.title: 一步登天
text.objectives: 获取诸天之拳。
text.description: 石块充满了元素能量，很可能就是当初对付伊尔马特时所遗留下来的魔法！$b$b如果你到外面去把石块举起来，应该就能释放它的精华，形成一股劲风。只要风力够足，它就可以带着你和你的勇士飞往天空之墙！$b$b如果伊尔马特的武器，诸天之拳，真的拥有古老传说中的巨大威力，那它们一定就在那里。

english.title: Into The Heavens
english.objectives: Obtain the Fists of the Heavens.
english.description: This stone is saturated with elemental power, possibly the remnant of the magic used against Irmaat!$b$bIf you went outside and held the stone aloft, it should unleash the stone's essence as a mighty whirlwind. So potent a windstorm could carry you and your companion all the way to Skywall!$b$bIf the hand blades of Irmaat, the Fists of the Heavens, are as powerful as the old tales say, they would certainly be found there.

text.title: 梦魇之王
text.objectives: 把萨维斯回来的消息告诉绍恩·月爪。
text.description: 你来得非常及时，朋友。$b$b康格拉克斯差点就把我献给他的主人了……那样我就必死无疑。$b$b我非常感激，不过我们还没有脱离危险……萨维斯回来了。$b$b梦魇之王就在瓦尔莎拉，他精心策划了对这片土地的腐化。俘获我的恶魔在拿我献祭之前透露了很多情报。$b$b我们必须尽快找到绍恩·月爪，并把这些事告诉他，以免为时已晚！
text.completion: Thaon Moonclaw was a great druid and a true protector of this land.$b$bHow can we hope to defeat the Nightmare Lord without him fighting beside us?

english.title: The Nightmare Lord
english.objectives: Inform Thaon Moonclaw of the return of Xavius.
english.description: You arrived just in time, friend.$b$bKagraxxis was moments away from sacrificing me to his master... I was certain I would perish.$b$bI am grateful, but we are not out of danger yet... Xavius has returned.$b$bThe Nightmare Lord is here in Val'sharah, personally orchestrating the corruption of this land. My captor revealed as much to me before I was to be sacrificed.$b$bWe must find Thaon Moonclaw and inform him before it is too late!
english.completion: Thaon Moonclaw was a great druid and a true protector of this land.$b$bHow can we hope to defeat the Nightmare Lord without him fighting beside us?

text.title: 表达敬意
text.objectives: 消灭8个被惊扰的幽魂或者被惊扰的鬼魂。
text.description: 我所见的尽是绝望。$b$b看啊，$r。土地被怨灵所占据，埋葬此地的人被什么东西所激怒，他们的灵魂倾巢而出。我可以感受到他们的痛苦。$b$b我会去寻找留存下来的遗物，而且我必须到一处墓地去看看。救赎对于这些不幸的灵魂来说，已经太迟了。请消灭你看到的任何灵魂，让他们享受应得的安息。
text.end: 消灭被惊扰的幽魂或者被惊扰的鬼魂。

english.title: Paying Respects
english.objectives: Slay 8 Disturbed Apparitions or Disturbed Spectres.
english.description: All I see is despair.$b$bLook, $r. The grounds are overwhelmed with these wraiths, spirits of those interred here. Something has made them angry and they are lashing out. I can feel their pain.$b$bI will go look for remaining relics, and there is a tomb I must see. It is too late for these unfortunate souls. Please defeat any you find and return them to the rest they deserve.
english.end: Slay Disturbed Apparitions or Disturbed Spectres.

objectiveDetails.description: 消灭被惊扰的幽魂或鬼魂

text.title: 传说武器
text.objectives: 选择追求哪件神器。
text.description: 作为殿堂里最伟大的战士，你需要一把强大的武器来实现我们的意志。我在艾泽拉斯调查之后，发现了一些配得上你的神器。$b$b现在，你来决定要追求哪一把神器，并用它来对付燃烧军团。至于其他的神器，就以后再考虑了。

english.title: Weapons of Legend
english.objectives: Select an artifact weapon to pursue.
english.description: As the greatest warrior in these halls, you require a great weapon to do both your will and mine. I have looked down on Azeroth and found artifacts worthy of your hands.$b$bI leave it to you to choose which artifact you wish to seek out and wield against the Legion.  We will recover the others in time.

text.title: 开始战斗
text.objectives: 为你的组织选择首个出击目标。
text.description: 燃烧军团以为你已经死了。你的下一次出击必定会让他们措手不及！$b$b我们可以通过这个东西纵览破碎群岛，并派遣战士们执行各种任务。$b$b你看过之后需要决定在哪里进行首次行动。我已经选出了好些绝佳的备选地点！

english.title: Thus Begins the War
english.objectives: Select your order's first assault point.
english.description: The Legion thinks you are dead. It will be quite the surprise when you punish them for that assumption!$b$bThis allows us to see all across the Broken Isles and assign warriors to various tasks.$b$bOnce you've taken a look, you should choose your first area of operation. I've already picked out the best spots!

text.title: 追踪诅咒
text.objectives: 护送瑞维尔·考斯特从暮色森林的密斯特曼托庄园前往逆风小径的埃瑞丁营地。
text.description:
很好。看来我得做一下自我介绍。我叫瑞维尔·考斯特，一名圣光牧师，我在寻找遗失的神器。我以前跟黑暗骑士打过交道，这次回来是为了彻底清理掉他们。

黑暗骑士一向神出鬼没，但是我可能有关于他们行踪的线索。先前交战的时候，我瞥见了他们的过去。圣洁斗篷向我展示了一个场景，让我看到了黑暗骑士以前的身份。

跟我一起到埃瑞丁营地去。我会在路上跟你解释。

english.title: Following the Curse
english.objectives: Escort Revil Kost from Manor Mistmantle in Duskwood to Ariden's Camp in Deadwind Pass.
english.description:
Very well. I suppose an introduction is in order. I am Revil Kost, priest of the Light and a seeker of lost artifacts. I've dealt with the Dark Riders before, and have returned to rid this place of them.

The Riders are elusive, but I may have a clue to their whereabouts. In our previous confrontation, I was able to see a glimpse into their past. Granted blessed vision by the Cloak of Purity, I saw the Dark Riders for who they were before.

Come with me to Ariden's camp. I will explain on the way.

objectiveDetails.description: 跟随瑞维尔前往埃瑞丁营地

text.title: The Second Valarjar
text.objectives: Welcome your new valarjar.
text.description: Whatever your feelings towards him, he is still one of the finests warriors on Azeroth. He has led battles from the front, advised Warchiefs, and mixes excellent martial prowess with tactical calm. You can trust his judgment as well as his axe. Speak with him yourself.

english.title: The Second Valarjar
english.objectives: Welcome your new valarjar.
english.description: Whatever your feelings towards him, he is still one of the finests warriors on Azeroth. He has led battles from the front, advised Warchiefs, and mixes excellent martial prowess with tactical calm. You can trust his judgment as well as his axe. Speak with him yourself.

text.title: Rusty Release DISABLED
text.objectives: Release Dagmyr and 5 Vrykul Prisoners in Azuregale Bay.
text.description: You fight alongside Brandolf, $r?$B$B<Dagmyr looks you over for a moment.>$B$BPerhaps there is more to you than what I see before me.$B$BWould you two get me out of this cage? I cannot slay naga from within these rusted confines.

english.title: Rusty Release DISABLED
english.objectives: Release Dagmyr and 5 Vrykul Prisoners in Azuregale Bay.
english.description: You fight alongside Brandolf, $r?$B$B<Dagmyr looks you over for a moment.>$B$BPerhaps there is more to you than what I see before me.$B$BWould you two get me out of this cage? I cannot slay naga from within these rusted confines.

text.title: 恶魔四伏
text.objectives: 保卫暴风要塞并击退燃烧军团的进攻。
text.description: 国王十分英明，将注意力集中在燃烧军团的威胁上面，$n。即使是在此刻，恶魔也在步步逼近。$b$b伊利达雷会协助联盟对抗燃烧军团。我们认为，恶魔已经将目光投向了艾泽拉斯的各个重要地区。事实上，他们可能已经混入了你们当中！$b$b我能感觉到，他们就在附近……
text.completion: This attack... even the battle on the Broken Shore... it's only the beginning of the Legion's campaign.$b$bIf we don't find a way to stop them, we're going to lose everything my father and the other leaders built.$b$bWe need the strength of the Illidari behind us.

english.title: Demons Among Us
english.objectives: Protect Stormwind Keep from the Legion.
english.description: The king is wise to focus on the Legion's threat, $n. Even now, the demons move against us.$b$bThe Illidari will aid the cause of the Alliance. We believe they have set their sights on key locations around Azeroth. In fact, they could already be in your midst!$b$bI sense they are close...
english.completion: This attack... even the battle on the Broken Shore... it's only the beginning of the Legion's campaign.$b$bIf we don't find a way to stop them, we're going to lose everything my father and the other leaders built.$b$bWe need the strength of the Illidari behind us.

objectiveDetails.description: 摧毁祈愿室的军团传送门
摧毁庭院的军团传送门
向杰斯·织暗了解有关恶魔的情报

text.title: 天降正义
text.objectives: 轰炸顶石隘口的部队。
text.description: 抛开哀痛，战个痛快！$b$b来吧，勇士，搭乘我的战斗雄鹰。利用我们联合部族所赋予你的力量，协助我们从天上消灭这些卓格巴尔。$b$b我们要堵住他们新的巢穴入口。
text.completion: Well done. We will make a Skyhorn out of you yet.

english.title: Justice Rains from Above
english.objectives: Bomb the forces of the Understone Breach
english.description: Kill now, grieve later!$b$bHere, champion, take flight with one of my war eagles. Use the powers bestowed upon you by our united tribes and help us rain destruction down on these drogbar.$b$bLet us clog that new doorway to their lair with the bodies of their own!
english.completion: Well done. We will make a Skyhorn out of you yet.

text.title: 7.0 Highmountain - Vignette - Pinerock Basin - Highmountain Beastmaster See Treasure (JLW)

english.title: 7.0 Highmountain - Vignette - Pinerock Basin - Highmountain Beastmaster See Treasure (JLW)

text.title: 寻找瓦尔基拉
text.objectives: 前往风暴峡湾，在艾尔的宝库那里找到艾希迪尔。
text.description: 我们再也无法承受再一次的失败了；在我们继续工作之前，我们必须防止心脏受到邪能的破坏。$B$B强大的艾希迪尔愿意帮助她所认可的对象，而她的主人能够帮助我们保护这颗心脏。$B$B你可以在风暴峡湾的艾尔的宝库那里找到她。我在那里等你。

english.title: Seeking the Valkyra
english.objectives: Seek out Ashildir at the Vault of Eyir in Stormheim.
english.description: We simply cannot risk another catastrophe like that; we have to protect the Heart against fel energy before we continue our work.$B$BThe mighty Ashildir has proven willing to aid those who she deems worthy, and her master just may be able to help us protect the Heart.$B$BYou should seek her out at the Vault of Eyir in Stormheim. I'll meet you there.

text.title: 调查过去
text.objectives: 搜查埃瑞丁营地，寻找关于黑暗骑士的线索。
text.description:
这里就是商人埃瑞丁所设的营地，当年他在这里向巫师麦迪文供应可疑的商品。这么多年过去了，这里居然没有丝毫变化。所以，我怀疑这可能跟它以前的主人有关系。

帮我搜查这个营地，看看能不能找到有关黑暗骑士的线索。

english.title: Disturbing the Past
english.objectives: Search around Ariden's Camp for clues leading to the Dark Riders.
english.description:
This place is where the merchant, Ariden, set up camp while he was trying to ply his dubious wares to the sorcerer Medivh. It has remained strangely untouched for all this time, which leads me to believe it may still have a connection to its former owner.

Help me search the camp. Let's see if we can find something to lead us to the Dark Riders.

text.title: 亲近你的朋友
text.objectives: 前往奥格瑞玛高地上的伊利达雷营地，与艾尔西·达莱对话。
text.description: 燃烧军团竟敢攻击部落的要塞，胆子真大！你帮助我们进行了防御，但现在我有一项更重要的任务要交给你。$b$b恶魔猎手似乎会在这场战争中发挥关键性的作用……但我依然不信任他们。你将担当我与伊利达雷之间的特使。了解他们所掌握的信息。学习他们的技巧。如果他们背叛我们，我们就用他们自己的知识来对抗他们。$b$b他们的营地位于城中的高地上。去吧。纳萨诺斯和我会收拾掉这里的烂摊子。

english.title: Keep Your Friends Close
english.objectives: Speak to Elthyn Da'rai at the Illidari camp atop the plateau in Orgrimmar.
english.description: The Legion is bold indeed to strike at the Horde's stronghold! You aided our defense, but now I have a more important task for you.$b$bIt seems the demon hunters will play a crucial part in this war... but I still don't trust them. You will be my envoy to the Illidari. Learn what they know. Study their techniques. If they betray us, we'll use their own knowledge against them.$b$bTheir camp lies atop the plateau in the city. Go. Nathanos and I will clean up this mess.

text.title: 指明方向
text.objectives: 在埃瑞丁营地里寻找日记里提到的罗盘。
text.description:
日记的内容逐渐变得阴沉杂乱，字迹也越来越潦草，不过有一段记录特别引人注意：

“乌萨勒斯。这个名字在我的脑海里回荡。我可以听到它的呼唤，但这声音是从何而来？

“幽灵……这片土地与之紧密相连。难怪我们经常在这里迷路。这种力量牵引着罗盘胡乱地指向四面八方……

“如果引力够强，或许可以让罗盘指出正确的方向……”

english.title: To Point the Way
english.objectives: Find the compass mentioned in the journal in Ariden's Camp.
english.description:
Though the journal devolves into dark ramblings written in hurried scribbles, one entry stands out:

"Ulthalesh. The name rings in my head. I can hear it calling, but where?

"The spirits... the very land here is tied to it. It is no wonder we would so often get lost in this place. The forces pull my compass point in every direction...

"Perhaps if it had a stronger pull, the compass could show the way..."

text.title: 恶魔四伏
text.objectives: 了解食魂者阿莱利看到的景象。
text.description: 看看四周。你看到了什么？$B$B<阿莱利凝视着你肩膀上的什么东西。>$B$B燃烧军团已经渗透进了部落……即便此刻，他们也潜藏在你们中间。$B$B我们必须保护你们的酋长。$B$B准备好看清真相的时候，就告诉我。

english.title: Demons Among Us
english.objectives: Learn what Allari the Souleater sees.
english.description: Look around. What do you see?$B$B<Allari glares at something over your shoulder.>$B$BThe Legion has already infiltrated the Horde... even now, they are among you.$B$BWe must protect your Warchief.$B$BWhen you are ready to see what lies beneath the veil, say the word.

objectiveDetails.description: 了解食魂者阿莱利所知的事情

text.title: 印记
text.objectives: 向瓦拉加尔证明自己的价值，然后找艾尔拿取瓦尔基拉的印记。
text.description: 你的武器虽然强大，但是尚未完全发挥潜能。英灵殿的全能之神奥丁可以赋予你超凡的力量。$B$B为了得到这份恩赐，你必须献上合适的贡品。我知道你该去哪里找到这样的礼物，不过在此之前，你必须先得到瓦尔基拉的印记。$B$B勇士，证明你的能力以取得我们的印记，然后就能进入艾尔的宝库，女神会在那里给你指引。

english.title: The Mark
english.objectives: Prove your worth to the Valarjar, then receive the Mark of the Valkyra from Eyir.
english.description: Your blade is powerful, but it has not yet met its full potential. The all-powerful Odyn in the Halls of Valor can bestow upon you his strength.$B$BIn order to seek this blessing, you must bring him a worthy tribute. I know where you may obtain such a gift, but in order to retrieve it you must first receive the mark of the Valkyra.$B$BProve yourself worthy of our mark, champion, then you may enter the Vault of Eyir- the goddess will guide you from there.

objectiveDetails.description: 在瓦拉加尔阵营中达到崇敬声望

text.title: 7.0 Highmountain - Vignette - Windripper Peak - Taurson - Tracking Quest Credit - See Treasure (JLW/RKS)

english.title: 7.0 Highmountain - Vignette - Windripper Peak - Taurson - Tracking Quest Credit - See Treasure (JLW/RKS)

text.title: 7.0 Highmountain - Vignette - Worm Treasure - Tracking Quest Credit - See Treasure (JLW/RKS)

english.title: 7.0 Highmountain - Vignette - Worm Treasure - Tracking Quest Credit - See Treasure (JLW/RKS)

text.title: 逆风的命运
text.objectives: 在逆风小径寻找躁动幽灵出没的地方，在那里调整埃瑞丁的罗盘。
text.description:
日记里提到如果罗盘受到的引力够强……如果这真的和幽灵有关，或许幽灵就是我们所需要的引力。

我在逆风小径发现了几处地方，经常有躁动之魂出没。如果你在幽灵附近调整罗盘，或许就能让它指出正确的方向。

你去找出那些地方，我会继续前往卡拉赞，看看能不能在那里找到跟黑暗骑士有关的线索。

english.title: The Fate of Deadwind
english.objectives: Attune Ariden's Compass at the sites of restless spirits around Deadwind Pass.
english.description:
The journal mentions a "stronger pull" for the compass. If the spirits of this place are indeed tied to it, they may serve as the pull we need.

I've come upon several locations in the pass where restless spirits tend to appear. Perhaps if you show the spirits there the compass, they may be able to help point it in the right direction.

You seek these locations out. I'll continue on to Karazhan and see if I can find anything leading to the Dark Riders.

text.title: 7.0 Highmountain - Vignette - Amateur Hunters - Tracking Quest Credit - See Treasure (JAP)

english.title: 7.0 Highmountain - Vignette - Amateur Hunters - Tracking Quest Credit - See Treasure (JAP)

text.title: 噬魂之喉：取回席瓦娜的庇佑
text.objectives: 在史诗难度的噬魂之喉取得席瓦娜的庇佑，并击败海拉。
text.description: 席瓦娜的庇佑原为奥丁之盾，据说是用来阻隔英灵殿下方的无尽黑暗。$B$B海拉在很久之前被驱逐出了光耀的殿堂，她盗走了这面盾牌，并把它藏在自己的诅咒之船纳格法尔号里。$B$B你必须登上纳格法尔号，打败海拉并取回席瓦娜的庇佑——它是你进献给奥丁的完美礼物。

english.title: Maw of Souls: Retrieving the Svalnguard
english.objectives: Retrieve the Svalnguard and defeat Helya in the Maw of Souls on Mythic difficulty.
english.description: The Svalnguard was once Odyn's shield; it is said that it hid the Halls of Valor from the endless darkness below his realm.$B$BHelya, who was cast from the shining halls long ago, stole the Svalnguard and keeps it on her accursed ship, the Naglfar.$B$BYou must board the Naglfar, defeat Helya, and retrieve the Svalnguard - it will make a worthy tribute for Odyn.

text.title: 奥丁的庆功宴
text.objectives: 从风暴峡湾取回雷蹄腰肉，从至高岭取回断骨者的脊骨，并从阿苏纳取回魔牙猪排。
text.description: 在战斗之后举行宴会是英灵殿的传统。如果你能够用配得上奥丁的王座的猎物举办一场盛大的宴会，你就能向他展示你的决心，并获得他的祝福。$B$B获得风暴峡湾的雷蹄肋排、至高岭的断骨者的脊骨，以及阿苏纳的顶级魔牙猪排。它们将足以让我们举办一场盛大的宴会，并为接下来的大战做好准备。

english.title: A Feast Fit for Odyn
english.objectives: Acquire flank meat from Thunderhoof in Stormheim, Spinesever's spine in Highmountain, and a steak from Leytusk in Azsuna.
english.description: It is customary in the Halls of Valor to feast after battle is finished. Presenting a truly glorious feast to Odyn from beasts worthy of his throne will show him your determination to earn his blessing.$B$BAcquire flank meat from Thunderhoof in Stormheim, Spinesever's spine in Highmountain, and the finest cut of steak from Leytusk in Azsuna. They will make a feast worthy of the great battle to come.

text.title: 英灵殿：奥丁的祝福
text.objectives: 在史诗难度下的英灵殿取得奥丁的祝福。
text.description: 你已经准备好了，$c$B$B前往奥丁的神殿，并在里面的祭坛上献上祭品吧。随后，强大的奥丁将注目于你——你必须在他的注视下，通过瓦拉加尔的古老试炼。$B$B只有那样，你才能获得奥丁的祝福。

english.title: Halls of Valor: Odyn's Blessing
english.objectives: Obtain Odyn's blessing in the Halls of Valor on Mythic difficulty.
english.description: You are ready, $c.$B$BTravel to Odyn's shining halls and offer the feast on the altar just inside. Mighty Odyn will then set his gaze upon you - you must pass the ancient trials of the Valarjar under his watch.$B$BOnly then will you receive Odyn's blessing.

text.title: Tracking Quest - W1 - Saw Leader Die

english.title: Tracking Quest - W1 - Saw Leader Die

text.title: 回来吧，夜眼
text.objectives: 帮助莉莉娅·晨风寻找夜眼。
text.description: 陌生人，你得帮帮我！$b$b夜眼……我的老伙计……他在空中侦察的时候发出了一声警告。我试着去追他，但是一不小心就踩到这个陷阱。$b$b他的位置很近，就在这座山脊的另一边。请你找到他！
text.end: 帮助莉莉娅·晨风寻找夜眼。

english.title: Turn Around, Nighteyes
english.objectives: Help Lilryia Dawnwind find Nighteyes.
english.description: Stranger, you must help me!$b$bNighteyes, my old friend... he was scouting ahead and I heard him cry out a warning. I tried to run after him, but in my carelessness I stepped in this trap.$b$bHe's so close, just on the other side of this ridge. Please find him!

text.title: 传说武器
text.objectives: 选择你首先要追求的神器。
text.description: 三种武器……三条值得尝试的道路。$b$b获取一把这样的神器将是对抗燃烧军团的第一步。武器的力量会随着你的历练而不断进化，所以你必须选择一把武器，并为之付出大量的心血，$n。$b$b等到时机成熟，你才能继续追求其他的武器。你必须决定首先追求哪一把神器。

english.title: Weapons of Legend
english.objectives: Select your first artifact weapon to pursue.
english.description: Three weapons... three worthy paths.$b$bAcquiring one such artifact will be the first step in battling the Legion. The weapon will grow in power as you wield it, so you must choose the one which will be the focus of your efforts, $n.$b$bAfter a time, you will be able to pursue the other weapons. But you must decide which to seek first.

text.title: 黑暗骑士
text.objectives: 在卡拉赞墓穴打败黑暗骑士并取得乌萨勒斯。
text.description:
河流边上有一扇下水道格栅，它可以通向卡拉赞的地下墓穴。我以前从没留意过它，不过那里可能就是幽灵指出来的地方。

想一想，黑暗骑士可能一直都在我们眼皮子底下！走吧，我们去看看里面会有什么。

english.title: The Dark Riders
english.objectives: Defeat the Dark Riders in the Karazhan Catacombs and claim Ulthalesh.
english.description:
There's a sewer grate along the edge of the river leading to catacombs underneath Karazhan. I've never paid it much attention, but it could be where the spirits are directing us.

To think, the Dark Riders may have been under our noses this entire time! Come, let us see where this leads.

objectiveDetails.description: 完成黑暗骑士场景战役

text.title: 新的来源
text.objectives: 帮凯托斯找一个邪能解离器。
text.description: 我要你帮我找些东西。$b$b我想我就快就能在新的魔法源方面取得突破了，但是我需要工具。$b$b我现在进不了自己的工作室，不过我看到下面的小型恶魔正在使用一些工具。给我找个他们的工具回来，我就可以拯救我的人民。
text.end: 帮凯托斯找一个邪能解离器。

english.title: A Different Source
english.objectives: Find a Fel Deconstructor for Kyrtos.
english.description: I need you to fetch me something.$b$bI think I might be on the verge of a breakthrough of a new source of magic, but I require tools. $b$bI can no longer access my workshop, but I have seen the smaller demons below using tools. Bring me one of their tools and I can save our people.
english.end: Find a Fel Deconstructor for Kyrtos.

text.title: 领袖会晤
text.objectives: 到苏拉玛与卡德加见面。
text.description: 我很高兴你能来，$n。$b$b这个……大法师卡德加收到了我的消息，并提议会面。他想尽快在城门口跟我们见面。$b$b你能跟我一起去见他吗？我有种奇怪的预感，那里可能不只他一个人。
text.end: 到苏拉玛与卡德加见面。

english.title: Take Me To Your Leader
english.objectives: Meet with Khadgar in Suramar.
english.description: I am glad you are here, $n.$b$bThis... Khadgar, the archmage who found my message, has called a meeting.$b$bHe wishes to meet us by the entrance to the city as soon as possible.$b$bWill you accompany me? I have the strangest feeling that he will not be alone.

text.title: 出去探险！
text.objectives: 在拉穆卡恒与丽丽碰面。
text.description: 噢，我好想去看看那个故事说的是不是真的！但老爸忙着胡吃海喝，根本不给我机会出去探险。他甚至还说，要是没有守卫跟着，我就不能离开村子！$b$b老爸该不会是认真的吧？我可以保护好自己！$b$b要不这样，你来当我的守卫，可以吗？求你了，只要带我离开这个无聊的地方，你就是我的大英雄！

english.title: Off To Adventure!
english.objectives: Meet with Li Li in Ramkahen.
english.description: Oh I'd love to go see if that story is true! But Pops is too busy stuffing his gut and being a grouch to let me go do any real exploring. He even told me that I can't leave the village unless I have a guardian!$b$bIs Pops for real? I can protect myself just fine!$b$bSay, would you be my guardian? Please, get me away from this boredom and you will totally be my hero!

objectiveDetails.description: 在拉穆卡恒与丽丽碰面
（可选）：搭乘丽丽的风筝前往拉穆卡恒

text.title: 沙地里的雷鸣
text.objectives: 消灭纳德尔并在他的尸体上寻找线索。
text.description: 我很熟悉伊尔马特的故事。据说那座早已被埋葬在沙漠之下的古城阿胡图尔，曾是他的家乡。$b$b最近，废墟上出现了一场奇异的风暴。此外，我听说有个叫做纳德尔的元素在附近地区袭击我的同胞。$b$b这些事情一定有关联。$b$b找到并消灭这个纳德尔。记得搜索他的尸体，寻找能够揭露真相的线索。

english.title: Thunder on the Sands
english.objectives: Defeat Nader and search his body for clues.
english.description: I know the tale of Irmaat well. It is said that his home was the ancient city of Ahmtul, long buried under the desert sands.$b$bRecently a strange storm has appeared over the ruins. What's more, I am told that an elemental called Nader has attacked my people in nearby lands.$b$bThese events must be related.$b$bFind this Nader and put an end to him. Make sure to search his body for clues as to what is behind this.

text.title: Sashj'tar Slayer
text.objectives: Slay 12 Sashj'tar naga in Azuregale Cove.
text.description: I cannot believe that Throndyr is gone.$B$BBy the horns on my head, we shall have revenge for all of the pain that the Sashj'tar have inflicted on us!$B$BPress forward, $n. Kill them! Kill them all!

english.title: Sashj'tar Slayer
english.objectives: Slay 12 Sashj'tar naga in Azuregale Cove.
english.description: I cannot believe that Throndyr is gone.$B$BBy the horns on my head, we shall have revenge for all of the pain that the Sashj'tar have inflicted on us!$B$BPress forward, $n. Kill them! Kill them all!

text.title: 准备出击
text.objectives: 选择追求哪件神器。
text.description: 燃烧军团在晴日峰把我们打了个措手不及，我们决不能再让他们得逞！$B$B虽然我们勤于操练，但是我们需要足够强大的武器来与邪恶势力相抗衡，才有胜利的希望。$b$b卷轴里记载了一些合适的武器，不过我们无法决定要先追求哪一种。$b$b大宗师，这件事就由你定夺。

english.title: Prepare To Strike
english.objectives: Select an artifact weapon to pursue.
english.description: The Burning Legion took us by surprise at the Peak of Serenity. We will not allow them to do so again!$B$BWe have trained hard, but we need weapons capable of destroying this great evil if we are to have any chance of success.$b$bOur scrolls speak of several weapons that should prove suitable, but we are unable to decide which one to pursue first.$b$bThe choice, Grand Master, is yours.

text.title: Proof of Honor
text.objectives: Return to Toryl in Jandvik.
text.description: <Brandolf breathes heavily.>$B$BThis cave will be my final resting place, $n.$B$BFind Toryl. Tell her of what happened here today.$B$BTell all of Jandvik that I died defending our village...

english.title: Proof of Honor
english.objectives: Return to Toryl in Jandvik.
english.description: <Brandolf breathes heavily.>$B$BThis cave will be my final resting place, $n.$B$BFind Toryl. Tell her of what happened here today.$B$BTell all of Jandvik that I died defending our village...

text.title: 能量！我要能量！
text.objectives: 帮凯托斯收集8个邪能精华。
text.description: 我要更多能量。我还要更多！$b$b我能操控能量，这些足够维持我的生命。但只是暂时足够。$b$b我绝不愿和那些弱小生物一样枯萎。$b$b去邪魂堡垒里击杀恶魔。尽快把他们的精华带回来给我！
text.end: 帮凯托斯收集8个邪能精华。

english.title: Power! Get The Power!
english.objectives: Collect 8 Fel Essence for Kyrtos.
english.description: I need more power. I need more!$b$bI can control the energies, and they are enough to sustain me. For now.$b$bI will not end up withered, like those weaklings.$b$bGo out into Felsoul Hold and slay the demons. Bring me their essence and make it quick!

text.title: 月光林地的召唤
text.objectives: 到月光林地去找伊哈缪尔·符文图腾。
text.description: $n，请你立刻前往月光林地。$b$b我们正在准备一个极其重要的仪式，而且我们需要你的帮助。$b$b我会在那里等你，请你尽快启程。

english.title: A Summons From Moonglade
english.objectives: Meet Hamuul Runetotem at the Moonglade.
english.description: $n, Your presence is requested at Moonglade at once.$b$bWe are preparing for a ritual of great importance and will require your assistance.$b$bI will meet you there, so please come with haste.

enders.name: 大德鲁伊哈缪尔·符文图腾

text.title: 梦境之路
text.objectives: 协助进行仪式。
text.description: 准备工作已经完成了。$b$b跟我走，$n，我会带你到进行仪式的地方。

english.title: The Dreamway
english.objectives: Assist with the ritual.
english.description: The preparations for the ritual are now complete.$b$bCome with me, $n, I will guide you to the ceremony.

objectiveDetails.description: 靠近并聆听玛法里奥说话
跟随大德鲁伊符文图腾

text.title: 进入梦境林地
text.objectives: 进入通向梦境林地的传送门。
text.description: 通往梦境之路的传送门已经开启，我们该告别了。月光林地还承受不了燃烧军团的攻击，我必须保护好这里。$b$b前往瓦尔莎拉的任务就交给你了，$n。大德鲁伊巨蹄是那里的德鲁伊领袖。他熟悉古老的传统，能为我们提供宝贵的帮助。$b$b翡翠梦境可能十分危险，所以我会派守护者雷姆洛斯为你带路。到另一边去见他吧。

english.title: To The Dreamgrove
english.objectives: Go through the portal to the Dreamgrove.
english.description: The portal to the Dreamway is open and it is here where our paths must part. The Moonglade remains vulnerable to the attacks of the Burning Legion and I must ensure it is well defended.$b$bI'm entrusting you with the mission to Val'sharah, $n. Archdruid Greathoof is the leader of the druids there. He is wise in the old ways and will provide us invaluable assistance.$b$bThe Dream can be dangerous so I will send Keeper Remulos to guide you. Meet with him upon the other side.

text.title: 传说武器
text.objectives: 选择追求哪件神器。
text.description: 我同意守护者雷姆洛斯的看法。想要打败燃烧军团，就需要具有传说之力的武器。$B$B在我们的历史上，有四把武器举世闻名。$B$B告诉我，你想首先追求哪一把武器？

english.title: Weapons of Legend
english.objectives: Select an artifact weapon to pursue.
english.description: I agree with Keeper Remulos. To confront and defeat the Legion, we will need weapons of legendary power.$B$BAmong the history of our kind, there have been four weapons of renown.$B$BTell me, which weapon would you pursue first?

text.title: 梦魇来袭
text.objectives: 进入翡翠梦境，取得乌索克之爪。
text.description: 有了乌索尔的祝福，我们就能安全穿过魔法结界，抵达利爪所在之处！$b$b现在，我们必须进入梦境。在乌索尔圣坛前躺下，然后喝下你之前准备的月井水，你的灵魂就会进入梦境。我会待在这里守护你的躯体。$b$b多加小心，梦境里面非常危险。

english.title: When Dreams Become Nightmares
english.objectives: Enter the Emerald Dream and obtain the Claws of Ursoc.
english.description: Now that we have Ursol's blessing, we can safely pass the magical wards and reach the claws' resting place!$b$bNow, we must pass into the Dream. Lay down before the Shrine of Ursol and drink of the moonwater you brought earlier and your spirit will drift off into the dream.$b$bBe careful, the Dream can be a dangerous place.

text.title: 与米露恩见面
text.objectives: 找到米露恩。
text.description: $n，今天，你选择追求加尼尔，这是一个明智的决定——树妖米露恩不久前才从一个圣殿来到这里，数个世纪以来，神杖一直保管在那个圣殿。$B$B很少有人知道它在莎拉达希尔根茎内部的秘密隐藏点，不过你已经为自己争取到了这个资格。$B$B你做好出发准备之后就去找米露恩吧，我之前在东边的山上看到过她。

english.title: Meet with Mylune
english.objectives: Find Mylune.
english.description: It would seem we are fortuitous that you seek G'Hanir this day, $n - the dryad Mylune arrived not long ago from the sacred shrine where the staff has been guarded for many centuries.$B$BFew are privy to its hidden location within the roots of Shaladrassil, but you have certainly earned that right.$B$BSpeak to Mylune when you are ready to depart - I saw her last just east of here up the hill.

text.title: 纪元之种
text.objectives: 使用神器能量为你的武器赋予特质。
text.description: 这些武器由古老的魔法所锻造。你这把神器真正的奇妙之处在于它的力量可以不断成长。你使用得越多，它就会变得越强大。$B$B你已经把你的武器与纪元之种调合，你可以用它的魔力为武器赋予更多的特质。$B$B现在，用它为你的武器开启潜能。

english.title: The Seed of Ages
english.objectives: Imbue your weapon with power by assigning an artifact point.
english.description: These weapons were crafted with ancient magic. The true power of your artifact lies in its ability to grow in strength. The more you use it, the stronger it will become.$B$BNow that you have attuned your weapon to the Seed of Ages you can use its magic to unlock additional attributes in your weapon.$B$BUse it now, and unlock your weapon's potential.

text.title: 风中的话语
text.objectives: 与啸天者欧穆隆谈一谈。
text.description: 是时候把我们的注意力转移到破碎群岛的问题上面了。$B$B啸天者欧穆隆收集了岛上的事务情报。如果有适合对燃烧军团发起攻击的机会，他一定会知道的。$b$b去找他看看有什么需要处理的事情。

english.title: Word on the Winds
english.objectives: Speak to Skylord Omnuron.
english.description: It is time that we turn our attention to matters in the Broken Isles.$B$BSkylord Omnuron has gathered information on events from all over the Isles. If we are presented with any opportunity to strike against the Legion he will know of it.$b$bGo and see if he has anything available.

text.title: 你的道路
text.objectives: 为你的组织选择首个行动地点。
text.description: 燃烧军团威胁着艾泽拉斯的生命，但梦魇直接威胁到艾泽拉斯的灵魂。如果要拯救我们的世界，就必须除掉这两个威胁。$b$b这张地图可以让我们追踪破碎群岛全境的事态进展，并在产生威胁时做出回应。我们的部队目前人数有限，所以我们必须集中精力，针对我们擅长处理的问题发挥最大的效力。$b$b等你看过地图以后，就选出我们的首个行动地点。

english.title: Making Trails
english.objectives: Select your order's first operational area.
english.description: The Burning Legion threatens the life of Azeroth, but the nightmare threatens its very soul. We must remove both threats if our world is to survive.$b$bThis map will allow us to track the developments all across the Broken Isles and respond to threats as they arise. Our forces are limited for now, so we should focus our efforts where they will be the most effective.$b$bOnce you've taken a look, you should choose where we shall begin.

text.title: 利爪德鲁伊
text.objectives: 与亚里斯·黑爪对话。
text.description: 一位新盟友加入了我们之中。他叫做亚里斯·黑爪，是一名经验丰富的利爪德鲁伊训练师。$B$B去和他谈谈吧。

english.title: Druids of the Claw
english.objectives: Speak to Yaris Darkclaw.
english.description: A new ally has joined our ranks. His name is Yaris Darkclaw, a skilled trainer among the Druids of the Claw.$B$BGo speak to him now.

text.title: 邪能研究之路
text.objectives: 为凯托斯收集10块灌魔金属板。
text.description: 想要理解魔法的运作方式，首先要对其创造物有所认识并进行研究。这就是我破解术士灵魂水晶的方法。$b$b深渊里的虫语爪牙会把金属板加工成建筑物，用以支撑和维修。这是一个不错的着手点。找些金属板回来，我忠实的助手！

english.title: The Road to Fel
english.objectives: Gather 10 Fel-Infused Plates for Kyrtos.
english.description: An early step to understanding how magic works is to understand and study materials made using that magic. That was how I made my breakthrough on warlock soul crystals, after all. $b$bThe wyrmtongue minions in this pit hammer plates into their structures for support and maintenance. Those will be a good starting point. Fetch me some, my faithful assistant!

text.title: Tracking Quest - W1 - See Demon Attack

english.title: Tracking Quest - W1 - See Demon Attack

text.title: Seeing Stars
text.objectives: Collect 4 Sea Stars from Elder Trenchwalkers in Azuregale Bay.
text.description: You think those naga are good sport, little rabbit?$B$B<Stokalfr chuckles.>$B$BI would savor the chance to do battle with one of those barnacle-crusted behemoths.$B$BIf you want to impress me, bring me the stars from their heads. I might consider you a true $c then.

english.title: Seeing Stars
english.objectives: Collect 4 Sea Stars from Elder Trenchwalkers in Azuregale Bay.
english.description: You think those naga are good sport, little rabbit?$B$B<Stokalfr chuckles.>$B$BI would savor the chance to do battle with one of those barnacle-crusted behemoths.$B$BIf you want to impress me, bring me the stars from their heads. I might consider you a true $c then.

text.title: 保卫家园
text.objectives: 打开地图，在卡利姆多或东部王国找到一个正在进行的军团入侵事件。前往入侵点并阻止恶魔！
text.description: 军团并不是只入侵了这座城市。他们的邪恶力量已经在艾泽拉斯各地蔓延，威胁着我们世界的每一个角落。$b$b无论他们的黑暗触手伸向何方，我们都必须找到并且阻止他们。$b$b我们已经向全世界派出了斥候，侦察军团的活动。只要有入侵发生，我们就会在你的地图上标记发生的地点。$b$b让他们付出代价，$n！
text.completion: You've done it! You've broken an invasion!$b$bIf only that had ended our campaign. But the Legion will never relent until they are destroyed... or have destroyed us.$b$bDon't let up! Fight off more of these wretched invasions, $n. The wyrmtongue we're holding captive here will reward your efforts.

english.title: Protect the Home Front
english.objectives: Open your map to find an active Legion invasion in Kalimdor or Eastern Kingdoms. Go to the invasion site and stop the demons!
english.description: The Legion hasn't just invaded this city. Their evil is spreading across Azeroth, threatening the far corners of our world.$b$bWe must seek them out and stop them, everywhere their darkness touches.$b$bWe've dispatched scouts around the world to watch for Legion activity. As invasions arise, we'll mark the locations on your map.$b$bMake them suffer, $n!
english.completion: You've done it! You've broken an invasion!$b$bIf only that had ended our campaign. But the Legion will never relent until they are destroyed... or have destroyed us.$b$bDon't let up! Fight off more of these wretched invasions, $n. The wyrmtongue we're holding captive here will reward your efforts.

text.title: 艾萨拉之眼：辛艾萨莉之心
text.objectives: 在史诗难度的艾萨拉之眼取得辛艾萨莉之心，并击败艾萨拉之怒。
text.description: 艾萨拉之眼的纳迦召唤出猛烈的风暴，不断破坏阿苏纳的海岸。风暴的威力甚至比他们最厉害的海妖还要强大。$B$B这一定跟辛艾萨莉之心有关。$B$B大分裂以前，被艾萨拉钦选的人就是用这颗心增强他们的力量。据说这是他们控制永恒之井的关键所在。$B$B如果你可以到他们的地盘取得这颗心，$n，我们就可以比那些邪恶的生物更加合理地利用它的力量。

english.title: Eye of Azshara: The Heart of Zin-Azshari
english.objectives: Retrieve the Heart of Zin-Azshari and defeat the Wrath of Azshara in the Eye of Azshara on Mythic difficulty.
english.description: The naga in the Eye of Azshara summon terrible storms that ravage the coastline of Azsuna - storms far beyond the abilities of even their best sirens.$B$BIt can only be the Heart of Zin-Azshari.$B$BPrior to the Sundering, Azshara's chosen used the Heart to greatly magnify their power - it is said to have been key in their dominance of the Well of Eternity.$B$BIf you can journey to their domain and retrieve it, $n, we will put its power to far better use than those foul creatures.

text.title: 奈萨里奥的巢穴：重要演示
text.objectives: 在史诗难度的奈萨里奥的巢穴取得4件合金镀层残片，并击败地底之王达古尔。
text.description: 奥丁对宴会的要求可以比得上你必须完成的那些古老试炼。一场宴会的亮点并不在于堆积成山的强大猎物，而在于它们所使用的盘子。$B$B至高岭的地下是奈萨里奥曾经的巢穴，这头地狱之龙有个更响亮的称号——死亡之翼。在他巢穴的最深处，你可以找到合金镀层的残片，它们原本是用来支撑他的熔火之皮的。$B$B那些东西非常适合作为此次宴会用的盘子。

english.title: Neltharion's Lair: Presentation is Key
english.objectives: Retrieve 4 Adamantium Casing Scraps and defeat Dargrul the Underking in Neltharion's Lair on Mythic difficulty.
english.description: Odyn will demand a feast worthy of the ancient trials you must complete; a feast's merit begins not at the great beasts piled upon it, but at the dish used to serve it.$B$BDeep beneath Highmountain lies the former lair of Neltharion - you may know the infernal drake better as Deathwing. You will find remnants of the adamantium plating used to hold his molten skin together in the deepest recesses of his lair.$B$BThey will form a fine dish for the feast.

text.title: 失落知识
text.objectives: 从首席奥术师塔莉萨处获得艾露迪斯卷轴。
text.description: 我们对夜之子的魔法极为熟悉，但我们被禁止靠近心脏。只有女王的宠臣才拥有这项权利。$B$B不过，我们还是有办法接触到它的一丝魔力。$B$B在数千年之前，一位夜之子学者曾研究过心脏的奥秘，并将他的发现详尽地记述了下来。虽然他随后就被处死，他记录的卷轴也被查禁，但堕夜精灵在逃亡的途中秘密地将卷轴带了出来。$B$B如果你获得了这份卷轴，我们就可以帮你。

english.title: Lost Knowledge
english.objectives: Obtain the Scroll of Elun'dris from First Arcanist Thalyssra.
english.description: We are indeed familiar with the Nightborne's magic, but we were never allowed access to the Heart. It was a right reserved only for the Queen's favored.$B$BHowever, we can still learn how to properly tap its magic.$B$BThousands of years ago, a Nightborne scholar studied the Heart and documented his findings in great detail. He was executed and the scroll of his writings banned, but the Nightfallen secreted it away in their escape.$B$BIf you obtain the scroll, we can help you.

text.title: 贾德维克治疗仪式
text.objectives: 从萨吉塔废墟找回6份愈合之水。
text.description: 上次见面的时候，$r，我被关在牢笼之中。你冒着生命危险拯救了我的族人。你可以再帮我一次吗？$B$B毒蛇的袭击让很多族人都受了伤。我需要愈合之水来举行治疗仪式。$B$B我见过那些毒蛇使用这种水。把你能找到的愈合之水带回来给我。

english.title: Jars for Jandvik
english.objectives: Retrieve 6 Mending Water from the Sashj'tar Ruins.
english.description: Last time we met, $r, I was in a cage. You risked your life once before for my kin. Are you willing to aid me once again?$B$BThe serpents' attack has left many of us wounded. I require mending waters to perform my healing rituals.$B$BI have seen the serpents use this water. Return any that you find to me.

text.title: 魔法回廊：队长的仪式
text.objectives: 在史诗难度的魔法回廊取得顾问凡多斯的永世之阶。
text.description: 只有月之守卫的队长才能获取我们这个组织的力量——我们古老的律法禁止他人插手。$B$B你必须完成队长的仪式。$B$B按照传统，有志于此的人必须不眠不休地巡行于魔法回廊，历时三个星期，而这片广阔的迷宫将考验他们作为月之守卫的能力。我们的律法的精神必须得到尊重，不过你还可以通过别的方式来证明自己。$B$B艾利桑德的顾问凡多斯最近堕入了魔法回廊的深渊。干掉他，然后拿走他的永世之阶。

english.title: The Arcway: Rite of the Captain
english.objectives: Take Advisor Vandros' Eon Winder from The Arcway on Mythic difficulty.
english.description: Only a captain of the Guard may receive the power of our order - our ancient laws forbid otherwise.$B$BYou must complete the rite of the captain.$B$BTraditionally, aspirants patrol the Arcway for three weeks without rest, the vast labyrinth putting their skills as a Guard to the test. Our laws must still be honored, but I believe there another way you may prove yourself.$B$BElisandre's advisor, Vandros, has recently descended into the Arcway's depths. Kill him, and take his Eon Winder.

text.title: 扭曲之力
text.objectives: 在法罗纳尔利用大型传送石召唤来自末世祭坛的扭曲的维祖尔，并获取他的腕轮。
text.description: 是时候了，注入我所知道的最强力量之源——邪恶魔法，以测试我们的作品。$B$B燃烧军团的爪牙偶尔会携带着较大的传送石碎片，用于引领他们的艾瑞达主人。如果你收集的碎片足以凑成一颗完整的传送石，就可以在法罗纳尔的末世祭坛用它召唤艾瑞达领主扭曲的维祖尔。$B$B维祖尔身上用于增强力量的腕轮应当可以将心脏的威力催至极限。

english.title: Twisted Power
english.objectives: Use a Greater Portal Stone to summon Vizuul the Twisted at the Altar of End Times in Faronaar and collect his runebindings.
english.description: It is time we put our work to the test by infusing the most potent source of power I know of - fel magic.$B$BRarely, the Legion's minions will carry fragments of the greater portal stones used to usher in their eredar masters. If you gather enough to form a complete stone, you can use it in Faronaar to call forth the eredar lord Vizuul the Twisted at the Altar of End Times.$B$BThe bindings Vizuul wears to augment his power should push the Heart to its very limit.

text.title: 实验出真知
text.objectives: 从邪火蜥蜴身上收集8个邪火精华。
text.description: 我感觉到你全身上下都是残留的魔法。你肯定会有用处。$b$b我要研究恶魔的躯体如何控制如此大量的邪能。虽然我有许多血肉样本，不过一定还会有某种东西……$b$b从附近的蜥蜴身上取得一些精华，这样我就可以研究其中的魔法残渣。没必要把我俩的手都弄脏，对吧？

english.title: Discovery Requires Experimentation
english.objectives: Collect 8 Felfire Spines from Felfire Basilisks.
english.description: I can sense residues of magic all over you. You will be useful.$b$bI must study how the demon bodies can handle the fel energies in such large quantities. I have plenty of flesh to sample, but there must be something...$b$bGo retrieve some spines from the nearby basilisks so that I may analyze their magical residues. No sense in both of us getting our hands dirty, is there?

text.title: 毁灭利器之书
text.objectives: 和卡里杜斯对话选择你要追求的神器。
text.description:
你携带的那本书是拯救你的朋友，并帮你获取绝对力量的关键！里面记录了许多让燃烧军团不得不提防的危险圣物。

仔细阅读它，朋友。然后选择一件用来打倒贾格诺斯的神器！

english.title: The Tome of Blighted Implements
english.objectives: Speak with Calydus to choose which artifact you will pursue.
english.description:
The book you carry is the key to your friends' salvation, and to your absolute power! It holds within information about many relics too dangerous to the Legion to leave unchecked.

Read, friend. And decide which of these artifacts you will use to strike Jagganoth down!

text.title: 学习魔法的一小步
text.objectives: 与凯托斯谈一谈，然后帮助他执行仪式。
text.description: 迎接未来的时候到了。$b$b我已经掌握了我们已知的所有魔法，而且我将再掌握这一种。$b$b我只要运用奥术魔法的原理，就能轻易控制你给我的材料里所蕴含的原始邪能。接下来，我需要活体实验品。$b$b我们先来进行一场小型的召唤仪式。帮我打败那个生物，然后看看真正的学者是怎么做事的。

english.title: One Small Step for Magic
english.objectives: Speak to Kyrtos and assist him with his ritual.
english.description: It is time to embrace the future.$b$bI have mastered every magic known to our kind. I will master this one.$b$bBy applying the principles of arcane magic it is fairly trivial to control the primitive fel energies within the material you have given me. I need to move to live prey next.$b$bLet us start with a small summoning. Defeat the creature for me and watch how a true scholar works!

text.title: 纯粹之形
text.objectives: 使用啸山熔炉为你的神器灌注新的力量。
text.description: 宗师，我们发现了一种新的技艺，能让拥有强大精力的人在魔法物体内塑造真气。这项技艺可以大幅提升神器的能力。$b$b不过，这需要消耗大量的精力，所以我们现在只能进行一次强化，但是应该足以派上用场了。

english.title: Purity of Form
english.objectives: Use the Forge of the Roaring Mountain to imbue your artifact with a new power.
english.description: Master, we have discovered a new technique that allows one with great focus to shape Chi within magical objects. This technique should allow you to considerably improve the abilities of your new weapon.$b$bThis technique requires a great deal of focus so we are limited to only a single upgrade for now, but that will have to do.

objectiveDetails.description: 使用啸山熔炉为你的神器灌魔

text.title: 牧师的事务
text.objectives: 在提瑞斯法林地的法奥之墓参加秘密会议。
text.description: $n大师，我所代表的人士希望组织一股强大的力量，对抗燃烧军团的威胁。$b$b不知你是否愿意前往提瑞斯法林地，在法奥之墓与他会面。他会保证你的安全，你也将有机会在这场战争中扮演一个至关重要的角色。

english.title: Priestly Matters
english.objectives: Attend the secret meeting at Faol's Rest in Tirisfal Glades.
english.description: $GMaster:Mistress; $n, I come at the behest of one who seeks to organize a stronger resistance to the Legion threat.$b$bIf you would meet him at Faol's Rest in Tirisfal Glades, he will guarantee both your safety and an opportunity to play a pivotal role in the conflict.

objectiveDetails.description: 倾听阿隆索斯·法奥说话
在提瑞斯法林地的法奥之墓与牧师见面
（可选）使用传送门前往达拉然巨坑

text.title: 称手神兵
text.objectives: 选择追求哪件神器。
text.description: 为了迎接今后的挑战，你需要一把能够帮你提升自身能力的武器。我了解到几把合适的，你可以考虑一下。$b$b你必须选择先追求哪一把，我对你的判断有绝对的信心。

english.title: A Legend You Can Hold
english.objectives: Select an artifact weapon to pursue.
english.description: To face the trials ahead, you require a weapon that can enhance your considerable abilities. I have learned of a few possibilities that you might consider.$b$bYou must decide which weapon to pursue first. I have the utmost confidence in your decision.

text.title: 暮光之刃
text.objectives: 阻止仪式并获取萨拉塔斯，黑暗帝国之刃。
text.description: 我一直与茉艾拉·索瑞森合作，试图渗透暮光之锤。我们了解到一件强大的上古之神遗物的事情。那是一把古老的利刃，曾多次为世界带来灾难。$b$b根据茉艾拉的双重间谍汇报，有一个新的首领正在崛起，他企图用这把武器进行邪恶的仪式，以巩固自己的地位。你必须找到他，阻止仪式并取得神器。$b$b事成后，我们在达拉然见面。

english.title: Blade in Twilight
english.objectives: Stop the ritual and acquire Xal'atath, Blade of the Black Empire.
english.description: I have been working with Moira Thaurissan to infiltrate the Twilight's Hammer cult. We've learned of an ancient and powerful Old God relic, a blade used at various points in history to wreak havoc.$b$bMoira's double agent informs us a new leader is rising, and plans to cement his ascension using this weapon in an unholy ritual. You must find him, stop the ritual, and seize the artifact.$b$bWe will meet in Dalaran afterwards.

objectiveDetails.description: 回去找阿隆索斯和茉艾拉
前往提瑞斯法林地里的标记地点

text.title: 获取力量
text.objectives: 回去找达拉然下水道的卡里杜斯。
text.description:
我误会你了，术士。在对抗黑暗骑士的过程中，你向圣光贡献了自己的力量。或许我不该这么武断。

不管怎么说，因为你的帮助我才能完成使命，把神器交到正确的人手里。至于天启，我觉得只有交给你才最为妥当。

希望它能帮你打败燃烧军团，术士。

english.title: The Power Possessed
english.objectives: Return to Calydus in The Underbelly in Dalaran.
english.description:
I was wrong about you, warlock. Your assistance against the Dark Riders has proven a great service to the Light. Perhaps I should not be so quick to judge.

Nevertheless, you have allowed me to fill my purpose in returning these artifacts to their rightful owners. As for Ulthalesh, I can think of no safer place than in your care. 

May it serve you well against the Legion, warlock.

text.title: 黑暗魔典
text.objectives: 取得黑暗魔典。
text.description: 我有一个重大发现，$n。$b$b灵魂引擎那里有一个强大的术士，他拥有一部威力无穷的魔典，里面记载着禁忌法术，可以召唤出最厉害的恶魔。$b$b就连燃烧军团都不敢召唤这些邪能领主，但是我现在比他们要厉害得多。$b$b为我取得魔典，从此以后，我就再也不怕没有法术可学了。

english.title: The Black Tome
english.objectives: Obtain the Black Tome.
english.description: I have made a great discovery, $n.$b$bThere is a powerful warlock in the Soul Engine, in possession of a powerful tome. It contains forbidden secrets to summoning the most powerful of demons.$b$bEven the Legion is afraid to call on these fel lords, but now I possess knowledge beyond theirs.$b$bFetch me the tome and I will never want for magic again.

text.title: 战争的召唤
text.objectives: 到克拉苏斯平台去见兰克拉尔公爵。
text.description: <一股凉意划过脑海。>$b$b听我说，$n。$b$b燃烧军团已经卷土重来。他们企图控制我们，让我们臣服于他们的意愿。真是愚不可及，他们这是自投罗网。$b$b你在达拉然的弟兄们已经开始在克拉苏斯平台聚集。去找兰克拉尔公爵，他会为你解释一切。

english.title: The Call To War
english.objectives: Meet with Duke Lankral at Krasus' Landing.
english.description: <A chilling thought brushes your mind.>$b$bHear me, $n.$b$bThe Legion has returned. They hope to control us, to bend us to their will. Fools - they only walk back within reach of our blades.$b$bYour brethren within Dalaran have begun to gather at Krasus' Landing. Go, meet with Duke Lankral and all will be explained.

text.title: 必要的选择
text.objectives: 选择追求哪件神器。
text.description: 在这场战争中，我们有一个意想不到的盟友，$n。如果要打败燃烧军团，我们必须尽可能取得所有优势。$b$b只要天灾军团不踏出诺森德，黑锋骑士团就会为巫妖王出力。作为回报，我们的盟友会帮我们最有实力的骑士寻找强大的武器——能够让我们彻底解决燃烧军团的神兵利器！$b$b你是我们当中的菁英，$n。我需要你来决定要追求哪件武器。

english.title: A Pact of Necessity
english.objectives: Select an artifact weapon to pursue.
english.description: We have an unexpected ally in this war, $n, and we're going to need every advantage we can get to defeat the Burning Legion.$b$bThe Ebon Blade will serve as the Lich King's arm as long as the Scourge is confined to Northrend. In return for our assistance, our ally has offered to assist in obtaining powerful weapons for the strongest of our knights. Weapons powerful enough to end the Legion once and for all!$b$bYou are one of our best, $n. I want you to decide which weapon you would like to seek out.

text.title: 第六人
text.objectives: 到达拉然下水道的意志竞技场与雷特森·焰怒见面。
text.description: 你好，术士。我代表黑暗收割议会来找你。$b$b燃烧军团已经大举入侵，我们必须变得更加强大才有一线生机。议会计划深入扭曲虚空，以召唤更厉害的恶魔同盟。仪式已经准备就绪，但是我们还缺一个人手。$b$b你应该已经听说了坎雷萨德·埃伯洛克的遭遇。$b$b我们需要你接替他的位置。你接受吗？

english.title: The Sixth
english.objectives: Meet with Ritssyn Flamescowl in the Circle of Wills beneath Dalaran.
english.description: Greetings, warlock. I speak on behalf of the Council of the Black Harvest.$b$bWith the Legion invasion upon us, it is painfully clear that our only hope is to grow stronger. The council plans to tap into the Twisting Nether and call forth more powerful demon allies. The ritual is ready, but we are short one number.$b$bNo doubt you have heard of the fate that befell Kanrethad Ebonlocke.$b$bYou will be his replacement. Do you accept?

text.title: 议会的召唤
text.objectives: 在逆风小径上空的达拉然和卡德加会面。
text.description: <奥术畸体传出了卡德加的声音，开始跟你说话。>$B$B虽然我很不想在你对抗燃烧军团的时候打扰你，但我有一个……外交问题要请你帮忙。我们正在面对一场极其严重的威胁，必须集结全部力量才能渡过难关。$b$b有些人或许不同意这一点。$b$b请到达拉然的紫罗兰城堡外和我会合。我们已经移动了城市的位置来防守东部王国。你可以在逆风小径的上方找到达拉然，就在卡拉赞上空。
text.completion: Jaina's reaction was unfortunate, but not unexpected. She has endured so much...$b$bThough it was Garrosh Hellscream who ordered the obliteration of Theramore, she blames all the Horde for her loss. I hope one day she can overcome that hatred.$b$bEnough ruminating. We must prepare the Kirin Tor for war.

english.title: Calling of the Council
english.objectives: Meet Khadgar in Dalaran at its new location above Deadwind Pass.
english.description: <The arcane anomaly turns to address you, speaking in what is clearly Khadgar's voice.>$B$BThough I am loathe to interrupt your fight against the Legion, I must request your help in a matter of... diplomacy. We face a grave threat, and we must be at our full strength to overcome it.$b$bSome will not agree with this position.$b$bPlease join me outside the Violet Citadel in Dalaran. We have repositioned the city to defend the Eastern Kingdoms. You'll find it over Deadwind Pass, above Karazhan.

english.objectives: Meet Khadgar in Dalaran at its new location above Deadwind Pass.
english.description: <The arcane anomaly addresses you in Khadgar's voice.>$B$BThough I am loathe to interrupt your fight against the Legion, I must request your help in a matter of... diplomacy. We face a grave threat, and we require the full might of Azeroth's people to overcome it.$b$bThe Horde must become part of the Kirin Tor once again. Some will not agree with this position.$b$bPlease join me outside the Violet Citadel in Dalaran. We have repositioned the city to defend the Eastern Kingdoms, above Karazhan.

text.title: Arganax
text.objectives: Find and slay Arganax in Lorlathil.
text.description: A satyr known as Arganax has infiltrated the village of Lorlathil in Val'sharah. I believe that Arganax has disguised himself as one of the local residents.$b$bUse the demon Eye of Azzorok on the villagers in Lorlathil. If there is a demon disguised as a local, the Eye of Azzorok will reveal their true identity.$b$bUncover the demon infiltrator Arganax, and slay him without mercy.

text.title: 水路通行
text.objectives: 杀掉3名暮色卫队晶球法师。
text.description:
我最近留意到一些探究的目光。

虽然我非常乐意继续给凡瑟尔送货，但现在的情况越来越危险了。

在集市巡逻的暮色卫队极为机警。

找到那些晶球法师，杀掉他们，让我可以安全送货。

我会带着货物跟在后面。

english.title: All Along the Waterways
english.objectives: Slay 3 Duskwatch Orbitists.
english.description:
I've noticed some wandering eyes, lately.

I am more than happy to continue delivering the goods to Vanthir, but it is getting increasingly dangerous to do so. 

The Duskwatch that walk the bazaar are by far the most observant.

Find and slay the Orbitists so that I may deliver the goods safely.

I will follow behind with the shipment.

text.title: 新鲜的血液
text.objectives: 在达拉然的意志竞技场与黑暗收割议会一起完成召唤仪式。
text.description: 是时候开始仪式了，术士。要做好充分的准备工作，我们今天举行的召唤仪式比你知道的任何仪式都要难得多。$b$b准备好了吗？

english.title: The New Blood
english.objectives: Complete the summoning ritual with the Council of the Black Harvest in the Circle of Wills in Dalaran.
english.description: It is time to begin the ritual, warlock. Be prepared, for the summoning we perform today will be more challenging than any you have known or seen before.$b$bAre you ready?

text.title: 重新分配
text.objectives: 获取20瓶魔力酒。
text.description:
我猜你可能会以为我这里就会有酒。

<德琳嘻嘻一笑。>

如果事情这么好办，他的人民就不会忍饥挨饿了。

<她的表情严肃起来。>

这些效忠者，就这么称呼吧，喜欢酒池肉林。他们对魔导师的突发奇想唯命是从，所以想要什么就有什么。

魔力酒从来都是不缺的。魔导师会造酒来约束我们。

他们不会在乎少几瓶的。他们的酒多得很。

搜索广场，能带多少就带多少回来。

english.title: Redistribution
english.objectives: Acquire 20 Bottles of Arcwine.
english.description:
I would imagine you thought I would simply have wine to deliver.

<Deline chuckles.>

If it were that easy, his people would not be starving.

<Her expression becomes serious.>

These... loyalists, shall we say, enjoy abundance. They dance to the Magistrix's whims and so they have all that they need.

There is no Arcwine shortage. The Magistrix created one to keep us in line.

They will not miss a few bottles. They have plenty.

Search the square and bring as much as you can carry back.

text.title: 恐痕之心
text.objectives: 消灭贾格诺斯，然后把他的心脏带到恐痕裂隙的大领主之座。
text.description: 朋友拿到神器了！现在贾格诺斯死定了！$b$b快点，你必须回到恐痕裂隙！你或许还有机会从贾格诺斯的复仇中救出你的朋友。$b$b如果你拿到大领主之心，就可以号令他的军队！

english.title: The Heart of the Dreadscar
english.objectives: Defeat Jagganoth and take his heart to the Seat of the Overlord in Dreadscar Rift.
english.description: Friend has the artifact! Now Jagganoth does not stand a chance!$b$bQuickly, you must go back to Dreadscar Rift! You may still be able to save your friends from Jagganoth's vengeance.$b$bIf you take the heart of the overlord, his army will be yours to command!
